open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma expansion_almost_conull {ι : Type*} {F D : ι → ℝ → ℝ}
    {K : ℝ≥0} {e U L : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ j x, HasDerivAt (F j) (D j x) x)
    (hp : ∀ j x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D j x) (hup : ∀ j x, D j x ≤ U)
    (hK : ∀ j, LipschitzWith K (D j)) (hlarge : ∀ x, ∃ j, 1+e ≤ D j x)
    (he : 0 < e) (hKL : (K : ℝ)*L ≤ e) (hU : 0 < U) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hinv : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ F j x ∈ A)
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hpos : volume A ≠ 0) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, L ≤ b-a ∧ volume (Icc a b \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
  let C := Real.exp (4*(K : ℝ)*U*L/e)*U*L
  have hC : 0 < C := mul_pos (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hU) hL
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,hsmall,hdef⟩ := exists_density_interval hA hpos hL (div_pos hε hC)
  obtain ⟨a',b',hl,_,hbound⟩ := expanding_interval_defect hd hp hup hK hlarge he hKL hU.le hinv hab hsmall
  refine ⟨a',b',hl,hbound.trans ?_⟩
  change ENNReal.ofReal (C/(b-a))*volume (Icc a b \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C/(b-a))*(ENNReal.ofReal (ε/C)*ENNReal.ofReal (b-a)) :=
      mul_le_mul_right hdef _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((C/(b-a))*((ε/C)*(b-a))) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (div_pos hε hC).le,← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (div_pos hC (sub_pos.mpr hab)).le]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ε := by congr 1; field_simp [hC.ne', (sub_pos.mpr hab).ne']
lemma expansion_conull_interval {ι : Type*} {F D : ι → ℝ → ℝ}
    {K : ℝ≥0} {e U L P : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ j x, HasDerivAt (F j) (D j x) x)
    (hp : ∀ j x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D j x) (hup : ∀ j x, D j x ≤ U)
    (hK : ∀ j, LipschitzWith K (D j)) (hlarge : ∀ x, ∃ j, 1+e ≤ D j x)
    (he : 0 < e) (hKL : (K : ℝ)*L ≤ e) (hU : 0 < U) (hL : 0 < L) (hP : 0 < P)
    (hinv : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ F j x ∈ A)
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hpos : volume A ≠ 0)
    (hper : ∀ (n : ℤ) x, x+(n : ℝ)*P ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, b-a=L/2 ∧ volume (Icc a b \ A)=0 := by
  have hex : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℝ, a ∈ Icc 0 P ∧ L ≤ b-a ∧
      volume (Icc a b \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1/((n : ℝ)+1)) := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨a,b,hl,hdef⟩ := expansion_almost_conull hd hp hup hK hlarge he hKL hU hL hinv hA hpos
      (by positivity : (0 : ℝ)<1/((n : ℝ)+1))
    obtain ⟨a',b',ha',hlen,hdef'⟩ := periodic_interval_normalize hP hper a b
    exact ⟨a',b',ha',by rwa [hlen],hdef'.trans_le hdef⟩
  choose a b ha hl hdef using hex
  apply compact_almost_conull_interval hL ha hl
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)/((n : ℝ)+1)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds
    (by simpa only [Function.comp_def,ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht)
    (fun _ => zero_le) hdef
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

lemma conull_extend_intervals {ι : Type*} {F : ι → ℝ → ℝ} {U : ℝ≥0}
    {e B a b : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ}
    (hLip : ∀ j, LipschitzWith U (F j)) (hmono : ∀ j, Monotone (F j))
    (hadvance : ∀ x, ∃ j, x+e ≤ F j x) (hdispl : ∀ j x, F j x ≤ x+B)
    (he : 0 < e) (hab : a ≤ b) (hB : B ≤ b-a)
    (hinv : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ F j x ∈ A)
    (hnull : volume (Icc a b \ A)=0) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ b' : ℝ, b+(n : ℝ)*e ≤ b' ∧ volume (Icc a b' \ A)=0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨b,by simp,hnull⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨b',hb',hnull'⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hadvance b'
    have hb : b ≤ b' := le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) he.le)) hb'
    have hfa : F j a ≤ b' := (hdispl j a).trans (by linarith)
    have himage : volume (Icc (F j a) (F j b') \ A)=0 := by
      apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
      exact (interval_defect_image_bound (hab.trans hb) (hLip j).continuous.continuousOn
        ((hmono j).monotoneOn _) (hLip j).lipschitzOnWith (hinv j)).trans (by simp [hnull'])
    refine ⟨F j b',?_,?_⟩
    · push_cast
      nlinarith
    · apply measure_mono_null (t := (Icc a b' \ A) ∪ (Icc (F j a) (F j b') \ A))
      · intro x hx
        by_cases hxb : x ≤ b'
        · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hx.1.1,hxb⟩,hx.2⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨le_trans hfa (le_of_not_ge hxb),hx.1.2⟩,hx.2⟩
      · exact le_antisymm ((measure_union_le _ _).trans (by rw [hnull',himage,add_zero])) bot_le
lemma conull_interval_alternation_false {A : Set ℝ} {a b κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hab : κ < b-a) (hnull : volume (Icc a b \ A)=0)
    (halt : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x+κ ∈ A ↔ x ∉ A) : False := by
  have hmem : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ Icc a b → x ∈ A := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    exact measure_mono_null (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Classical.not_imp] at hx
      exact hx) hnull
  have hmem' := (measurePreserving_add_right volume κ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hmem
  have hbad : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∉ Icc a (b-κ) := by
    filter_upwards [hmem,hmem',halt] with x hx hx' ha hxin
    have hxa : x ∈ A := hx ⟨hxin.1,by linarith [hxin.2]⟩
    have hxka : x+κ ∈ A := hx' ⟨by linarith [hxin.1],by linarith [hxin.2]⟩
    exact (ha.mp hxka) hxa
  have hz : volume (Icc a (b-κ))=0 := by
    have hh := ae_iff.mp hbad
    convert hh using 2
    ext x
    simp only [mem_Icc,mem_ofPred_eq,not_not]
  rw [Real.volume_Icc,ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero] at hz
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Expansion

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def binaryQ (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := 1-2*d*Real.cos t+d^2
def binaryR (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := 2*Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)*Real.sqrt (1-binaryQ d t/4)
def binaryB (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := (Real.cos t-d)/binaryQ d t+Real.sin t/binaryR d t
def binaryM (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.sin t/binaryQ d t+(d-Real.cos t)/binaryR d t
def binaryCircleMap (d t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  t+Real.pi/3+Real.arctan (d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))-Real.arccos (Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2)
lemma binaryQ_range {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    0 < binaryQ d t ∧ binaryQ d t < 4 ∧ 0 < 1-d*Real.cos t := by
  have hdc : |d*Real.cos t| ≤ |d| := by
    simpa only [abs_mul,mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one t) (abs_nonneg d)
  have hdc' := abs_le.mp hdc
  have hd' := abs_lt.mp hd
  dsimp [binaryQ]
  constructor
  · nlinarith [sq_nonneg d]
  constructor
  · nlinarith [sq_abs d,abs_nonneg d]
  · linarith
lemma binaryR_pos {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) : 0 < binaryR d t := by
  have h := binaryQ_range hd t
  unfold binaryR
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h.1)) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [h.2.1]))
lemma binary_arctan_identity (d t : ℝ) :
    (1-d*Real.cos t)^2+(d*Real.sin t)^2=binaryQ d t := by
  have h := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t
  dsimp [binaryQ]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg d]
lemma binary_arctan_recip {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2=1/binaryQ d t := by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hi := binary_arctan_identity d t
  field_simp [hq.1.ne',hq.2.2.ne']
  simp only [mul_pow] at hi
  rw [hi,div_self hq.1.ne']
lemma binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_t {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (binaryCircleMap d) (1+d*binaryB d t) t := by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hq.1.le
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq.1
  have hc : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ -1 := by linarith
  have hc' : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ 1 := by intro h; nlinarith [hq.2.1]
  have hqd : HasDerivAt (binaryQ d) (2*d*Real.sin t) t := by
    convert (((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).const_mul (2*d)).const_sub 1).add_const (d^2) using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | ring
  have hat := (((Real.hasDerivAt_sin t).const_mul d).div
    (((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).const_mul d).const_sub 1) hq.2.2.ne').arctan
  have hac := (Real.hasDerivAt_arccos hc hc').comp t ((hqd.sqrt hq.1.ne').div_const 2)
  have hh := (((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const (Real.pi/3)).add hat).sub hac
  change HasDerivAt (binaryCircleMap d) _ t at hh
  convert hh using 1
  dsimp [binaryB,binaryR]
  have hss : 1-(Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2)^2=1-binaryQ d t/4 := by nlinarith [hsq]
  rw [hss]
  have hrec := binary_arctan_recip hd t
  have hnum : d*Real.cos t*(1-d*Real.cos t)-d*Real.sin t*-(d*-Real.sin t)=
      d*(Real.cos t-d) := by linear_combination -d^2*(Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t)
  rw [hnum]
  have hrearr : 1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)*
      (d*(Real.cos t-d)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2) = d*(Real.cos t-d)/binaryQ d t := by
    calc
      _ = (1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2)*(d*(Real.cos t-d)) := by ring
      _ = d*(Real.cos t-d)/binaryQ d t := by rw [hrec]; ring
  rw [hrearr]
  ring
lemma binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_d {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => binaryCircleMap s t) (binaryM d t) d := by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hq.1.le
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq.1
  have hc : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ -1 := by linarith
  have hc' : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≠ 1 := by intro h; nlinarith [hq.2.1]
  have hqd : HasDerivAt (fun s => binaryQ s t) (2*(d-Real.cos t)) d := by
    convert (((hasDerivAt_id d).mul_const (2*Real.cos t)).const_sub 1).add ((hasDerivAt_id d).pow 2) using 1 <;>
      first | rfl | (funext s; dsimp only [binaryQ,Pi.add_apply,Pi.pow_apply,id_eq]; ring) |
        (try dsimp only [id_eq]; ring)
  have hat := (((hasDerivAt_id d).mul_const (Real.sin t)).div
    (((hasDerivAt_id d).mul_const (Real.cos t)).const_sub 1) hq.2.2.ne').arctan
  have hac := (Real.hasDerivAt_arccos hc hc').comp d ((hqd.sqrt hq.1.ne').div_const 2)
  have hh := (hat.const_add (t+Real.pi/3)).sub hac
  change HasDerivAt (fun s => binaryCircleMap s t) _ d at hh
  convert hh using 1
  dsimp [binaryM,binaryR]
  have hss : 1-(Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2)^2=1-binaryQ d t/4 := by nlinarith [hsq]
  rw [hss]
  have hrec := binary_arctan_recip hd t
  simp only [one_mul]
  have hnum : Real.sin t*(1-d*Real.cos t)-d*Real.sin t*-(Real.cos t)=Real.sin t := by ring
  rw [hnum]
  have hrearr : 1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)*
      (Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2) = Real.sin t/binaryQ d t := by
    calc
      _ = (1/(1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2)*Real.sin t := by ring
      _ = Real.sin t/binaryQ d t := by rw [hrec]; ring
  rw [hrearr]
  ring
end EuclideanFiveColor

open Set Filter Topology

lemma periodic_reduce_to_period {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 < P) (t : ℝ) :
    ∃ u ∈ Icc 0 P, ∃ n : ℤ, t=u+(n : ℝ)*P := by
  refine ⟨Int.fract (t/P)*P,?_,⌊t/P⌋,?_⟩
  · exact ⟨(Int.fract_div_mul_self_mem_Ico P t hP).1,(Int.fract_div_mul_self_mem_Ico P t hP).2.le⟩
  · simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using (Int.fract_div_mul_self_add_zsmul_eq P t hP.ne').symm
lemma compact_periodic_uniform {g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {a P : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hP : 0 < P)
    (hg : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => g p.1 p.2) (Icc (-a) a ×ˢ Icc 0 P))
    (hper : ∀ d, Function.Periodic (g d) P) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, δ ≤ a ∧ ∀ d, |d| < δ → ∀ t, |g d t-g 0 t| < ε := by
  have hu := (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hg
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδg⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp hu ε hε
  refine ⟨min a δ,lt_min ha hδ,min_le_left _ _,?_⟩
  intro d hd t
  obtain ⟨u,hu,n,rfl⟩ := periodic_reduce_to_period hP t
  have hper' : ∀ d, g d (u+(n : ℝ)*P)=g d u := fun d => by
    simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using (hper d).int_mul n u
  rw [hper' d,hper' 0]
  have hda := abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_left _ _))
  have hh := hδg (d,u) ⟨⟨hda.1.le,hda.2.le⟩,hu⟩ (0,u) ⟨⟨by linarith,ha.le⟩,hu⟩
  rw [Prod.dist_eq,dist_self,dist_zero_right,max_eq_left (norm_nonneg d)] at hh
  exact hh (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_right _ _))
lemma compact_periodic_bounded {g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ} {a P : ℝ} (_ha : 0 ≤ a) (hP : 0 < P)
    (hg : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => g p.1 p.2) (Icc (-a) a ×ˢ Icc 0 P))
    (hper : ∀ d, |d| ≤ a → Function.Periodic (g d) P) :
    ∃ C > 0, ∀ d, |d| ≤ a → ∀ t, |g d t| ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := ((isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).image_of_continuousOn hg).isBounded |>.exists_pos_norm_le
  refine ⟨C,hC.1,?_⟩
  intro d hd t
  obtain ⟨u,hu,n,rfl⟩ := periodic_reduce_to_period hP t
  have he : g d (u+(n : ℝ)*P)=g d u := by
    simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul] using (hper d hd).int_mul n u
  rw [he]
  exact hC.2 _ ⟨(d,u),⟨abs_le.mp hd,hu⟩,rfl⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor

open Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma binaryQ_contDiff : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => binaryQ p.1 p.2) := by
  unfold binaryQ
  fun_prop
lemma binaryB_contDiffAt {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 1/2) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => binaryB q.1 q.2) p := by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hp p.2
  have hr := binaryR_pos hp p.2
  have hs := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq.1
  have hs' : 0 < 1-binaryQ p.1 p.2/4 := by linarith [hq.2.1]
  have hQ := binaryQ_contDiff.contDiffAt (x := p)
  have hR : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => binaryR q.1 q.2) p := by
    unfold binaryR
    fun_prop (disch := first | exact hq.1.ne' | exact hs'.ne')
  unfold binaryB
  exact ((contDiffAt_snd.cos.sub contDiffAt_fst).div hQ hq.1.ne').add
    (contDiffAt_snd.sin.div hR hr.ne')
lemma binaryM_contDiffAt {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 1/2) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => binaryM q.1 q.2) p := by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hp p.2
  have hr := binaryR_pos hp p.2
  have hs := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq.1
  have hs' : 0 < 1-binaryQ p.1 p.2/4 := by linarith [hq.2.1]
  have hQ := binaryQ_contDiff.contDiffAt (x := p)
  have hR : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => binaryR q.1 q.2) p := by
    unfold binaryR
    fun_prop (disch := first | exact hq.1.ne' | exact hs'.ne')
  unfold binaryM
  exact (contDiffAt_snd.sin.div hQ hq.1.ne').add
    ((contDiffAt_fst.sub contDiffAt_snd.cos).div hR hr.ne')
lemma binaryB_periodic (d : ℝ) : Function.Periodic (binaryB d) (2*Real.pi) := by
  intro t
  simp only [binaryB,binaryQ,binaryR,Real.cos_add_two_pi,Real.sin_add_two_pi]
lemma binaryM_periodic (d : ℝ) : Function.Periodic (binaryM d) (2*Real.pi) := by
  intro t
  simp only [binaryM,binaryQ,binaryR,Real.cos_add_two_pi,Real.sin_add_two_pi]
def binaryE (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => binaryB q.1 q.2) (d,t) (0,1)
lemma binaryE_continuousAt {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : |p.1| < 1/2) :
    ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => binaryE q.1 q.2) p := by
  exact ((binaryB_contDiffAt hp).continuousAt_fderiv (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuousAt_const
lemma binaryB_hasDeriv_t {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| < 1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (binaryB d) (binaryE d t) t := by
  have h := (binaryB_contDiffAt (p := (d,t)) hd).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  convert h.hasFDerivAt.comp t ((hasFDerivAt_const d t).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id t)) |>.hasDerivAt using 1 <;> rfl
lemma binaryE_periodic (d : ℝ) (hd : |d| < 1/2) : Function.Periodic (binaryE d) (2*Real.pi) := by
  intro t
  have h := (binaryB_hasDeriv_t hd (t+2*Real.pi)).comp t ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const (2*Real.pi))
  simp only [mul_one] at h
  have he : (fun s => binaryB d (s+2*Real.pi))=binaryB d := funext (binaryB_periodic d)
  change HasDerivAt (fun s => binaryB d (s+2*Real.pi)) _ t at h
  rw [he] at h
  exact h.unique (binaryB_hasDeriv_t hd t)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

lemma binary_uniform_controls {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ 1/4 ∧ 0 < C ∧
    (∀ d, |d| < δ → ∀ t, |binaryB d t-binaryB 0 t| < ε ∧

    (∀ d, |d| ≤ δ → ∀ t, |binaryB d t| ≤ C ∧ |binaryM d t| ≤ C ∧ |binaryE d t| ≤ C) := by
  have hB : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => binaryB p.1 p.2)
      (Icc (-(1/4)) (1/4) ×ˢ Icc 0 (2*Real.pi)) := by
    intro p hp
    exact (binaryB_contDiffAt (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hp.1.1,hp.1.2])).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hM : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => binaryM p.1 p.2)
      (Icc (-(1/4)) (1/4) ×ˢ Icc 0 (2*Real.pi)) := by
    intro p hp
    exact (binaryM_contDiffAt (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hp.1.1,hp.1.2])).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hE : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => binaryE p.1 p.2)
      (Icc (-(1/4)) (1/4) ×ˢ Icc 0 (2*Real.pi)) := by
    intro p hp
    exact (binaryE_continuousAt (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith [hp.1.1,hp.1.2])).continuousWithinAt
  have hP : 0 < 2*Real.pi := by positivity
  obtain ⟨δB,hδB,hδBa,hδBg⟩ := compact_periodic_uniform (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/4) hP hB binaryB_periodic hε
  obtain ⟨δM,hδM,hδMa,hδMg⟩ := compact_periodic_uniform (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/4) hP hM binaryM_periodic hε
  obtain ⟨CB,hCB,hCBg⟩ := compact_periodic_bounded (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/4) hP hB (fun d _ => binaryB_periodic d)
  obtain ⟨CM,hCM,hCMg⟩ := compact_periodic_bounded (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/4) hP hM (fun d _ => binaryM_periodic d)
  obtain ⟨CE,hCE,hCEg⟩ := compact_periodic_bounded (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1/4) hP hE
    (fun d hd => binaryE_periodic d (by linarith))
  refine ⟨min δB δM,CB+CM+CE,lt_min hδB hδM,(min_le_left _ _).trans hδBa,by positivity,?_,?_⟩
  · intro d hd t
    exact ⟨hδBg d (hd.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)) t,hδMg d (hd.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)) t⟩
  · intro d hd t
    have hda := hd.trans ((min_le_left δB δM).trans hδBa)
    exact ⟨(hCBg d hda t).trans (by linarith),(hCMg d hda t).trans (by linarith),(hCEg d hda t).trans (by linarith)⟩

  have h : Real.arccos (1/2) = Real.pi/3 := by
    rw [← Real.cos_pi_div_three,Real.arccos_cos (by positivity) (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])]
  simp only [binaryCircleMap,binaryQ,mul_zero,zero_mul,sub_zero,zero_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0),add_zero,Real.sqrt_one,one_div,zero_div,Real.arctan_zero]
  rw [← one_div,h]

lemma binaryCircleMap_displacement {d δ C : ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) (hδ : δ < 1/2) (hdδ : d ≤ δ)

    intro s hs
    exact (binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_d (lt_of_le_of_lt (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; exact hs.2.trans hdδ) hδ) t).hasDerivWithinAt

  simpa only [binaryCircleMap_zero,Real.norm_eq_abs,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg hd] using h
end EuclideanFiveColor

lemma binaryR_zero (t : ℝ) : binaryR 0 t=Real.sqrt 3 := by
  simp only [binaryR,binaryQ,mul_zero,zero_mul,sub_zero,zero_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0),add_zero,Real.sqrt_one,mul_one]
  have h : (1:ℝ)-1/4=3/(2^2) := by norm_num

lemma binaryB_zero (t : ℝ) : binaryB 0 t=Real.cos t+Real.sin t/Real.sqrt 3 := by
  simp [binaryB,binaryQ,binaryR_zero]
lemma binaryM_zero (t : ℝ) : binaryM 0 t=Real.sin t-Real.cos t/Real.sqrt 3 := by

lemma binaryB_zero_shift (t : ℝ) : binaryB 0 (t+Real.pi/3)=Real.cos t-Real.sin t/Real.sqrt 3 := by
  rw [binaryB_zero,Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,Real.cos_pi_div_three,Real.sin_pi_div_three]
  have hr : Real.sqrt 3 ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤3)
  field_simp
  linear_combination -Real.sin t*hs
lemma binaryM_zero_shift (t : ℝ) : binaryM 0 (t+Real.pi/3)=Real.sin t+Real.cos t/Real.sqrt 3 := by
  rw [binaryM_zero,Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,Real.cos_pi_div_three,Real.sin_pi_div_three]
  have hr : Real.sqrt 3 ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤3)
  field_simp
  linear_combination Real.cos t*hs
lemma trig_two_large {c s : ℝ} (hcs : c^2+s^2=1) :
    1/4 ≤ |c+s/Real.sqrt 3| ∨ 1/4 ≤ |c-s/Real.sqrt 3| := by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have h1 := abs_lt.mp h.1
  have h2 := abs_lt.mp h.2
  have hc : |c| < 1/4 := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hq : |s/Real.sqrt 3| < 1/4 := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt 3 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hr2 : Real.sqrt 3 < 2 := by nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤3)]
  rw [abs_div,abs_of_pos hr,div_lt_iff₀ hr] at hq
  have hs : |s| < 1/2 := by linarith
  have hc2 : c^2 < (1/4 : ℝ)^2 := by nlinarith [sq_abs c,abs_nonneg c]
  have hs2 : s^2 < (1/2 : ℝ)^2 := by nlinarith [sq_abs s,abs_nonneg s]
  nlinarith
lemma sign_shift_large {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hg : ∀ t, g (t+Real.pi) = -g t)
    {t r : ℝ} (hr : r ≤ |g t|) : r ≤ g t ∨ r ≤ g (t+Real.pi) := by
  rw [hg]
  rcases le_total 0 (g t) with h|h
  · exact Or.inl (by simpa only [abs_of_nonneg h] using hr)
  · exact Or.inr (by simpa only [abs_of_nonpos h] using hr)
lemma binaryB_zero_large (t : ℝ) : ∃ n : ℕ, 1/4 ≤ binaryB 0 (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) := by
  have hg : ∀ u, binaryB 0 (u+Real.pi) = -binaryB 0 u := by
    intro u
    simp only [binaryB_zero,Real.cos_add_pi,Real.sin_add_pi]
    ring
  have hh := trig_two_large (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq t)
  rw [← binaryB_zero,← binaryB_zero_shift] at hh
  rcases hh with h|h
  · rcases sign_shift_large hg h with h|h
    · exact ⟨0,by simpa using h⟩
    · refine ⟨3,?_⟩
      convert h using 2; norm_num; ring
  · rcases sign_shift_large hg h with h|h
    · exact ⟨1,by simpa using h⟩
    · refine ⟨4,?_⟩
      convert h using 2; norm_num; ring
lemma binaryM_zero_large (t : ℝ) : ∃ n : ℕ, 1/4 ≤ binaryM 0 (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) := by
  have hg : ∀ u, binaryM 0 (u+Real.pi) = -binaryM 0 u := by
    intro u
    simp only [binaryM_zero,Real.cos_add_pi,Real.sin_add_pi]
    ring
  have hh := trig_two_large (Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t)
  rw [← binaryM_zero_shift,← binaryM_zero] at hh
  rcases hh with h|h
  · rcases sign_shift_large hg h with h|h
    · exact ⟨1,by simpa using h⟩
    · refine ⟨4,?_⟩
      convert h using 2; norm_num; ring
  · rcases sign_shift_large hg h with h|h
    · exact ⟨0,by simpa using h⟩
    · refine ⟨3,?_⟩
      convert h using 2; norm_num; ring
end EuclideanFiveColor

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set

namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma expansion_alternation_false {ι : Type*} {F D : ι → ℝ → ℝ}
    {K : ℝ≥0} {e U L P B κ : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ j x, HasDerivAt (F j) (D j x) x)
    (hp : ∀ j x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D j x) (hup : ∀ j x, D j x ≤ U)
    (hK : ∀ j, LipschitzWith K (D j)) (hlarge : ∀ x, ∃ j, 1+e ≤ D j x)
    (hadvance : ∀ x, ∃ j, x+e ≤ F j x) (hdispl : ∀ j x, F j x ≤ x+B)
    (he : 0 < e) (hKL : (K : ℝ)*L ≤ e) (hU : 0 < U) (hL : 0 < L) (hP : 0 < P)
    (hB : B ≤ L/2) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (hinv : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ F j x ∈ A)
    (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    (hper : ∀ (n : ℤ) x, x+(n : ℝ)*P ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A)
    (halt : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x+κ ∈ A ↔ x ∉ A) : False := by
  have hpos : volume A ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have ha : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∉ A := by
      rw [ae_iff]
      convert hz using 2
      ext x
      simp only [mem_ofPred_eq,not_not]
    have hf : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, False := by
      filter_upwards [ha,(measurePreserving_add_right volume κ).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae ha,halt] with x hx hx' hh
      exact hx' (hh.mpr hx)
    exact hf.exists.choose_spec
  obtain ⟨a,b,hlen,hnull⟩ := expansion_conull_interval hd hp hup hK hlarge he hKL hU hL hP hinv hA hpos hper
  have hLip : ∀ j, LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal U) (F j) := by
    intro j
    apply lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_deriv_le (fun x => (hd j x).differentiableAt)
    intro x
    rw [(hd j x).deriv]
    apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
    rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hU.le,coe_nnnorm,Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (le_trans (by norm_num) (hp j x))]
    exact hup j x
  have hmono : ∀ j, Monotone (F j) := by
    intro j
    apply StrictMono.monotone
    apply strictMono_of_deriv_pos
    intro x
    rw [(hd j x).deriv]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hp j x)
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((κ-(b-a))/e)
  have hnn : κ < b+(n : ℝ)*e-a := by
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ he).mp hn
    linarith
  obtain ⟨b',hb',hnull'⟩ := conull_extend_intervals hLip hmono hadvance hdispl he
    (by linarith) (hB.trans_eq hlen.symm) hinv hnull n
  exact conull_interval_alternation_false hκ (by linarith) hnull' halt
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

def binaryConjugate (d : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=

lemma binaryConjugate_hasDeriv {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (binaryConjugate d n) (1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))) t := by
  convert ((binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_t hd (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).comp t
    ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const ((n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))).sub_const ((n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) using 1 <;> first | rfl | simp

    (hM : ∀ s, |s| < δ → ∀ t, |binaryM s t-binaryM 0 t| < 1/8)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 1/4 ≤ binaryM 0 t) : t+d/8 ≤ binaryCircleMap d t := by

    intro s hs
    exact binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_d (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; linarith [hs.2]) t
  obtain ⟨s,hs,he⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun s => binaryCircleMap s t) (fun s => binaryM s t) hd
    (fun s hs => (hh s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (fun s hs => hh s ⟨hs.1.le,hs.2.le⟩)
  have hms := (abs_lt.mp (hM s (by rw [abs_of_pos hs.1]; exact hs.2.trans hdδ) t)).1
  rw [binaryCircleMap_zero,sub_zero] at he
  have hl : 1/8 ≤ (binaryCircleMap d t-t)/d := by rw [← he]; linarith
  have := (le_div_iff₀ hd).mp hl
  linarith
lemma binary_dynamics_controls : ∃ δ > 0, ∀ d, 0 < d → d < δ →
    ∃ C L : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < L ∧ C*d ≤ L/2 ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) t, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ 1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) t, 1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)) ≤ 2) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal (d*C)) (fun t => 1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))) ∧
    (∀ t, ∃ n : ℕ, 1+d/8 ≤ 1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))) ∧
    (∀ t, ∃ n : ℕ, t+d/8 ≤ binaryConjugate d n t) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) t, binaryConjugate d n t ≤ t+C*d) ∧ d*C*L ≤ d/8 ∧ d < 1/2 := by
  obtain ⟨δ,C,hδ,hδa,hC,hclose,hbound⟩ := binary_uniform_controls (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/8)
  let L := 1/(8*C)
  have hL : 0 < L := by dsimp [L]; positivity
  refine ⟨min δ (min (1/(2*C)) (L/(2*C))),lt_min hδ (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)),?_⟩
  intro d hd hds

  have hda : d < 1/2 := by linarith
  have hdC : d*C < 1/2 := by

  have hdL : C*d ≤ L/2 := by

    nlinarith
  have hbd := hbound d (by rw [abs_of_pos hd]; exact hdδ.le)
  have hdd : |d|<1/2 := by rwa [abs_of_pos hd]
  refine ⟨C,L,hC,hL,hdL,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,hda⟩
  · intro n t
    have h := (abs_le.mp (hbd (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).1).1
    nlinarith
  · intro n t
    have h := (abs_le.mp (hbd (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).1).2
    nlinarith
  · intro n
    have hder : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun t => 1+d*binaryB d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))
        (d*binaryE d (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))) t := by
      intro t
      convert (((binaryB_hasDeriv_t hdd (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).comp t
        ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const ((n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)))).const_mul d).const_add 1 using 1 <;> first | rfl | simp
    apply lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_deriv_le (fun t => (hder t).differentiableAt)
    intro t
    rw [(hder t).deriv]
    apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
    rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by positivity),coe_nnnorm,norm_mul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hd,Real.norm_eq_abs]

    refine ⟨n,?_⟩
    have hh := (abs_lt.mp (hclose d (by rwa [abs_of_pos hd]) (t+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3))).1).1
    nlinarith
  · intro t
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := binaryM_zero_large t

    have hh := binaryCircleMap_advance hd hδa hdδ (fun s hs u => (hclose s hs u).2) hn

    have hh := binaryCircleMap_displacement hd.le (lt_of_le_of_lt hδa (by norm_num)) hdδ.le

    dsimp only [binaryConjugate]
    linarith [(abs_le.mp hh).2]
  · dsimp [L]
    field_simp
    norm_num
end EuclideanFiveColor

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma binaryConjugate_step (d : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    binaryConjugate d n (x+Real.pi/3)=binaryConjugate d (n+1) x+Real.pi/3 := by
  unfold binaryConjugate
  push_cast
  have h : x+Real.pi/3+(n : ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)=x+((n : ℝ)+1)*(Real.pi/3) := by ring
  rw [h]
  ring
lemma binary_conjugates_invariant {d : ℝ} {A : Set ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (binaryConjugate d n) volume volume)
    (hF : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ binaryCircleMap d x ∈ A)
    (halt : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x+Real.pi/3 ∈ A ↔ x ∉ A) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ binaryConjugate d n x ∈ A := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa only [binaryConjugate,Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul,add_zero,sub_zero] using hF
  | succ n ih =>
    have hshift := (measurePreserving_add_right volume (Real.pi/3)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae ih
    filter_upwards [hshift,halt,(hq (n+1)).ae halt] with x hx ha hb
    rw [binaryConjugate_step] at hx
    exact not_iff_not.mp (ha.symm.trans (hx.trans hb))
lemma binary_alternating_invariant_false : ∃ δ > 0, ∀ d, 0 < d → d < δ →
    ∀ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A →
    (∀ (n : ℤ) x, x+(n : ℝ)*(2*Real.pi) ∈ A ↔ x ∈ A) →
    (∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x+Real.pi/3 ∈ A ↔ x ∉ A) →
    (∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x ∈ A ↔ binaryCircleMap d x ∈ A) → False := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hctrl⟩ := binary_dynamics_controls
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,?_⟩
  intro d hd hdδ A hA hper halt hF
  obtain ⟨C,L,hC,hL,hB,hlo,hhi,hLip,hlarge,hadvance,hdispl,hKL,hda⟩ := hctrl d hd hdδ
  have hdd : |d|<1/2 := by rwa [abs_of_pos hd]
  have hder := fun n t => binaryConjugate_hasDeriv hdd n t
  have hinv := binary_conjugates_invariant (fun n => deriv_lower_qmp (hder n) (hlo n)) hF halt
  exact expansion_alternation_false hder hlo hhi hLip hlarge hadvance hdispl (by positivity)
    (by simpa only [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (mul_pos hd hC).le] using hKL) (by norm_num) hL
    (by positivity : 0<2*Real.pi) hB (by positivity : 0<Real.pi/3) hinv hA hper halt
end EuclideanFiveColor

import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Coloring

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
abbrev RealPlane := ℝ × ℝ
def circleSum (r : ℝ) (p : RealPlane) : RealPlane :=
  (r*Real.cos p.1+Real.cos p.2,r*Real.sin p.1+Real.sin p.2)
def circleSumDeriv (r : ℝ) (p : RealPlane) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane :=
  (r • ((-Real.sin p.1) • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) +
    (-Real.sin p.2) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).prod
  (r • (Real.cos p.1 • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) +
    Real.cos p.2 • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ)
lemma circleSum_strict (r : ℝ) (p : RealPlane) : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum r) (circleSumDeriv r p) p := by
  have hc1 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_cos p.1).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hc2 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_cos p.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hs1 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_sin p.1).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hs2 := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_sin p.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt p
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
  exact ((hc1.const_smul r).add hc2).prodMk ((hs1.const_smul r).add hs2)
lemma circleSum_continuous (r : ℝ) : Continuous (circleSum r) :=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun p => (circleSum_strict r p).continuousAt
lemma circleSumDeriv_injective {r : ℝ} {p : RealPlane} (h : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (circleSumDeriv r p) := by
  apply (circleSumDeriv r p).toLinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
  intro q hq
  have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst hq
  have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd hq
  change r * (-Real.sin p.1 * q.1) + -Real.sin p.2 * q.2 = 0 at h1
  change r * (Real.cos p.1 * q.1) + Real.cos p.2 * q.2 = 0 at h2
  have ha : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1)*q.1=0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination Real.cos p.2*h1+Real.sin p.2*h2
  have hb : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1)*q.2=0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination -(r*Real.cos p.1)*h1-(r*Real.sin p.1)*h2
  exact Prod.ext ((mul_eq_zero.mp ha).resolve_left h) ((mul_eq_zero.mp hb).resolve_left h)
def circleSumDerivEquiv {r : ℝ} {p : RealPlane} (h : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0) :
    RealPlane ≃L[ℝ] RealPlane :=
  ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective (circleSumDeriv r p)
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (circleSumDeriv_injective h))
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr ((LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank rfl).mp
      (circleSumDeriv_injective h)))
lemma circleSum_local_antilipschitz {r : ℝ} {p : RealPlane} (h : r*Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ s : Set RealPlane, IsOpen s ∧ p ∈ s ∧ ∃ K : ℝ≥0, AntilipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict (circleSum r)) := by
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv h
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum r) (L : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane) p := circleSum_strict r p
  obtain ⟨s,hp,hs,ha⟩ := hd.approximates_deriv_on_open_nhds
  refine ⟨s,hs,hp,_,ha.antilipschitz ?_⟩
  right
  have hpos := L.subsingleton_or_nnnorm_symm_pos.resolve_left (not_subsingleton RealPlane)
  exact half_lt_self (inv_pos.mpr hpos)
lemma realDirection_lipschitz : LipschitzWith 1 (fun t : ℝ => (Real.cos t,Real.sin t)) := by
  simpa using Real.lipschitzWith_cos.prodMk Real.lipschitzWith_sin
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0)
def circleInverseHomeo : OpenPartialHomeomorph RealPlane RealPlane :=
  (show HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
    (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
    (t,u) from circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)).toOpenPartialHomeomorph (circleSum 1)
def circleInverse : RealPlane → RealPlane := by
  classical
  exact (circleInverseHomeo h).target.piecewise (circleInverseHomeo h).symm (fun _ => 0)
lemma circleInverse_measurable : Measurable (circleInverse h) := by
  classical
  exact (circleInverseHomeo h).continuousOn_invFun.measurable_piecewise continuous_const.continuousOn
    (circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.measurableSet
lemma circleInverse_eq {q : RealPlane} (hq : q ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target) :
    circleInverse h q=(circleInverseHomeo h).symm q := by simp [circleInverse,hq]
lemma circleInverse_at : circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (t,u))=(t,u) := by
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
      (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (t,u) := circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)
  rw [circleInverse_eq h hd.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target]
  exact hd.localInverse_apply_image
lemma circleInverse_continuousAt {q : RealPlane} (hq : q ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target) :
    ContinuousAt (circleInverse h) q := by
  apply ((circleInverseHomeo h).continuousAt_symm hq).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [(circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds hq] with y hy
  exact circleInverse_eq h hy
lemma circleInverse_strict : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleInverse h)
    ((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (circleSum 1 (t,u)) := by
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
      (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (t,u) := circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)
  apply hd.to_localInverse.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [(circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds hd.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target] with q hq
  exact (circleInverse_eq h hq).symm
lemma circleInverse_right {q : RealPlane} (hq : q ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target) :
    circleSum 1 (circleInverse h q)=q := by
  rw [circleInverse_eq h hq]
  exact (circleInverseHomeo h).right_inv hq
lemma circleInverse_regular :
    ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (circleSum 1 (t,u)), Real.sin ((circleInverse h q).2-(circleInverse h q).1) ≠ 0 := by
  have hc := (Real.continuous_sin.continuousAt.comp
    ((circleInverse_strict h).continuousAt.snd.sub (circleInverse_strict h).continuousAt.fst))
  have hh : Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (t,u))).2-(circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (t,u))).1) ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [circleInverse_at h]
  exact hc.eventually_ne hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
omit [CompleteSpace E] in
lemma triangular_injective (L : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hc : L (0,1) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ).prod L) := by
  intro a b hab
  change (a.1,L a)=(b.1,L b) at hab
  have hab₁ := congrArg (fun q : E × ℝ => q.1) hab
  have hab₂ := congrArg (fun q : E × ℝ => q.2) hab
  dsimp only at hab₁ hab₂
  have he : a-b=(0,a.2-b.2) := Prod.ext (by simp [hab₁]) rfl
  have hz : L (0,a.2-b.2)=0 := by rw [← he,map_sub,hab₂,sub_self]
  have hm : L (0,a.2-b.2)=(a.2-b.2)*L (0,1) := by
    have h : (0,a.2-b.2)=(a.2-b.2) • ((0,1) : E × ℝ) := by ext <;> simp
    rw [h,map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hm] at hz
  exact Prod.ext hab₁ (sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right hc))
omit [CompleteSpace E] in
lemma triangular_surjective (L : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hc : L (0,1) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ).prod L) := by
  intro b
  refine ⟨(b.1,(b.2-L (b.1,0))/L (0,1)),Prod.ext rfl ?_⟩
  change L (b.1,(b.2-L (b.1,0))/L (0,1))=b.2
  have h (r : ℝ) : L (b.1,r)=L (b.1,0)+r*L (0,1) := by
    have he : (b.1,r)=(b.1,0)+r • ((0,1) : E × ℝ) := by ext <;> simp
    rw [he,map_add,map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [h,div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc]
  ring
/-- Joint strict differentiability and a nonzero fiber derivative give one inverse
Lipschitz bound simultaneously for every nearby parameter. -/
lemma strict_fiber_uniform_antilipschitz {S : E × ℝ → ℝ} {L : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    {p : E} {t : ℝ} (hS : HasStrictFDerivAt S L (p,t)) (hc : L (0,1) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P : Set E, ∃ I : Set ℝ, IsOpen P ∧ p ∈ P ∧ IsOpen I ∧ t ∈ I ∧
      ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ q ∈ P, AntilipschitzWith K (I.domRestrict (fun u => S (q,u))) := by
  let T := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E ℝ).prod L
  let H : E × ℝ → E × ℝ := fun q => (q.1,S q)
  let Q : (E × ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] (E × ℝ) := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective T
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (triangular_injective L hc))
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (triangular_surjective L hc))
  have hd : HasStrictFDerivAt H (Q : E × ℝ →L[ℝ] E × ℝ) (p,t) :=
    hasStrictFDerivAt_fst.prodMk hS
  obtain ⟨V,hpt,hVo,hA⟩ := hd.approximates_deriv_on_open_nhds
  have hK := hA.antilipschitz (Or.inr (half_lt_self (inv_pos.mpr
    (Q.subsingleton_or_nnnorm_symm_pos.resolve_left (not_subsingleton (E × ℝ))))))
  obtain ⟨P,hP,I,hI,hsub⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp (hVo.mem_nhds hpt)
  obtain ⟨P',hP'P,hP'o,hp⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hP
  obtain ⟨I',hI'I,hI'o,ht⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hI
  refine ⟨P',I',hP'o,hp,hI'o,ht,(‖(Q.symm : (E × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E × ℝ))‖₊⁻¹ - ‖(Q.symm : (E × ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E × ℝ))‖₊⁻¹ / 2)⁻¹,?_⟩
  intro q hq
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro a b
  have ha : (q,a.1) ∈ V := hsub ⟨hP'P hq,hI'I a.2⟩
  have hb : (q,b.1) ∈ V := hsub ⟨hP'P hq,hI'I b.2⟩
  have h := hK.le_mul_dist ⟨(q,a.1),ha⟩ ⟨(q,b.1),hb⟩
  simpa only [Subtype.dist_eq,domRestrict,H,Prod.dist_eq,dist_self,max_eq_right (dist_nonneg)] using h
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Filter Topology Set MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
abbrev CircleParameter := RealPlane × ℝ
abbrev CircleJet := CircleParameter × ℝ
def jetCenter : CircleJet →L[ℝ] RealPlane :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ RealPlane ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ CircleParameter ℝ)
def jetRadius : CircleJet →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ RealPlane ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ CircleParameter ℝ)
def jetAngle : CircleJet →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ CircleParameter ℝ
def circleTarget (q : CircleJet) : RealPlane := q.1.1+q.1.2 • (Real.cos q.2,Real.sin q.2)
def circleTargetDeriv (q : CircleJet) : CircleJet →L[ℝ] RealPlane :=
  jetCenter + (q.1.2 • (((-Real.sin q.2) • jetAngle).prod (Real.cos q.2 • jetAngle)) +
    jetRadius.smulRight (Real.cos q.2,Real.sin q.2))
lemma circleTarget_strict (q : CircleJet) : HasStrictFDerivAt circleTarget (circleTargetDeriv q) q := by
  have hc := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_cos q.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt q jetAngle.hasStrictFDerivAt
  have hs := (Real.hasStrictDerivAt_sin q.2).comp_hasStrictFDerivAt q jetAngle.hasStrictFDerivAt
  exact jetCenter.hasStrictFDerivAt.add (jetRadius.hasStrictFDerivAt.smul (hc.prodMk hs))
lemma circleTarget_continuous : Continuous circleTarget :=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun q => (circleTarget_strict q).continuousAt
variable {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0)
def circleEndpoint (q : CircleJet) : ℝ := (circleInverse h (circleTarget q)).1
def circleEndpointDeriv (q : CircleJet) : CircleJet →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).comp
    (((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane).comp
      (circleTargetDeriv q))
lemma circleEndpoint_measurable : Measurable (circleEndpoint h) :=
  measurable_fst.comp ((circleInverse_measurable h).comp circleTarget_continuous.measurable)
lemma circleEndpoint_strict {q : CircleJet} (he : circleTarget q=circleSum 1 (t,u)) :
    HasStrictFDerivAt (circleEndpoint h) (circleEndpointDeriv h q) q := by
  have hi := circleInverse_strict h
  rw [← he] at hi
  exact hasStrictFDerivAt_fst.comp q (hi.comp q (circleTarget_strict q))
lemma inverse_tangent_first_ne {a : ℝ} (ha : Real.sin (a-u) ≠ 0) :
    ((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm
      (-Real.sin a,Real.cos a)).1 ≠ 0 := by
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)
  let q := L.symm (-Real.sin a,Real.cos a)
  intro hq
  have he : circleSumDeriv 1 (t,u) q=(-Real.sin a,Real.cos a) := L.apply_symm_apply _
  have h₁ := congrArg Prod.fst he
  have h₂ := congrArg Prod.snd he
  change q.1=0 at hq
  change 1*(-Real.sin t*q.1) + -Real.sin u*q.2 = -Real.sin a at h₁
  change 1*(Real.cos t*q.1) + Real.cos u*q.2 = Real.cos a at h₂
  simp only [hq,mul_zero,zero_add] at h₁ h₂
  apply ha
  rw [Real.sin_sub]
  linear_combination (Real.cos u)*h₁+(Real.sin u)*h₂
lemma circleEndpoint_fiber_ne {q : CircleJet} (hr : q.1.2=1) (ha : Real.sin (q.2-u) ≠ 0) :
    circleEndpointDeriv h q (0,1) ≠ 0 := by
  have he : circleTargetDeriv q (0,1)=(-Real.sin q.2,Real.cos q.2) := by
    simp [circleTargetDeriv,jetCenter,jetRadius,jetAngle,hr]
  change (((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm
    (circleTargetDeriv q (0,1))).1) ≠ 0
  rw [he]
  exact inverse_tangent_first_ne h ha
lemma circleEndpoint_uniform {p : CircleParameter} {a : ℝ}
    (he : circleTarget (p,a)=circleSum 1 (t,u)) (hr : p.2=1) (ha : Real.sin (a-u) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P : Set CircleParameter, ∃ I : Set ℝ, IsOpen P ∧ p ∈ P ∧ IsOpen I ∧ a ∈ I ∧
      ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ q ∈ P, AntilipschitzWith K (I.domRestrict (fun v => circleEndpoint h (q,v))) :=
  strict_fiber_uniform_antilipschitz (circleEndpoint_strict h he) (circleEndpoint_fiber_ne h hr ha)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Filter Topology Set MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0)
lemma circleEndpoint_good_neighborhood {p : CircleParameter} {a : ℝ}
    (he : circleTarget (p,a)=circleSum 1 (t,u)) (hr : p.2=1) (ha : Real.sin (a-u) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P : Set CircleParameter, ∃ I : Set ℝ, IsOpen P ∧ p ∈ P ∧ IsOpen I ∧ a ∈ I ∧
      I ⊆ Ioc (a-Real.pi) (a-Real.pi+2*Real.pi) ∧
      ∃ K : ℝ≥0, (∀ q ∈ P, AntilipschitzWith K (I.domRestrict (fun v => circleEndpoint h (q,v)))) ∧
        ∀ q ∈ P, ∀ v ∈ I,
          circleTarget (q,v) ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target ∧
          Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleTarget (q,v))).2-(circleInverse h (circleTarget (q,v))).1) ≠ 0 ∧
          circleEndpoint h (q,v) ∈ Metric.closedBall t 1 := by
  obtain ⟨P₀,I₀,hP₀,hp₀,hI₀,ha₀,K,hK⟩ := circleEndpoint_uniform h he hr ha
  have hc : ContinuousAt circleTarget (p,a) := circleTarget_continuous.continuousAt
  have hi := (circleEndpoint_strict h he).continuousAt
  have hs : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (p,a), circleEndpoint h w ∈ Metric.ball t 1 := by
    have hb : Metric.ball t 1 ∈ 𝓝 (circleEndpoint h (p,a)) := by
      have ht : circleEndpoint h (p,a)=t := by simp [circleEndpoint,he,circleInverse_at]
      rw [ht]
      exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num)
    exact hi hb
  have ht : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (p,a), circleTarget w ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target := by
    apply hc
    rw [he]
    exact (circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds
      ((show HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
        (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (t,u)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
        (t,u) from circleSum_strict 1 (t,u)).image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target)
  have hn : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (p,a), Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleTarget w)).2-(circleInverse h (circleTarget w)).1) ≠ 0 := by
    exact hc.eventually (by simpa only [he] using circleInverse_regular h)
  obtain ⟨P₁,hP₁,I₁,hI₁,hsub⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp (ht.and (hn.and hs))
  obtain ⟨P₂,hP₂,hP₂o,hp₂⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hP₁
  obtain ⟨I₂,hI₂,hI₂o,ha₂⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hI₁
  let P := P₀ ∩ P₂
  let I := I₀ ∩ I₂ ∩ Ioo (a-Real.pi) (a+Real.pi)
  refine ⟨P,I,hP₀.inter hP₂o,⟨hp₀,hp₂⟩,(hI₀.inter hI₂o).inter isOpen_Ioo,
    ⟨⟨ha₀,ha₂⟩,by constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩,?_,K,?_,?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    exact ⟨hv.2.1,by linarith [hv.2.2]⟩
  · intro q hq
    apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
    intro v w
    exact (hK q hq.1).le_mul_dist ⟨v.1,v.2.1.1⟩ ⟨w.1,w.2.1.1⟩
  · intro q hq v hv
    have hh := hsub (show (q,v) ∈ P₁ ×ˢ I₁ from ⟨hP₂ hq.2,hI₂ hv.1.2⟩)
    exact ⟨hh.1,hh.2.1,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hh.2.2⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def angleChart (p : RealPlane) : Angles × Angles := ((p.1 : Angles),(p.2 : Angles))
def angleChartMeasure : Measure RealPlane :=
  volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2*Real.pi) ×ˢ Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2*Real.pi))
lemma angleChartMeas_le : angleChartMeasure ≤ volume := Measure.restrict_le_self
instance : IsFiniteMeasure angleChartMeasure := by
  change IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict _)
  apply isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr
  apply ne_of_lt
  apply (measure_mono (Set.prod_mono Ioc_subset_Icc_self Ioc_subset_Icc_self)).trans_lt
  exact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc).measure_lt_top
lemma angleChart_preserving : MeasurePreserving angleChart angleChartMeasure
    ((volume : Measure Angles).prod volume) := by
  have h := (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) 0).prod
    (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) 0)
  convert h using 1
  · rfl
  · simp only [angleChartMeasure,zero_add,Measure.prod_restrict,← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
lemma angleChart_measure : (angleChartMeasure.map angleChart) =
    (ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi))^2 • angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure := by
  rw [angleChart_preserving.map_eq,AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle,
    Measure.prod_smul_left,Measure.prod_smul_right,smul_smul,pow_two]
  rfl
lemma integral_angular_eq_chart {f : Angles × Angles → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫ p, f p ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure) =
      ((2*Real.pi)^2)⁻¹ * ∫ q, f (angleChart q) ∂angleChartMeasure := by
  have h := integral_map (μ := angleChartMeasure) angleChart_preserving.measurable.aemeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [angleChart_measure,integral_smul_measure,ENNReal.toReal_pow,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*Real.pi),smul_eq_mul] at h
  rw [← h]
  field_simp
lemma direction_realPlane (t : ℝ) : Complex.equivRealProdCLM (direction (t : Angles)) =
    (Real.cos t,Real.sin t) := by
  rw [direction_real,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I]
  ext <;> simp [Complex.cos_ofReal_re,Complex.sin_ofReal_re]
lemma circleSum_chart (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (q : RealPlane) :
    Complex.equivRealProdCLM (x+(r : ℂ)*direction (angleChart q).1+direction (angleChart q).2) =
      Complex.equivRealProdCLM x+circleSum r q := by
  change Complex.equivRealProdCLM (x+(r : ℂ)*direction (q.1 : Angles)+direction (q.2 : Angles)) = _
  rw [map_add,map_add]
  have h : (r : ℂ)*direction (q.1 : Angles) = r • direction (q.1 : Angles) := by simp
  rw [h,map_smul,direction_realPlane,direction_realPlane]
  ext <;> simp [circleSum,add_assoc]
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma volume_preimage_bound {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} {s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} {K : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : AntilipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict F)) (A : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    volume (F ⁻¹' A ∩ s) ≤ (K : ENNReal)^2 * volume A := by
  have he : Subtype.val '' ((s.domRestrict F) ⁻¹' A) = F ⁻¹' A ∩ s := by
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩; exact ⟨hq,q.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨hp,hs⟩; exact ⟨⟨p,hs⟩,hp,rfl⟩
  have hi := (isometry_subtype_coe : Isometry (Subtype.val : s → ℝ × ℝ)).hausdorffMeasure_image
    (Or.inl (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤2)) ((s.domRestrict F) ⁻¹' A)
  have ha := hF.hausdorffMeasure_preimage_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)≤2) A
  rw [he,hausdorffMeasure_prod_real] at hi
  rw [← hi,hausdorffMeasure_prod_real,ENNReal.rpow_two] at ha
  exact ha
lemma map_restrict_volume_le {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ} (hm : Measurable F)
    {s B : Set (ℝ × ℝ)} (_hB : MeasurableSet B) {K : ℝ≥0}
    (hF : AntilipschitzWith K (s.domRestrict F)) (himage : MapsTo F s B) :
    (volume.restrict s).map F ≤ ((K^2 : ℝ≥0) : ENNReal) • volume.restrict B := by
  apply Measure.le_iff.mpr
  intro A hA
  rw [Measure.map_apply hm hA,Measure.restrict_apply (hm hA),Measure.smul_apply,
    Measure.restrict_apply hA,smul_eq_mul,ENNReal.coe_pow]
  have he : F ⁻¹' A ∩ s = F ⁻¹' (A ∩ B) ∩ s := by
    ext x
    exact ⟨fun hx => ⟨⟨hx.1,himage hx.2⟩,hx.2⟩,fun hx => ⟨hx.1.1,hx.2⟩⟩
  rw [he]
  exact volume_preimage_bound hF (A ∩ B)
lemma antilipschitz_small_perturbation {E X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [PseudoMetricSpace X] {F G : X → E} {K L : ℝ≥0} (hf : AntilipschitzWith K F)
    (hg : LipschitzWith L G) {a : ℝ} (ha : (K : ℝ)*‖a‖*(L : ℝ) ≤ 1/2) :
    AntilipschitzWith (2*K) (fun x => F x+a • G x) := by
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro x y
  have h1 := hf.le_mul_dist x y
  have h2 := hg.dist_le_mul x y
  have h3 : dist (F x) (F y) ≤ dist (F x+a • G x) (F y+a • G y) + ‖a‖*dist (G x) (G y) := by
    simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right,dist_smul₀] using
      dist_sub_sub_le (F x+a • G x) (a • G x) (F y+a • G y) (a • G y)
  have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (norm_nonneg a)
  have h5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h3.trans (add_le_add_right h4 _)) K.2
  have h6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha (dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y))
  simp only [NNReal.coe_mul,NNReal.coe_ofNat]
  nlinarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma realDirection_norm_le (t : ℝ) : ‖(Real.cos t,Real.sin t)‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
  rw [Prod.norm_def,max_le_iff]
  exact ⟨by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_cos_le_one t,
    by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using Real.abs_sin_le_one t⟩
lemma circleSum_decompose (r : ℝ) (q : RealPlane) :
    circleSum r q = r • (Real.cos q.1,Real.sin q.1) + (Real.cos q.2,Real.sin q.2) := rfl
lemma circleSum_norm_le (r : ℝ) (q : RealPlane) : ‖circleSum r q‖ ≤ |r|+1 := by
  rw [circleSum_decompose]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖r • (Real.cos q.1,Real.sin q.1)‖+‖(Real.cos q.2,Real.sin q.2)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ |r| * 1+1 := by rw [norm_smul]; exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (realDirection_norm_le _) (norm_nonneg r)) (realDirection_norm_le _)
    _ = _ := by ring
lemma circleSum_perturb_identity (r : ℝ) (q : RealPlane) :
    circleSum r q = circleSum 1 q + (r-1) • (Real.cos q.1,Real.sin q.1) := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change r*Real.cos q.1+Real.cos q.2 = 1*Real.cos q.1+Real.cos q.2+(r-1)*Real.cos q.1
    ring
  · change r*Real.sin q.1+Real.sin q.2 = 1*Real.sin q.1+Real.sin q.2+(r-1)*Real.sin q.1
    ring
lemma circleSum_parameter_tendsto {r : ℕ → ℝ} (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (q : RealPlane) :
    Tendsto (fun n => circleSum (r n) q) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 q)) := by
  exact (hr.mul_const (Real.cos q.1) |>.add_const (Real.cos q.2)).prodMk_nhds
    (hr.mul_const (Real.sin q.1) |>.add_const (Real.sin q.2))
lemma circleSum_eventual_image {r : ℕ → ℝ} {y : ℕ → RealPlane} {x : RealPlane}
    (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (hy : Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x)) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ q, y n+circleSum (r n) q ∈ Metric.closedBall x 4 := by
  filter_upwards [hr.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (1 : ℝ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1)),
    hy.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1))] with n hn hyn
  intro q
  have hh := circleSum_norm_le (r n) q
  have hb : |r n| ≤ 2 := by
    have ht := norm_le_norm_sub_add (r n) (1 : ℝ)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,Real.norm_eq_abs,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_one] at ht
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hn
    linarith
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
  calc
    _ ≤ dist (y n+circleSum (r n) q) (y n)+dist (y n) x := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ = ‖circleSum (r n) q‖+dist (y n) x := by rw [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_left]
    _ ≤ 4 := by linarith
lemma circleSum_limit_image (x q : RealPlane) : x+circleSum 1 q ∈ Metric.closedBall x 4 := by
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hh := circleSum_norm_le 1 q
  norm_num at hh
  linarith
lemma circleSum_eventual_antilipschitz {V : Set RealPlane} {K : ℝ≥0}
    (hK : AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict (circleSum 1)))
    {r : ℕ → ℝ} (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (y : ℕ → RealPlane) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, AntilipschitzWith (2*K) (V.domRestrict (fun q => y n+circleSum (r n) q)) := by
  have hD : LipschitzWith 1 (fun q : V => (Real.cos q.1.1,Real.sin q.1.1)) := by
    have hf : LipschitzWith 1 (fun q : V => q.1.1) := LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (fun q p => by
      simp only [NNReal.coe_one,one_mul]
      exact le_max_left _ _)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,one_mul] using realDirection_lipschitz.comp hf
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => (K : ℝ)*‖r n-1‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh : Tendsto (fun n => r n-1) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa using hr.sub_const 1
    simpa using hh.norm.const_mul (K : ℝ)
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<1/2))] with n hn
  have ha := antilipschitz_small_perturbation hK hD (a := r n-1) (by simpa using le_of_lt hn)
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro q p
  have hh := ha.le_mul_dist q p
  simpa only [Set.domRestrict_apply,dist_add_left,← circleSum_perturb_identity] using hh
lemma circleSum_limit_antilipschitz {V : Set RealPlane} {K : ℝ≥0}
    (hK : AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict (circleSum 1))) (x : RealPlane) :
    AntilipschitzWith (2*K) (V.domRestrict (fun q => x+circleSum 1 q)) := by
  apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
  intro q p
  have hh := hK.le_mul_dist q p
  simpa only [Set.domRestrict_apply,dist_add_left] using hh.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by simp only [NNReal.coe_mul,NNReal.coe_ofNat]; linarith [K.2] : (K : ℝ)≤ ((2*K : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) dist_nonneg)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma measure_null_of_locally_null_on_conull {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [HereditarilyLindelofSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {R A : Set X}
    (hR : μ Rᶜ = 0) (h : ∀ x ∈ R, ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ μ (A ∩ V) = 0) :
    μ A = 0 := by
  classical
  choose V hVo hxV hV0 using (fun x : R => h x.1 x.2)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hcov⟩ := (HereditarilyLindelofSpace.isLindelof R).elim_countable_subcover V hVo
    (fun x hx => mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,hxV ⟨x,hx⟩⟩)
  have hu : μ (⋃ i ∈ t, A ∩ V i) = 0 := (measure_biUnion_null_iff ht).mpr (fun i _ => hV0 i)
  apply measure_mono_null (t := Rᶜ ∪ ⋃ i ∈ t, A ∩ V i) _ (measure_union_null hR hu)
  intro x hx
  by_cases hr : x ∈ R
  · obtain ⟨i,hi,hxi⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcov hr)
    exact Or.inr (mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨i,hi,hx,hxi⟩)
  · exact Or.inl hr
lemma circleSum_regular_ae : ∀ᵐ p : RealPlane ∂volume, Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod]
  apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae ?_).mpr
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun t => by
      have hs : {s : ℝ | Real.sin (s-t)=0} ⊆ Set.range (fun n : ℤ => t+n*Real.pi) := by
        intro s h
        obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp h
        exact ⟨n,by linarith⟩
      change volume {s : ℝ | ¬ Real.sin (s-t) ≠ 0} = 0
      simpa only [not_not] using measure_mono_null hs ((countable_range _).measure_zero volume)
  · exact (measurableSet_eq_fun (Real.measurable_sin.comp (measurable_snd.sub measurable_fst)) measurable_const).compl
lemma circleSum_preimage_null {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) {A : Set RealPlane} (hA : volume A=0) :
    volume (circleSum r ⁻¹' A)=0 := by
  apply measure_null_of_locally_null_on_conull (μ := (volume : Measure RealPlane))
    (R := {p : RealPlane | Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0}) (A := circleSum r ⁻¹' A) circleSum_regular_ae
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨s,hso,hps,K,hK⟩ := circleSum_local_antilipschitz (mul_ne_zero hr hp)
  refine ⟨s,hso,hps,?_⟩
  have hh := volume_preimage_bound hK A
  rw [hA,mul_zero] at hh
  exact nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp hh
lemma circleSum_quasiMeasurePreserving {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (circleSum r) volume volume := by
  refine ⟨(circleSum_continuous r).measurable,Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.mk (fun A hA hz => ?_)⟩
  rw [Measure.map_apply (circleSum_continuous r).measurable hA]
  exact circleSum_preimage_null hr hz
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- A uniformly bounded nonnegative sequence converging locally in L¹ on a conull open
cover converges globally in L¹ for a finite inner-regular measure. -/
lemma tendsto_integral_of_local_cover {X I : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    [MeasurableSpace X] [OpensMeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [Measure.InnerRegularCompactLTTop μ] {F : ℕ → X → ℝ}
    (hF : ∀ n, Integrable (F n) μ) (hb : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ F n x ∧ F n x ≤ 1)
    (V : I → Set X) (hVo : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) (hfull : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ ⋃ i, V i)
    (hlocal : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in V i, F n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, F n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  classical
  apply Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨K,hKU,hK,hμK⟩ := (isOpen_iUnion hVo).measurableSet.exists_isCompact_sdiff_lt
    (measure_ne_top μ _) (by exact ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (half_pos hε)))
  have hδ : μ Kᶜ < ENNReal.ofReal (ε/2) := by
    have he : (Kᶜ : Set X) =ᵐ[μ] ((⋃ i, V i) \ K : Set X) := by
      filter_upwards [hfull] with x hx
      exact propext ⟨fun h => ⟨hx,h⟩,fun h => h.2⟩
    exact (measure_congr he).trans_lt hμK
  have hδr : μ.real Kᶜ < ε/2 := by
    have hh := (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal (measure_ne_top μ _) (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)).mpr hδ
    simpa only [Measure.real,ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (le_of_lt (half_pos hε))] using hh
  obtain ⟨J,hJ⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover V hVo hKU
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ J, ∫ x in V i, F n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using tendsto_finsetSum J (fun i _ => hlocal i)
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hlim (ε/2) (half_pos hε)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hmaj : (∫ x, F n x ∂μ) ≤ (∑ i ∈ J, ∫ x in V i, F n x ∂μ) + μ.real Kᶜ := by
    have hJJ : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i ∈ J, (V i).indicator (F n) x) μ :=
      integrable_finsetSum J (fun i _ => (hF n).indicator (hVo i).measurableSet)
    have hCC : Integrable (Kᶜ.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) μ :=
      (integrable_const _).indicator hK.measurableSet.compl
    have hi := integral_mono (hF n) (hJJ.add hCC) (fun x => by
      have hs (i : I) : 0 ≤ (V i).indicator (F n) x := indicator_nonneg (fun y _ => (hb n y).1) x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ K
      · obtain ⟨i,hi,hxi⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hJ hx)
        have hsum := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hs j) hi
        simp only [Pi.add_apply,indicator_of_notMem (show x ∉ Kᶜ from not_not.mpr hx),add_zero]
        exact (by simpa only [indicator_of_mem hxi] using hsum)
      · change F n x ≤ (∑ i ∈ J, (V i).indicator (F n) x) + Kᶜ.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x
        rw [indicator_of_mem hx]
        linarith [Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i (_ : i ∈ J) => hs i), (hb n x).2])
    apply hi.trans_eq
    refine (integral_add hJJ hCC).trans ?_
    apply congrArg₂ (·+·)
    · exact (integral_finsetSum J (fun i _ => (hF n).indicator (hVo i).measurableSet)).trans
        (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => integral_indicator (hVo i).measurableSet))
    · rw [integral_indicator hK.measurableSet.compl]
      simp only [integral_const,smul_eq_mul,mul_one,Measure.real,Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun x => (hb n x).1)]
  have hh := hN n hn
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ J, ∫ x in V i, F n x ∂μ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => integral_nonneg (fun x => (hb n x).1)
  rw [Real.dist_eq,sub_zero,abs_of_nonneg hs0] at hh
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set

lemma bounded_difference_integrable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {f g : X → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (hfb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1) (hgb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ 1) :
    Integrable (fun x => ‖f x-g x‖) μ := by
  apply Integrable.of_bound ((hf.sub hg).norm.aestronglyMeasurable) 1
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
    rw [norm_norm,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_le]
    change -1 ≤ f x-g x ∧ f x-g x ≤ 1
    constructor <;> linarith [(hfb x).1,(hfb x).2,(hgb x).1,(hgb x).2]
lemma circleSum_tendsto_L1 {μ : Measure RealPlane} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [μ.InnerRegularCompactLTTop] (hμ : μ ≤ volume)
    {r : ℕ → ℝ} {y : ℕ → RealPlane} {x : RealPlane}
    (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (hy : Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x))
    {f : RealPlane → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (hfb : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z ∧ f z ≤ 1) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ q, ‖f (y n+circleSum (r n) q)-f (x+circleSum 1 q)‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  classical
  let T : ℕ → RealPlane → RealPlane := fun n q => y n+circleSum (r n) q
  let S : RealPlane → RealPlane := fun q => x+circleSum 1 q
  have hT (n : ℕ) : Measurable (T n) := (continuous_const.add (circleSum_continuous _)).measurable
  have hS : Measurable S := (continuous_const.add (circleSum_continuous _)).measurable
  let R : Set RealPlane := {p | Real.sin (p.2-p.1) ≠ 0}
  have hex : ∀ p : R, ∃ V : Set RealPlane, IsOpen V ∧ p.1 ∈ V ∧
      ∃ K : ℝ≥0, AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict (circleSum 1)) := by
    intro p
    exact circleSum_local_antilipschitz (by simpa only [one_mul] using (show Real.sin (p.1.2-p.1.1) ≠ 0 from p.2))
  choose V hVo hpV K hK using hex
  have hfull : ∀ᵐ q ∂μ, q ∈ ⋃ p : R, V p := by
    filter_upwards [circleSum_regular_ae.filter_mono (ae_mono hμ)] with q hq
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨q,hq⟩,hpV ⟨q,hq⟩⟩
  apply tendsto_integral_of_local_cover (μ := μ)
    (fun n => bounded_difference_integrable (hf.comp (hT n)) (hf.comp hS)
      (fun q => hfb (T n q)) (fun q => hfb (S q)))
    (fun n q => ⟨norm_nonneg _,by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_le]
      change -1 ≤ f (T n q)-f (S q) ∧ f (T n q)-f (S q) ≤ 1
      constructor <;> linarith [(hfb (T n q)).1,(hfb (T n q)).2,(hfb (S q)).1,(hfb (S q)).2]⟩)
    V hVo hfull
  intro p
  let B := Metric.closedBall x (4 : ℝ)
  let ν : Measure RealPlane := volume.restrict B
  have hB : MeasurableSet B := measurableSet_closedBall
  let : IsFiniteMeasure ν := ⟨by simpa [ν] using (isCompact_closedBall x 4).measure_lt_top⟩
  have hfi : Integrable f ν := Integrable.of_bound hf.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    (Eventually.of_forall fun z => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (hfb z).1]; exact (hfb z).2)
  have hmapT : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ((μ.restrict (V p)).map (T n)) ≤
      (((2*K p)^2 : ℝ≥0) : ENNReal) • ν := by
    filter_upwards [circleSum_eventual_image hr hy,circleSum_eventual_antilipschitz (hK p) hr y] with n hn ha
    apply (Measure.map_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure hμ (V p)) (hT n)).trans
    exact map_restrict_volume_le (hT n) hB ha (fun q _ => hn q)
  have hmapS : ((μ.restrict (V p)).map S) ≤ (((2*K p)^2 : ℝ≥0) : ENNReal) • ν := by
    apply (Measure.map_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure hμ (V p)) hS).trans
    exact map_restrict_volume_le hS hB (circleSum_limit_antilipschitz (hK p) x)
      (fun q _ => circleSum_limit_image x q)
  apply tendsto_integral_norm_comp_sub_eventual hT hS hmapT hmapS _ hfi
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun q => hy.add (circleSum_parameter_tendsto hr q)
end EuclideanFiveColor

open MeasureTheory Filter Topology Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def angularSum (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (p : Angles × Angles) :=
  x+(r : ℂ)*direction p.1+direction p.2
lemma angularSum_measurable (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : Measurable (angularSum x r) :=
  (measurable_const.add (measurable_const.mul (direction_continuous.measurable.comp measurable_fst))).add
    (direction_continuous.measurable.comp measurable_snd)
lemma angularSum_chart (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) (q : RealPlane) :
    angularSum x r (angleChart q) = Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm
      (Complex.equivRealProdCLM x+circleSum r q) := by
  apply Complex.equivRealProdCLM.injective
  simpa only [angularSum,ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using circleSum_chart x r q
lemma angularSum_quasiMeasurePreserving (x : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving (angularSum x r) (angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure) volume := by
  have hreal : Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving
      (fun q => Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm (Complex.equivRealProdCLM x+circleSum r q)) volume volume :=
    (Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.symm).quasiMeasurePreserving.comp
      ((measurePreserving_add_left volume (Complex.equivRealProdCLM x)).quasiMeasurePreserving.comp
        (circleSum_quasiMeasurePreserving hr))
  refine ⟨angularSum_measurable x r,Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.mk (fun A hA hz => ?_)⟩
  rw [Measure.map_apply (angularSum_measurable x r) hA]
  have hpre : angleChartMeasure (angleChart ⁻¹' (angularSum x r ⁻¹' A))=0 := by
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    apply (angleChartMeas_le _).trans
    have hz' := hreal.preimage_null hz
    simpa [preimage_preimage,Function.comp_def,angularSum_chart] using le_of_eq hz'
  have hz' : (ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi))^2 *
      (angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure) (angularSum x r ⁻¹' A)=0 := by
    rw [← smul_eq_mul,← Measure.smul_apply,← angleChart_measure,
      Measure.map_apply angleChart_preserving.measurable ((angularSum_measurable x r) hA)]
    exact hpre
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz').resolve_left (by positivity)
lemma angularSum_tendsto_L1 {r : ℕ → ℝ} {y : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) (hy : Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 x))
    {f : ℂ → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) (hfb : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f z ∧ f z ≤ 1) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ p, ‖f (angularSum (y n) (r n) p)-f (angularSum x 1 p)‖
      ∂angularMeasure.prod angularMeasure) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have h := circleSum_tendsto_L1 (μ := angleChartMeasure) angleChartMeas_le hr
    (Complex.equivRealProdCLM.continuous.tendsto x |>.comp hy)
    (hf.comp Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm.continuous.measurable)
    (fun z => hfb (Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm z))
  have he := h.const_mul (((2*Real.pi)^2)⁻¹)
  simp only [mul_zero] at he
  convert he using 1
  ext n
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,Pi.sub_apply,angularSum_chart] using
    (integral_angular_eq_chart (f := fun p => ‖f (angularSum (y n) (r n) p)-f (angularSum x 1 p)‖)
      (((hf.comp (angularSum_measurable _ _)).sub (hf.comp (angularSum_measurable _ _))).norm))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Filter Topology Set MeasureTheory

def samplingParameter (x y : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : CircleParameter := (Complex.equivRealProdCLM (y-x),r)
lemma samplingParameter_tendsto {x z : ℂ} {y : ℕ → ℂ} {r : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hy : Tendsto y atTop (𝓝 z)) (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => samplingParameter x (y n) (r n)) atTop (𝓝 (samplingParameter x z 1)) :=
  (Complex.equivRealProdCLM.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hy.sub_const x)).prodMk_nhds hr
lemma circleTarget_sampling (x y : ℂ) (r f : ℝ) :
    Complex.equivRealProdCLM x + circleTarget (samplingParameter x y r,f) =
      Complex.equivRealProdCLM (y+(r : ℂ)*direction (f : Angles)) := by
  have he : (r : ℂ)*direction (f : Angles)=r • direction (f : Angles) := by simp
  rw [he,map_add,map_smul,direction_realPlane]
  simp only [circleTarget,samplingParameter,map_sub]
  abel
lemma circleInverse_sampling {t u : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (u-t) ≠ 0) {x y : ℂ} {r f : ℝ}
    (ht : circleTarget (samplingParameter x y r,f) ∈ (circleInverseHomeo h).target) :
    y+(r : ℂ)*direction (f : Angles) =
      angularSum x 1 (angleChart (circleInverse h (circleTarget (samplingParameter x y r,f)))) := by
  rw [angularSum_chart,circleInverse_right h ht]
  apply Complex.equivRealProdCLM.injective
  exact (circleTarget_sampling x y r f).symm
end EuclideanFiveColor

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def binaryPhi (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := t+Real.arctan (d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))
def binaryBeta (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.arccos (Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2)
def binaryTarget (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := -binaryCircleMap d (-t)+Real.pi/3
def binaryOther (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := binaryCircleMap d t+2*(Real.pi/3)
lemma binaryTarget_eq (d t : ℝ) : binaryTarget d t=binaryPhi d t+binaryBeta d t := by
  simp only [binaryTarget,binaryCircleMap,binaryPhi,binaryBeta,binaryQ,Real.sin_neg,Real.cos_neg,
    mul_neg,neg_div,Real.arctan_neg]
  ring
lemma binaryOther_eq (d t : ℝ) : binaryOther d t=binaryPhi d t+Real.pi-binaryBeta d t := by
  dsimp [binaryOther,binaryCircleMap,binaryPhi,binaryBeta]
  ring
lemma binaryPhi_trig {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.cos (binaryPhi d t)=(Real.cos t-d)/Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) ∧
    Real.sin (binaryPhi d t)=Real.sin t/Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hq.1
  have hi := binary_arctan_identity d t
  have he : 1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2=binaryQ d t/(1-d*Real.cos t)^2 := by
    field_simp [hq.2.2.ne']
    nlinarith [hi]
  have hs : Real.sqrt (1+(d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t))^2)=Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/(1-d*Real.cos t) := by
    rw [he,Real.sqrt_div hq.1.le,Real.sqrt_sq hq.2.2.le]
  have hcθ : Real.cos (Real.arctan (d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t)))=(1-d*Real.cos t)/Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := by
    rw [Real.cos_arctan,hs]
    field_simp
  have hsθ : Real.sin (Real.arctan (d*Real.sin t/(1-d*Real.cos t)))=d*Real.sin t/Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) := by
    rw [Real.sin_arctan,hs]
    field_simp [hq.2.2.ne']
  dsimp [binaryPhi]
  simp only [Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,hcθ,hsθ]
  constructor
  · field_simp [hq.2.2.ne',hsq]
    linear_combination -d*(Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t)
  · field_simp [hq.2.2.ne',hsq]
    ring
lemma binaryBeta_trig {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.cos (binaryBeta d t)=Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ∧
    Real.sin (binaryBeta d t)=Real.sqrt (1-binaryQ d t/4) := by
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hq.1.le
  have hs' : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)/2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (binaryQ d t)]
  constructor
  · exact Real.cos_arccos (by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (binaryQ d t)]) hs'
  · dsimp [binaryBeta]
    rw [Real.sin_arccos]
    congr 1
    nlinarith
lemma binary_geometry {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    d+Real.cos (binaryTarget d t)=Real.cos t+Real.cos (binaryOther d t) ∧
    Real.sin (binaryTarget d t)=Real.sin t+Real.sin (binaryOther d t) := by
  have hp := binaryPhi_trig hd t
  have hb := binaryBeta_trig hd t
  have hq := binaryQ_range hd t
  have hs : Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hq.1
  rw [binaryTarget_eq,binaryOther_eq,
    show binaryPhi d t+Real.pi-binaryBeta d t=(binaryPhi d t-binaryBeta d t)+Real.pi by ring,
    Real.cos_add_pi,Real.sin_add_pi,Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,Real.cos_sub,Real.sin_sub,hp.1,hp.2,hb.1,hb.2]
  constructor <;> field_simp <;> ring
lemma binaryTarget_hasDeriv {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (binaryTarget d) (1+d*binaryB d (-t)) t := by
  convert ((binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_t hd (-t)).comp t (hasDerivAt_neg t)).neg.add_const (Real.pi/3) using 1 <;>
    first | rfl | ring
lemma binaryOther_hasDeriv {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (binaryOther d) (1+d*binaryB d t) t := by
  exact (binaryCircleMap_hasDeriv_t hd t).add_const (2*(Real.pi/3))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma binary_nonparallel {d : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.sin (binaryOther d t-t) ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  have hq := binaryQ_range (show |-d|<1/2 by simpa only [abs_neg] using hd) (binaryTarget d t)
  have hg := binary_geometry hd t
  have hs := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (binaryOther d t-t)
  rw [hz] at hs
  have hi : binaryQ (-d) (binaryTarget d t)=2+2*Real.cos (binaryOther d t-t) := by
    have hc := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t
    have hh := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (binaryOther d t)
    have ht := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (binaryTarget d t)
    dsimp only [binaryQ]
    rw [Real.cos_sub]
    nlinarith [sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mpr (Or.inl hg.1),sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mpr (Or.inl hg.2)]
  rw [hi] at hq
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.cos (binaryOther d t-t))]
lemma binary_geometry_rotated {x z : ℂ} {d φ : ℝ} (hd : |d|<1/2)
    (hxr : (z-x).re=d*Real.cos φ) (hxi : (z-x).im=d*Real.sin φ) (t : ℝ) :
    circleTarget (samplingParameter x z 1,binaryTarget d t+φ)=
      circleSum 1 (t+φ,binaryOther d t+φ) := by
  have hg := binary_geometry hd t
  simp only [circleTarget,samplingParameter,one_smul,circleSum,one_mul]
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (z-x).re+Real.cos (binaryTarget d t+φ)=Real.cos (t+φ)+Real.cos (binaryOther d t+φ)
    rw [hxr,Real.cos_add,Real.cos_add,Real.cos_add]
    linear_combination Real.cos φ*hg.1-Real.sin φ*hg.2
  · change (z-x).im+Real.sin (binaryTarget d t+φ)=Real.sin (t+φ)+Real.sin (binaryOther d t+φ)
    rw [hxi,Real.sin_add,Real.sin_add,Real.sin_add]
    linear_combination Real.sin φ*hg.1+Real.cos φ*hg.2
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma deriv_lower_surjective {f D : ℝ → ℝ} (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (D x) x)
    (hp : ∀ x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D x) : Function.Surjective f := by
  intro y
  let R := 2*(|y-f 0|+1)
  have hR : 0 < R := by dsimp [R]; positivity
  have h₁ := mul_sub_le_image_sub_of_le_deriv (fun x => (hd x).differentiableAt)
    (fun x => by rw [(hd x).deriv]; exact hp x) (show -R ≤ 0 by linarith)
  have h₂ := mul_sub_le_image_sub_of_le_deriv (fun x => (hd x).differentiableAt)
    (fun x => by rw [(hd x).deriv]; exact hp x) hR.le
  have hy : y ∈ Icc (f (-R)) (f R) := by
    constructor <;> dsimp [R] at * <;> linarith [le_abs_self (y-f 0),neg_abs_le (y-f 0)]
  obtain ⟨x,_,hx⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by linarith : -R ≤ R)
    (continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x => (hd x).continuousAt)).continuousOn hy
  exact ⟨x,hx⟩
def derivLowerOrderIso {f D : ℝ → ℝ} (hd : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (D x) x)
    (hp : ∀ x, (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ D x) : ℝ ≃o ℝ :=
  (strictMono_of_deriv_pos (fun x => by rw [(hd x).deriv]; linarith [hp x])).orderIsoOfRightInverse f
    (Function.surjInv (deriv_lower_surjective hd hp)) (Function.rightInverse_surjInv (deriv_lower_surjective hd hp))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

import Mathlib

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Topology FourierTransform
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
namespace Multiplier
variable {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X)
def apply (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C)
    (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : Lp ℂ 2 μ :=
  ((memLp_top_of_bound hf C hbound).fun_mul (Lp.memLp g)).toLp (fun x => f x*g x)
lemma apply_ae (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C)
    (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : apply μ f hf hbound g =ᵐ[μ] fun x => f x*g x := MemLp.coeFn_toLp _
def linear (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C) :
    Lp ℂ 2 μ →ₗ[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ where
  toFun := apply μ f hf hbound
  map_add' g h := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [apply_ae μ f hf hbound (g+h),apply_ae μ f hf hbound g,apply_ae μ f hf hbound h,
      Lp.coeFn_add g h,Lp.coeFn_add (apply μ f hf hbound g) (apply μ f hf hbound h)] with x ha hb hc hd he
    simp only [ha,he,Pi.add_apply,hb,hc,hd,mul_add]
  map_smul' c g := by
    apply Lp.ext
    filter_upwards [apply_ae μ f hf hbound (c • g),apply_ae μ f hf hbound g,
      Lp.coeFn_smul c g,Lp.coeFn_smul c (apply μ f hf hbound g)] with x ha hb hc hd
    simp only [RingHom.id_apply,ha,hd,Pi.smul_apply,hb,hc,smul_eq_mul]
    ring
lemma apply_norm_le (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C)
    (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : ‖apply μ f hf hbound g‖ ≤ C*‖g‖ := by
  apply Lp.norm_le_mul_norm_of_ae_le_mul
  filter_upwards [apply_ae μ f hf hbound g,hbound] with x hx hf
  rw [hx,norm_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf (norm_nonneg _)
def clm (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C) :
    Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ :=
  (linear μ f hf hbound).mkContinuous C (apply_norm_le μ f hf hbound)
lemma clm_ae (f : X → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {C : ℝ} (hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖≤C)
    (g : Lp ℂ 2 μ) : clm μ f hf hbound g =ᵐ[μ] fun x => f x*g x := apply_ae μ f hf hbound g
end Multiplier
abbrev ComplexPlaneL2 := Lp (α := ℂ) ℂ 2 volume
def planeTranslate (h : ℂ) : ComplexPlaneL2 →ₗᵢ[ℂ] ComplexPlaneL2 :=
  Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℂ (fun x => x+h) (measurePreserving_add_right volume h)
lemma planeTranslate_ae (h : ℂ) (g : ComplexPlaneL2) :
    planeTranslate h g =ᵐ[volume] fun x => g (x+h) :=
  Lp.coeFn_compMeasurePreserving g (measurePreserving_add_right volume h)
def planePhase (h ξ : ℂ) : ℂ := Real.fourierChar (inner ℝ h ξ)
lemma planePhase_norm (h ξ : ℂ) : ‖planePhase h ξ‖=1 := Circle.norm_coe _
lemma planePhase_continuous (h : ℂ) : Continuous (planePhase h) := by
  unfold planePhase
  fun_prop

def phaseMultiplier (h : ℂ) : ComplexPlaneL2 →L[ℂ] ComplexPlaneL2 :=
  Multiplier.clm volume (planePhase h) (planePhase_continuous h).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => (planePhase_norm h ξ).le)
lemma phaseMultiplier_ae (h : ℂ) (g : ComplexPlaneL2) :
    phaseMultiplier h g =ᵐ[volume] fun ξ => planePhase h ξ*g ξ := Multiplier.clm_ae _ _ _ _ _
def schwartzTranslate (h : ℂ) : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ →L[ℂ] SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ :=
  SchwartzMap.compCLMOfAntilipschitz ℂ
    (Function.HasTemperateGrowth.id.add (Function.HasTemperateGrowth.const h)) (isometry_add_right h).antilipschitzWith
lemma schwartzTranslate_apply (h : ℂ) (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (x : ℂ) :
    schwartzTranslate h f x = f (x+h) := rfl
lemma schwartzTranslate_toLp (h : ℂ) (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) :
    (schwartzTranslate h f).toLp 2 = planeTranslate h (f.toLp 2) := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(schwartzTranslate h f).coeFn_toLp 2,planeTranslate_ae h (f.toLp 2),
    (measurePreserving_add_right volume h).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (f.coeFn_toLp 2 volume)] with x hx hy hz
  exact hx.trans ((schwartzTranslate_apply h f x).trans (hz.symm.trans hy.symm))
lemma fourier_schwartzTranslate (h : ℂ) (f : SchwartzMap ℂ ℂ) (ξ : ℂ) :
    𝓕 (schwartzTranslate h f) ξ = planePhase h ξ * 𝓕 f ξ := by
  have hh := congrFun (VectorFourier.fourierIntegral_comp_add_right Real.fourierChar volume
    (innerₗ ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) h) ξ
  simpa only [SchwartzMap.fourier_coe,Real.fourier_eq,schwartzTranslate_apply,
    planePhase,Circle.smul_def,smul_eq_mul,VectorFourier.fourierIntegral,Function.comp_def,innerₗ_apply_apply] using hh
lemma fourier_planeTranslate (h : ℂ) (g : ComplexPlaneL2) :
    𝓕 (planeTranslate h g) = phaseMultiplier h (𝓕 g) := by
  apply DenseRange.induction_on (p := fun g : ComplexPlaneL2 => 𝓕 (planeTranslate h g) = phaseMultiplier h (𝓕 g))
    (SchwartzMap.denseRange_toLpCLM (E := ℂ) (F := ℂ) (p := 2) ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top) g
  · exact isClosed_eq ((Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℂ ℂ).continuous.comp (planeTranslate h).continuous)
      ((phaseMultiplier h).continuous.comp (Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℂ ℂ).continuous)
  intro f
  change 𝓕 (planeTranslate h (f.toLp 2)) = phaseMultiplier h (𝓕 (f.toLp 2))
  rw [← schwartzTranslate_toLp,SchwartzMap.toLp_fourier_eq,SchwartzMap.toLp_fourier_eq]
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [(𝓕 (schwartzTranslate h f)).coeFn_toLp 2,phaseMultiplier_ae h ((𝓕 f).toLp 2),
    (𝓕 f).coeFn_toLp 2] with ξ hξ hmul hf
  rw [hξ,hmul,hf]
  exact fourier_schwartzTranslate h f ξ
end EuclideanFiveColor
