open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma outer_strip_trace {x : ℂ} {t : Angles} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ)
    {W : Set ℂ} (ho : IsOpen W) {J : Finset (Fin k)}
    (hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J)
    (hstrip : ∀u : Angles,dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ → ∀r : ℝ,
      1<r → r<1+δ → x+(r : ℂ)*direction u∈W) :
    ∃U : Set Angles,IsOpen U ∧ t∈U ∧
      ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈U → (palette c hc x u∩J).Nonempty := by
  let K : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)≤δ/2}
  let U : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2}
  have hK : IsCompact K := (isClosed_le (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const).isCompact
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1+(δ/2)/(n+1)
  have hr (n) : 0<r n := by dsimp [r]; positivity
  have hrt : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [r,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul,mul_zero,add_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).add
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (δ/2))
  have hh := trace_region_palette c hc hK ho hW hr hrt (fun n u hu => by
    apply hstrip u (by dsimp [K] at hu; linarith)
    · dsimp [r]
      have : 0<(δ/2)/((n:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
      linarith
    · have hn : (1:ℝ)≤(n:ℝ)+1 := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
      have hb := div_le_self (by positivity : (0:ℝ)≤δ/2) hn
      dsimp [r]
      linarith)
  refine ⟨U,isOpen_lt (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const,?_,?_⟩
  · change dist (direction t) (direction t)<δ/2
    simp only [dist_self]; positivity
  · exact hh.mono fun u hu hU => hu (show u∈K from (show dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2 from hU).le)
lemma inner_strip_trace {x : ℂ} {t : Angles} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ)
    {W : Set ℂ} (ho : IsOpen W) {J : Finset (Fin k)}
    (hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J)
    (hstrip : ∀u : Angles,dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ → ∀r : ℝ,
      0<r → 1-δ<r → r<1 → x+(r : ℂ)*direction u∈W) :
    ∃U : Set Angles,IsOpen U ∧ t∈U ∧
      ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈U → (palette c hc x u∩J).Nonempty := by
  let K : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)≤δ/2}
  let U : Set Angles := {u | dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2}
  have hK : IsCompact K := (isClosed_le (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const).isCompact
  let ε := min δ (1/2)
  have he : 0<ε := lt_min hδ (by norm_num)
  have heδ : ε≤δ := min_le_left _ _
  have he1 : ε≤1/2 := min_le_right _ _
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => 1-(ε/2)/(n+1)
  have hb (n : ℕ) : (ε/2)/(n+1)≤ε/2 := div_le_self (by positivity) (by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n])
  have hr (n) : 0<r n := by dsimp [r]; linarith [hb n]
  have hrt : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [r,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul,mul_zero,sub_zero] using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).sub
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (ε/2))
  have hh := trace_region_palette c hc hK ho hW hr hrt (fun n u hu => by
    apply hstrip u (by dsimp [K] at hu; linarith) (r n) (hr n)
    · dsimp [r]; linarith [hb n]
    · dsimp [r]
      have : 0<(ε/2)/((n:ℝ)+1) := by positivity
      linarith)
  refine ⟨U,isOpen_lt (direction_continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const,?_,?_⟩
  · change dist (direction t) (direction t)<δ/2
    simp only [dist_self]; positivity
  · exact hh.mono fun u hu hU => hu (show u∈K from (show dist (direction u) (direction t)<δ/2 from hU).le)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- The source local binary rigidity on arbitrary one-sided strips, allowing
independent choices of radial side at the two equilateral neighbors. -/
lemma binary_strip_rigidity {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c)
    {a b : Fin k} {U V : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hUc : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈U → c q=a ∨ c q=b)
    (hVc : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈V → c q=a ∨ c q=b)
    {x e : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖=1) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (bu bv : Bool)
    (hstripU : ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,
      0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if bu then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈U)
    (hstripV : ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' (e*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ))<δ → ∀r : ℝ,
      0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if bv then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈V) :
    ∃i : Fin k,(i=a ∨ i=b) ∧ ∃η>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<η → ∀r : ℝ,
      0<r → |r-1|<η → (if bu then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈essentialLocalSet c i := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hpv⟩ := radial_unit_contact he hδ bv hstripV
  obtain ⟨w,hpw,hw',hd⟩ := open_two_unit_directions hV hv hpv
  let W : Set ℂ := {p | p+v∈V ∧ p+w∈V}
  have hW : IsOpen W := (hV.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).inter
    (hV.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const))
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hbox⟩ := polarBox_small hδ hW ⟨hpv,hpw⟩ hstripU he
  obtain ⟨i,hi,_⟩ := connected_local_ae_constant (polarBox_connected x e bu hε) (fun p hp => by
    have hp' := hbox hp
    obtain ⟨r,hr,j,hj⟩ := binary_open_local_rigidity hc hw hU hV hUc hVc hp'.1 hp'.2.1 hp'.2.2 hv hw' hd
    exact ⟨j,Metric.ball p r,Metric.isOpen_ball,Metric.mem_ball_self hr,hj⟩)
  have hab : i=a ∨ i=b := by
    obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := (polarBox_connected x e bu hε).nonempty
    have hpos := (hU.inter (essentialLocalSet_open c i)).measure_pos (volume : Measure ℂ)
      ⟨p,(hbox hp).1,hi hp⟩
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hqa⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos.ne'
      (ae_restrict_of_ae (hUc.and (essentialLocalSet_ae c i)))
    simpa only [hqa.2 hq.2] using hqa.1 hq.1
  obtain ⟨η,hη,hh⟩ := polarBox_contains_strip he bu hε
  exact ⟨i,hab,η,hη,fun e' he' hh' r _ hr hside => hi (hh e' he' hh' r hr hside)⟩
/-- The resulting fixed outsider is actually in the maximal palette on an
angular neighborhood, by one-sided radial weak traces. -/
lemma binary_strip_palette_rigidity {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c)
    {a b : Fin k} {U V : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hUc : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈U → c q=a ∨ c q=b)
    (hVc : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈V → c q=a ∨ c q=b)
    {x : ℂ} {t : Angles} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (bu bv : Bool)
    (hstripU : ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' (direction t)<δ → ∀r : ℝ,
      0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if bu then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈U)
    (hstripV : ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' (direction t*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ))<δ → ∀r : ℝ,
      0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if bv then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈V) :
    ∃i : Fin k,(i=a ∨ i=b) ∧ ∃A : Set Angles,IsOpen A ∧ t∈A ∧
      ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈A → i∈palette c hc x u := by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,η,hη,hs⟩ := binary_strip_rigidity hc hw hU hV hUc hVc (direction_norm t) hδ bu bv hstripU hstripV
  have hmono : ∀ᵐq : ℂ∂volume,q∈essentialLocalSet c i → c q∈({i} : Finset (Fin k)) :=
    (essentialLocalSet_ae c i).mono fun q hq hqi => by simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton] using hq hqi
  have hex : ∃A : Set Angles,IsOpen A ∧ t∈A ∧
      ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈A → (palette c hc x u∩{i}).Nonempty := by
    cases bu
    · apply inner_strip_trace c hc hη (essentialLocalSet_open c i) hmono
      intro u hu r hr hrη hr1
      apply hs (direction u) (direction_norm u) hu r hr _ hr1
      rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
    · apply outer_strip_trace c hc hη (essentialLocalSet_open c i) hmono
      intro u hu r hr1 hrη
      apply hs (direction u) (direction_norm u) hu r (by linarith) _ hr1
      rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨A,hA,ht,hae⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨i,hi,A,hA,ht,hae.mono fun u hu hAu => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hu hAu
  rcases Finset.mem_inter.mp hj with ⟨hjp,hji⟩
  simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hji] using hjp
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- If two unit rays can never be simultaneously positive at a generic angle,
they are antipodal. This avoids any assumption about multiplicities of ray lines. -/
lemma unit_antipodes_of_no_positive {v w : ℂ} (hv : ‖v‖=1) (hw : ‖w‖=1)
    (h : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,¬(0<⟪direction t,v⟫ ∧ 0<⟪direction t,w⟫)) : w= -v := by
  by_contra hne
  have hsum : v+w≠0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hne
    apply eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero.mpr
    simpa only [add_comm] using hz
  have hvv : ⟪v,v⟫=(1:ℝ) := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,hv]; norm_num
  have hww : ⟪w,w⟫=(1:ℝ) := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,hw]; norm_num
  have hs : 0<⟪v+w,v+w⟫ := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    exact sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hsum)
  have hc := real_inner_comm v w
  simp only [inner_add_left,inner_add_right,hvv,hww] at hs
  have hvpos : 0<⟪v+w,v⟫ := by rw [inner_add_left,hvv]; linarith
  have hwpos : 0<⟪v+w,w⟫ := by rw [inner_add_left,hww]; linarith
  let e : ℂ := ‖v+w‖⁻¹ • (v+w)
  have he : ‖e‖=1 := by
    simp only [e,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_inv,abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg (v+w))]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hsum)
  have hev : 0<⟪e,v⟫ := by
    change 0<⟪‖v+w‖⁻¹ • (v+w),_⟫
    rw [real_inner_smul_left]
    exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hsum)) hvpos
  have hew : 0<⟪e,w⟫ := by
    change 0<⟪‖v+w‖⁻¹ • (v+w),_⟫
    rw [real_inner_smul_left]
    exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hsum)) hwpos
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := direction_exists he
  let U : Set Angles := {t | 0<⟪direction t,v⟫ ∧ 0<⟪direction t,w⟫}
  have hUv : IsOpen {t : Angles | 0<⟪direction t,v⟫} := isOpen_lt continuous_const (direction_continuous.inner continuous_const)
  have hUw : IsOpen {t : Angles | 0<⟪direction t,w⟫} := isOpen_lt continuous_const (direction_continuous.inner continuous_const)
  have hU : IsOpen U := hUv.inter hUw
  have htU : t∈U := by change _∧_; rw [ht]; exact ⟨hev,hew⟩
  have hpos := hU.measure_pos angularMeasure ⟨t,htU⟩
  obtain ⟨u,hu,hu'⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos.ne' (ae_restrict_of_ae h)
  exact hu' hu
/-- The source's all-generic split condition already forces opposite edge
positions to be actual antipodes; the collinear case is retained. -/
lemma four_split_antipodes (v : Fin 4 → ℂ) (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1)
    (hsplit : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,∀i,¬(0<⟪direction t,v i⟫ ∧ 0<⟪direction t,v (i+2)⟫)) :
    ∀i,v (i+2)= -v i := by
  intro i
  exact unit_antipodes_of_no_positive (hv i) (hv (i+2)) (hsplit.mono fun _ ht => ht i)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/AngularBoundary.lean

import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.BoundaryTrace

noncomputable section
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- `0` is the outsider and `1,2` the two diagonal states. -/
def FourWordValid (w : Fin 6 → Fin 3) : Prop :=
  (∀j,w j≠w (j+1)) ∧ (∀j,w j≠0 → w (j+3)≠0 → w (j+3)=w j)
instance (w : Fin 6 → Fin 3) : Decidable (FourWordValid w) := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_∧_))
def FourWordMixed (w : Fin 6 → Fin 3) : Prop :=
  ∃i j,w i=0 ∧ w j=0 ∧ i.val%2≠j.val%2
instance (w : Fin 6 → Fin 3) : Decidable (FourWordMixed w) := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃_i _j,_∧_∧_))
def FourWordCross (w u : Fin 6 → Fin 3) : Prop :=
  ∀j,w j≠0 → u (j+1)≠w j ∧ u (j-1)≠w j
instance (w u : Fin 6 → Fin 3) : Decidable (FourWordCross w u) := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀_j,_→_∧_))
lemma forall_six_word (P : (Fin 6 → Fin 3) → Prop) :
    (∀w,P w) ↔ ∀a b c d e f : Fin 3,P ![a,b,c,d,e,f] := by
  constructor
  · intro h a b c d e f
    exact h _
  · intro h w
    have he : w=![w 0,w 1,w 2,w 3,w 4,w 5] := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> rfl
    rw [he]
    exact h _ _ _ _ _ _
lemma four_word_has_outsider : ∀w : Fin 6 → Fin 3,FourWordValid w → ∃j,w j=0 := by
  simp only [forall_six_word]
  decide
lemma four_word_mixed_periodic : ∀w : Fin 6 → Fin 3,FourWordValid w → FourWordMixed w →
    (∀j,w (j+3)=w j) ∧ w 0≠w 1 ∧ w 1≠w 2 ∧ w 0≠w 2 := by
  simp only [forall_six_word]
  decide
lemma four_word_mixed_isolated : ∀w : Fin 6 → Fin 3,FourWordValid w → FourWordMixed w →
    ∀u : Fin 6 → Fin 3,FourWordValid u → FourWordCross w u → u=w := by
  simp only [forall_six_word]
  decide
lemma four_word_parity : ∀w : Fin 6 → Fin 3,FourWordValid w → ¬FourWordMixed w →
    ∃p : Fin 2,∀j,w j=0 → j.val%2=p.val := by
  simp only [forall_six_word]
  decide
lemma four_word_shift_parity : ∀w : Fin 6 → Fin 3,∀p : Fin 2,
    (∀j,w j=0 → j.val%2=p.val) → ∀j,w (j+1)=0 → j.val%2=(p+1).val := by
  simp only [forall_six_word]
  decide
lemma four_word_opposite_parity : ∀w : Fin 6 → Fin 3,FourWordValid w →
    (∀j,w j=0 → j.val%2=0) → ∀u : Fin 6 → Fin 3,FourWordValid u →
    (∀j,u j=0 → j.val%2=1) → FourWordCross w u →
    ∃a b : Fin 3,a≠0 ∧ b≠0 ∧ a≠b ∧
      (∀j,j.val%2=1 → w j=a) ∧ (∀j,j.val%2=0 → u j=b) := by
  simp only [forall_six_word]
  decide
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Uniform local isolation of a value on a dense subset of a connected metric
space propagates globally. This is the manuscript dense-set chain argument. -/
lemma dense_isolated_value_constant {E F : Type*} [MetricSpace E] [PreconnectedSpace E]
    {G : Set E} (hG : Dense G) (f : E → F) {b : F} {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε)
    (hne : ∃x∈G,f x=b)
    (hl : ∀x∈G,f x=b → ∀y∈G,dist x y<ε → f y=b) : ∀y∈G,f y=b := by
  let A : Set E := {x | x∈G ∧ f x=b}
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := hne
  have hAopen : IsOpen (closure A) := by
    apply isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.mpr
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a,ha,had⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hx ε hε
    have hsub : Metric.ball a ε∩G⊆A := by
      intro y hy
      exact ⟨hy.2,hl a ha.1 ha.2 y hy.2 (by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_comm] using hy.1)⟩
    have hball : Metric.ball a ε⊆closure A := by
      intro y hy
      apply closure_mono hsub
      exact Metric.isOpen_ball.inter_closure ⟨hy,hG y⟩
    exact ⟨Metric.ball a ε,hball,Metric.isOpen_ball,had⟩
  have hfull : closure A=univ := (show IsClopen (closure A) from ⟨isClosed_closure,hAopen⟩).eq_univ
    (hAne.mono subset_closure)
  intro y hy
  have hym : y∈closure A := by rw [hfull]; trivial
  obtain ⟨a,ha,had⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.mp hym ε hε
  exact hl a ha.1 ha.2 y hy (by simpa only [dist_comm] using had)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma sixty_six : (6 : ℕ) • (sixty : Angles)=0 := by
  rw [← AddCircle.coe_nsmul]
  convert AddCircle.coe_period (p := 2*Real.pi) using 1
  congr 1
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul,sixty]
  ring
lemma sixty_three : (3 : ℕ) • (sixty : Angles)=(Real.pi : Angles) := by
  rw [← AddCircle.coe_nsmul]
  congr 1
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul,sixty]
  ring
def sixAngle (j : Fin 6) : Angles := j.val • (sixty : Angles)
lemma sixAngle_step (j : Fin 6) : sixAngle (j+1)=sixAngle j+(sixty : Angles) := by
  fin_cases j <;> norm_num [sixAngle,Fin.val_add,succ_nsmul]
  simpa only [succ_nsmul,zero_nsmul,zero_add] using sixty_six.symm
lemma sixAngle_half (j : Fin 6) : sixAngle (j+3)=sixAngle j+(Real.pi : Angles) := by
  rw [show j+3=(j+1+1)+1 from (by decide : ∀j : Fin 6,j+3=(j+1+1)+1) j,sixAngle_step,sixAngle_step,sixAngle_step,← sixty_three]
  simp only [succ_nsmul,zero_nsmul,zero_add]
  abel
lemma direction_add_pi (t : Angles) : direction (t+(Real.pi : Angles))= -direction t := by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective t
  rw [← AddCircle.coe_add,direction_real,direction_real,Circle.exp_add]
  simp
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- The mixed-parity exceptional words are excluded by actual local isolation
and sixty-degree covariance on a dense set. -/
lemma four_words_no_mixed (G : Set Angles) (hG : Dense G) (w : Angles → Fin 6 → Fin 3)
    (hv : ∀t∈G,FourWordValid (w t))
    (hshiftG : ∀t∈G,t+(sixty : Angles)∈G)
    (hshift : ∀t∈G,∀j,w (t+(sixty : Angles)) j=w t (j+1))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε)
    (hcross : ∀t∈G,∀u∈G,dist t u<ε → FourWordCross (w t) (w u)) :
    ∀t∈G,¬FourWordMixed (w t) := by
  intro t ht hm
  have he : ∀u∈G,w u=w t := by
    apply dense_isolated_value_constant hG w hε ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩
    intro u hu hue v hv' hdist
    exact (four_word_mixed_isolated (w u) (hv u hu) (by rw [hue]; exact hm)
      (w v) (hv v hv') (hcross u hu v hv' hdist)).trans hue
  have hconst := congrFun (he (t+(sixty : Angles)) (hshiftG t ht)) 0
  rw [hshift t ht 0] at hconst
  exact (hv t ht).1 0 hconst.symm
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- The source's strict min/max straddling region, in equivalent witness form. -/
def Straddle (K : Set ℂ) : Set ℂ := {z | ∃p∈K,∃q∈K,dist z p<1 ∧ 1<dist z q}
lemma straddle_isOpen (K : Set ℂ) : IsOpen (Straddle K) := by
  have he : Straddle K=⋃p∈K,⋃q∈K,{z | dist z p<1 ∧ 1<dist z q} := by
    ext z
    simp only [Straddle,mem_iUnion,mem_ofPred_eq,exists_prop]
  rw [he]
  exact isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ =>
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_id.dist continuous_const) continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const))
lemma straddle_connected_unit {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsPreconnected K) {z : ℂ} (hz : z∈Straddle K) :
    ∃p∈K,dist z p=1 := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp,q,hq,hp1,hq1⟩ := hz
  exact hK.intermediate_value hp hq (continuous_const.dist continuous_id).continuousOn ⟨hp1.le,hq1.le⟩
lemma approaching_direction_inside {r : ℕ → ℝ} {w : ℕ → ℂ} {v e : ℂ}
    (hr : ∀n,0<r n) (hr0 : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0)) (hw : ∀n,‖w n‖=1)
    (hwv : Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 v)) (he : ‖e‖=1) (hv : 0<⟪e,v⟫) :
    ∀ᶠn in atTop,‖e-(r n : ℂ)*w n‖<1 := by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => 2*⟪e,w n⟫-r n) atTop (𝓝 (2*⟪e,v⟫)) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using ((tendsto_const_nhds.inner hwv).const_mul 2).sub hr0
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<2*⟪e,v⟫))] with n hn
  have heq : ‖e-(r n : ℂ)*w n‖^2=1-2*r n*⟪e,w n⟫+(r n)^2 := by
    change ‖e-r n • w n‖^2= _
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real,inner_smul_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hr n),he,hw]
    ring
  have hpos := mul_pos (hr n) hn
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (e-(r n : ℂ)*w n)]
lemma approaching_direction_outside {r : ℕ → ℝ} {w : ℕ → ℂ} {v e : ℂ}
    (hr : ∀n,0<r n) (hr0 : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0)) (hw : ∀n,‖w n‖=1)
    (hwv : Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 v)) (he : ‖e‖=1) (hv : ⟪e,v⟫<0) :
    ∀ᶠn in atTop,1<‖e-(r n : ℂ)*w n‖ := by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => 2*⟪e,w n⟫-r n) atTop (𝓝 (2*⟪e,v⟫)) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using ((tendsto_const_nhds.inner hwv).const_mul 2).sub hr0
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by linarith : 2*⟪e,v⟫<(0:ℝ)))] with n hn
  have heq : ‖e-(r n : ℂ)*w n‖^2=1-2*r n*⟪e,w n⟫+(r n)^2 := by
    change ‖e-r n • w n‖^2= _
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real,inner_smul_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hr n),he,hw]
    ring
  have hneg := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (hr n) hn
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (e-(r n : ℂ)*w n)]
lemma outer_straddle_strip {K : Set ℂ} {x e q : ℂ} (hx : x∈K) (hq : q∈K)
    (_he : ‖e‖=1) (hed : dist (x+e) q<1) :
    ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,1<r → r<1+δ →
      x+(r : ℂ)*e'∈Straddle K := by
  have hn : ∀ᶠp : ℝ × ℂ in 𝓝 (1,e),dist (x+(p.1 : ℂ)*p.2) q<1 :=
    (show Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => dist (x+(p.1 : ℂ)*p.2) q) by fun_prop).continuousAt.eventually
      (gt_mem_nhds (by simpa only [Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul] using hed))
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hn
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun e' he' heδ r hr hrδ => ⟨q,hq,x,hx,?_,?_⟩⟩
  · apply hsub (a := (r,e'))
    rw [Metric.mem_ball,Prod.dist_eq,max_lt_iff]
    exact ⟨by rw [Real.dist_eq,abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0<r-1)]; linarith,heδ⟩
  · rw [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_left,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (by linarith : 0<r),he',mul_one]
    exact hr
lemma inner_straddle_strip {K : Set ℂ} {x e q : ℂ} (hx : x∈K) (hq : q∈K)
    (_he : ‖e‖=1) (hed : 1<dist (x+e) q) :
    ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,0<r → 1-δ<r → r<1 →
      x+(r : ℂ)*e'∈Straddle K := by
  have hn : ∀ᶠp : ℝ × ℂ in 𝓝 (1,e),1<dist (x+(p.1 : ℂ)*p.2) q :=
    (show Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => dist (x+(p.1 : ℂ)*p.2) q) by fun_prop).continuousAt.eventually
      (lt_mem_nhds (by simpa only [Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul] using hed))
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hn
  refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun e' he' heδ r hr hrδ hr1 => ⟨x,hx,q,hq,?_,?_⟩⟩
  · rw [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_left,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hr,he',mul_one]
    exact hr1
  · apply hsub (a := (r,e'))
    rw [Metric.mem_ball,Prod.dist_eq,max_lt_iff]
    exact ⟨by rw [Real.dist_eq,abs_of_neg (by linarith : r-1<0)]; linarith,heδ⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma finite_positive_lower_bound {ι : Type*} (E : Finset ι) (d : ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀i∈E,0<d i) : ∃δ>0,δ≤1 ∧ ∀i∈E,δ≤d i := by
  classical
  induction E using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨1,by norm_num,le_rfl,by simp⟩
  | @insert a E ha ih =>
    obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδ1,hδd⟩ := ih (fun i hi => hd i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
    refine ⟨min δ (d a),lt_min hδ (hd a (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)),(min_le_left _ _).trans hδ1,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl|hi
    · exact min_le_right _ _
    · exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (hδd i hi)
/-- The approach data furnished by the manuscript interface proposition, with no
assumption of angular strip conclusions. -/
structure ApproachingContinuum (x : ℂ) (K : Set ℂ) (v : ℂ) where
  center_mem : x∈K
  r : ℕ → ℝ
  w : ℕ → ℂ
  r_pos : ∀n,0<r n
  r_tendsto : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0)
  w_unit : ∀n,‖w n‖=1
  w_tendsto : Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 v)
  point_mem : ∀n,x+(r n : ℂ)*w n∈K
lemma ApproachingContinuum.outer_strip {x : ℂ} {K : Set ℂ} {v e : ℂ}
    (h : ApproachingContinuum x K v) (he : ‖e‖=1) (hv : 0<⟪e,v⟫) :
    ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,1<r → r<1+δ →
      x+(r : ℂ)*e'∈Straddle K := by
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := (approaching_direction_inside h.r_pos h.r_tendsto h.w_unit h.w_tendsto he hv).exists
  apply outer_straddle_strip h.center_mem (h.point_mem n) he
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_add_left_eq_sub] using hn
lemma ApproachingContinuum.inner_strip {x : ℂ} {K : Set ℂ} {v e : ℂ}
    (h : ApproachingContinuum x K v) (he : ‖e‖=1) (hv : ⟪e,v⟫<0) :
    ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,0<r → 1-δ<r → r<1 →
      x+(r : ℂ)*e'∈Straddle K := by
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := (approaching_direction_outside h.r_pos h.r_tendsto h.w_unit h.w_tendsto he hv).exists
  apply inner_straddle_strip h.center_mem (h.point_mem n) he
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_add_left_eq_sub] using hn
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma continuum_outer_restriction {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (E : Finset ι)
    {x : ℂ} {K : ι → Set ℂ} {v : ι → ℂ} (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    {J : Finset (Fin k)}
    (hJ : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,(∀i∈E,z∈Straddle (K i)) → c z∈J) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,(∀i∈E,0<⟪direction t,v i⟫) → (palette c hc x t∩J).Nonempty := by
  classical
  apply ae_of_locally_ae angularMeasure
  intro t ht
  have hex (i : E) := (hK i).outer_strip (direction_norm t) (ht i i.2)
  choose d hd hs using hex
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,_,hδd⟩ := finite_positive_lower_bound Finset.univ d (fun i _ => hd i)
  let W : Set ℂ := ⋂i : E,Straddle (K i)
  have ho : IsOpen W := isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i => straddle_isOpen (K i)
  have hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J := hJ.mono fun z hz hzW => hz
    (fun i hi => mem_iInter.mp hzW ⟨i,hi⟩)
  exact outer_strip_trace c hc hδ ho hW (fun u hu r hr hrδ => by
    apply mem_iInter.mpr
    intro i
    apply hs i (direction u) (direction_norm u) (hu.trans_le (hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _))) r hr
    linarith [hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _)])
lemma continuum_inner_restriction {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (E : Finset ι)
    {x : ℂ} {K : ι → Set ℂ} {v : ι → ℂ} (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    {J : Finset (Fin k)}
    (hJ : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,(∀i∈E,z∈Straddle (K i)) → c z∈J) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,(∀i∈E,⟪direction t,v i⟫<0) → (palette c hc x t∩J).Nonempty := by
  classical
  apply ae_of_locally_ae angularMeasure
  intro t ht
  have hex (i : E) := (hK i).inner_strip (direction_norm t) (ht i i.2)
  choose d hd hs using hex
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,_,hδd⟩ := finite_positive_lower_bound Finset.univ d (fun i _ => hd i)
  let W : Set ℂ := ⋂i : E,Straddle (K i)
  have ho : IsOpen W := isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i => straddle_isOpen (K i)
  have hW : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈J := hJ.mono fun z hz hzW => hz
    (fun i hi => mem_iInter.mp hzW ⟨i,hi⟩)
  exact inner_strip_trace c hc hδ ho hW (fun u hu r hr hrδ hr1 => by
    apply mem_iInter.mpr
    intro i
    apply hs i (direction u) (direction_norm u) (hu.trans_le (hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _))) r hr
    · linarith [hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _)]
    · exact hr1)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k)
/-- The manuscript's essential spatial color support. -/
def spatialSupport (i : Fin k) : Set ℂ := (volume.restrict {z | c z=i}).support
lemma mem_spatialSupport_ae (hc : Measurable c) (i : Fin k) :
    ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,c z=i → z∈spatialSupport c i :=
  (ae_restrict_iff' (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const)).mp
    (volume.restrict {z | c z=i}).support_mem_ae
lemma support_exclusion_ae (hc : Measurable c) {i : Fin k} {W : Set ℂ}
    (h : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) W) : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z≠i := by
  filter_upwards [mem_spatialSupport_ae c hc i] with z hz hzW hzcol
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp h (hz hzcol) hzW
lemma finite_support_exclusion_ae (hc : Measurable c) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (K : ι → Set ℂ) (F : ι → Finset (Fin k))
    (h : ∀i,∀j∈F i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) :
    ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,∀i,z∈Straddle (K i) → c z∉F i := by
  have hh : ∀i,∀j,∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,j∈F i → z∈Straddle (K i) → c z≠j := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hj : j∈F i
    · exact (support_exclusion_ae c hc (h i j hj)).mono fun z hz _ => hz
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ h => (hj h).elim
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_all_iff.mpr (hh i))] with z hz i hi hj
  exact hz i (c z) hj hi rfl
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def angleEssential (s : Angles → Bool) (b : Bool) : Set Angles :=
  {t | ∃U : Set Angles,IsOpen U ∧ t∈U ∧ ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈U → s u=b}
lemma angleEssential_open (s : Angles → Bool) (b : Bool) : IsOpen (angleEssential s b) := by
  apply isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.mpr
  rintro t ⟨U,hU,ht,ha⟩
  exact ⟨U,fun u hu => ⟨U,hU,hu,ha⟩,hU,ht⟩
lemma angleEssential_ae (s : Angles → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈angleEssential s b → s t=b := ae_of_locally_ae angularMeasure (fun _ h => h)
lemma angleEssential_disjoint (s : Angles → Bool) {a b : Bool} (hab : a≠b) :
    Disjoint (angleEssential s a) (angleEssential s b) := by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  rintro t ⟨U,hU,ht,ha⟩ ⟨V,hV,ht',hb⟩
  have hpos := (hU.inter hV).measure_pos angularMeasure ⟨t,ht,ht'⟩
  obtain ⟨u,hu,huab⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos.ne' (ae_restrict_of_ae (ha.and hb))
  exact hab ((huab.1 hu.1).symm.trans (huab.2 hu.2))
def angleBoundary (s : Angles → Bool) : Set Angles := (⋃b,angleEssential s b)ᶜ
lemma angleBoundary_closed (s : Angles → Bool) : IsClosed (angleBoundary s) :=
  (isOpen_iUnion (angleEssential_open s)).isClosed_compl
lemma angleEssential_shift {s : Angles → Bool}
    (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) (t : Angles) (b : Bool) :
    t+(sixty : Angles)∈angleEssential s (!b) ↔ t∈angleEssential s b := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U,hU,ht,ha⟩
    refine ⟨(fun q : Angles => q+(sixty : Angles)) ⁻¹' U,hU.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const),ht,?_⟩
    filter_upwards [(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae ha,hf] with q hq hqf hqU
    have hh := hq hqU
    rw [hqf] at hh
    exact Bool.not_injective hh
  · rintro ⟨U,hU,ht,ha⟩
    refine ⟨(fun q : Angles => q-(sixty : Angles)) ⁻¹' U,hU.preimage (continuous_id.sub continuous_const),by simpa,?_⟩
    have hh := (measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (-(sixty : Angles))).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ha.and hf)
    filter_upwards [hh] with q hq hqU
    have hcol := hq.1 hqU
    have hflip := hq.2
    change s (q-(sixty : Angles))=b at hcol
    simpa only [←sub_eq_add_neg,sub_add_cancel,hcol] using hflip
lemma angleBoundary_shift {s : Angles → Bool}
    (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) (t : Angles) :
    t+(sixty : Angles)∈angleBoundary s ↔ t∈angleBoundary s := by
  simp only [angleBoundary,mem_compl_iff,mem_iUnion,not_exists]
  constructor
  · intro h b hb
    exact h (!b) ((angleEssential_shift hf t b).mpr hb)
  · intro h b hb
    apply h (!b)
    apply (angleEssential_shift hf t (!b)).mp
    simpa only [Bool.not_not] using hb
lemma angleBoundary_nonempty {s : Angles → Bool}
    (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) : (angleBoundary s).Nonempty := by
  by_contra hn
  have hcov : (univ : Set Angles)⊆angleEssential s false∪angleEssential s true := by
    intro t _
    have ht : t∉angleBoundary s := fun h => hn ⟨t,h⟩
    simp only [angleBoundary,mem_compl_iff,not_not,mem_iUnion] at ht
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := ht
    cases b
    · exact Or.inl hb
    · exact Or.inr hb
  have hzero := hcov (mem_univ (0:Angles))
  have hconst : ∃b,∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s t=b := by
    rcases hzero with h0|h0
    · have hs := isPreconnected_univ.subset_left_of_subset_union (angleEssential_open s false)
        (angleEssential_open s true) (angleEssential_disjoint s (by decide)) hcov ⟨0,mem_univ _,h0⟩
      exact ⟨false,(angleEssential_ae s false).mono fun t ht => ht (hs (mem_univ _))⟩
    · have hs := isPreconnected_univ.subset_left_of_subset_union (angleEssential_open s true)
        (angleEssential_open s false) (angleEssential_disjoint s (by decide))
        (by simpa only [union_comm] using hcov) ⟨0,mem_univ _,h0⟩
      exact ⟨true,(angleEssential_ae s true).mono fun t ht => ht (hs (mem_univ _))⟩
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hconst
  have hh : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,False := by
    filter_upwards [hb,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hb,hf] with t ht ht' he
    rw [ht,ht'] at he
    cases b <;> cases he
  exact hh.exists.choose_spec
lemma sixAngle_add (i j : Fin 6) : sixAngle (i+j)=sixAngle i+sixAngle j := by
  induction j using Fin.induction with
  | zero => simp [sixAngle]
  | succ j hj =>
    have he : j.succ=(j.castSucc : Fin 6)+1 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_succ,Fin.val_add,Fin.val_castSucc,Fin.val_one]
      exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)).symm
    rw [he,←add_assoc,sixAngle_step,sixAngle_step,hj]
    abel
lemma sixty_order : addOrderOf (sixty : Angles)=6 := by
  convert (AddCircle.addOrderOf_period_div (p:=2*Real.pi) (by norm_num : 0<(6:ℕ))) using 1
  congr 2
  dsimp [sixty]
  ring
lemma sixAngle_injective : Function.Injective sixAngle := by
  intro i j hij
  apply Fin.ext
  apply nsmul_injOn_Iio_addOrderOf (x := (sixty : Angles))
  · simpa only [sixty_order,mem_Iio] using i.isLt
  · simpa only [sixty_order,mem_Iio] using j.isLt
  · exact hij
def sixAngleHom : Fin 6 →+ Angles where
  toFun := sixAngle
  map_zero' := rfl
  map_add' := sixAngle_add
lemma sixAngle_sub (i j : Fin 6) : sixAngle (i-j)=sixAngle i-sixAngle j := sixAngleHom.map_sub i j
lemma angleBoundary_six {s : Angles → Bool}
    (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) {t : Angles} (ht : t∈angleBoundary s)
    (j : Fin 6) : t+sixAngle j∈angleBoundary s := by
  have hh (n : ℕ) : t+n•(sixty : Angles)∈angleBoundary s := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using ht
    | succ n ih =>
      simpa only [add_nsmul,one_nsmul,←add_assoc] using (angleBoundary_shift hf (t+n•(sixty : Angles))).mpr ih
  exact hh j.val
lemma six_antipodal_vertex_cover : ∀b : Fin 6 → Bool,
    (∀j,b (j+3)=b j) → (∀j,b j=true ∨ b (j+1)=true) →
      4≤(Finset.univ.filter fun j => b j=true).card := by decide
/-- Core finite obstruction behind the one-orbit boundary theorem. -/
lemma angleBoundary_one_orbit {s : Angles → Bool}
    (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) (B : Finset Angles)
    (hB : B.card≤6) (hanti : ∀t,t+(Real.pi : Angles)∈B ↔ t∈B)
    (hl : ∀t,t∉B → t+(sixty : Angles)∉B → ∃b,t∈angleEssential s b) :
    ∃t,angleBoundary s={u | ∃j : Fin 6,u=t+sixAngle j} := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := angleBoundary_nonempty hf
  let O (q : Angles) : Finset Angles := Finset.univ.image (fun j : Fin 6 => q+sixAngle j)
  have hcard (q : Angles) (hq : q∈angleBoundary s) : 4≤(B∩O q).card := by
    let b : Fin 6 → Bool := fun j => decide (q+sixAngle j∈B)
    have ha (j) : b (j+3)=b j := by
      simp only [b,sixAngle_half,←add_assoc,hanti]
    have hc (j) : b j=true ∨ b (j+1)=true := by
      by_contra hn
      have hh : q+sixAngle j∉B ∧ q+sixAngle (j+1)∉B := by simpa only [b,decide_eq_true_eq,not_or] using hn
      obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hl (q+sixAngle j) hh.1 (by simpa only [sixAngle_step,←add_assoc] using hh.2)
      exact (angleBoundary_six hf hq j) (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨v,hv⟩)
    have hcount := six_antipodal_vertex_cover b ha hc
    have hi : Function.Injective (fun j : Fin 6 => q+sixAngle j) := (add_right_injective q).comp sixAngle_injective
    have him : (Finset.univ.filter fun j => b j=true).image (fun j : Fin 6 => q+sixAngle j)=B∩O q := by
      ext u
      simp only [Finset.mem_image,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,b,decide_eq_true_eq,
        Finset.mem_inter,O]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j,hj,rfl⟩; exact ⟨hj,j,rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨hu,j,rfl⟩; exact ⟨j,hu,rfl⟩
    rw [←him,Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hi]
    exact hcount
  refine ⟨t,Set.ext fun u => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro hu
    by_contra hn
    have hd : Disjoint (O t) (O u) := by
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro q hqt hqu
      obtain ⟨i,_,hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hqt
      obtain ⟨j,_,hj⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hqu
      apply hn
      refine ⟨i-j,?_⟩
      rw [sixAngle_sub]
      have he : t+sixAngle i=u+sixAngle j := hi.trans hj.symm
      calc u = (u+sixAngle j)-sixAngle j := by abel
           _ = (t+sixAngle i)-sixAngle j := by rw [he]
           _ = t+(sixAngle i-sixAngle j) := by abel
    have hd' : Disjoint (B∩O t) (B∩O u) := hd.mono Finset.inter_subset_right Finset.inter_subset_right
    have hh := Finset.card_le_card (show (B∩O t)∪(B∩O u)⊆B from Finset.union_subset Finset.inter_subset_left Finset.inter_subset_left)
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hd'] at hh
    have hct := hcard t ht
    have hcu := hcard u hu
    omega
  · rintro ⟨j,rfl⟩
    exact angleBoundary_six hf ht j
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Exclusion.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Exclusion.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.AngularBoundary

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def fiveDiag (i : Fin 5) : Finset (Fin 5) := {i,i+2}
def fiveAdj (i j : Fin 5) : Prop := i+1=j ∨ j+1=i
instance (i j : Fin 5) : Decidable (fiveAdj i j) := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∨ _))
def fiveEdge (i : Fin 5) : Finset (Fin 5) := {i,i+1}
def FiveAdmissible (p : Finset (Fin 5)) : Prop :=
  p.Nonempty ∧ p.card≤2 ∧ ∀ i : Fin 5, ¬p⊆fiveEdge i
def fiveCanonical (p : Finset (Fin 5)) : Fin 5 :=
  if p=fiveDiag 0 then 0 else if p=fiveDiag 1 then 1 else if p=fiveDiag 2 then 2 else
    if p=fiveDiag 3 then 3 else 4
lemma five_admissible_diag : ∀p : Finset (Fin 5), FiveAdmissible p → p=fiveDiag (fiveCanonical p) := by
  unfold FiveAdmissible
  decide
lemma five_diag_disjoint : ∀i j : Fin 5, Disjoint (fiveDiag i) (fiveDiag j) ↔ fiveAdj i j := by decide
lemma five_diag_nonempty (i : Fin 5) : (fiveDiag i).Nonempty := ⟨i,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
lemma five_diag_unique : ∀i j : Fin 5, fiveDiag i=fiveDiag j → i=j := by decide
lemma five_adj_four : ∀i j : Fin 5, fiveAdj i j → ∃ X : Fin 5, ∀k, k∉fiveDiag i∪fiveDiag j ↔ k=X := by decide
lemma five_no_common_adj : ∀I : Finset (Fin 5), I.Nonempty → (∀k,∃i∈I,k∉fiveDiag i) →
    ∃i∈I,∃j∈I,fiveAdj i j := by decide
lemma five_forced_label : ∀i j X : Fin 5, fiveAdj i j →
    (∀k,k∉fiveDiag i∪fiveDiag j ↔ k=X) → ∀p : Finset (Fin 5),
    Disjoint p (fiveDiag i) → ¬p⊆fiveDiag j → X∈p := by decide
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Labels allowed on the side selected by `b`; a label survives precisely when
both of its incident edges have the opposite sign. -/
def sideAllowed (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (b : Bool) : Finset (Fin 5) :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun i => s (i-1)≠b ∧ s i≠b
/-- Both actual one-sided strip restrictions on a palette. -/
def SideCompatible (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (p : Finset (Fin 5)) : Prop :=
  p.card≤2 ∧ (p∩sideAllowed s true).Nonempty ∧ (p∩sideAllowed s false).Nonempty
instance (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (p : Finset (Fin 5)) : Decidable (SideCompatible s p) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_∧_∧_))
lemma side_compatible_diagonal : ∀s : Fin 5 → Bool,∀p : Finset (Fin 5),
    SideCompatible s p → p=fiveDiag (fiveCanonical p) := by decide
lemma side_compatible_options : ∀s : Fin 5 → Bool,∀i j : Fin 5,
    SideCompatible s (fiveDiag i) → SideCompatible s (fiveDiag j) →
    j=i ∨ j=i+2 ∨ j=i-2 := by decide
lemma side_allowed_not (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (b : Bool) :
    sideAllowed (fun i => !(s i)) b=sideAllowed s (!b) := by
  ext i
  simp only [sideAllowed,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
  cases hb : b <;> cases h0 : s (i-1) <;> cases h1 : s i <;> decide
lemma side_compatible_not (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (p : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    SideCompatible (fun i => !(s i)) p ↔ SideCompatible s p := by
  simp only [SideCompatible,side_allowed_not,Bool.not_true,Bool.not_false]
  tauto
lemma five_triple_forced : ∀a b c d : Fin 5,
    fiveAdj a b → fiveAdj b c → fiveAdj c d → (d=a ∨ d=a+2 ∨ d=a-2) →
    b=a+1 ∧ c=b+1 ∧ d=c+1 ∨ a=b+1 ∧ b=c+1 ∧ c=d+1 := by decide
lemma five_six_constant_steps_impossible : ∀a b c d e f : Fin 5,
    (b=a+1 ∧ c=b+1 ∧ d=c+1 ∨ a=b+1 ∧ b=c+1 ∧ c=d+1) →
    (e=d+1 ∧ f=e+1 ∧ a=f+1 ∨ d=e+1 ∧ e=f+1 ∧ f=a+1) →
    (c=b+1 ∧ d=c+1 ∧ e=d+1 ∨ b=c+1 ∧ c=d+1 ∧ d=e+1) → False := by decide
lemma five_word_impossible (p : Fin 6 → Fin 5)
    (ha : ∀j,fiveAdj (p j) (p (j+1)))
    (ho : ∀j,p (j+3)=p j ∨ p (j+3)=p j+2 ∨ p (j+3)=p j-2) : False := by
  have h0 := five_triple_forced (p 0) (p 1) (p 2) (p 3) (ha 0) (ha 1) (ha 2) (ho 0)
  have h3 := five_triple_forced (p 3) (p 4) (p 5) (p 0) (ha 3) (ha 4) (ha 5) (ho 3)
  have h1 := five_triple_forced (p 1) (p 2) (p 3) (p 4) (ha 1) (ha 2) (ha 3) (ho 1)
  exact five_six_constant_steps_impossible _ _ _ _ _ _ h0 h3 h1
lemma five_strip_orbit_impossible (s : Fin 6 → Fin 5 → Bool) (P : Fin 6 → Finset (Fin 5))
    (hp : ∀j,SideCompatible (s j) (P j))
    (hopp : ∀j i,s (j+3) i= !(s j i))
    (hdis : ∀j,Disjoint (P j) (P (j+1))) : False := by
  let p : Fin 6 → Fin 5 := fun j => fiveCanonical (P j)
  have he (j) : P j=fiveDiag (p j) := side_compatible_diagonal (s j) (P j) (hp j)
  apply five_word_impossible p
  · intro j
    exact (five_diag_disjoint _ _).mp (by rw [← he,← he]; exact hdis j)
  · intro j
    apply side_compatible_options (s j)
    · rw [← he]; exact hp j
    · have ho : s (j+3)=(fun i => !(s j i)) := funext (hopp j)
      have hh := hp (j+3)
      rw [ho,side_compatible_not,he] at hh
      exact hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def angularSign (v : Fin 5 → ℂ) (t : Angles) (i : Fin 5) : Bool := decide (0<⟪direction t,v i⟫)
lemma angularSign_opposite {v : Fin 5 → ℂ} {t : Angles} (h : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) :
    ∀i,angularSign v (t+(Real.pi : Angles)) i= !(angularSign v t i) := by
  intro i
  simp only [angularSign,direction_add_pi,inner_neg_left]
  by_cases hi : 0<⟪direction t,v i⟫
  · simp only [hi,show ¬0< -⟪direction t,v i⟫ by linarith,decide_true,decide_false,Bool.not_true]
  · have hn : ⟪direction t,v i⟫<0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hi) (h i)
    simp only [hi,show 0< -⟪direction t,v i⟫ by linarith,decide_true,decide_false,Bool.not_false]
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma five_sides_compatible (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ}
    {K : Fin 5 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 5 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1)
    (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    (hH : ∀i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle (K i)) ∧
      Disjoint (spatialSupport c (i+1)) (Straddle (K i))) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,SideCompatible (angularSign v t) (palette c hc x t) := by
  let E (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (b : Bool) : Finset (Fin 5) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i=b
  have hex := finite_support_exclusion_ae c hc K (fun i => {i,i+1})
    (fun i j hj => by
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl|hj
      · exact (hH _).1
      · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hj; subst j; exact (hH _).2)
  have hJ (s : Fin 5 → Bool) (b : Bool) :
      ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,(∀i∈E s b,z∈Straddle (K i)) → c z∈sideAllowed s b := by
    filter_upwards [hex] with z hz hzE
    simp only [sideAllowed,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
    constructor
    · intro he
      have hmem : c z-1∈E s b := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,he⟩
      apply hz (c z-1) (hzE _ hmem)
      simp
    · intro he
      have hmem : c z∈E s b := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,he⟩
      exact hz (c z) (hzE _ hmem) (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  have hout (s : Fin 5 → Bool) := continuum_outer_restriction c hc (E s true) hK (hJ s true)
  have hin (s : Fin 5 → Bool) := continuum_inner_restriction c hc (E s false) hK (hJ s false)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hout,ae_all_iff.mpr hin,palette_cardinality c hc hw x,
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i))] with t ho hi hp hn
  refine ⟨hp.2,ho (angularSign v t) ?_,hi (angularSign v t) ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    have hh : angularSign v t i=true := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    exact of_decide_eq_true hh
  · intro i hi
    have hh : angularSign v t i=false := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have hn' : ¬0<⟪direction t,v i⟫ := of_decide_eq_false hh
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hn') (hn i)
include hc in
/-- Actual five-cycle angular obstruction under exactly the directional and
common-support-exclusion data extracted in source Proposition interface-cycle.
This does not assert that such data have been extracted. -/
lemma no_five_exclusion_continua (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ}
    {K : Fin 5 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 5 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1)
    (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    (hH : ∀i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle (K i)) ∧
      Disjoint (spatialSupport c (i+1)) (Straddle (K i))) : False := by
  have hh := (five_sides_compatible c hc hw hv hK hH).and
    ((palette_sixty_disjoint c hc hw x).and (ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i))))
  have hshift (j : Fin 6) := (measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixAngle j)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hh
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := (ae_all_iff.mpr hshift).exists
  apply five_strip_orbit_impossible
    (fun j => angularSign v (t+sixAngle j)) (fun j => palette c hc x (t+sixAngle j))
  · intro j; exact (ht j).1
  · intro j i
    rw [sixAngle_half,← add_assoc]
    exact angularSign_opposite (ht j).2.2 i
  · intro j
    rw [sixAngle_step,← add_assoc]
    exact (ht j).2.1
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/FourContinuity.lean

import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.States

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma four_avoiding_traces (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) :
    ∃ b : Fin 4 → TraceVector 5, (∀e,IsTrace c hc x (b e)) ∧
      ∀e,∀i∈fourEdge e,traceValue (b e) i=0 := by
  have hh (i j : Fin 5) (he : TransitionEdge c i j x) :
      ∃ b : TraceVector 5, IsTrace c hc x b ∧ ∀a∈({i,j} : Finset (Fin 5)),traceValue b a=0 := by
    obtain ⟨b,hb,hi,hj⟩ := transition_avoiding_trace c hc hw he
    refine ⟨b,hb,?_⟩
    intro a ha
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
    rcases ha with rfl|rfl <;> assumption
  have he (e : Fin 4) : ∃ b : TraceVector 5, IsTrace c hc x b ∧ ∀i∈fourEdge e,traceValue b i=0 := by
    fin_cases e
    · exact hh 0 1 hx.1
    · exact hh 1 2 hx.2.1
    · exact hh 2 3 hx.2.2.1
    · exact hh 3 0 hx.2.2.2
  choose b hb hz using he
  exact ⟨b,hb,hz⟩
lemma four_state_trace_domination (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x)
    (b : Fin 4 → TraceVector 5) (hb : ∀e,IsTrace c hc x (b e))
    (hz : ∀e,∀i∈fourEdge e,traceValue (b e) i=0) (s : Fin 3) {i : Fin 5} (hi : i∈fourGroup s) :
    {t | fourState c hc x t=s}.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) ≤ᵐ[angularMeasure]
      (fun t => ∑e,traceValue (b e) i t) := by
  have hs (e : Fin 4) : (fun t => ∑a,traceValue (b e) a t)=ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (traceValue (b e))
    rw [(trace_bounds c hc (hb e)).2.2] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  have hzero (e : Fin 4) (a : Fin 5) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,a∈fourEdge e → traceValue (b e) a t=0 := by
    by_cases ha : a∈fourEdge e
    · rw [hz e a ha]
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_zero ℝ 2 angularMeasure] with t ht
      exact fun _ => ht
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ => fun h => (ha h).elim
  filter_upwards [four_palette_admissible c hc hw hx,
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr fun a => (trace_bounds c hc (hb e)).1 a),
    ae_all_iff.mpr hs,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr (hzero e)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr fun a => tracePositive_le_palette c hc x a ⟨b e,hb e⟩)]
    with t hadm hnon hsum hzero hpal
  by_cases hts : fourState c hc x t=s
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show t∈{t | fourState c hc x t=s} from hts)]
    obtain ⟨e,_,hep⟩ := four_trace_edge (palette c hc x t) hadm i (by simpa only [← hts, fourState] using hi)
    have hj (a : Fin 5) (ha : a≠i) : traceValue (b e) a t=0 := by
      by_cases he : a∈fourEdge e
      · exact hzero e a he
      · apply le_antisymm _ (hnon e a)
        by_contra! hpos
        have hp := (mem_palette c hc x t a).mpr (hpal e a hpos)
        exact he (hep (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hp,by simpa using ha⟩))
    have heq : traceValue (b e) i t=1 := by
      rw [← hsum e,Finset.sum_eq_single i _ (by simp)]
      intro a _ hai
      exact hj a hai
    rw [← heq]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hnon j i) (Finset.mem_univ e)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t∉{t | fourState c hc x t=s} from hts)]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun e _ => hnon e i)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Y] {μ : Measure Y} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
def indL2 (A : Set Y) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : RealL2 μ :=
  indicatorConstLp 2 hA (measure_ne_top μ A) 1
lemma indL2_ae (A : Set Y) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    indL2 (μ := μ) A hA =ᵐ[μ] A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := indicatorConstLp_coeFn
lemma indL2_nonneg (A : Set Y) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : 0≤ᵐ[μ] indL2 (μ := μ) A hA := by
  filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := μ) A hA] with t ht
  rw [ht]
  exact indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _
lemma indL2_le_one (A : Set Y) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : indL2 (μ := μ) A hA≤ᵐ[μ] (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
  filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := μ) A hA] with t ht
  rw [ht]
  exact indicator_le_self' (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _
lemma indL2_norm (A : Set Y) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : ‖indL2 (μ := μ) A hA‖≤1 := by
  have hh : ∀ᵐt∂μ,‖indL2 (μ := μ) A hA t‖≤1 := by
    filter_upwards [indL2_nonneg (μ := μ) A hA,indL2_le_one (μ := μ) A hA] with t ht hu
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg ht]
  simpa [measureUnivNNReal] using Lp.norm_le_of_ae_bound (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1) hh
lemma indL2_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    {s : Y → ι} (hs : Measurable s) :
    ∑ i, indL2 (μ := μ) {t | s t=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hs measurable_const)=oneL2 μ := by
  apply Lp.ext
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i => indL2 (μ := μ) {t | s t=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hs measurable_const)),
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => indL2_ae (μ := μ) {t | s t=i} (measurableSet_eq_fun hs measurable_const)),oneL2_ae μ] with t ht ha hu
  rw [ht,hu]
  simp only [ha,Set.indicator_apply,mem_ofPred_eq]
  simp
lemma weak_limit_le {f g : ℕ → RealL2 μ} {a b : RealL2 μ}
    (hf : ∀v,Tendsto (fun n => ⟪f n,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪a,v⟫))
    (hg : ∀v,Tendsto (fun n => ⟪g n,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪b,v⟫))
    (hle : ∀n,f n≤ᵐ[μ] g n) : a≤ᵐ[μ] b := by
  have hh : 0≤ᵐ[μ] b-a := weak_limit_nonneg μ (f := fun n => g n-f n)
    (fun v => by simpa only [inner_sub_left] using (hg v).sub (hf v)) (fun n => by
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (g n) (f n),hle n] with t ht hh
      simpa only [ht,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.zero_apply,sub_nonneg] using hh)
  filter_upwards [hh,Lp.coeFn_sub b a] with t ht he
  simpa only [he,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.zero_apply,sub_nonneg] using ht
lemma indL2_weak_L1 {A : ℕ → Set Y} (hA : ∀n,MeasurableSet (A n)) {B : Set Y} (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (hw : ∀v : RealL2 μ,Tendsto (fun n => ⟪indL2 (A n) (hA n),v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪indL2 B hB,v⟫)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫t,‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-B.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hone (w : RealL2 μ) : ⟪w,oneL2 μ⟫=∫t,w t ∂μ := by
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    simpa only [oneL2,setIntegral_univ] using
      L2.inner_indicatorConstLp_one MeasurableSet.univ (measure_ne_top μ univ) w
  have hBB : ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,indL2 B hB⟫=⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫ := by
    rw [hone,L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := μ) B hB] with t ht
    rw [ht]
    by_cases hb : t∈B <;> simp [hb]
  have he (n : ℕ) : (∫t,‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-B.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖ ∂μ) =
      ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) (A n) (hA n),oneL2 μ⟫+⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫-
      2*⟪indL2 (μ := μ) (A n) (hA n),indL2 (μ := μ) B hB⟫ := by
    rw [hone,hone,L2.inner_def,← integral_const_mul,← integral_add,
      ← integral_sub]
    · apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := μ) (A n) (hA n),indL2_ae (μ := μ) B hB] with t ht hu
      rw [ht,hu]
      by_cases ha : t∈A n <;> by_cases hb : t∈B <;> norm_num [ha,hb]
    · exact ((Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num)).add ((Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num))
    · exact (L2.integrable_inner _ _).const_mul 2
    · exact (Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num)
    · exact (Lp.memLp _).integrable (by norm_num)
  simp_rw [he]
  have ht := ((hw (oneL2 μ)).add_const ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫).sub
    ((hw (indL2 (μ := μ) B hB)).const_mul 2)
  rw [hBB,show ⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB, oneL2 μ⟫+⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫-
    2*⟪indL2 (μ := μ) B hB,oneL2 μ⟫=0 by ring] at ht
  exact ht
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory

namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fourStateL2 (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : RealL2 angularMeasure :=
  indL2 {t | fourState c hc x t=s} (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const)
lemma four_weak_limit_identify (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y)
    (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) {f : Fin 3 → RealL2 angularMeasure}
    (hf : ∀s v,Tendsto (fun n => ⟪fourStateL2 c hc (x n) s,v⟫) atTop (𝓝 ⟪f s,v⟫))
    (b : ℕ → Fin 4 → TraceVector 5) (a : Fin 4 → TraceVector 5)
    (hb : ∀n e,IsTrace c hc (x n) (b n e))
    (hz : ∀n e,∀i∈fourEdge e,traceValue (b n e) i=0)
    (ht : ∀e,Tendsto (fun n => b n e) atTop (𝓝 (a e))) :
    ∀s,f s=fourStateL2 c hc y s := by
  have hat (e : Fin 4) : IsTrace c hc y (a e) := trace_limit c hc (fun n => hb n e) hxt (ht e)
  have hdom (s : Fin 3) (i : Fin 5) (hi : i∈fourGroup s) :
      f s≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] (∑e,traceValue (a e) i : RealL2 angularMeasure) := by
    apply weak_limit_le (hf s) (f := fun n => fourStateL2 c hc (x n) s)
      (g := fun n => ∑e,traceValue (b n e) i)
      (fun v => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
    · simpa only [sum_inner] using tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ
        (fun e _ => traceCode_tendsto_iff.mp (ht e) i v)
    · filter_upwards [indL2_ae (μ := angularMeasure) {t | fourState c hc (x n) t=s}
        (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc (x n)) measurable_const),
        Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun e => traceValue (b n e) i),
        four_state_trace_domination c hc hw (hx n) (b n) (hb n) (hz n) s hi] with t h₁ h₂ h₃
      simpa only [fourStateL2,h₁,h₂] using h₃
  have hnon (s : Fin 3) : 0≤ᵐ[angularMeasure] f s :=
    weak_limit_nonneg angularMeasure (hf s) (fun n => indL2_nonneg _ _)
  have hsumf : ∑s,f s=oneL2 angularMeasure :=
    weak_limit_sum angularMeasure hf (fun n => indL2_sum (fourState_measurable c hc (x n)))
  have hsupport (s : Fin 3) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,0<f s t → fourGroup s⊆palette c hc y t := by
    have hdom' (i : Fin 5) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,i∈fourGroup s → f s t≤∑e,traceValue (a e) i t := by
      by_cases hi : i∈fourGroup s
      · filter_upwards [hdom s i hi,Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun e => traceValue (a e) i)] with t ht he
        exact fun _ => by simpa only [he] using ht
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ h => (hi h).elim
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hdom',
      ae_all_iff.mpr (fun e => ae_all_iff.mpr fun i => tracePositive_le_palette c hc y i ⟨a e,hat e⟩)] with t hdom hpal hp i hi
    have hsum : 0<∑e,traceValue (a e) i t := hp.trans_le (hdom i hi)
    have hex : ∃e,0<traceValue (a e) i t := by
      by_contra! hh
      exact hsum.not_ge (Finset.sum_nonpos fun e _ => hh e)
    obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := hex
    exact (mem_palette c hc y t i).mpr (hpal e i he)
  intro s
  apply Lp.ext
  have hsumae : (fun t => ∑s,f s t)=ᵐ[angularMeasure] (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) := by
    have hh := Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum Finset.univ f
    rw [hsumf] at hh
    exact hh.symm.trans (oneL2_ae angularMeasure)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hnon,ae_all_iff.mpr hsupport,hsumae,
    four_palette_admissible c hc hw hy,
    indL2_ae (μ := angularMeasure) {t | fourState c hc y t=s}
      (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc y) measurable_const)] with t hn hp hsum hadm hi
  change f s t=indL2 (μ := angularMeasure) {t | fourState c hc y t=s} _ t
  rw [hi]
  have hz (v : Fin 3) (hv : v≠fourState c hc y t) : f v t=0 := by
    apply le_antisymm _ (hn v)
    by_contra! hh
    have he := (four_admissible_character (palette c hc y t) hadm v).mp (hp v hh)
    exact hv he.symm
  by_cases he : fourState c hc y t=s
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show t∈{t | fourState c hc y t=s} from he)]
    rw [← hsum,Finset.sum_eq_single s _ (by simp)]
    intro v _ hvs
    exact hz v (by simpa only [he] using hvs)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t∉{t | fourState c hc y t=s} from he)]
    exact hz s (Ne.symm he)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fourStateDistance (x y : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  ∫t,‖{t | fourState c hc x t=s}.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-
    {t | fourState c hc y t=s}.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖ ∂angularMeasure
lemma four_state_subseq_continuity (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y)
    (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) :
    ∃φ : ℕ → ℕ,StrictMono φ ∧ ∀s,Tendsto (fun n => fourStateDistance c hc (x (φ n)) y s) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨f,φ,hφ,_,hf⟩ := exists_finite_weak_subseq (fun n s => fourStateL2 c hc (x n) s) 1
    (fun _ _ => indL2_norm _ _)
  choose b hb hz using fun n => four_avoiding_traces c hc hw (hx (φ n))
  obtain ⟨a,_,ψ,hψ,ha⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (univ : Set (Fin 4 → TraceVector 5))).isSeqCompact
    (fun n => mem_univ (b n))
  have hid := four_weak_limit_identify c hc hw (fun n => hx (φ (ψ n))) hy
    (hxt.comp (hφ.tendsto_atTop.comp hψ.tendsto_atTop))
    (fun s v => (hf s v).comp hψ.tendsto_atTop) (fun n => b (ψ n)) a
    (fun n => hb (ψ n)) (fun n => hz (ψ n))
    (fun e => (continuous_apply e).tendsto a |>.comp ha)
  refine ⟨φ∘ψ,hφ.comp hψ,?_⟩
  intro s
  apply indL2_weak_L1 (fun n => measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc (x (φ (ψ n)))) measurable_const)
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc y) measurable_const)
  intro v
  have hh := (hf s v).comp hψ.tendsto_atTop
  rw [hid s] at hh
  exact hh
lemma four_state_continuity (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y)
    (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) (s : Fin 3) :
    Tendsto (fun n => fourStateDistance c hc (x n) y s) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  by_contra hn
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at hn
  push Not at hn
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,he⟩ := hn
  choose m hm using he
  have hmt : Tendsto m atTop atTop := tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n => (hm n).1) tendsto_id
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ,ht⟩ := four_state_subseq_continuity c hc hw (fun n => hx (m n)) hy (hxt.comp hmt)
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp (ht s) ε hε
  exact (hm (φ N)).2.not_gt (hN N le_rfl)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma angleMk_compact_bound {E : Set ℝ} (hE : IsCompact E) :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0, (volume.restrict E).map ((↑) : ℝ → Angles)≤(C:ENNReal) • angularMeasure := by
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := hE.elim_finite_subcover (fun a : ℝ => Ioo (a-Real.pi) (a+Real.pi))
    (fun _ => isOpen_Ioo) (fun a _ => mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨a,by constructor <;> linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩)
  let C : ℝ≥0 := ⟨(F.card:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi),by positivity⟩
  refine ⟨C,Measure.le_iff.mpr (fun A hA => ?_)⟩
  rw [Measure.map_apply angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable hA,
    Measure.restrict_apply (angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable hA),Measure.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  have hsub : ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩E ⊆
      ⋃a∈F,((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩Ioc (a-Real.pi) ((a-Real.pi)+2*Real.pi) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨a,ha,h₁,h₂⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hF ht.2)
    exact mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨a,ha,ht.1,h₁,by linarith⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ volume (⋃a∈F,((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩Ioc (a-Real.pi) ((a-Real.pi)+2*Real.pi)) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ ∑a∈F,volume (((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A∩Ioc (a-Real.pi) ((a-Real.pi)+2*Real.pi)) := measure_biUnion_finset_le F _
    _ = ∑_a∈F,(volume : Measure Angles) A := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      exact (AddCircle.add_projection_respects_measure (2*Real.pi) (a-Real.pi) hA).symm
    _ = (C:ENNReal)*angularMeasure A := by
      rw [AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle]
      simp only [Measure.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul]
      change (F.card:ENNReal)*(ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi)*angularMeasure A)=_
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      congr 1
      rw [show (C:ENNReal)=ENNReal.ofReal ((F.card:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi)) from ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal.symm]
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0≤(F.card:ℝ)),ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
lemma angular_compact_L1 {f : ℕ → Angles → ℝ} {g : Angles → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀n,Integrable (f n) angularMeasure) (hg : Integrable g angularMeasure)
    (ht : Tendsto (fun n => ∫t,‖f n t-g t‖ ∂angularMeasure) atTop (𝓝 0))
    {E : Set ℝ} (hE : IsCompact E) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫t in E,‖f n (t : Angles)-g (t : Angles)‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := angleMk_compact_bound hE
  apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => integral_nonneg fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    (fun n => integral_norm_comp_le angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable hC ((hf n).sub hg))
  simpa only [mul_zero,Pi.sub_apply] using ht.const_mul (C:ℝ)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma support_lower_semicontinuity {A : Set ℝ} {B : ℕ → Set ℝ}
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : ∀n,MeasurableSet (B n))
    (ht : ∀E : Set ℝ,IsCompact E → Tendsto
      (fun n => ∫t in E,‖(B n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖) atTop (𝓝 0))
    {b : ℝ} (hb : b∈(volume.restrict A).support) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε) :
    ∀ᶠn in atTop,∃v∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support,dist v b<ε := by
  let E := Metric.closedBall b (ε/2)
  have hp : 0<(volume.restrict E) A := by
    have hh := (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall b).mp hb (Metric.ball b (ε/2))
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds b (by positivity))
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_ball] at hh
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply hA]
    apply hh.trans_le (measure_mono _)
    exact fun t ht => ⟨ht.2,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall ht.1⟩
  let : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict E) := ⟨by simpa [E] using (isCompact_closedBall b (ε/2)).measure_lt_top (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ))⟩
  have hpos := indicator_inter_positive (μ := volume.restrict E) hA hB (fun _ => hA) hp
    (ht E (isCompact_closedBall _ _)) (by simp)
  filter_upwards [hpos] with n hn
  have hpB : (volume.restrict (B n)) E≠0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_closedBall]
    rw [Measure.restrict_apply ((hB n).inter hA)] at hn
    exact hn.trans_le (measure_mono (fun t ht => ⟨ht.2,ht.1.1⟩))
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hs⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpB (ae_restrict_of_ae (volume.restrict (B n)).support_mem_ae)
  exact ⟨v,hs,(show dist v b≤ε/2 from hv).trans_lt (by linarith)⟩
lemma support_sequence_continuity {A : Set ℝ} {B : ℕ → Set ℝ}
    (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : ∀n,MeasurableSet (B n)) (hpB : ∀n,0<volume (B n))
    (ht : ∀E : Set ℝ,IsCompact E → Tendsto
      (fun n => ∫t in E,‖(B n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-A.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖) atTop (𝓝 0))
    {b : ℝ} (hb : b∈(volume.restrict A).support) :
    ∃v : ℕ → ℝ,(∀n,v n∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support) ∧ Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 b) := by
  have hne (n : ℕ) : (volume.restrict (B n)).support.Nonempty := by
    apply Measure.nonempty_support
    intro he
    have hz := congrArg (fun μ : Measure ℝ => μ univ) he
    exact (hpB n).ne' (by simpa using hz)
  choose v hv hd using fun n => (volume.restrict (B n)).isClosed_support.exists_infDist_eq_dist (hne n) b
  refine ⟨v,hv,Metric.tendsto_atTop.mpr ?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (support_lower_semicontinuity hA hB ht hb hε)
  refine ⟨N,fun n hn => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨w,hw,hwb⟩ := hN n hn
  rw [dist_comm,← hd n]
  exact (Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem hw).trans_lt (by simpa only [dist_comm] using hwb)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma strict_state_uniform_on_compact {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k}
    (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c)
    (x : ℕ → ℂ) (J K : Finset (Fin k)) (X : Fin k)
    (hlabels : ∀i, i∉J∪K ↔ i=X)
    (A B : ℕ → Set ℝ) (D : Set ℝ) (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hp : 0<volume D)
    (hA : ∀n,RealState hc (x n) (A n) J) (hB : ∀n,RealState hc (x n) (B n) K)
    (hL1 : ∀ E : Set ℝ, IsCompact E →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ v in E, ‖(A n).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v-D.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) v‖)
        atTop (𝓝 0))
    {C : Set ℝ} (hC : IsCompact C) :
    ∃ ε>0, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀b∈C, ∀d∈C,
      b∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support → d∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support →
      ε≤|‖direction (b : Angles)-direction (d : Angles)‖-1| := by
  by_contra! hbad
  have hex (N : ℕ) : ∃ n≥N, ∃ b∈C, ∃ d∈C,
      b∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support ∧ d∈(volume.restrict (B n)).support ∧
      |‖direction (b : Angles)-direction (d : Angles)‖-1|<1/(N+1) := by
    have hh := hbad (1/((N:ℝ)+1)) (by positivity)
    simpa only [and_assoc] using (frequently_atTop.mp hh) N
  choose f hf b hb d hd hbs hds hsmall using hex
  have hft : Tendsto f atTop atTop := tendsto_atTop_mono hf tendsto_id
  obtain ⟨q,_hq,φ,hφ,hqt⟩ := (hC.prod hC).isSeqCompact
    (fun n => show (b n,d n)∈C×ˢC from ⟨hb n,hd n⟩)
  have hqb : Tendsto (b∘φ) atTop (𝓝 q.1) := (continuous_fst.tendsto q).comp hqt
  have hqd : Tendsto (d∘φ) atTop (𝓝 q.2) := (continuous_snd.tendsto q).comp hqt
  have hdir : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => direction (v : Angles)) :=
    direction_continuous.comp (AddCircle.continuous_mk' (2*Real.pi))
  have he : ‖direction (q.1 : Angles)-direction (q.2 : Angles)‖=1 := by
    have hn : Tendsto (fun N => |‖direction (b N : Angles)-direction (d N : Angles)‖-1|) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => abs_nonneg _) (fun N => (hsmall N).le)
        tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    have hl := (((hdir.tendsto q.1).comp hqb).sub ((hdir.tendsto q.2).comp hqd)).norm.sub_const 1 |>.abs
    have he := tendsto_nhds_unique hl (hn.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp he)
  apply strict_state_sequence_false hc hw (fun n => x (f (φ n))) J K X hlabels
    (fun n => A (f (φ n))) (fun n => B (f (φ n))) D hD hp
    (fun n => hA (f (φ n))) (fun n => hB (f (φ n)))
    (b∘φ) (d∘φ) q.1 q.2 hqb hqd (fun n => hbs (φ n)) (fun n => hds (φ n)) he
  intro E hE
  exact (hL1 E hE).comp (hft.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma angle_preimage_positive {A : Set Angles} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hp : 0<angularMeasure A) :
    0<volume (((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A) := by
  by_contra! hn
  have hz := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (le_antisymm hn zero_le)
  have ha : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∉A := ae_angular_of_ae_line hA.compl hz
  exact hp.ne' (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr ha)
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fourRealState (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : Set ℝ := {t | fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=s}
def fourSupport (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : Set ℝ := (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x s)).support
lemma four_realState_measurable (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : MeasurableSet (fourRealState c hc x s) :=
  (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const).preimage
    angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable
lemma four_realState_positive (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x)
    {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) : 0<volume (fourRealState c hc x s) :=
  angle_preimage_positive (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const)
    (fourState_diagonal_positive c hc hw hx s hs)
lemma four_realState_continuity (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y)
    (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) (s : Fin 3) {E : Set ℝ} (hE : IsCompact E) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫t in E,‖(fourRealState c hc (x n) s).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t-
      (fourRealState c hc y s).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) t‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  exact angular_compact_L1
    (fun n => (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc (x n)) measurable_const))
    ((integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc y) measurable_const))
    (four_state_continuity c hc hw hx hy hxt s) hE
lemma four_support_continuity (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y)
    (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) {b : ℝ}
    (hb : b∈fourSupport c hc y s) :
    ∃v : ℕ → ℝ,(∀n,v n∈fourSupport c hc (x n) s) ∧ Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 b) :=
  support_sequence_continuity (four_realState_measurable c hc y s)
    (fun n => four_realState_measurable c hc (x n) s)
    (fun n => four_realState_positive c hc hw (hx n) hs)
    (fun _ hE => four_realState_continuity c hc hw hx hy hxt s hE) hb
lemma four_support_sequence_no_unit (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℕ → ℂ} {y : ℂ} (hx : ∀n,FourCenter c (x n)) (hy : FourCenter c y)
    (hxt : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 y)) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0)
    {b d : ℕ → ℝ} {b₀ d₀ : ℝ} (hb : Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 b₀)) (hd : Tendsto d atTop (𝓝 d₀))
    (hbs : ∀n,b n∈fourSupport c hc (x n) s) (hds : ∀n,d n∈fourSupport c hc (x n) s) :
    ‖direction (b₀ : Angles)-direction (d₀ : Angles)‖≠1 := by
  let r : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have hr : r≠0 := by dsimp [r]; split <;> decide
  have hl : ∀i : Fin 5,i∉fourGroup r∪fourGroup s ↔ i=4 := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → ∀i : Fin 5,i∉fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1)∪fourGroup s ↔ i=4 from by decide) s hs
  intro hu
  exact strict_state_sequence_false hc hw x (fourGroup r) (fourGroup s) 4 hl
    (fun n => fourRealState c hc (x n) r) (fun n => fourRealState c hc (x n) s)
    (fourRealState c hc y r) (four_realState_measurable c hc y r)
    (four_realState_positive c hc hw hy hr)
    (fun n => fourState_represents c hc hw (hx n) r) (fun n => fourState_represents c hc hw (hx n) s)
    b d b₀ d₀ hb hd hbs hds hu (fun _ hE => four_realState_continuity c hc hw hx hy hxt r hE)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma plane_antilipschitz_qmp {F : RealPlane → RealPlane} (hF : Measurable F)
    {V : Set RealPlane} {K : ℝ≥0} (hK : AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict F)) :
    Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving F (volume.restrict V) volume := by
  refine ⟨hF,?_⟩
  have hh := map_restrict_volume_le hF MeasurableSet.univ hK (mapsTo_univ F V)
  rw [Measure.restrict_univ] at hh
  exact Measure.absolutelyContinuous_of_le_smul hh
lemma support_prod_real {μ ν : Measure ℝ} [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : a∈μ.support) (hb : b∈ν.support) : (a,b)∈(μ.prod ν).support := by
  apply (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall _).mpr
  intro S hS
  obtain ⟨I,hI,J,hJ,hIJ⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp hS
  apply (ENNReal.mul_pos ((Measure.mem_support_iff_forall _).mp ha I hI).ne'
    ((Measure.mem_support_iff_forall _).mp hb J hJ).ne').trans_le
  rw [← Measure.prod_prod]
  exact measure_mono hIJ
lemma continuousAt_maps_support_closed {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {F : X → Y} {C : Set Y} {p : X}
    (hp : p∈μ.support) (hF : ContinuousAt F p) (hC : IsClosed C)
    (hae : ∀ᵐq∂μ,F q∈C) : F p∈C := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hh : {q | F q∉C}∈𝓝 p := hF (hC.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hnot)
  exact ((Measure.mem_support_iff_forall _).mp hp _ hh).ne' hae
lemma state_support_transport {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k}
    (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x y : ℂ}
    {A B C : Set ℝ} {J K : Finset (Fin k)} {X : Fin k}
    (hA : RealState hc x A J) (hB : RealState hc x B K) (hC : RealState hc y C {X})
    (hlabels : ∀i,i∉J∪K ↔ i=X)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : a∈(volume.restrict A).support) (hb : b∈(volume.restrict B).support)
    {F : RealPlane → RealPlane} (hF : Measurable F) (hFc : ContinuousAt F (a,b))
    {V : Set RealPlane} (hV : IsOpen V) (hab : (a,b)∈V) {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hL : AntilipschitzWith L (V.domRestrict F))
    (hi : ∀q∈V,Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0)
    (ho : ∀q∈V,Real.sin ((F q).2-(F q).1)≠0)
    (heq : ∀q∈V,angularSum x 1 (angleChart q)=angularSum y 1 (angleChart (F q))) :
    F (a,b)∈(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support ×ˢ (volume.restrict Cᶜ).support := by
  have hdA : ∀ᵐq : RealPlane∂volume,q.1∈A → LineDensityZero Aᶜ q.1 := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))).ae (ae_lineDensityZero_compl hA.1)
  have hdB : ∀ᵐq : RealPlane∂volume,q.2∈B → LineDensityZero Bᶜ q.2 := by
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using
      (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))).ae (ae_lineDensityZero_compl hB.1)
  have hdC : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∉(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support → LineDensityZero Cᶜ t := by
    have hs : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈Cᶜ → t∈(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support := by
      exact (ae_restrict_iff' hC.1.compl).mp (volume.restrict Cᶜ).support_mem_ae
    filter_upwards [hs,ae_lineDensityZero_compl hC.1] with t ht hd hn
    apply hd
    by_contra htC
    exact hn (ht htC)
  have hdpair : ∀ᵐq : RealPlane∂volume,
      (q.1∉(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support → LineDensityZero Cᶜ q.1) ∧
      (q.2∉(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support → LineDensityZero Cᶜ q.2) := by
    have h₁ := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))).ae hdC
    have h₂ := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))).ae hdC
    simpa only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] using h₁.and h₂
  have hforced : ∀ᵐq∂volume.restrict V,q∈A×ˢB →
      F q∈(volume.restrict Cᶜ).support ×ˢ (volume.restrict Cᶜ).support := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_of_ae hdA,ae_restrict_of_ae hdB,
      (plane_antilipschitz_qmp hF hL).ae hdpair,ae_restrict_mem hV.measurableSet] with q hqa hqb hqc hq hAB
    have hOne : DensityOne {z | c z=X} (angularSum x 1 (angleChart q)) := by
      simpa only [hlabels] using states_densityOne hc hw hA hB (hqa hAB.1) (hqb hAB.2) (hi q hq)
    have hnot (hZero : DensityZero {z | c z=X} (angularSum y 1 (angleChart (F q)))) : False := by
      rw [heq q hq] at hOne
      have hh := tendsto_nhds_unique hOne hZero
      exact one_ne_zero hh
    constructor
    · by_contra hn
      exact hnot (state_densityZero hc hw hC (hqc.1 hn) (ho q hq) (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))
    · by_contra hn
      apply hnot
      rw [← angularSum_swap y (F q).1 (F q).2]
      apply state_densityZero hc hw hC (hqc.2 hn) _ (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
      simpa only [← neg_sub (F q).2 (F q).1,Real.sin_neg,neg_ne_zero] using ho q hq
  have hp : (a,b)∈(volume.restrict (A×ˢB)).support := by
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod,← Measure.prod_restrict]
    exact support_prod_real ha hb
  have hpV : (a,b)∈((volume.restrict (A×ˢB)).restrict V).support :=
    Measure.interior_inter_support ⟨hV.interior_eq.symm ▸ hab,hp⟩
  apply continuousAt_maps_support_closed hpV hFc
    ((volume.restrict Cᶜ).isClosed_support.prod (volume.restrict Cᶜ).isClosed_support)
  filter_upwards [hforced.filter_mono (ae_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self V)),
    ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_restrict_mem (hA.1.prod hB.1))] with q hq hAB
  exact hq hAB
end EuclideanFiveColor
end
