import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.FourContinuity

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma circleSum_one_lipschitz_sumTransport : LipschitzWith 2 (circleSum 1) := by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro p q
  have hh (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : LipschitzWith 1 g) :
      dist (g p.1+g p.2) (g q.1+g q.2)≤2*max (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2) := by
    have h1 := hg.dist_le_mul p.1 q.1
    have h2 := hg.dist_le_mul p.2 q.2
    norm_num only [NNReal.coe_one,one_mul] at h1 h2
    have h3 := dist_add_add_le (g p.1) (g p.2) (g q.1) (g q.2)
    have h4 := le_max_left (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2)
    have h5 := le_max_right (dist p.1 q.1) (dist p.2 q.2)
    linarith
  simpa only [circleSum,one_mul,Prod.dist_eq,NNReal.coe_ofNat] using
    max_le (hh _ Real.lipschitzWith_cos) (hh _ Real.lipschitzWith_sin)

def sumTransport {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (H : RealPlane) (q : RealPlane) :=
  circleInverse h (circleSum 1 q-H)
lemma sumTransport_measurable {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (H : RealPlane) :
    Measurable (sumTransport h H) :=
  (circleInverse_measurable h).comp ((circleSum_continuous 1).sub continuous_const).measurable
lemma sumTransport_neighborhood {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) :
    ∃P V : Set RealPlane,IsOpen P ∧ 0∈P ∧ IsOpen V ∧ (a,b)∈V ∧
      ∃K : ℝ≥0,∀H∈P,
        (∀q∈V,ContinuousAt (sumTransport h H) q) ∧
        AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict (sumTransport h H)) ∧
        (∀q∈V,Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0) ∧
        (∀q∈V,Real.sin ((sumTransport h H q).2-(sumTransport h H q).1)≠0) ∧
        ∀q∈V,circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H q)=circleSum 1 q-H := by
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : RealPlane×RealPlane => circleSum 1 z.2-z.1) :=
    ((circleSum_continuous 1).comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_fst
  have hbtarget : circleSum 1 (a,b)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target :=
    (circleSum_strict 1 (a,b)).image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target
  have ht : ∀ᶠ z : RealPlane×RealPlane in 𝓝 (0,(a,b)),
      circleSum 1 z.2-z.1∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target ∧
      Real.sin ((circleInverse h (circleSum 1 z.2-z.1)).2-(circleInverse h (circleSum 1 z.2-z.1)).1)≠0 := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun z : RealPlane×RealPlane => circleSum 1 z.2-z.1)
        (𝓝 (0,(a,b))) (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) := by simpa only [sub_zero] using hc.tendsto (0,(a,b))
    have htt : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b)),q∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target :=
      (circleInverseHomeo h).open_target.mem_nhds hbtarget
    exact hlim.eventually (htt.and (circleInverse_regular h))
  obtain ⟨P,hP,W,hW,hPW⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp ht
  obtain ⟨P₀,hP₀,hPsub,hPmem⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hP
  obtain ⟨W₀,hW₀,hWsub,hWmem⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hW
  obtain ⟨V₀,hV₀,hv₀,L,hL⟩ := circleSum_local_antilipschitz (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)
  let V := W₀∩V₀∩{q : RealPlane | Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0}
  have hV : IsOpen V := (hWsub.inter hV₀).inter ((Real.continuous_sin.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst)).isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_ne)
  refine ⟨P₀,V,hPsub,hPmem,hV,⟨⟨hWmem,hv₀⟩,h⟩,L*2,?_⟩
  intro H hH
  have htarget (q : RealPlane) (hq : q∈V) := hPW (a := (H,q)) ⟨hP₀ hH,hW₀ hq.1.1⟩
  have heq (q : RealPlane) (hq : q∈V) : circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H q)=circleSum 1 q-H :=
    circleInverse_right h (htarget q hq).1
  refine ⟨?_,?_,fun _ hq => hq.2,fun q hq => (htarget q hq).2,heq⟩
  · intro q hq
    change ContinuousAt (fun z : RealPlane => circleInverse h (circleSum 1 z-H)) q
    exact (circleInverse_continuousAt h (htarget q hq).1).comp (x := q)
      (((circleSum_continuous 1).sub (continuous_const (y := H))).continuousAt)
  · apply AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist
    intro q r
    have hh := hL.le_mul_dist ⟨q,q.2.1.2⟩ ⟨r,r.2.1.2⟩
    have hd : dist (circleSum 1 q) (circleSum 1 r)=dist (circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H q)) (circleSum 1 (sumTransport h H r)) := by
      rw [heq q q.2,heq r r.2,dist_sub_right]
    change dist (q : RealPlane) (r : RealPlane) ≤ L*dist (circleSum 1 q) (circleSum 1 r) at hh
    rw [hd] at hh
    have hl := circleSum_one_lipschitz_sumTransport.dist_le_mul (sumTransport h H q) (sumTransport h H r)
    apply hh.trans
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl L.2
    simp only [NNReal.coe_mul,NNReal.coe_ofNat,Set.domRestrict_apply] at *
    nlinarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped NNReal
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fourNonSingleton (x : ℂ) : Set ℝ := fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2
lemma four_complement_support (x : ℂ) :
    (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x 0)ᶜ).support=fourNonSingleton c hc x := by
  have he : (fourRealState c hc x 0)ᶜ=fourRealState c hc x 1∪fourRealState c hc x 2 := by
    ext t
    change (fourState c hc x (t : Angles)≠0) ↔
      fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=1 ∨ fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=2
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 ↔ s=1 ∨ s=2 from by decide) _
  have hd : Disjoint (fourRealState c hc x 1) (fourRealState c hc x 2) := by
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro t h1 h2
    exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 3)≠2) (h1.symm.trans h2)
  rw [he,Measure.restrict_union hd (four_realState_measurable c hc x 2),Measure.support_add]
  rfl
lemma four_support_transport (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x y : ℂ}
    (hx : FourCenter c x) (hy : FourCenter c y) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : a∈fourSupport c hc x s)
    (hb : b∈fourSupport c hc x (if s=1 then 2 else 1)) (hab : Real.sin (b-a)≠0)
    {P V : Set RealPlane} {K : ℝ≥0} (hV : IsOpen V) (habV : (a,b)∈V)
    (hbranch : ∀H∈P,
        (∀q∈V,ContinuousAt (sumTransport hab H) q) ∧
        AntilipschitzWith K (V.domRestrict (sumTransport hab H)) ∧
        (∀q∈V,Real.sin (q.2-q.1)≠0) ∧
        (∀q∈V,Real.sin ((sumTransport hab H q).2-(sumTransport hab H q).1)≠0) ∧
        ∀q∈V,circleSum 1 (sumTransport hab H q)=circleSum 1 q-H)
    (hxy : Complex.equivRealProdCLM (y-x)∈P) :
    sumTransport hab (Complex.equivRealProdCLM (y-x)) (a,b)∈
      fourNonSingleton c hc y×ˢfourNonSingleton c hc y := by
  obtain ⟨hct,hL,hi,ho,heq⟩ := hbranch _ hxy
  rw [← four_complement_support c hc y]
  apply state_support_transport hc hw
    (fourState_represents c hc hw hx s)
    (fourState_represents c hc hw hx (if s=1 then 2 else 1))
    (fourState_represents c hc hw hy 0)
    ((show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → ∀i : Fin 5,i∉fourGroup s∪fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1) ↔ i=4 from by decide) s hs)
    ha hb (sumTransport_measurable hab _) (hct _ habV) hV habV hL hi ho
  intro q hq
  rw [angularSum_chart,angularSum_chart,heq q hq,map_sub]
  congr 1
  abel
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

    (hw : WeakColoring 5 coloring) {x y : ℂ}

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma two_closed_shift_separated_not_cover {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [PreconnectedSpace X] {A B : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B)
    (ha : A.Nonempty) (hb : B.Nonempty) (R : X → X)
    (hRA : ∀x∈A,R x∉A) (hRB : ∀x∈B,R x∉B) : A∪B≠univ := by
  intro hcov
  obtain ⟨x,_,hxA,hxB⟩ := isPreconnected_closed_iff.mp isPreconnected_univ A B hA hB
    (by rw [hcov]) (by simpa using ha) (by simpa using hb)
  have hm : R x∈A∪B := hcov.symm ▸ mem_univ _
  exact hm.elim (hRA x hxA) (hRB x hxB)
lemma closed_gap {N : Set ℝ} (hN : IsClosed N) {z l r : ℝ}
    (hz : z∉N) (hl : l∈N) (hr : r∈N) (hlz : l<z) (hzr : z<r) :
    ∃a b : ℝ,a∈N ∧ b∈N ∧ a<z ∧ z<b ∧ Ioo a b⊆Nᶜ := by
  have hLC : IsCompact (N∩Icc l z) := isCompact_Icc.inter_left hN
  have hRC : IsCompact (N∩Icc z r) := isCompact_Icc.inter_left hN
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ham⟩ := hLC.exists_isMaxOn (f := id) ⟨l,hl,le_rfl,hlz.le⟩ continuous_id.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbm⟩ := hRC.exists_isMinOn (f := id) ⟨r,hr,hzr.le,le_rfl⟩ continuous_id.continuousOn
  have haz : a<z := lt_of_le_of_ne ha.2.2 (fun he => hz (he ▸ ha.1))
  have hzb : z<b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb.2.1 (fun he => hz (he.symm ▸ hb.1))
  refine ⟨a,b,ha.1,hb.1,haz,hzb,?_⟩
  intro t ht hn
  by_cases htz : t≤z
  · have hta : t≤a := ham ⟨hn,ha.2.1.trans ht.1.le,htz⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hta) ht.1
  · have hbt : b≤t := hbm ⟨hn,(not_le.mp htz).le,ht.2.le.trans hb.2.2⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hbt) ht.2
lemma positive_normalized_increment_enters_gap {a b : ℝ} (hab : a<b)
    {u δ : ℕ → ℝ} {v : ℝ} (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hv : 0<v)
    (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 a))
    (hs : Tendsto (fun n => (u n-a)/δ n) atTop (𝓝 v)) :
    ∀ᶠn in atTop,u n∈Ioo a b := by
  filter_upwards [hu.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hab),hs.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hv)] with n hn hp
  exact ⟨sub_pos.mp ((div_pos_iff.mp hp).resolve_right (fun h => (not_lt_of_ge (hδ n).le) h.2)).1,hn⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma direction_sixty_unit_real (a : ℝ) :
    ‖direction (a : Angles)-direction ((a+sixty : ℝ) : Angles)‖=1 := by
  have he : direction (a : Angles)=direction ((a+sixty : ℝ) : Angles)+direction ((a-sixty : ℝ) : Angles) := by
    apply Complex.equivRealProdCLM.injective
    simpa only [map_add,direction_realPlane,circleTarget,samplingParameter,sub_self,map_zero,one_smul,zero_add,circleSum,one_mul,Prod.mk_add_mk] using sixty_sum (0:ℂ) a
  rw [he,add_sub_cancel_left,direction_norm]
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma four_support_nonempty (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x)
    {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) : (fourSupport c hc x s).Nonempty := by
  apply Measure.nonempty_support
  intro hz
  have hh := congrArg (fun μ : Measure ℝ => μ univ) hz
  simp only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ,Measure.coe_zero,Pi.zero_apply] at hh
  exact (four_realState_positive c hc hw hx hs).ne' hh
lemma four_support_no_sixty (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x)
    {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) {a : ℝ} (ha : a∈fourSupport c hc x s) :
    a+sixty∉fourSupport c hc x s := by
  intro hb
  exact four_support_sequence_no_unit c hc hw (fun _ => hx) hx tendsto_const_nhds hs
    tendsto_const_nhds tendsto_const_nhds (fun _ => ha) (fun _ => hb) (direction_sixty_unit_real a)
lemma four_support_union_proper (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) :
    fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2≠univ :=
  two_closed_shift_separated_not_cover Measure.isClosed_support Measure.isClosed_support
    (four_support_nonempty c hc hw hx (by decide)) (four_support_nonempty c hc hw hx (by decide))
    (fun a => a+sixty) (fun _ ha => four_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx (by decide) ha)
    (fun _ ha => four_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx (by decide) ha)
lemma four_outside_support_state (x : ℂ) :
    ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∉fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2 →
      fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=0 := by
  have h1 : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈fourRealState c hc x 1 → t∈fourSupport c hc x 1 :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' (four_realState_measurable c hc x 1)).mp (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x 1)).support_mem_ae
  have h2 : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈fourRealState c hc x 2 → t∈fourSupport c hc x 2 :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' (four_realState_measurable c hc x 2)).mp (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x 2)).support_mem_ae
  filter_upwards [h1,h2] with t ht1 ht2 hn
  have hn1 : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)≠1 := fun he => hn (Or.inl (ht1 he))
  have hn2 : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)≠2 := fun he => hn (Or.inr (ht2 he))
  exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠1 → s≠2 → s=0 from by decide) _ hn1 hn2
lemma four_gap_length (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x)
    {a b : ℝ} (hgap : Ioo a b⊆(fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2)ᶜ) : b-a ≤ sixty := by
  by_contra! hab
  have hp : 0<volume (Ioo a (b-sixty)) := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have h0 := four_outside_support_state c hc x
  have hshift := (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℝ) sixty).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h0
  have hneq := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fourState_changes c hc hw hx)
  obtain ⟨t,ht,ht0,hts,htn⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hp.ne'
    (ae_restrict_of_ae (h0.and (hshift.and hneq)))
  have hκ : 0<sixty := by dsimp [sixty]; positivity
  have he0 := ht0 (hgap ⟨ht.1,by linarith [ht.2]⟩)
  have he1 := hts (hgap ⟨by linarith [ht.1],by linarith [ht.2]⟩)
  apply htn
  simpa only [sixty,AddCircle.coe_add,he0] using he1.symm
lemma four_gap_exists (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x) :
    ∃a b : ℝ,a∈fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2 ∧
      b∈fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2 ∧ a<b ∧ b-a ≤ sixty ∧
      Ioo a b⊆(fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2)ᶜ := by
  let N := fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2
  have hN : IsClosed N := Measure.isClosed_support.union Measure.isClosed_support
  have hex : ∃z : ℝ,z∉N := by
    by_contra! h
    exact four_support_union_proper c hc hw hx (Set.eq_univ_of_forall h)
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := hex
  have hκ : 0<sixty := by dsimp [sixty]; positivity
  have hn (a b : ℝ) (hab : sixty<b-a) : ∃t∈Ioo a b,t∈N := by
    by_contra! hbad
    have hle := four_gap_length c hc hw hx hbad
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hab
  obtain ⟨l,hl,hlN⟩ := hn (z-sixty-1) z (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hrN⟩ := hn z (z+sixty+1) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,haz,hzb,hgap⟩ := closed_gap hN hz hlN hrN hl.2 hr.1
  exact ⟨a,b,ha,hb,haz.trans hzb,four_gap_length c hc hw hx hgap,hgap⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma open_subset_closed_of_ae {U N : Set ℝ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hN : IsClosed N)
    (h : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈U → t∈N) : U⊆N := by
  apply Set.sdiff_eq_empty.mp
  apply (hU.sdiff hN).eq_empty_of_measure_zero (μ := volume)
  apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
  filter_upwards [h] with t ht htn
  exact htn.2 (ht htn.1)
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma four_gap_shift_subset (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a<b)
    (hgap : Ioo a b⊆(fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2)ᶜ) :
    Icc (a+sixty) (b+sixty)⊆fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2 := by
  have hN : IsClosed (fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2) :=
    Measure.isClosed_support.union Measure.isClosed_support
  have hs : Ioo (a+sixty) (b+sixty)⊆fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2 := by
    apply open_subset_closed_of_ae isOpen_Ioo hN
    have h0 := four_outside_support_state c hc x
    have hneq : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,fourState c hc x (t : Angles)≠fourState c hc x ((t+sixty : ℝ) : Angles) := by
      simpa only [AddCircle.coe_add,sixty] using angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fourState_changes c hc hw hx)
    have hm := (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℝ) (-sixty)).quasiMeasurePreserving
    filter_upwards [h0,hm.ae h0,hm.ae hneq] with t ht htm htn htI
    by_contra hn
    have he0 := ht hn
    have hem := htm (hgap ⟨by linarith [htI.1],by linarith [htI.2]⟩)
    apply htn
    simp only [neg_add_cancel_right,he0,hem]
  have hz := closure_minimal hs hN
  rwa [closure_Ioo (by linarith : a+sixty≠b+sixty)] at hz
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Filter Topology Asymptotics
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma strict_increment_limit {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {f : E → F} {L : E →L[ℝ] F} {p : E}
    (hf : HasStrictFDerivAt f L p) {u v : ℕ → E} {δ : ℕ → ℝ} {w : E}
    (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 p)) (hv : Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 p)) (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n)
    (hw : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹ • (u n-v n)) atTop (𝓝 w)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹ • (f (u n)-f (v n))) atTop (𝓝 (L w)) := by
  have hb : (fun n => u n-v n) =O[atTop] δ := by
    apply IsBigO.of_bound (‖w‖+1)
    filter_upwards [hw.norm.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (lt_add_one ‖w‖))] with n hn
    rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_inv,abs_of_pos (hδ n)] at hn
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (hδ n)]
    exact ((inv_mul_lt_iff₀ (hδ n)).mp hn).le.trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)
  have ho : (fun n => f (u n)-f (v n)-L (u n-v n)) =o[atTop] δ :=
    (hf.isLittleO.comp_tendsto (hu.prodMk_nhds hv)).trans_isBigO hb
  have hz := ho.tendsto_inv_smul_nhds_zero
  have hl := L.continuous.tendsto w |>.comp hw
  have hh := hz.add hl
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,map_smul,smul_sub,map_sub,sub_add_cancel,zero_add] using hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def transportVelocity (H : RealPlane) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(H.1*Real.cos b+H.2*Real.sin b)/Real.sin (b-a)
lemma circleInverseDeriv_fst {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (H : RealPlane) :
    ((circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)).symm (-H)).1=
      transportVelocity H a b := by
  let L := circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa only [one_mul] using h)
  let q := L.symm (-H)
  have he : circleSumDeriv 1 (a,b) q = -H := L.apply_symm_apply (-H)
  have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst he
  have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd he
  change 1*(-Real.sin a*q.1)+(-Real.sin b)*q.2= -H.1 at h1
  change 1*(Real.cos a*q.1)+Real.cos b*q.2= -H.2 at h2
  change q.1= -(H.1*Real.cos b+H.2*Real.sin b)/Real.sin (b-a)
  apply (eq_div_iff h).mpr
  rw [Real.sin_sub]
  linear_combination Real.cos b*h1+Real.sin b*h2
lemma sumTransport_increment_limit {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0)
    {Hn q : ℕ → RealPlane} {δ : ℕ → ℝ} {H : RealPlane}
    (hH : Tendsto Hn atTop (𝓝 0)) (hq : Tendsto q atTop (𝓝 (a,b)))
    (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hdir : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•Hn n) atTop (𝓝 H)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ((sumTransport h (Hn n) (q n)).1-(q n).1)/δ n)
      atTop (𝓝 (transportVelocity H a b)) := by
  have hv : Tendsto (fun n => circleSum 1 (q n)) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) :=
    ((circleSum_continuous 1).tendsto (a,b)).comp hq
  have hu : Tendsto (fun n => circleSum 1 (q n)-Hn n) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hv.sub hH
  have hdiff : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•((circleSum 1 (q n)-Hn n)-circleSum 1 (q n)))
      atTop (𝓝 (-H)) := by
    simpa only [sub_sub_cancel_left,smul_neg] using hdir.neg
  have hh := strict_increment_limit (circleInverse_strict h) hu hv hδ hdiff
  have hid : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,circleInverse h (circleSum 1 (q n))=q n := by
    have hb : (a,b)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).source :=
      (circleSum_strict 1 (a,b)).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
    filter_upwards [hq.eventually ((circleInverseHomeo h).open_source.mem_nhds hb)] with n hn
    have ht : circleSum 1 (q n)∈(circleInverseHomeo h).target := (circleInverseHomeo h).map_source hn
    rw [circleInverse_eq h ht]
    exact (circleInverseHomeo h).left_inv hn
  have hf := hh.fst_nhds
  simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hf
  rw [circleInverseDeriv_fst h H] at hf
  apply hf.congr'
  filter_upwards [hid] with n hn
  simp only [hn,div_eq_inv_mul,sumTransport]
  rfl
lemma sumTransport_tendsto {a b : ℝ} (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0)
    {Hn q : ℕ → RealPlane} (hH : Tendsto Hn atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hq : Tendsto q atTop (𝓝 (a,b))) :
    Tendsto (fun n => sumTransport h (Hn n) (q n)) atTop (𝓝 (a,b)) := by
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => circleSum 1 (q n)-Hn n) atTop (𝓝 (circleSum 1 (a,b))) := by
    simpa only [sub_zero,Function.comp_def] using (((circleSum_continuous 1).tendsto (a,b)).comp hq).sub hH
  have hi := (circleInverse_strict h).continuousAt.tendsto.comp ht
  simpa only [sub_zero,circleInverse_at,sumTransport,Function.comp_def] using hi
lemma transportVelocity_neg (H : RealPlane) (a b : ℝ) :
    transportVelocity (-H) a b= -transportVelocity H a b := by
  simp only [transportVelocity,Prod.fst_neg,Prod.snd_neg]
  ring
lemma sumTransport_double_increment {a b b' : ℝ}
    (h : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (h' : Real.sin (b'-a)≠0)
    {Hn : ℕ → RealPlane} {δ bn : ℕ → ℝ} {H : RealPlane}
    (hH : Tendsto Hn atTop (𝓝 0)) (hb : Tendsto bn atTop (𝓝 b'))
    (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hdir : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•Hn n) atTop (𝓝 H)) :
    Tendsto (fun n =>
      ((sumTransport h' (-Hn n) ((sumTransport h (Hn n) (a,b)).1,bn n)).1-a)/δ n)
      atTop (𝓝 (transportVelocity H a b-transportVelocity H a b')) := by
  have hct := sumTransport_tendsto h hH tendsto_const_nhds
  have hf := sumTransport_increment_limit h hH tendsto_const_nhds hδ hdir
  have hn : Tendsto (fun n => -Hn n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [neg_zero] using hH.neg
  have hnd : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•(-Hn n)) atTop (𝓝 (-H)) := by
    simpa only [smul_neg] using hdir.neg
  have hr := sumTransport_increment_limit h' hn (hct.fst_nhds.prodMk_nhds hb) hδ hnd
  have hh := hr.add hf
  rw [transportVelocity_neg] at hh
  convert hh using 1
  · funext n
    dsimp
    ring
  · ring_nf
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma ae_angular_nonparallel (a : ℝ) : ∀ᵐb : ℝ∂volume,Real.sin (b-a)≠0 := by
  have hs : {b : ℝ | Real.sin (b-a)=0}⊆Set.range (fun n : ℤ => a+n*Real.pi) := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp hb
    exact ⟨n,by linarith⟩
  rw [ae_iff]
  simpa only [not_not] using measure_mono_null hs ((countable_range _).measure_zero volume)
lemma transportVelocity_ne {H : RealPlane} {a b b' : ℝ}
    (ha : H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a≠0)
    (hb : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (hb' : Real.sin (b'-a)≠0)
    (hbb : Real.sin (b'-b)≠0) : transportVelocity H a b≠transportVelocity H a b' := by
  intro he
  have hq := (div_eq_div_iff hb hb').mp he
  have hz : (H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a)*Real.sin (b'-b)=0 := by
    simp only [Real.sin_sub] at hq ⊢
    linear_combination -hq
  exact mul_ne_zero ha hbb hz
lemma exists_transportVelocity_lt {A : Set ℝ} (hA : 0<volume A)
    {H : RealPlane} {a : ℝ} (ha : H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a≠0) :
    ∃b∈A,∃b'∈A,Real.sin (b-a)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (b'-a)≠0 ∧
      transportVelocity H a b<transportVelocity H a b' := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hba⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hA.ne'
    (ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_angular_nonparallel a))
  obtain ⟨b',hb',hba',hbb⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hA.ne'
    (ae_restrict_of_ae ((ae_angular_nonparallel a).and (ae_angular_nonparallel b)))
  rcases (transportVelocity_ne ha hba hba' hbb).lt_or_gt with hlt | hgt
  · exact ⟨b,hb,b',hb',hba,hba',hlt⟩
  · exact ⟨b',hb',b,hb,hba',hba,hgt⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Accumulation.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Accumulation.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Exclusion
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.FourTransport

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma normalized_increment_endpoint_gap {l r a : ℝ} (hlr : l<r)
    {u δ : ℕ → ℝ} {v : ℝ} (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n)
    (hv : (a=l ∧ 0<v) ∨ (a=r ∧ v<0))
    (hu : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 a))
    (hs : Tendsto (fun n => (u n-a)/δ n) atTop (𝓝 v)) :
    ∀ᶠn in atTop,u n∈Ioo l r := by
  rcases hv with ⟨rfl,hv⟩ | ⟨rfl,hv⟩
  · exact positive_normalized_increment_enters_gap hlr hδ hv hu hs
  · filter_upwards [hu.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hlr),hs.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hv)] with n hn hp
    exact ⟨hn,sub_neg.mp ((div_neg_iff.mp hp).resolve_left (fun h => (not_lt_of_ge (hδ n).le) h.2)).1⟩
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma four_support_positive (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FourCenter c x)
    {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) : 0<volume (fourSupport c hc x s) := by
  apply (four_realState_positive c hc hw hx hs).trans_le
  apply measure_mono_ae
  exact (ae_restrict_iff' (four_realState_measurable c hc x s)).mp
    (volume.restrict (fourRealState c hc x s)).support_mem_ae
lemma four_other_union (x : ℂ) {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) :
    fourNonSingleton c hc x=fourSupport c hc x s∪fourSupport c hc x (if s=1 then 2 else 1) := by
  fin_cases s
  · exact (hs rfl).elim
  · rfl
  · exact Set.union_comm _ _
lemma four_endpoint_sequence_false (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {yn : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hyn : ∀n,FourCenter c (yn n)) (hx : FourCenter c x)
    (hy : Tendsto yn atTop (𝓝 x)) {δ : ℕ → ℝ} {H : RealPlane} (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n)
    (hdir : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•Complex.equivRealProdCLM (yn n-x)) atTop (𝓝 H))
    {l r a : ℝ} (hlr : l<r) (haEnd : a=l ∨ a=r)
    (hgap : Ioo l r⊆(fourSupport c hc x 1∪fourSupport c hc x 2)ᶜ)
    {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) (ha : a∈fourSupport c hc x s)
    (hHa : H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a≠0) : False := by
  classical
  let t : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have ht : t≠0 := by dsimp [t]; split <;> decide
  have hRaN := four_gap_shift_subset c hc hw hx hlr hgap
    (show a+sixty∈Icc (l+sixty) (r+sixty) from by rcases haEnd with rfl|rfl <;> constructor <;> linarith)
  have hRa : a+sixty∈fourSupport c hc x t := by
    change a+sixty∈fourNonSingleton c hc x at hRaN
    rw [four_other_union c hc x hs] at hRaN
    exact hRaN.resolve_left (four_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx hs ha)
  obtain ⟨b0,hb0,b1,hb1,hb0a,hb1a,hv01⟩ := exists_transportVelocity_lt
    (four_support_positive c hc hw hx ht) hHa
  have hp : ∃b b',b∈fourSupport c hc x t ∧ b'∈fourSupport c hc x t ∧
      Real.sin (b-a)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (b'-a)≠0 ∧
      ((a=l ∧ 0<transportVelocity H a b-transportVelocity H a b') ∨
       (a=r ∧ transportVelocity H a b-transportVelocity H a b'<0)) := by
    rcases haEnd with hal|har
    · exact ⟨b1,b0,hb1,hb0,hb1a,hb0a,Or.inl ⟨hal,sub_pos.mpr hv01⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨b0,b1,hb0,hb1,hb0a,hb1a,Or.inr ⟨har,sub_neg.mpr hv01⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨b,b',hb,hb',hab,hab',hvel⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨bn,hbn,hbt⟩ := four_support_continuity c hc hw hyn hx hy ht hb'
  obtain ⟨dn,hdn,hdt⟩ := four_support_continuity c hc hw hyn hx hy ht hRa
  let Hn := fun n => Complex.equivRealProdCLM (yn n-x)
  have hH : Tendsto Hn atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [sub_self,map_zero,Function.comp_def] using
      Complex.equivRealProdCLM.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hy.sub_const x)
  let cn := fun n => (sumTransport hab (Hn n) (a,b)).1
  have hcn : Tendsto cn atTop (𝓝 a) := (sumTransport_tendsto hab hH tendsto_const_nhds).fst_nhds
  have hneg : Tendsto (fun n => -Hn n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa only [neg_zero] using hH.neg
  let un := fun n => (sumTransport hab' (-Hn n) (cn n,bn n)).1
  have hun : Tendsto un atTop (𝓝 a) :=
    (sumTransport_tendsto hab' hneg (hcn.prodMk_nhds hbt)).fst_nhds
  have huGap : ∀ᶠn in atTop,un n∈Ioo l r := normalized_increment_endpoint_gap hlr hδ hvel hun
    (sumTransport_double_increment hab hab' hH hbt hδ hdir)
  obtain ⟨P,V,hP,hP0,hV,haV,K,hbranch⟩ := sumTransport_neighborhood hab
  have hcN : ∀ᶠn in atTop,cn n∈fourNonSingleton c hc (yn n) := by
    filter_upwards [hH.eventually (hP.mem_nhds hP0)] with n hn
    exact (four_support_transport c hc hw hx (hyn n) hs ha hb hab hV haV hbranch hn).1
  obtain ⟨P',V',hP',hP0',hV',haV',K',hbranch'⟩ := sumTransport_neighborhood hab'
  have hcNot : ∀ᶠn in atTop,cn n∉fourSupport c hc (yn n) s := by
    filter_upwards [hneg.eventually (hP'.mem_nhds hP0'),
      (hcn.prodMk_nhds hbt).eventually (hV'.mem_nhds haV'),huGap] with n hn hqn hgn hcu
    have hcenter : Complex.equivRealProdCLM (x-yn n)= -Hn n := by
      dsimp [Hn]
      rw [← map_neg,neg_sub]
    have htr := four_support_transport_general c hc hw (hyn n) hx hs hab' hcu (hbn n)
      hV' hqn hbranch' (hcenter.symm ▸ hn)
    rw [hcenter] at htr
    exact hgap hgn htr.1
  have hcT : ∀ᶠn in atTop,cn n∈fourSupport c hc (yn n) t := by
    filter_upwards [hcN,hcNot] with n hn hnot
    rw [four_other_union c hc (yn n) hs] at hn
    exact hn.resolve_left hnot
  let vn := fun n => if h : cn n∈fourSupport c hc (yn n) t then cn n
    else (four_support_nonempty c hc hw (hyn n) ht).choose
  have hvn : ∀n,vn n∈fourSupport c hc (yn n) t := by
    intro n
    dsimp [vn]
    split
    · assumption
    · exact (four_support_nonempty c hc hw (hyn n) ht).choose_spec
  have hvlim : Tendsto vn atTop (𝓝 a) := hcn.congr' (by
    filter_upwards [hcT] with n hn
    simp only [vn,dite_eq_left hn])
  exact four_support_sequence_no_unit c hc hw hyn hx hy ht hvlim hdt hvn hdn (direction_sixty_unit_real a)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma gap_endpoint_nonorthogonal {H : ℝ×ℝ} (hH : H≠0) {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : 0<b-a) (hab' : b-a<Real.pi) :
    H.1*Real.cos a+H.2*Real.sin a≠0 ∨ H.1*Real.cos b+H.2*Real.sin b≠0 := by
  by_contra! h
  have hs := (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hab hab').ne'
  have h1 : H.1*Real.sin (b-a)=0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination Real.sin b*h.1-Real.sin a*h.2
  have h2 : H.2*Real.sin (b-a)=0 := by
    rw [Real.sin_sub]
    linear_combination -Real.cos b*h.1+Real.cos a*h.2
  apply hH
  exact Prod.ext ((mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_right hs) ((mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_right hs)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma triple_subset_pair {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {S : Finset α} {a b d : α}
    (hS : S.card ≤ 2) (hsub : S ⊆ {a,b,d}) :
    S ⊆ {a,b} ∨ S ⊆ {a,d} ∨ S ⊆ {b,d} := by
  by_cases hab : a=b
  · subst b
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by simpa using hsub))
  by_cases ha : a∈S
  · by_cases hb : b∈S
    · left
      intro x hx
      by_contra hn
      have hxne : x≠a ∧ x≠b := by simpa only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,not_or] using hn
      have : 3 ≤ S.card := by
        have hh : ({a,b,x} : Finset α) ⊆ S := by simp only [Finset.insert_subset_iff,Finset.singleton_subset_iff]; exact ⟨ha,hb,hx⟩
        have hc := Finset.card_le_card hh
        simpa [hab,hxne.1.symm,hxne.2.symm] using hc
      omega
    · right; left
      intro x hx
      have := hsub hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at this ⊢
      rcases this with h|h|h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact False.elim (hb (h ▸ hx))
      · exact Or.inr h
  · right; right
    intro x hx
    exact (Finset.mem_insert.mp (hsub hx)).resolve_left (fun h => ha (h ▸ hx))
lemma triangle_binary (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℂ} {a b d i j : Fin 5}
    (hab : TransitionEdge c a b x) (had : TransitionEdge c a d x) (hbd : TransitionEdge c b d x)
    (hcomp : Finset.univ\{a,b,d}={i,j}) : BinaryCenter c hc x i j := by
  filter_upwards [palette_cardinality c hc hw x,edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hab,
    edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw had,edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw hbd] with t ht hab had hbd
  by_contra hn
  have hnot : i∉palette c hc x t ∧ j∉palette c hc x t := by
    simpa only [mem_palette,not_or] using hn
  have hsub : palette c hc x t ⊆ {a,b,d} := by
    intro s hs
    by_contra hns
    have : s∈({i,j} : Finset (Fin 5)) := by rw [← hcomp]; simp [hns]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at this
    rcases this with rfl|rfl
    · exact hnot.1 hs
    · exact hnot.2 hs
  rcases triple_subset_pair ht.2 hsub with h|h|h
  · exact hab h
  · exact had h
  · exact hbd h
lemma triangle_centers_separated (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    (a b d i j : Fin 5) (hcomp : Finset.univ\{a,b,d}={i,j}) :
    ∃ δ>0, ∀ x z : ℂ, TransitionEdge c a b x → TransitionEdge c a d x → TransitionEdge c b d x →
      TransitionEdge c a b z → TransitionEdge c a d z → TransitionEdge c b d z → x≠z → δ≤dist x z := by
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hsep⟩ := binary_centers_separated c hc hw
  exact ⟨δ,hδ,fun x z h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 hne => hsep x z i j
    (triangle_binary c hc hw h1 h2 h3 hcomp) (triangle_binary c hc hw h4 h5 h6 hcomp) hne⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k)
lemma transitionRatio_mono {i j : Fin k} {x y : ℂ} {R S : ℝ}
    (hB : Metric.ball x R ⊆ Metric.ball y S) (h : ℂ) :
    transitionRatio c i j x R h ≤ transitionRatio c i j y S h := by
  apply ENNReal.div_le_div_right
  exact measure_mono (fun _ hq => ⟨hB hq.1,hq.2⟩)
lemma transitionEdge_closed (i j : Fin k) : IsClosed {x | TransitionEdge c i j x} := by
  apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
  intro x hx
  have hne : i≠j := by
    obtain ⟨y,_,hy⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hx Set.univ isOpen_univ (mem_univ _)
    exact hy.1
  refine ⟨hne,fun R hR => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y,hyB,hy⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hx (Metric.ball x (R/2)) Metric.isOpen_ball
    (Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith))
  have hB : Metric.ball y (R/2) ⊆ Metric.ball x R := by
    intro z hz
    have ht := dist_triangle z y x
    have hz' : dist z y < R/2 := hz
    have hy' : dist y x < R/2 := hyB
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt ht (by linarith)
  exact (hy.2 (R/2) (by linarith)).trans_le (limsup_le_limsup
    (Eventually.of_forall (transitionRatio_mono c hB)))
lemma missing_edge_lim (i j : Fin k) (hne : i≠j) {x : ℂ}
    (he : ¬TransitionEdge c i j x) : ∃ R>0,
    Tendsto (transitionRatio c i j x R) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ)) (𝓝 0) := by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hr⟩ : ∃ R, 0<R ∧ ¬0<limsup (transitionRatio c i j x R) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ)) := by
    have hh : ¬∀ R, 0<R → 0<limsup (transitionRatio c i j x R) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ)) :=
      fun hh => he ⟨hne,hh⟩
    push Not at hh
    exact ⟨hh.choose,hh.choose_spec.1,not_lt.mpr hh.choose_spec.2⟩
  refine ⟨R,hR,?_⟩
  have hs : limsup (transitionRatio c i j x R) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ))=0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hr) (bot_le)
  exact tendsto_of_le_liminf_of_limsup_le (bot_le) hs.le
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
include hc
lemma four_normalized_sequence_false (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {yn : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hyn : ∀n,FourCenter c (yn n)) (hx : FourCenter c x)
    (hy : Tendsto yn atTop (𝓝 x)) {δ : ℕ → ℝ} {H : RealPlane} (hδ : ∀n,0<δ n) (hH : H≠0)
    (hdir : Tendsto (fun n => (δ n)⁻¹•Complex.equivRealProdCLM (yn n-x)) atTop (𝓝 H)) : False := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hab,hab',hgap⟩ := four_gap_exists c hc hw hx
  have hp : b-a<Real.pi := hab'.trans_lt (by dsimp [sixty]; linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  rcases gap_endpoint_nonorthogonal hH (sub_pos.mpr hab) hp with hda|hdb
  · rcases ha with ha|ha
    · exact four_endpoint_sequence_false c hc hw hyn hx hy hδ hdir hab (Or.inl rfl) hgap (by decide) ha hda
    · exact four_endpoint_sequence_false c hc hw hyn hx hy hδ hdir hab (Or.inl rfl) hgap (by decide) ha hda
  · rcases hb with hb|hb
    · exact four_endpoint_sequence_false c hc hw hyn hx hy hδ hdir hab (Or.inr rfl) hgap (by decide) hb hdb
    · exact four_endpoint_sequence_false c hc hw hyn hx hy hδ hdir hab (Or.inr rfl) hgap (by decide) hb hdb
lemma four_sequence_no_accumulation (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {yn : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hyn : ∀n,FourCenter c (yn n)) (hx : FourCenter c x)
    (hy : Tendsto yn atTop (𝓝 x)) (hne : ∀n,yn n≠x) : False := by
  let Hn := fun n => Complex.equivRealProdCLM (yn n-x)
  have hn : ∀n,Hn n≠0 := by
    intro n h
    apply hne n
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    exact Complex.equivRealProdCLM.injective (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  let δ := fun n => ‖Hn n‖
  have hδ : ∀n,0<δ n := fun n => norm_pos_iff.mpr (hn n)
  have hd : ∀n,(δ n)⁻¹•Hn n∈Metric.sphere 0 1 := by
    intro n
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
    exact norm_smul_inv_norm (𝕜 := ℝ) (hn n)
  obtain ⟨H,hH,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := (isCompact_sphere (0 : RealPlane) 1).tendsto_subseq hd
  have hH0 : H≠0 := by
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm] at hH
    intro hz
    simp only [hz,norm_zero] at hH
    norm_num at hH
  exact four_normalized_sequence_false c hc hw (fun n => hyn (φ n)) hx
    (hy.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) (fun n => hδ (φ n)) hH0 hlim
omit hc in
lemma fourCenter_closed : IsClosed {x | FourCenter c x} :=
  (transitionEdge_closed c 0 1).inter ((transitionEdge_closed c 1 2).inter
    ((transitionEdge_closed c 2 3).inter (transitionEdge_closed c 3 0)))
lemma fourCenter_discrete (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) : IsDiscrete {x | FourCenter c x} := by
  apply isDiscrete_iff_discreteTopology.mpr
  apply discreteTopology_of_noAccPts
  intro x hx ha
  obtain ⟨yn,hyn,hy⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp
    (accPt_principal_iff_clusterPt.mp ha).mem_closure
  exact four_sequence_no_accumulation c hc hw (fun n => (hyn n).1) hx hy
    (fun n => by simpa only [mem_singleton_iff] using (hyn n).2)
lemma fourCenter_compact_finite (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    (K∩{x | FourCenter c x}).Finite :=
  (hK.inter_right (fourCenter_closed c)).finite ((fourCenter_discrete c hc hw).mono inter_subset_right)

end EuclideanFiveColor

end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin k))
lemma weak_relabel (hw : WeakColoring k c) : WeakColoring k (e ∘ c) := by
  refine ⟨(measurable_of_finite e).comp_aemeasurable hw.1,?_⟩
  exact hw.2.mono fun p hp h => hp (e.injective h)
lemma transitionSet_relabel (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (h : ℂ) :
    transitionSet (e ∘ c) (e i) (e j) x R h=transitionSet c i j x R h := by
  ext q
  simp only [transitionSet,Set.mem_ofPred_eq,Function.comp_apply,Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
lemma transitionEdge_relabel (i j : Fin k) (x : ℂ) :
    TransitionEdge (e ∘ c) (e i) (e j) x ↔ TransitionEdge c i j x := by
  have he : transitionRatio (e ∘ c) (e i) (e j) x=transitionRatio c i j x := by
    funext R h
    unfold transitionRatio
    rw [transitionSet_relabel]
  simp only [TransitionEdge,he,ne_eq,Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
lemma transitionEdge_symm {i j : Fin k} {x : ℂ} (h : TransitionEdge c i j x) :
    TransitionEdge c j i x := by
  have he : transitionRatio c j i x=transitionRatio c i j x := by
    funext R z
    have hs : transitionSet c j i x R z=transitionSet c i j x R z := by
      ext q
      simp only [transitionSet,Set.mem_ofPred_eq,or_comm]
    change volume _ / _ = volume _ / _
    rw [hs]
  exact ⟨h.1.symm,by simpa only [he] using h.2⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

lemma threeCenter_closed : IsClosed {x | ThreeCenter c x} :=
  (transitionEdge_closed c 0 1).inter ((transitionEdge_closed c 0 2).inter (transitionEdge_closed c 1 2))
include hc in
lemma three_sequence_no_accumulation (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {yn : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hyn : ∀n,ThreeCenter c (yn n)) (hx : ThreeCenter c x)
    (hy : Tendsto yn atTop (𝓝 x)) (hne : ∀n,yn n≠x) : False := by

    simpa only [dist_self] using hy.dist (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => x) atTop (𝓝 x))
  have hev : ∀ᶠn in atTop,dist (yn n) x<δ := hd.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ)
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := hev.exists
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hsep (yn n) x (hyn n).1 (hyn n).2.1 (hyn n).2.2 hx.1 hx.2.1 hx.2.2 (hne n))) hn
include hc in
lemma threeCenter_discrete (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) : IsDiscrete {x | ThreeCenter c x} := by
  apply isDiscrete_iff_discreteTopology.mpr
  apply discreteTopology_of_noAccPts
  intro x hx ha
  obtain ⟨yn,hyn,hy⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp
    (accPt_principal_iff_clusterPt.mp ha).mem_closure
  exact three_sequence_no_accumulation c hc hw (fun n => (hyn n).1) hx hy
    (fun n => by simpa only [mem_singleton_iff] using (hyn n).2)
include hc in
lemma threeCenter_compact_finite (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    (K∩{x | ThreeCenter c x}).Finite :=
  (hK.inter_right (threeCenter_closed c)).finite ((threeCenter_discrete c hc hw).mono inter_subset_right)

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def FiveCenter (x : ℂ) : Prop := ∀i : Fin 5,TransitionEdge c i (i+1) x
lemma five_palette_admissible (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,FiveAdmissible (palette c hc x t) := by
  filter_upwards [palette_nonempty c hc x,palette_cardinality c hc hw x,
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => edge_palette_not_pair c hc hw (hx i))] with t hn hs he
  exact ⟨hn,hs.2,he⟩
def fiveState (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) : Fin 5 := fiveCanonical (palette c hc x t)
lemma palette_eq_measurable (x : ℂ) (p : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    MeasurableSet {t | palette c hc x t=p} := by
  simp only [Finset.ext_iff,Set.ofPred_forall]
  apply MeasurableSet.iInter
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i∈p
  · simpa only [hi,iff_true,mem_palette,Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using paletteSet_measurable c hc x i
  · simpa only [hi,iff_false,mem_palette,← Set.mem_compl_iff,Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using (paletteSet_measurable c hc x i).compl
lemma fiveState_measurable (x : ℂ) : Measurable (fiveState c hc x) := by
  exact Measurable.ite (palette_eq_measurable c hc x _) measurable_const
    (Measurable.ite (palette_eq_measurable c hc x _) measurable_const
      (Measurable.ite (palette_eq_measurable c hc x _) measurable_const
        (Measurable.ite (palette_eq_measurable c hc x _) measurable_const measurable_const)))
lemma fiveState_diag (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,palette c hc x t=fiveDiag (fiveState c hc x t) :=
  (five_palette_admissible c hc hw hx).mono fun _ ht => five_admissible_diag _ ht
lemma fiveState_represents (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) (i : Fin 5) :
    RealState hc x {t : ℝ | fiveState c hc x (t : Angles)=i} (fiveDiag i) := by
  refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
  intro j hj
  filter_upwards [angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fiveState_diag c hc hw hx)] with t ht hti
  change fiveState c hc x (t : Angles)=i at hti
  apply (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) j).mp
  rw [ht,hti]
  exact hj
lemma fiveState_adj (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fiveAdj (fiveState c hc x t) (fiveState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles))) := by
  have hs := fiveState_diag c hc hw hx
  filter_upwards [hs,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hs,
    palette_sixty_disjoint c hc hw x] with t ht hu hd
  apply (five_diag_disjoint _ _).mp
  change Disjoint (palette c hc x t) (palette c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles))) at hd
  rwa [ht,hu] at hd
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma palette_neighbor_real (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈liftPalette c hc (x+direction (a : Angles)) i → t∉liftPalette c hc x i := by
  let U : Set ℝ := {t | Real.sin (a-t)≠0}
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_ne_fun (Real.continuous_sin.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)) continuous_const
  have hu : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈U := by
    filter_upwards [ae_sin_sub_ne_zero a] with t ht
    change Real.sin (a-t)≠0
    rwa [← neg_sub t a,Real.sin_neg,neg_ne_zero]
  have hh := palette_smooth_transport c hc hw (x := x) (z := x+direction (a : Angles)) hU (s := id) (t := fun _ => a)
    (ds := fun _ => 1) (dt := fun _ => 0) (fun t _ => hasDerivAt_id t)
    (fun t _ => hasDerivAt_const t a) (fun _ _ => one_ne_zero) (fun _ ht => ht) (fun t _ => ?_) i
  · exact (ae_restrict_iff' hU.measurableSet).mp hh |>.mp (hu.mono fun t ht hi => hi ht)
  · simp only [circleTarget,samplingParameter,add_sub_cancel_left,direction_realPlane,circleSum,one_smul,one_mul,id_eq]
    exact Prod.ext (add_comm _ _) (add_comm _ _)
lemma palette_neighbor_disjoint (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x : ℂ) (a : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,Disjoint (palette c hc (x+direction (a : Angles)) t) (palette c hc x t) := by
  have hp (i : Fin k) : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈paletteSet c hc (x+direction (a : Angles)) i → t∉paletteSet c hc x i := by
    apply ae_angular_of_ae_line
    · simpa only [imp_iff_not_or,Set.compl_def,Set.union_def,Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using
        (paletteSet_measurable c hc (x+direction (a : Angles)) i).compl.union (paletteSet_measurable c hc x i).compl
    · exact palette_neighbor_real c hc hw x a i
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hp] with t ht
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun i hi hj => ht i ((mem_palette c hc _ t i).mp hi) ((mem_palette c hc _ t i).mp hj)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
def stateSupport (f : ℝ → ι) (i : ι) : Set ℝ := (volume.restrict {t | f t=i}).support
lemma ae_mem_stateSupport {f : ℝ → ι} (hf : Measurable f) (i : ι) :
    ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,f t=i → t∈stateSupport f i :=
  (ae_restrict_iff' (measurableSet_eq_fun hf measurable_const)).mp
    (volume.restrict {t | f t=i}).support_mem_ae
lemma ae_state_support {f : ℝ → ι} (hf : Measurable f) :
    ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈stateSupport f (f t) := by
  have h : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,∀i : ι,f t=i → t∈stateSupport f i :=
    ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_mem_stateSupport hf i)
  exact h.mono fun t ht => ht (f t) rfl
lemma stateSupport_cover {f : ℝ → ι} (hf : Measurable f) (a : ℝ) : ∃i,a∈stateSupport f i := by
  have hclosed : IsClosed (⋃i,stateSupport f i)  := isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun _ => Measure.isClosed_support
  have hae : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈⋃i,stateSupport f i :=
    (ae_state_support hf).mono fun t ht => mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨f t,ht⟩
  have hd := Measure.dense_of_ae hae
  exact mem_iUnion.mp ((hclosed.closure_eq ▸ hd a) : a∈⋃i,stateSupport f i)
lemma stateSupport_shift_relation {f : ℝ → ι} (hf : Measurable f) {R : ι → ι → Prop}
    {d : ℝ} (hR : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,R (f t) (f (t+d))) {i : ι} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : a∈stateSupport f i) : ∃j,R i j ∧ a+d∈stateSupport f j := by
  classical
  let K : Set ℝ := ⋃j∈({j | R i j} : Set ι),(fun t => t+d)⁻¹'stateSupport f j
  have hK : IsClosed K := (Set.toFinite _).isClosed_biUnion (fun j _ =>
    Measure.isClosed_support.preimage (continuous_id.add continuous_const))
  have hm : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,f t=i → t∈K := by
    filter_upwards [hR,(measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℝ) d).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ae_state_support hf)] with t hR ht hti
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨f (t+d),mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hti ▸ hR,ht⟩⟩
  have hk : a∈K := Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed hK
    ((ae_restrict_iff' (hf (measurableSet_singleton i))).mpr hm) ha
  rcases mem_iUnion.mp hk with ⟨j,hj⟩
  obtain ⟨hr,hs⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hj
  exact ⟨j,hr,hs⟩
omit [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] in
lemma stateSupport_nonempty_measure {f : ℝ → ι} {i : ι} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : a∈stateSupport f i) : 0<volume {t | f t=i} := by
  have h := (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall a).mp ha univ (univ_mem)
  simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ] using h
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fiveRealState (x : ℂ) (i : Fin 5) : Set ℝ := {t | fiveState c hc x (t : Angles)=i}
def fiveSupport (x : ℂ) (i : Fin 5) : Set ℝ := (volume.restrict (fiveRealState c hc x i)).support
lemma five_realState_measurable (x : ℂ) (i : Fin 5) : MeasurableSet (fiveRealState c hc x i) :=
  measurableSet_eq_fun ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const
lemma five_support_trace (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5}
    (ha : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) :
    ∃b : TraceVector 5,IsTrace c hc (x+direction (a : Angles)) b ∧ ∀j∈fiveDiag i,traceValue b j=0 :=
  state_support_avoiding_trace c hc hw (fiveState_represents c hc hw hx i) ha
lemma five_support_step_ban (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i j : Fin 5}
    (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) (hj : a∈fiveSupport c hc x j) (hij : fiveAdj i j) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,¬(fiveState c hc x t=i ∧ fiveState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles))=j) ∧
      ¬(fiveState c hc x t=j ∧ fiveState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles))=i) := by
  obtain ⟨bi,hbi,hzi⟩ := five_support_trace c hc hw hx hi
  obtain ⟨bj,hbj,hzj⟩ := five_support_trace c hc hw hx hj
  obtain ⟨X,hX⟩ := five_adj_four i j hij
  have hji : fiveAdj j i := hij.symm
  have hv : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fiveState c hc x t=i ∨ fiveState c hc x t=j →
      X∈palette c hc (x+direction (a : Angles)) t := by
    filter_upwards [avoiding_trace_palette c hc hbi hzi,avoiding_trace_palette c hc hbj hzj,
      palette_neighbor_disjoint c hc hw x a,fiveState_diag c hc hw hx] with t hni hnj hd he hs
    rw [he] at hd
    rcases hs with hi|hj
    · rw [hi] at hd
      exact five_forced_label i j X hij hX _ hd hnj
    · rw [hj] at hd
      exact five_forced_label j i X hji (by simpa only [Finset.union_comm] using hX) _ hd hni
  filter_upwards [hv,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hv,
    palette_sixty_disjoint c hc hw (x+direction (a : Angles))] with t ht hu hd
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi,hj⟩
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (ht (Or.inl hi)) (hu (Or.inr hj))
  · rintro ⟨hj,hi⟩
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (ht (Or.inr hj)) (hu (Or.inl hi))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma five_support_cover (x : ℂ) (a : ℝ) : ∃i,a∈fiveSupport c hc x i :=
  stateSupport_cover ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) a
lemma five_support_next (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5}
    (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) : ∃j,fiveAdj i j ∧ a+sixty∈fiveSupport c hc x j := by
  apply stateSupport_shift_relation ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) _ hi
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,AddCircle.coe_add] using angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fiveState_adj c hc hw hx)
lemma five_support_prev (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5}
    (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) : ∃j,fiveAdj i j ∧ a-sixty∈fiveSupport c hc x j := by
  apply stateSupport_shift_relation ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) (d := -sixty) _ hi
  have hh := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fiveState_adj c hc hw hx)
  have hh' := (measurePreserving_add_right (volume : Measure ℝ) (-sixty)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hh
  filter_upwards [hh'] with t ht
  have he : ((t+-sixty : ℝ) : Angles)+(sixty : Angles)=(t : Angles) := by
    rw [← AddCircle.coe_add,neg_add_cancel_right]
  rw [he] at ht
  exact ht.symm
lemma five_support_no_sixty (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5}
    (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) : a+sixty∉fiveSupport c hc x i := by
  obtain ⟨j,hj,hsj⟩ := five_support_next c hc hw hx hi
  obtain ⟨X,hX⟩ := five_adj_four j i hj.symm
  have hp : 0<volume (fiveRealState c hc x j) := stateSupport_nonempty_measure hsj
  intro hs
  exact strict_state_no_unit_support hc hw hX (fiveState_represents c hc hw hx j)
    (fiveState_represents c hc hw hx i) hp hi hs (direction_sixty_unit_real a)
end EuclideanFiveColor

noncomputable section
namespace EuclideanFiveColor.FiveComb
-- Independent finite arithmetic facts; the source labels are Z/5Z, represented by Fin 5.
def Adj (i j : Fin 5) : Prop := i+1=j ∨ j+1=i
instance (i j : Fin 5) : Decidable (Adj i j) := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_∨_))
lemma contact_neighbors : ∀i : Fin 5,∀L : Finset (Fin 5), i∉L → i+1∉L →
    (∃j∈L,Adj i j) → (∃j∈L,Adj (i+1) j) → i-1∈L ∧ i+2∈L := by decide
lemma opposite_contacts : ∀i j : Fin 5, Disjoint ({i-1,i+2} : Finset (Fin 5)) {j-1,j+2} →
    j=i+1 ∨ j+1=i := by decide
lemma adjacent_oriented : ∀I : Finset (Fin 5), (∃i∈I,∃j∈I,Adj i j) → ∃i,i∈I ∧ i+1∈I := by decide
lemma neighbors : ∀i j : Fin 5, Adj i j → j=i-1 ∨ j=i+1 := by decide
lemma two_bans : ∀i j : Fin 5, j=i+1 ∨ j+1=i → ∃s,
    (s=i ∨ s=i+1) ∧ (s=j ∨ s=j+1) ∧
    ∀t,Adj s t → ((s=i ∧ t=i+1) ∨ (s=i+1 ∧ t=i)) ∨ ((s=j ∧ t=j+1) ∨ (s=j+1 ∧ t=j)) := by decide
end EuclideanFiveColor.FiveComb
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def fiveSupportList (x : ℂ) (a : ℝ) : Finset (Fin 5) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (fun i => a∈fiveSupport c hc x i)
@[simp] lemma mem_fiveSupportList (x : ℂ) (a : ℝ) (i : Fin 5) :
    i∈fiveSupportList c hc x a ↔ a∈fiveSupport c hc x i := by simp only [fiveSupportList,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
lemma five_contact_next (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5}
    (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) (hi' : a∈fiveSupport c hc x (i+1)) :
    i-1∈fiveSupportList c hc x (a+sixty) ∧ i+2∈fiveSupportList c hc x (a+sixty) := by
  apply FiveComb.contact_neighbors
  · exact fun h => five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx hi ((mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp h)
  · exact fun h => five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx hi' ((mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp h)
  · obtain ⟨j,hj,hs⟩ := five_support_next c hc hw hx hi
    exact ⟨j,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mpr hs,hj⟩
  · obtain ⟨j,hj,hs⟩ := five_support_next c hc hw hx hi'
    exact ⟨j,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mpr hs,hj⟩
lemma five_contact_prev (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {i : Fin 5}
    (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) (hi' : a∈fiveSupport c hc x (i+1)) :
    i-1∈fiveSupportList c hc x (a-sixty) ∧ i+2∈fiveSupportList c hc x (a-sixty) := by
  apply FiveComb.contact_neighbors
  · intro h
    have hh := five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx ((mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp h)
    exact hh (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hi)
  · intro h
    have hh := five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx ((mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp h)
    exact hh (by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hi')
  · obtain ⟨j,hj,hs⟩ := five_support_prev c hc hw hx hi
    exact ⟨j,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mpr hs,hj⟩
  · obtain ⟨j,hj,hs⟩ := five_support_prev c hc hw hx hi'
    exact ⟨j,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mpr hs,hj⟩
lemma five_opposite_contacts_false (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : b=a+3*sixty) {i j : Fin 5}
    (hi : a∈fiveSupport c hc x i) (hi' : a∈fiveSupport c hc x (i+1))
    (hj : b∈fiveSupport c hc x j) (hj' : b∈fiveSupport c hc x (j+1)) : False := by
  have hn := five_contact_next c hc hw hx hi hi'
  have hp := five_contact_prev c hc hw hx hj hj'
  have hdis : Disjoint ({i-1,i+2} : Finset (Fin 5)) {j-1,j+2} := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro k hk hl
    have hiK : a+sixty∈fiveSupport c hc x k := by
      apply (mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hk
      rcases hk with rfl|rfl <;> tauto
    have hjK : b-sixty∈fiveSupport c hc x k := by
      apply (mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hl
      rcases hl with rfl|rfl <;> tauto
    exact five_support_no_sixty c hc hw hx hiK (by convert hjK using 1; rw [hab]; ring)
  have hji := FiveComb.opposite_contacts i j hdis
  obtain ⟨s,hs,_hst,hban⟩ := FiveComb.two_bans i j hji
  have hss : a∈fiveSupport c hc x s := by rcases hs with rfl|rfl <;> assumption
  have hbanI := five_support_step_ban c hc hw hx hi hi' (Or.inl rfl)
  have hbanJ := five_support_step_ban c hc hw hx hj hj' (Or.inl rfl)
  have hnot : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fiveState c hc x t≠s := by
    filter_upwards [hbanI,hbanJ,fiveState_adj c hc hw hx] with t hbI hbJ ha he
    rw [he] at ha
    rcases hban _ ha with h|h
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl,ht⟩|⟨rfl,ht⟩
      · exact hbI.1 ⟨he,ht⟩
      · exact hbI.2 ⟨he,ht⟩
    · rcases h with ⟨rfl,ht⟩|⟨rfl,ht⟩
      · exact hbJ.1 ⟨he,ht⟩
      · exact hbJ.2 ⟨he,ht⟩
  have hz : volume (fiveRealState c hc x s)=0 := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr (angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot)
  exact (stateSupport_nonempty_measure hss).ne' hz
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
lemma plane_lipschitz_image_null {F : RealPlane → RealPlane} {K : ℝ≥0}
    (hf : LipschitzWith K F) {A : Set RealPlane} (ha : volume A=0) : volume (F '' A)=0 := by
  have h := hf.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2) A
  rw [hausdorffMeasure_prod_real,ha,mul_zero] at h
  exact bot_unique h
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma palette_open_exclusion (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {i : Fin k} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) {V : Set ℝ} (hV : IsOpen V) (ha : a∈V)
    (hpal : ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈V → (t : Angles)∈paletteSet c hc x i) :
    ∃U : Set ℂ, IsOpen U ∧ x+direction (a : Angles)+direction (b : Angles)∈U ∧
      volume (U∩{z | c z=i})=0 := by
  let e := circleInverseHomeo hab
  let W : Set RealPlane := e.source ∩ Prod.fst ⁻¹' V
  have hW : IsOpen W := e.open_source.inter (hV.preimage continuous_fst)
  have haW : (a,b)∈W := by
    refine ⟨?_,ha⟩
    exact (show HasStrictFDerivAt (circleSum 1)
      (circleSumDerivEquiv (r := 1) (p := (a,b)) (by simpa using hab) : RealPlane →L[ℝ] RealPlane)
      (a,b) from circleSum_strict 1 (a,b)).mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  have hO : IsOpen (circleSum 1 '' W) := e.isOpen_image_of_subset_source hW inter_subset_left
  let g : RealPlane → ℂ := fun q => x+Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm q
  have hgs (q : RealPlane) : g (circleSum 1 q)=angularSum x 1 (angleChart q) := by
    rw [angularSum_chart]
    simp only [g,map_add,ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hgc : IsOpenMap g := (Homeomorph.addLeft x).isOpenMap.comp Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm.toHomeomorph.isOpenMap
  have hex := anglePair_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (palette_first_exclusion c hc hw x i)
  have hp : ∀ᵐq : RealPlane∂volume,q.1∈V → (q.1 : Angles)∈paletteSet c hc x i :=
    Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst.ae hpal
  have hnull : volume (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i})=0 := by
    apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
    filter_upwards [hex,hp] with q hq hp hmem
    apply hq (hp hmem.1.2)
    change c (angularSum x 1 (angleChart q))=i
    rw [← hgs]
    exact hmem.2
  have himage := plane_lipschitz_image_null circleSum_one_lipschitz_sumTransport hnull
  have hnullg : volume (g '' (circleSum 1 '' (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i})))=0 := by
    rw [show g '' (circleSum 1 '' (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i}))=
      (fun z => Complex.equivRealProdCLM (z-x)) ⁻¹' (circleSum 1 '' (W∩{q | c (g (circleSum 1 q))=i})) by
        ext z
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
          simpa only [Set.mem_preimage,g,add_sub_cancel_left,ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hp
        · intro hz
          refine ⟨Complex.equivRealProdCLM (z-x),hz,?_⟩
          change x+Complex.equivRealProdCLM.symm (Complex.equivRealProdCLM (z-x))=z
          rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
          abel]
    exact ((Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.comp (measurePreserving_sub_right volume x)).quasiMeasurePreserving.preimage_null himage)
  refine ⟨g '' (circleSum 1 '' W),hgc _ hO,?_,?_⟩
  · refine ⟨circleSum 1 (a,b),⟨(a,b),haW,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    simpa only [angularSum,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,angleChart] using hgs (a,b)
  · exact measure_mono_null (by rintro z ⟨⟨q,⟨p,hp,rfl⟩,rfl⟩,hz⟩; exact ⟨_,⟨p,⟨hp,hz⟩,rfl⟩,rfl⟩) hnullg
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k)
lemma transitionEdge_no_open_exclusion {i j : Fin k} {x : ℂ} (he : TransitionEdge c i j x)
    {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x∈U) (hz : volume (U∩{z | c z=i})=0) : False := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hB⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hU x hx
  have hae : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈U → c z≠i := by
    filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hz] with z hz hu he
    exact hz ⟨hu,he⟩
  have hratio : ∀ᶠh : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0, transitionRatio c i j x (r/2) h=0 := by
    have hh : ∀ᶠh : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0,‖h‖<r/2 := by
      have hb : ∀ᶠh : ℂ in 𝓝[≠] 0,h∈Metric.ball 0 (r/2) :=
        nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (show 0<r/2 by linarith))
      filter_upwards [hb] with h hh
      simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] using hh
    filter_upwards [hh] with h hh
    have hap := (measurePreserving_add_right volume h).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hae
    have hzT : volume (transitionSet c i j x (r/2) h)=0 := by
      apply measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr
      filter_upwards [hae,hap] with q hq hqh ht
      have hqU : q∈U := hB (Metric.ball_subset_ball (show r/2≤r by linarith) ht.1)
      have hqhU : q+h∈U := by
        apply hB
        have hd := dist_triangle (q+h) q x
        have hdist : dist (q+h) q=‖h‖ := by simp [dist_eq_norm]
        rw [hdist] at hd
        exact hd.trans_lt (by have hqx : dist q x<r/2 := ht.1; linarith)
      rcases ht.2 with ht|ht
      · exact hq hqU ht.1
      · exact hqh hqhU ht.2
    simp only [transitionRatio,hzT,ENNReal.zero_div]
  have hh : limsup (transitionRatio c i j x (r/2)) (𝓝[≠] (0:ℂ))=0 := by
    rw [limsup_congr hratio]
    exact limsup_const 0
  have hp := he.2 (r/2) (by linarith)
  rw [hh] at hp
  exact lt_irrefl _ hp
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable {ι X : Type*} [Finite ι] [TopologicalSpace X]
lemma finite_closed_family_locally_subset {S : ι → Set X} (hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i)) (a : X) :
    ∃V,IsOpen V ∧ a∈V ∧ ∀v∈V,∀i,v∈S i → a∈S i := by
  let V := ⋂i∈({i | a∉S i} : Set ι),(S i)ᶜ
  have hop : IsOpen V := (Set.toFinite _).isOpen_biInter (fun i _ => (hS i).isOpen_compl)
  refine ⟨V,hop,?_,?_⟩
  · exact mem_iInter₂.mpr (fun _ hi => hi)
  · intro v hv i hi
    by_contra hn
    exact mem_iInter₂.mp hv i hn hi
lemma finite_closed_family_no_common_limit {S : ι → Set X} (hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i))
    {P : ι → Prop} {a : X} {an : ℕ → X} (ha : Tendsto an atTop (𝓝 a))
    (hn : ∀n,∃i,an n∈S i ∧ P i) : ∃i,a∈S i ∧ P i := by
  obtain ⟨V,hV,haV,hsub⟩ := finite_closed_family_locally_subset hS a
  have hev : ∀ᶠn in atTop,an n∈V := ha (hV.mem_nhds haV)
  obtain ⟨n,hnV⟩ := hev.exists
  obtain ⟨i,hi,hP⟩ := hn n
  exact ⟨i,hsub _ hnV i hi,hP⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma stateSupport_local_pred {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    {f : ℝ → ι} (hf : Measurable f) {P : ι → Prop} {a : ℝ}
    (ha : ∀i,a∈stateSupport f i → P i) :
    ∃V,IsOpen V ∧ a∈V ∧ ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈V → P (f t) := by
  obtain ⟨V,hV,haV,hsub⟩ := finite_closed_family_locally_subset
    (S := stateSupport f) (fun _ => Measure.isClosed_support) a
  refine ⟨V,hV,haV,?_⟩
  exact (ae_state_support hf).mono fun t ht hv => ha _ (hsub t hv _ ht)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.FiveSupport

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
lemma five_ae_mem_support (x : ℂ) :
    ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈fiveSupport c hc x (fiveState c hc x (t : Angles)) :=
  ae_state_support ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable)
lemma five_real_diag (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) :
    ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,palette c hc x (t : Angles)=fiveDiag (fiveState c hc x (t : Angles)) :=
  angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (fiveState_diag c hc hw hx)
lemma five_local_palette (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a : ℝ} {k : Fin 5}
    (hk : ∀i,a∈fiveSupport c hc x i → k∈fiveDiag i) :
    ∃V, IsOpen V ∧ a∈V ∧ ∀ᵐt : ℝ∂volume,t∈V → (t : Angles)∈paletteSet c hc x k := by
  obtain ⟨V,hV,ha,hkV⟩ := stateSupport_local_pred
    ((fiveState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) hk
  refine ⟨V,hV,ha,?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hkV,five_real_diag c hc hw hx] with t ht hd htv
  apply (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) k).mp
  rw [hd]
  exact ht htv
lemma five_endpoint_no_common (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (hx : FiveCenter c x) {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : Real.sin (b-a)≠0) (hy : FiveCenter c (x+direction (a : Angles)+direction (b : Angles))) :
    ∀k : Fin 5,∃i,a∈fiveSupport c hc x i ∧ k∉fiveDiag i := by
  intro k
  by_contra! h
  obtain ⟨V,hV,ha,hpal⟩ := five_local_palette c hc hw hx h
  obtain ⟨U,hU,hyU,hnull⟩ := palette_open_exclusion c hc hw hab hV ha hpal
  exact transitionEdge_no_open_exclusion c (hy k) hU hyU hnull
lemma five_limit_contact {x : ℂ} {an : ℕ → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : Tendsto an atTop (𝓝 a))
    (hn : ∀n,∀k : Fin 5,∃i,an n∈fiveSupport c hc x i ∧ k∉fiveDiag i) :
    ∃i,a∈fiveSupport c hc x i ∧ a∈fiveSupport c hc x (i+1) := by
  have hall : ∀k : Fin 5,∃i,a∈fiveSupport c hc x i ∧ k∉fiveDiag i := fun k =>
    finite_closed_family_no_common_limit (fun _ => Measure.isClosed_support) ha (fun n => hn n k)
  have hnList : (fiveSupportList c hc x a).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := five_support_cover c hc x a
    exact ⟨i,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mpr hi⟩
  have hp : ∀k,∃i∈fiveSupportList c hc x a,k∉fiveDiag i := by
    intro k; obtain ⟨i,hi,hk⟩ := hall k
    exact ⟨i,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mpr hi,hk⟩
  obtain ⟨i,hi,hi'⟩ := FiveComb.adjacent_oriented _ (five_no_common_adj _ hnList hp)
  exact ⟨i,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp hi,(mem_fiveSupportList _ _ _ _ _).mp hi'⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma chord_angles_sum {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖≤2) :
    Complex.exp (((z.arg-Real.arccos (‖z‖/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I)+
      Complex.exp (((z.arg+Real.arccos (‖z‖/2) : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I)=z := by
  have hc := Real.cos_arccos (x := ‖z‖/2) (by have := norm_nonneg z; linarith) (by linarith)
  have hre := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg z
  have him := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg z
  rw [Complex.exp_mul_I,Complex.exp_mul_I]
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [Complex.add_re,Complex.mul_re,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
      Complex.cos_ofReal_re,Complex.sin_ofReal_re,Complex.sin_ofReal_im,mul_zero,
      sub_zero,mul_one]
    rw [Real.cos_sub,Real.cos_add,hc]
    nlinarith
  · simp only [Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
      Complex.cos_ofReal_im,Complex.sin_ofReal_re,Complex.sin_ofReal_im,mul_zero,
      zero_add,add_zero,mul_one]
    rw [Real.sin_sub,Real.sin_add,hc]
    nlinarith
lemma chord_angles_nonparallel {r t : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) (hr2 : r<2) :
    Real.sin ((t+Real.arccos (r/2))-(t-Real.arccos (r/2)))≠0 := by
  have ha := Real.arccos_pos.mpr (show r/2<1 by linarith)
  have hb := Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two.mpr (show 0<r/2 by linarith)
  exact (Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi (by linarith) (by linarith)).ne'
lemma chord_sequence_lifts {z : ℕ → ℂ} (hz : Tendsto z atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hne : ∀n,z n≠0) (hsmall : ∀n,‖z n‖<2) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ t : ℝ,∃ a b : ℕ → ℝ,
      Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 (t-Real.pi/2)) ∧ Tendsto b atTop (𝓝 (t+Real.pi/2)) ∧
      (∀n,Complex.exp ((a n : ℂ)*Complex.I)+Complex.exp ((b n : ℂ)*Complex.I)=z (φ n)) ∧
      ∀n,Real.sin (b n-a n)≠0 := by
  obtain ⟨t,_ht,φ,hφ,harg⟩ := (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi)).tendsto_subseq
    (fun n => ⟨(Complex.neg_pi_lt_arg (z n)).le,Complex.arg_le_pi (z n)⟩)
  have hn : Tendsto (fun n => ‖z (φ n)‖/2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,norm_zero,zero_div] using ((hz.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop).norm.div_const 2)
  have hac : Tendsto (fun n => Real.arccos (‖z (φ n)‖/2)) atTop (𝓝 (Real.pi/2)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def,Real.arccos_zero] using Real.continuous_arccos.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hn
  refine ⟨φ,hφ,t,(fun n => (z (φ n)).arg-Real.arccos (‖z (φ n)‖/2)),
    (fun n => (z (φ n)).arg+Real.arccos (‖z (φ n)‖/2)),harg.sub hac,harg.add hac,?_,?_⟩
  · exact fun n => chord_angles_sum (hsmall (φ n)).le
  · exact fun n => chord_angles_nonparallel (norm_pos_iff.mpr (hne (φ n))) (hsmall (φ n))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
include hc in
lemma five_sequence_small_no_accumulation (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {yn : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hyn : ∀n,FiveCenter c (yn n)) (hx : FiveCenter c x)
    (hy : Tendsto yn atTop (𝓝 x)) (hne : ∀n,yn n≠x) (hsmall : ∀n,‖yn n-x‖<2) : False := by
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ,t,a,b,ha,hb,hs,hab⟩ := chord_sequence_lifts
    (by simpa only [sub_self] using hy.sub_const x) (fun n => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hne n)) hsmall
  have hcSum (n : ℕ) : x+direction (a n : Angles)+direction (b n : Angles)=yn (φ n) := by
    rw [direction_real,direction_real,Circle.coe_exp,Circle.coe_exp,add_assoc,hs]
    abel
  have haC : ∀n,∀k : Fin 5,∃i,a n∈fiveSupport c hc x i ∧ k∉fiveDiag i := by
    intro n
    apply five_endpoint_no_common c hc hw hx (hab n)
    rw [hcSum]; exact hyn _
  have hbC : ∀n,∀k : Fin 5,∃i,b n∈fiveSupport c hc x i ∧ k∉fiveDiag i := by
    intro n
    apply five_endpoint_no_common c hc hw hx
    · rw [show a n-b n=-(b n-a n) by ring,Real.sin_neg]
      exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (hab n)
    · rw [add_right_comm,hcSum]; exact hyn _
  obtain ⟨i,hi,hi'⟩ := five_limit_contact c hc ha haC
  obtain ⟨j,hj,hj'⟩ := five_limit_contact c hc hb hbC
  exact five_opposite_contacts_false c hc hw hx (by dsimp [sixty]; ring) hi hi' hj hj'
include hc in
lemma five_sequence_no_accumulation (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {yn : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hyn : ∀n,FiveCenter c (yn n)) (hx : FiveCenter c x)
    (hy : Tendsto yn atTop (𝓝 x)) (hne : ∀n,yn n≠x) : False := by
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠn in atTop,‖yn n-x‖<2 := by
    have hn : Tendsto (fun n => ‖yn n-x‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa only [sub_self,norm_zero] using (hy.sub_const x).norm
    exact hn.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ)<2))
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hsmall
  exact five_sequence_small_no_accumulation c hc hw (fun n => hyn (n+N)) hx
    (hy.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat N)) (fun n => hne (n+N)) (fun n => hN (n+N) (Nat.le_add_left _ _))
lemma fiveCenter_closed : IsClosed {x | FiveCenter c x} := by
  change IsClosed {x | ∀i : Fin 5,TransitionEdge c i (i+1) x}
  simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun i => transitionEdge_closed c i (i+1)
include hc in
lemma fiveCenter_discrete (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) : IsDiscrete {x | FiveCenter c x} := by
  apply isDiscrete_iff_discreteTopology.mpr
  apply discreteTopology_of_noAccPts
  intro x hx ha
  obtain ⟨yn,hyn,hy⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp
    (accPt_principal_iff_clusterPt.mp ha).mem_closure
  exact five_sequence_no_accumulation c hc hw (fun n => (hyn n).1) hx hy
    (fun n => by simpa only [mem_singleton_iff] using (hyn n).2)
include hc in
lemma fiveCenter_compact_finite (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    (K∩{x | FiveCenter c x}).Finite :=
  (hK.inter_right (fiveCenter_closed c)).finite ((fiveCenter_discrete c hc hw).mono inter_subset_right)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma cycle_standard_permutation {G : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)} {v : Fin 5}
    {p : G.Walk v v} (hp : p.IsCycle) : ∃e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5),
    (G.Adj (e 0) (e 1) ∧ G.Adj (e 0) (e 2) ∧ G.Adj (e 1) (e 2)) ∨
    (G.Adj (e 0) (e 1) ∧ G.Adj (e 1) (e 2) ∧ G.Adj (e 2) (e 3) ∧ G.Adj (e 3) (e 0)) ∨
    (∀i : Fin 5,G.Adj (e i) (e (i+1))) := by
  have hl := hp.three_le_length
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin p.length => p.getVert i) := by
    intro i j h
    apply Fin.ext
    exact hp.getVert_injOn' (by change i.val≤p.length-1; omega)
      (by change j.val≤p.length-1; omega) h
  have hle : p.length≤5 := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := Equiv.Perm.exists_extending_pair (Fin.castLE hle)
    (fun i : Fin p.length => p.getVert i) (Fin.castLE_injective hle) hinj
  have hem (n : ℕ) (hn : n<p.length) : e ⟨n,lt_of_lt_of_le hn hle⟩=p.getVert n := he ⟨n,hn⟩
  have h0 : e 0=p.getVert 0 := hem 0 (by omega)
  have h1 : e 1=p.getVert 1 := hem 1 (by omega)
  have h2 : e 2=p.getVert 2 := hem 2 (by omega)
  have h01 : G.Adj (e 0) (e 1) := by rw [h0,h1]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
  have h12 : G.Adj (e 1) (e 2) := by rw [h1,h2]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
  refine ⟨e,?_⟩
  rcases (by omega : p.length=3 ∨ p.length=4 ∨ p.length=5) with hL|hL|hL
  · left
    refine ⟨h01,?_,h12⟩
    have h20 := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := 2) (by omega)
    have hlast : p.getVert 3=p.getVert 0 := by simpa only [hL,SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero] using p.getVert_length
    rw [hlast,← h2,← h0] at h20
    exact h20.symm
  · right; left
    have h3 : e 3=p.getVert 3 := hem 3 (by omega)
    refine ⟨h01,h12,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [h2,h3]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
    · have h30 := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := 3) (by omega)
      have hlast : p.getVert 4=p.getVert 0 := by simpa only [hL,SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero] using p.getVert_length
      rwa [hlast,← h3,← h0] at h30
  · right; right
    have h3 : e 3=p.getVert 3 := hem 3 (by omega)
    have h4 : e 4=p.getVert 4 := hem 4 (by omega)
    have h23 : G.Adj (e 2) (e 3) := by rw [h2,h3]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
    have h34 : G.Adj (e 3) (e 4) := by rw [h3,h4]; exact p.adj_getVert_succ (by omega)
    have h40 : G.Adj (e 4) (e 0) := by
      have h40 := p.adj_getVert_succ (i := 4) (by omega)
      have hlast : p.getVert 5=p.getVert 0 := by simpa only [hL,SimpleGraph.Walk.getVert_zero] using p.getVert_length
      rwa [hlast,← h4,← h0] at h40
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h01
    · exact h12
    · exact h23
    · exact h34
    · exact h40
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
variable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c)
def transitionGraph (x : ℂ) : SimpleGraph (Fin 5) where
  Adj i j := TransitionEdge c i j x
  symm := ⟨fun _ _ h => transitionEdge_symm c h⟩
  loopless := ⟨fun _ h => h.1 rfl⟩

def CyclicCore : Set ℂ := {x | ¬(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic}
def StandardCore (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : Set ℂ :=
  {x | ThreeCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x ∨ FourCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x ∨ FiveCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x}
lemma transitionEdge_unlabel (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (i j : Fin 5) (x : ℂ) :
    TransitionEdge (e.symm ∘ c) i j x ↔ TransitionEdge c (e i) (e j) x := by
  simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using transitionEdge_relabel c e.symm (e i) (e j) x
lemma cyclicCore_subset_standard : CyclicCore c ⊆ ⋃e,StandardCore c e := by
  intro x hx
  change ¬∀v (p : (transitionGraph c x).Walk v v),¬p.IsCycle at hx
  push Not at hx
  obtain ⟨v,p,hp⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := cycle_standard_permutation hp
  refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e,?_⟩
  change ThreeCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x ∨ FourCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x ∨ FiveCenter (e.symm ∘ c) x
  simp only [ThreeCenter,FourCenter,FiveCenter,transitionEdge_unlabel]
  exact he
lemma cyclicCore_closed : IsClosed (CyclicCore c) := by
  rw [← isOpen_compl_iff]
  apply isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr
  intro x hx
  have hx' : (transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic := not_not.mp hx
  have he : ∀i j : Fin 5,∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x,
      TransitionEdge c i j y → TransitionEdge c i j x := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : TransitionEdge c i j x
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ _ => hij
    · have ho := (transitionEdge_closed c i j).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hij
      exact Filter.Eventually.mono ho fun _ hy h => False.elim (hy h)
  have hall : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x,∀i j : Fin 5,
      TransitionEdge c i j y → TransitionEdge c i j x :=
    (Filter.eventually_all.mpr fun i => Filter.eventually_all.mpr (he i))
  filter_upwards [hall] with y hy
  change ¬¬(transitionGraph c y).IsAcyclic
  exact not_not.mpr (hx'.anti (fun {i j} h => hy i j h))
lemma standardCore_closed (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : IsClosed (StandardCore c e) :=
  (threeCenter_closed (e.symm ∘ c)).union
    ((fourCenter_closed (e.symm ∘ c)).union (fiveCenter_closed (e.symm ∘ c)))
include hc in
lemma standardCore_compact_finite (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : (K∩StandardCore c e).Finite := by
  have hc' : Measurable (e.symm ∘ c) := (measurable_of_finite e.symm).comp hc
  have hw' := weak_relabel c e.symm hw
  exact ((threeCenter_compact_finite _ hc' hw' hK).union
    ((fourCenter_compact_finite _ hc' hw' hK).union
      (fiveCenter_compact_finite _ hc' hw' hK))).subset (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx.2 with h|h|h
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hx.1,h⟩
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hx.1,h⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hx.1,h⟩))
include hc in
lemma cyclicCore_compact_finite (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    (K∩CyclicCore c).Finite := by
  have hf : (⋃e,K∩StandardCore c e).Finite := finite_iUnion fun e =>
    standardCore_compact_finite c hc hw hK e
  apply hf.subset
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp (cyclicCore_subset_standard c hx.2)
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨e,hx.1,he⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/DiskAverages.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/DiskAverages.lean
