~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.AngularBoundary

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open Set
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- The four cyclic edges, with outsider label `4`. This definition is local to
this interface argument and agrees extensionally with `fourEdge`. -/
def interfaceFourEdge (i : Fin 4) : Finset (Fin 5) :=
  if i=0 then {0,1} else if i=1 then {1,2} else if i=2 then {2,3} else {3,0}
def interfaceFourAllowed (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (b : Bool) : Finset (Fin 5) :=
  Finset.univ.filter fun j => ∀i, s i=b → j∉interfaceFourEdge i
def InterfaceFourCompatible (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (p : Finset (Fin 5)) : Prop :=
  p.Nonempty ∧ p.card≤2 ∧
    (p∩interfaceFourAllowed s true).Nonempty ∧ (p∩interfaceFourAllowed s false).Nonempty
def InterfaceFourSplit (s : Fin 4 → Bool) : Prop := s 0≠s 2 ∧ s 1≠s 3
def interfaceFourDiagonal (s : Fin 4 → Bool) : Fin 3 := if s 0=s 1 then 2 else 1
lemma interface_four_not_edge : ∀s : Fin 4 → Bool, ∀p : Finset (Fin 5),
    InterfaceFourCompatible s p → ∀i, ¬p⊆interfaceFourEdge i := by
  unfold InterfaceFourCompatible interfaceFourAllowed
  decide
lemma interface_four_split : ∀s : Fin 4 → Bool, ∀p : Finset (Fin 5),
    InterfaceFourCompatible s p → 4∉p → InterfaceFourSplit s ∧
      (if 4∈p then (0:Fin 3) else if 0∈p then 1 else 2)=interfaceFourDiagonal s := by
  unfold InterfaceFourCompatible InterfaceFourSplit interfaceFourAllowed interfaceFourDiagonal
  decide
lemma interface_four_split_neg (s : Fin 4 → Bool) :
    InterfaceFourSplit (fun i => !(s i)) ↔ InterfaceFourSplit s := by
  simp [InterfaceFourSplit]
lemma interface_four_diagonal_neg (s : Fin 4 → Bool) :
    interfaceFourDiagonal (fun i => !(s i))=interfaceFourDiagonal s := by
  simp [interfaceFourDiagonal]
lemma interface_four_diagonal_ne_zero (s : Fin 4 → Bool) : interfaceFourDiagonal s≠0 := by
  unfold interfaceFourDiagonal
  split <;> decide
lemma interface_four_split_no_opposite : ∀s : Fin 4 → Bool,
    InterfaceFourSplit s → ∀i,¬(s i=true ∧ s (i+2)=true) := by
  unfold InterfaceFourSplit
  decide
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def fourInterfaceSign (v : Fin 4 → ℂ) (t : Angles) (i : Fin 4) : Bool :=
  decide (0<⟪direction t,v i⟫)
lemma interfaceFourEdge_eq (i : Fin 4) : interfaceFourEdge i=fourEdge i := rfl
lemma fourInterfaceSign_opposite {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles}
    (hn : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) :
    fourInterfaceSign v (t+(Real.pi : Angles))=fun i => !(fourInterfaceSign v t i) := by
  funext i
  simp only [fourInterfaceSign,direction_add_pi,inner_neg_left]
  by_cases hi : 0<⟪direction t,v i⟫
  · simp only [hi,show ¬0< -⟪direction t,v i⟫ by linarith,decide_true,decide_false,Bool.not_true]
  · have hneg : ⟪direction t,v i⟫<0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hi) (hn i)
    simp only [hi,show 0< -⟪direction t,v i⟫ by linarith,decide_true,decide_false,Bool.not_false]
variable {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
lemma four_interface_compatible (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ}
    {K : Fin 4 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1)
    (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    (hH : ∀i,∀j∈fourEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,InterfaceFourCompatible (fourInterfaceSign v t) (palette c hc x t) := by
  classical
  let E (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (b : Bool) : Finset (Fin 4) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i=b
  have hex := finite_support_exclusion_ae c hc K fourEdge hH
  have hJ (s : Fin 4 → Bool) (b : Bool) :
      ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,(∀i∈E s b,z∈Straddle (K i)) → c z∈interfaceFourAllowed s b := by
    filter_upwards [hex] with z hz hzE
    simp only [interfaceFourAllowed,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and]
    intro i hi
    exact hz i (hzE i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hi⟩))
  have hout (s : Fin 4 → Bool) := continuum_outer_restriction c hc (E s true) hK (hJ s true)
  have hin (s : Fin 4 → Bool) := continuum_inner_restriction c hc (E s false) hK (hJ s false)
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr hout,ae_all_iff.mpr hin,palette_nonempty c hc x,
    palette_cardinality c hc hw x,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i))]
    with t ho hi hp hcard hn
  refine ⟨hp,hcard.2,ho (fourInterfaceSign v t) ?_,hi (fourInterfaceSign v t) ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    exact of_decide_eq_true (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  · intro i hi
    have hn' : ¬0<⟪direction t,v i⟫ := of_decide_eq_false (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hn') (hn i)
lemma four_interface_admissible {x : ℂ} {v : Fin 4 → ℂ}
    (h : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,InterfaceFourCompatible (fourInterfaceSign v t) (palette c hc x t)) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,FourAdmissible (palette c hc x t) := by
  filter_upwards [h] with t ht
  exact ⟨ht.1,ht.2.1,interface_four_not_edge _ _ ht⟩
lemma four_state_group_of_admissible {x : ℂ}
    (h : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,FourAdmissible (palette c hc x t)) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t :=
  h.mono fun _ ht => four_admissible_group _ ht
lemma four_state_represents_of_group {x : ℂ}
    (hg : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t)
    (s : Fin 3) :
    RealState hc x {t : ℝ | fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=s} (fourGroup s) := by
  refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun ((fourState_measurable c hc x).comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
  intro i hi
  filter_upwards [angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hg] with t ht hts
  change fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=s at hts
  exact (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mp (ht (by simpa only [hts] using hi))
lemma four_state_changes_of_group (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ}
    (hg : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourState c hc x t≠fourState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles)) := by
  filter_upwards [hg,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hg,
    palette_sixty_disjoint c hc hw x] with t ht hu hd he
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := fourGroup_nonempty (fourState c hc x t)
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (ht hi) (hu (by simpa only [he] using hi))
lemma four_state_diagonal_positive_of_group (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ}
    (hg : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t)
    (s : Fin 3) (hs : s≠0) : 0<angularMeasure {t | fourState c hc x t=s} := by
  by_contra! hn
  have hnot : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourState c hc x t≠s :=
    measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (le_antisymm hn zero_le)
  let r : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have hr : r≠0 ∧ r≠s ∧ ∀t : Fin 3,t≠0 → t≠s → t=r := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → (if s=1 then (2:Fin 3) else 1)≠0 ∧ (if s=1 then (2:Fin 3) else 1)≠s ∧
      ∀t : Fin 3,t≠0 → t≠s → t=(if s=1 then 2 else 1) from by decide) s hs
  let f : Angles → Bool := fun t => if fourState c hc x t=0 then false else true
  have hf : Measurable f := Measurable.ite
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const) measurable_const measurable_const
  have hrep (v : Bool) : RealState hc x {t : ℝ | f (t : Angles)=v} (if v then fourGroup r else fourGroup 0) := by
    refine ⟨measurableSet_eq_fun (hf.comp angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.measurable) measurable_const,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    filter_upwards [angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hg,angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot]
      with t ht htn htv
    change f (t : Angles)=v at htv
    apply (mem_palette c hc x (t : Angles) i).mp
    apply ht
    cases v
    · have hz : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=0 := by simpa [f] using htv
      simpa only [hz,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false] using hi
    · have hz : fourState c hc x (t : Angles)=r := hr.2.2 _ (by simpa [f] using htv) htn
      simpa only [hz,ite_true] using hi
  have hcard : (Finset.univ\(fourGroup 0∪fourGroup r)).card≤2 := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → (Finset.univ\(fourGroup 0∪fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1))).card≤2 from by decide) s hs
  apply two_state_impossible hc hw x (fourGroup 0) (fourGroup r) hcard f hf (hrep false) (hrep true)
  filter_upwards [hnot,(measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixty : Angles)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hnot,
      four_state_changes_of_group hc hw hg] with t ht hu hne
  exact three_exclude_flip _ _ s hs ht hu hne
lemma four_interface_state_rule {x : ℂ} {v : Fin 4 → ℂ}
    (h : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,InterfaceFourCompatible (fourInterfaceSign v t) (palette c hc x t)) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourState c hc x t≠0 →
      InterfaceFourSplit (fourInterfaceSign v t) ∧ fourState c hc x t=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v t) := by
  filter_upwards [h] with t ht hn
  have ho : 4∉palette c hc x t := by
    intro ho
    exact hn (by simp only [fourState,fourCanonical,ho,ite_true])
  exact interface_four_split _ _ ht ho
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma angle_state_preimage_positive {A : Set Angles} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hp : 0<angularMeasure A) :
    0<volume (((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A) := by
  by_contra! hn
  have hz := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp (le_antisymm hn zero_le)
  have ha : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∉A := ae_angular_of_ae_line hA.compl hz
  exact hp.ne' (measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mpr ha)
/-- Every point of an angular essential support has a real essential-support lift.
The compact fundamental domain is used only to establish the support inclusion. -/
lemma angle_support_lift {A : Set Angles} (hA : MeasurableSet A) {t : Angles}
    (ht : t∈(angularMeasure.restrict A).support) :
    ∃b : ℝ,(b : Angles)=t ∧ b∈(volume.restrict (((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A)).support := by
  let B : Set ℝ := ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) ⁻¹' A
  let S : Set ℝ := (volume.restrict B).support∩Icc 0 (2*Real.pi)
  let F : Set Angles := ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) '' S
  have hm : Continuous ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) := AddCircle.continuous_mk' _
  have hS : IsCompact S := isCompact_Icc.inter_left Measure.isClosed_support
  have hF : IsClosed F := (hS.image hm).isClosed
  have ha : ∀ᵐt∂((volume : Measure Angles).restrict A),t∈F := by
    rw [← (AddCircle.measurePreserving_mk (2*Real.pi) 0).map_eq,
      Measure.restrict_map hm.measurable hA]
    apply (ae_map_iff hm.measurable.aemeasurable hF.measurableSet).mpr
    have hs : ∀ᵐb∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (0+2*Real.pi))).restrict B),b∈(volume.restrict B).support := by
      apply ae_mono (Measure.restrict_mono_measure Measure.restrict_le_self B)
      exact Measure.support_mem_ae
    have hi : ∀ᵐb∂((volume.restrict (Ioc 0 (0+2*Real.pi))).restrict B),b∈Ioc 0 (0+2*Real.pi) :=
      ae_restrict_of_ae (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc)
    filter_upwards [hs,hi] with b hb hib
    exact ⟨b,⟨hb,hib.1.le,by simpa only [zero_add] using hib.2⟩,rfl⟩
  have ha' : ∀ᵐt∂(angularMeasure.restrict A),t∈F := by
    rw [AddCircle.volume_eq_smul_haarAddCircle,Measure.restrict_smul] at ha
    exact (Measure.ae_ennreal_smul_measure_iff (by positivity : ENNReal.ofReal (2*Real.pi)≠0)).mp ha
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbt⟩ := Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed hF ha' ht
  exact ⟨b,hbt,hb.1⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma direction_inner_real (t : ℝ) (v : ℂ) :
    ⟪direction (t : Angles),v⟫=Real.cos t*v.re+Real.sin t*v.im := by
  rw [Complex.inner,direction_real,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re,Complex.conj_re,Complex.conj_im,Complex.add_re,
    Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_im]
  ring
lemma three_direction_moment (t : Angles) (v w : ℂ) :
    ⟪direction t,v⟫*⟪direction t,w⟫+
      ⟪direction (t+(sixty : Angles)),v⟫*⟪direction (t+(sixty : Angles)),w⟫+
      ⟪direction (t+2•(sixty : Angles)),v⟫*⟪direction (t+2•(sixty : Angles)),w⟫=
      (3/2:ℝ)*⟪v,w⟫ := by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective t
  rw [← AddCircle.coe_nsmul,← AddCircle.coe_add,← AddCircle.coe_add]
  simp only [direction_inner_real,nsmul_eq_mul,sixty,Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,
    Real.cos_pi_div_three,Real.sin_pi_div_three]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
  rw [show 2*(Real.pi/3)=Real.pi/3+Real.pi/3 by ring]
  simp only [Real.cos_add,Real.sin_add,Real.cos_pi_div_three,Real.sin_pi_div_three,
    Complex.inner,Complex.mul_re,Complex.conj_re,Complex.conj_im]
  have hs : Real.sqrt 3^2=3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hc := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq a
  ring_nf
  have hs3 : Real.sqrt 3^3=3*Real.sqrt 3 := by rw [pow_succ,hs]
  have hs4 : Real.sqrt 3^4=9 := by rw [show 4=2*2 from rfl,pow_mul,hs]; norm_num
  simp only [hs,hs3,hs4]
  linear_combination (3/2:ℝ)*(v.re*w.re+v.im*w.im)*hc
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma direction_sixty_unit (t : Angles) : ‖direction t-direction (t+(sixty : Angles))‖=1 := by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective t
  rw [← AddCircle.coe_add,direction_real,direction_real]
  have he : (Circle.exp a : ℂ)-(Circle.exp (a+sixty) : ℂ)=(Circle.exp (a-sixty) : ℂ) := by
    simp only [Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I]
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp only [Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im,Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,
      Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_re,Complex.I_im,
      Real.cos_add,Real.cos_sub,Real.sin_add,Real.sin_sub,sixty,Real.cos_pi_div_three] <;> ring
  rw [he]
  exact Circle.norm_coe _
lemma compact_no_unit_margin {F : Set Angles} (hF : IsCompact F)
    (hu : ∀t∈F,∀u∈F,‖direction t-direction u‖≠1) :
    ∃ε : ℝ,0<ε ∧ ∀t∈F,∀u,dist t u<ε → u+(sixty : Angles)∉F ∧ u-(sixty : Angles)∉F := by
  let T : Set Angles := {u | u+(sixty : Angles)∉F ∧ u-(sixty : Angles)∉F}
  have ho : IsOpen T := (hF.isClosed.isOpen_compl.preimage (continuous_id.add_const _)).inter
    (hF.isClosed.isOpen_compl.preimage (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))
  have hs : F⊆T := by
    intro t ht
    refine ⟨fun hh => hu t ht _ hh (direction_sixty_unit t),fun hh => ?_⟩
    apply hu (t-(sixty : Angles)) hh t ht
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using direction_sixty_unit (t-(sixty : Angles))
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hsub⟩ := hF.exists_thickening_subset_open ho hs
  exact ⟨ε,hε,fun t ht u htu => hsub (Metric.mem_thickening_iff.mpr ⟨t,ht,by simpa only [dist_comm] using htu⟩)⟩

variable {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
def interfaceStateSet (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : Set Angles := {t | fourState c hc x t=s}
def interfaceStateSupport (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : Set Angles :=
  (angularMeasure.restrict (interfaceStateSet hc x s)).support
lemma interfaceStateSet_measurable (x : ℂ) (s : Fin 3) : MeasurableSet (interfaceStateSet hc x s) :=
  measurableSet_eq_fun (fourState_measurable c hc x) measurable_const
lemma interfaceStateSupport_ae (x : ℂ) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,∀s : Fin 3,fourState c hc x t=s → t∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s := by
  apply ae_all_iff.mpr
  intro s
  exact (ae_restrict_iff' (interfaceStateSet_measurable hc x s)).mp Measure.support_mem_ae
lemma interfaceStateSupport_no_unit (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ}
    (hg : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t)
    {s : Fin 3} (hs : s≠0) {t u : Angles}
    (ht : t∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s) (hu : u∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s) :
    ‖direction t-direction u‖≠1 := by
  let r : Fin 3 := if s=1 then 2 else 1
  have hr : r≠0 := by dsimp [r]; split <;> decide
  have hl : ∀i : Fin 5,i∉fourGroup r∪fourGroup s ↔ i=4 := by
    exact (show ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → ∀i : Fin 5,i∉fourGroup (if s=1 then 2 else 1)∪fourGroup s ↔ i=4 from by decide) s hs
  obtain ⟨b,rfl,hb⟩ := angle_support_lift (interfaceStateSet_measurable hc x s) ht
  obtain ⟨d,rfl,hd⟩ := angle_support_lift (interfaceStateSet_measurable hc x s) hu
  exact strict_state_no_unit_support hc hw hl (four_state_represents_of_group hc hg r)
    (four_state_represents_of_group hc hg s)
    (angle_state_preimage_positive (interfaceStateSet_measurable hc x r)
      (four_state_diagonal_positive_of_group hc hw hg r hr)) hb hd
lemma interfaceStateSupport_margin (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ}
    (hg : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,fourGroup (fourState c hc x t)⊆palette c hc x t) :
    ∃ε : ℝ,0<ε ∧ ∀s : Fin 3,s≠0 → ∀t∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s,∀u,dist t u<ε →
      u+(sixty : Angles)∉interfaceStateSupport hc x s ∧ u-(sixty : Angles)∉interfaceStateSupport hc x s := by
  have h (s : Fin 3) (hs : s≠0) := compact_no_unit_margin
    (show IsCompact (interfaceStateSupport hc x s) from Measure.isClosed_support.isCompact)
    (fun t ht u hu => interfaceStateSupport_no_unit hc hw hg hs ht hu)
  obtain ⟨ε₁,hε₁,h₁⟩ := h 1 (by decide)
  obtain ⟨ε₂,hε₂,h₂⟩ := h 2 (by decide)
  refine ⟨min ε₁ ε₂,lt_min hε₁ hε₂,?_⟩
  intro s hs t ht u htu
  fin_cases s
  · exact (hs rfl).elim
  · exact h₁ t ht u (htu.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))
  · exact h₂ t ht u (htu.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma four_diagonal_product_neg {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles}
    (hn : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) (hd : interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v t)=1) :
    ⟪direction t,v 0⟫*⟪direction t,v 1⟫<0 := by
  by_cases h0 : 0<⟪direction t,v 0⟫ <;> by_cases h1 : 0<⟪direction t,v 1⟫
  · simp only [interfaceFourDiagonal,fourInterfaceSign,h0,h1] at hd
    norm_num at hd
  · exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg h0 (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h1) (hn 1))
  · exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h0) (hn 0)) h1
  · simp only [interfaceFourDiagonal,fourInterfaceSign,h0,h1] at hd
    norm_num at hd
lemma four_diagonal_product_pos {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles}
    (hn : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) (hd : interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v t)=2) :
    0<⟪direction t,v 0⟫*⟪direction t,v 1⟫ := by
  by_cases h0 : 0<⟪direction t,v 0⟫ <;> by_cases h1 : 0<⟪direction t,v 1⟫
  · exact mul_pos h0 h1
  · simp only [interfaceFourDiagonal,fourInterfaceSign,h0,h1,decide_true,decide_false] at hd
    norm_num at hd
  · simp only [interfaceFourDiagonal,fourInterfaceSign,h0,h1,decide_true,decide_false] at hd
    norm_num at hd
  · exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h0) (hn 0))
      (lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h1) (hn 1))
lemma four_diagonal_orbit_half {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles} {j : Fin 6}
    (hn : ∀i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) :
    interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle (j+3)))=
      interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j)) := by
  rw [sixAngle_half,← add_assoc,fourInterfaceSign_opposite hn,interface_four_diagonal_neg]
lemma four_diagonal_uniform_of_parity {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles} {a : Fin 3} {p : Fin 2}
    (hn : ∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0)
    (hd : ∀j : Fin 6,j.val%2≠p.val → interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))=a) :
    ∀j : Fin 6,interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))=a := by
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j.val%2≠p.val
  · exact hd j hj
  have hh : (j+3).val%2≠p.val := by
    have h : ∀p : Fin 2,∀j : Fin 6,¬j.val%2≠p.val → (j+3).val%2≠p.val := by decide
    exact h p j hj
  rw [← four_diagonal_orbit_half (hn j)]
  exact hd (j+3) hh
lemma four_uniform_diagonal_one {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles}
    (hn : ∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0)
    (hd : ∀j : Fin 6,interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))=1) :
    ⟪v 0,v 1⟫<0 := by
  have h0 := four_diagonal_product_neg (hn 0) (hd 0)
  have h1 := four_diagonal_product_neg (hn 1) (hd 1)
  have h2 := four_diagonal_product_neg (hn 2) (hd 2)
  norm_num only [sixAngle,Fin.val_zero,Fin.val_one,Fin.val_two,zero_nsmul,one_nsmul,add_zero] at h0 h1 h2
  have hm := three_direction_moment t (v 0) (v 1)
  linarith
lemma four_uniform_diagonal_two {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t : Angles}
    (hn : ∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0)
    (hd : ∀j : Fin 6,interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))=2) :
    0<⟪v 0,v 1⟫ := by
  have h0 := four_diagonal_product_pos (hn 0) (hd 0)
  have h1 := four_diagonal_product_pos (hn 1) (hd 1)
  have h2 := four_diagonal_product_pos (hn 2) (hd 2)
  norm_num only [sixAngle,Fin.val_zero,Fin.val_one,Fin.val_two,zero_nsmul,one_nsmul,add_zero] at h0 h1 h2
  have hm := three_direction_moment t (v 0) (v 1)
  linarith
/-- The three-direction quadratic moment replaces the source's projective arc
length argument. No assumption about antipodal ray pairs or the collinear case
is required: two opposite uniform diagonal triples are already contradictory. -/
lemma four_opposite_uniform_diagonals_false {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t u : Angles}
    (hnt : ∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0)
    (hnu : ∀j i,⟪direction (u+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0)
    {a b : Fin 3} (ha : a≠0) (hb : b≠0) (hab : a≠b)
    (hdt : ∀j : Fin 6,interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))=a)
    (hdu : ∀j : Fin 6,interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (u+sixAngle j))=b) : False := by
  have hab' : (a=1 ∧ b=2) ∨ (a=2 ∧ b=1) :=
    (show ∀a b : Fin 3,a≠0 → b≠0 → a≠b → (a=1 ∧ b=2) ∨ (a=2 ∧ b=1) from by decide) a b ha hb hab
  rcases hab' with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩|⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  · exact (four_uniform_diagonal_one hnt hdt).not_gt (four_uniform_diagonal_two hnu hdu)
  · exact (four_uniform_diagonal_one hnu hdu).not_gt (four_uniform_diagonal_two hnt hdt)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma sixAngle_prev (j : Fin 6) : sixAngle (j-1)=sixAngle j-(sixty : Angles) := by
  have h := sixAngle_step (j-1)
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr h.symm
variable {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
def fourInterfaceWord (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) (j : Fin 6) : Fin 3 :=
  fourState c hc x (t+sixAngle j)
lemma fourInterfaceWord_shift (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) (j : Fin 6) :
    fourInterfaceWord hc x (t+(sixty : Angles)) j=fourInterfaceWord hc x t (j+1) := by
  simp only [fourInterfaceWord,sixAngle_step]
  congr 1
  abel
/-- Construction of the dense conull shift-invariant set and its actual
six-position words, from the previously established genuine state system. -/
lemma four_interface_word_data (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {v : Fin 4 → ℂ}
    (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1)
    (hcompat : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,InterfaceFourCompatible (fourInterfaceSign v t) (palette c hc x t)) :
    ∃G : Set Angles,Dense G ∧ (∀t∈G,t+(sixty : Angles)∈G) ∧
      (∀t∈G,∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0) ∧
      (∀t∈G,∀j,fourInterfaceWord hc x t j≠0 → fourInterfaceWord hc x t j=
        interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j))) ∧
      (∀t∈G,FourWordValid (fourInterfaceWord hc x t)) ∧
      ∃ε : ℝ,0<ε ∧ ∀t∈G,∀u∈G,dist t u<ε →
        FourWordCross (fourInterfaceWord hc x t) (fourInterfaceWord hc x u) := by
  have hg := four_state_group_of_admissible hc (four_interface_admissible hc hcompat)
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hmargin⟩ := interfaceStateSupport_margin hc hw hg
  let Q (t : Angles) : Prop := (∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) ∧
    (fourState c hc x t≠0 → fourState c hc x t=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v t)) ∧
    fourState c hc x t≠fourState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles)) ∧
    ∀s : Fin 3,fourState c hc x t=s → t∈interfaceStateSupport hc x s
  have hQ : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,Q t := by
    filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i)),
      four_interface_state_rule hc hcompat,four_state_changes_of_group hc hw hg,
      interfaceStateSupport_ae hc x] with t hn hr hs hF
    exact ⟨hn,fun h => (hr h).2,hs,hF⟩
  let G : Set Angles := {t | ∀j : Fin 6,Q (t+sixAngle j)}
  have hGae : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,t∈G := ae_all_iff.mpr fun j =>
    (measurePreserving_add_right angularMeasure (sixAngle j)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hQ
  have hGshift : ∀t∈G,t+(sixty : Angles)∈G := by
    intro t ht j
    have he : t+(sixty : Angles)+sixAngle j=t+sixAngle (j+1) := by
      rw [sixAngle_step]
      abel
    rw [he]
    exact ht (j+1)
  refine ⟨G,Measure.dense_of_ae hGae,hGshift,fun t ht j => (ht j).1,fun t ht j => (ht j).2.1,?_,ε,hε,?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro j
      simpa only [fourInterfaceWord,sixAngle_step,← add_assoc] using (ht j).2.2.1
    · intro j hj hj3
      dsimp only [fourInterfaceWord]
      rw [(ht (j+3)).2.1 hj3,(ht j).2.1 hj]
      exact four_diagonal_orbit_half (ht j).1
  · intro t ht u hu htu j hj
    have hm := hmargin (fourInterfaceWord hc x t j) hj (t+sixAngle j)
      ((ht j).2.2.2 _ rfl) (u+sixAngle j) (by simpa only [dist_add_right] using htu)
    constructor
    · intro he
      apply hm.1
      have hh := (hu (j+1)).2.2.2 _ he
      simpa only [sixAngle_step,← add_assoc] using hh
    · intro he
      apply hm.2
      have hh := (hu (j-1)).2.2.2 _ he
      simpa only [sixAngle_prev,add_sub_assoc] using hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma four_word_opposite_geometry_false {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} {t u : Angles}
    {w z : Fin 6 → Fin 3} (hw : FourWordValid w) (hz : FourWordValid z)
    (hzero : ∀j,w j=0 → j.val%2=0) (hzero' : ∀j,z j=0 → j.val%2=1)
    (hcross : FourWordCross w z)
    (hnt : ∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0)
    (hnu : ∀j i,⟪direction (u+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0)
    (hdt : ∀j,w j≠0 → w j=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j)))
    (hdu : ∀j,z j≠0 → z j=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (u+sixAngle j))) : False := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb,hab,hwa,hzb⟩ := four_word_opposite_parity w hw hzero z hz hzero' hcross
  apply four_opposite_uniform_diagonals_false hnt hnu ha hb hab
  · apply four_diagonal_uniform_of_parity (p:=0) hnt
    intro j hj
    have hh := hwa j (by norm_num only [Fin.val_zero] at hj; omega)
    exact (hdt j (fun h => ha (hh.symm.trans h))).symm.trans hh
  · apply four_diagonal_uniform_of_parity (p:=1) hnu
    intro j hj
    have hh := hzb j (by norm_num only [Fin.val_one] at hj; omega)
    exact (hdu j (fun h => hb (hh.symm.trans h))).symm.trans hh

lemma no_four_word_geometry (v : Fin 4 → ℂ) (G : Set Angles) (hG : Dense G)
    (w : Angles → Fin 6 → Fin 3) (hw : ∀t∈G,FourWordValid (w t))
    (hshiftG : ∀t∈G,t+(sixty : Angles)∈G)
    (hshift : ∀t∈G,∀j,w (t+(sixty : Angles)) j=w t (j+1))
    (hn : ∀t∈G,∀j i,⟪direction (t+sixAngle j),v i⟫≠0)
    (hd : ∀t∈G,∀j,w t j≠0 → w t j=interfaceFourDiagonal (fourInterfaceSign v (t+sixAngle j)))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0<ε)
    (hcross : ∀t∈G,∀u∈G,dist t u<ε → FourWordCross (w t) (w u)) : False := by
  classical
  have hnomix := four_words_no_mixed G hG w hw hshiftG hshift hε hcross
  have hpar (t : Angles) (ht : t∈G) := four_word_parity (w t) (hw t ht) (hnomix t ht)
  let p : Angles → Fin 2 := fun t => if ht : t∈G then (hpar t ht).choose else 0
  have hp (t : Angles) (ht : t∈G) : ∀j,w t j=0 → j.val%2=(p t).val := by
    simpa only [p,dite_eq_left ht] using (hpar t ht).choose_spec
  have hclose (t : Angles) (ht : t∈G) (u : Angles) (hu : u∈G) (htu : dist t u<ε) : p t=p u := by
    by_contra hne
    have hcases : (p t=0 ∧ p u=1) ∨ (p t=1 ∧ p u=0) :=
      (show ∀a b : Fin 2,a≠b → (a=0 ∧ b=1) ∨ (a=1 ∧ b=0) from by decide) _ _ hne
    rcases hcases with ⟨hpt,hpu⟩|⟨hpt,hpu⟩
    · exact four_word_opposite_geometry_false (hw t ht) (hw u hu)
        (by simpa only [hpt,Fin.val_zero] using hp t ht)
        (by simpa only [hpu,Fin.val_one] using hp u hu)
        (hcross t ht u hu htu) (hn t ht) (hn u hu) (hd t ht) (hd u hu)
    · exact four_word_opposite_geometry_false (hw u hu) (hw t ht)
        (by simpa only [hpu,Fin.val_zero] using hp u hu)
        (by simpa only [hpt,Fin.val_one] using hp t ht)
        (hcross u hu t ht (by simpa only [dist_comm] using htu))
        (hn u hu) (hn t ht) (hd u hu) (hd t ht)
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := hG.nonempty
  have hconst : ∀u∈G,p u=p t := by
    apply dense_isolated_value_constant hG p hε ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩
    intro u hu hut z hz huz
    exact (hclose u hu z hz huz).symm.trans hut
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := four_word_has_outsider (w (t+(sixty : Angles))) (hw _ (hshiftG t ht))
  have hh := four_word_shift_parity (w t) (p t) (hp t ht) j
    (by simpa only [hshift t ht j] using hj)
  have hh' := hp _ (hshiftG t ht) j hj
  rw [hconst _ (hshiftG t ht)] at hh'
  have he : (p t).val=(p t+1).val := hh'.symm.trans hh
  exact (show ∀a : Fin 2,a.val≠(a+1).val from by decide) (p t) he

/-- The actual length-four interface cycle is impossible. All hypotheses are
exactly approach directions and common straddling exclusion of both endpoints. -/
lemma no_four_interfaces {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 4 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 4 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1)
    (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    (hH : ∀i,∀j∈fourEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) : False := by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hshiftG,hn,hd,hw',ε,hε,hcross⟩ := four_interface_word_data hc hw hv
    (four_interface_compatible hc hw hv hK hH)
  exact no_four_word_geometry v G hG (fourInterfaceWord hc x) hw' hshiftG
    (fun t _ j => fourInterfaceWord_shift hc x t j) hn hd hε hcross
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Moser.lean

~~~~lean
import Mathlib

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def ThreeLabelRegion (x y : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0<x^2+y^2 ∧ x^2+y^2<4 ∧
    y^2*(3*x^2-y^2)^2 < (x^2+y^2)^3*(1-(x^2+y^2)/4)*(x^2+y^2-1)^2
lemma square_coordinate_bounds {x c h : ℝ} (_hh : 0≤h) (hc : h≤|c|) (hx : |x-c|≤h) :
    (|c|-h)^2≤x^2 ∧ x^2≤(|c|+h)^2 := by
  have hu : |x|≤|c|+h := by
    calc |x|=|c+(x-c)| := by congr 1; ring
         _≤|c|+|x-c| := abs_add_le _ _
         _≤|c|+h := by linarith
  have hl : |c|-h≤|x| := by
    have ht : |c|≤|x|+|x-c| := by
      calc |c|=|x-(x-c)| := by congr 1; ring
           _≤|x|+|x-c| := abs_sub _ _
    linarith
  constructor
  · simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (sub_nonneg.mpr hc) hl 2
  · simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg x) hu 2
lemma region_of_rational_bounds {x y a b Y H d : ℝ}
    (ha : 0<a) (hb : b<4) (hY : 0≤Y) (_hH : 0≤H) (hd : 0≤d)
    (hl : a≤x^2+y^2) (hu : x^2+y^2≤b)
    (hy : y^2≤Y) (habs : |3*x^2-y^2|≤H) (hg : d≤|x^2+y^2-1|)
    (hnum : Y*H^2<a^3*(1-b/4)*d^2) : ThreeLabelRegion x y := by
  refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le ha hl,lt_of_le_of_lt hu hb,?_⟩
  calc y^2*(3*x^2-y^2)^2 ≤ Y*H^2 := by
         have hpow : (3*x^2-y^2)^2≤H^2 := by
           simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) habs 2
         exact mul_le_mul hy hpow (sq_nonneg _) hY
       _ < a^3*(1-b/4)*d^2 := hnum
       _ ≤ (x^2+y^2)^3*(1-(x^2+y^2)/4)*(x^2+y^2-1)^2 := by
         have hnonneg : 0≤1-b/4 := by linarith
         have hgap : d^2≤(x^2+y^2-1)^2 := by
           simpa only [sq_abs] using pow_le_pow_left₀ hd hg 2
         have hpos : 0≤(x^2+y^2)^3*(1-(x^2+y^2)/4) :=
           mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (le_trans ha.le hl) _) (by linarith)
         gcongr
lemma abs_le_of_bounds {x l u c h : ℝ} (hl : l≤x) (hu : x≤u)
    (hc1 : c-h≤l) (hc2 : u≤c+h) : |x-c|≤h := by
  rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma sin_sub_add_product (a b : ℝ) :
    Real.sin (a-b)*Real.sin (a+b)=Real.sin a^2-Real.sin b^2 := by
  rw [Real.sin_sub,Real.sin_add]
  have ha : Real.cos a^2=1-Real.sin a^2 := by linarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq a]
  have hb : Real.cos b^2=1-Real.sin b^2 := by linarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq b]
  calc _ = Real.sin a^2*Real.cos b^2-Real.cos a^2*Real.sin b^2 := by ring
       _ = _ := by rw [ha,hb]; ring
lemma sin_three_using_cos (a : ℝ) :
    Real.sin (3*a)=Real.sin a*(4*Real.cos a^2-1) := by
  rw [Real.sin_three_mul]
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin a*x) (Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq a)]
/-- Exact strict angular form of the manuscript's polynomial region. -/
lemma polynomial_region_angles {z : ℂ} (hz : ThreeLabelRegion z.re z.im) :
    ∃ t u : ℝ, (Circle.exp t : ℂ)+(Circle.exp u : ℂ)=z ∧
      Real.sin (u-t)≠0 ∧ Real.sin (3*t)*Real.sin (3*u)<0 := by
  let r : ℝ := ‖z‖
  let p : ℝ := z.arg
  let d : ℝ := Real.arccos (r/2)
  have hr2 : r^2=z.re^2+z.im^2 := by
    change ‖z‖^2=_
    rw [Complex.sq_norm,Complex.normSq_apply]
    ring
  have hr0 : 0<r := by
    have hn : 0≤r := norm_nonneg z
    nlinarith [hz.1]
  have hrlt : r<2 := by nlinarith [hz.2.1]
  have hdcos : Real.cos d=r/2 := Real.cos_arccos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hd0 : 0<d := Real.arccos_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hdlt : d<Real.pi/2 := Real.arccos_lt_pi_div_two.mpr (by positivity)
  have hdsin : 0<Real.sin d := Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hd0 (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
  have hdsq : Real.sin d^2=1-r^2/4 := by
    have hh := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq d
    rw [hdcos] at hh
    nlinarith
  have hdp : Real.sin (3*d)=Real.sin d*(r^2-1) := by
    rw [sin_three_using_cos,hdcos]; ring
  have hpysin : r*Real.sin p=z.im := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg z
  have hpxcos : r*Real.cos p=z.re := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg z
  have hpy : r^3*Real.sin (3*p)=z.im*(3*z.re^2-z.im^2) := by
    rw [Real.sin_three_mul]
    calc _ = 3*r^2*(r*Real.sin p)-4*(r*Real.sin p)^3 := by ring
         _ = _ := by rw [hr2,hpysin]; ring
  have hP : z.im^2*(3*z.re^2-z.im^2)^2=r^6*Real.sin (3*p)^2 := by
    calc _ = (z.im*(3*z.re^2-z.im^2))^2 := by ring
         _ = (r^3*Real.sin (3*p))^2 := by rw [hpy]
         _ = _ := by ring
  have hP' : (z.re^2+z.im^2)^3*(1-(z.re^2+z.im^2)/4)*(z.re^2+z.im^2-1)^2=
      r^6*Real.sin (3*d)^2 := by
    rw [←hr2,hdp]
    rw [show 1-r^2/4=Real.sin d^2 from hdsq.symm]
    ring
  have hlt : Real.sin (3*p)^2<Real.sin (3*d)^2 := by
    have hh := hz.2.2
    rw [hP,hP'] at hh
    exact (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ (pow_pos hr0 6)).mp hh
  refine ⟨p-d,p+d,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · apply Complex.ext
    · simp only [Complex.add_re,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,
        ←Complex.ofReal_cos,←Complex.ofReal_sin,Complex.add_re,Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_im,mul_zero,
        sub_zero,zero_mul,add_zero]
      rw [Real.cos_sub,Real.cos_add,hdcos]
      nlinarith
    · simp only [Complex.add_im,Circle.coe_exp,Complex.exp_mul_I,
        ←Complex.ofReal_cos,←Complex.ofReal_sin,Complex.add_im,Complex.mul_im,
        Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.I_re,Complex.ofReal_im,Complex.I_im,mul_zero,
        mul_one,add_zero,zero_add]
      rw [Real.sin_sub,Real.sin_add,hdcos]
      nlinarith
  · rw [show p+d-(p-d)=2*d by ring,Real.sin_two_mul,hdcos]
    exact ne_of_gt (by positivity)
  · rw [mul_sub,mul_add,sin_sub_add_product]
    linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def moserA : ℂ := ((Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ)+Complex.I)/2
def moserB : ℂ := ((Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ)-Complex.I)/2
def moserT : ℂ := Real.sqrt 3
def moserU : ℂ := (5+Complex.I*(Real.sqrt 11 : ℂ))/6
def moserPoint : Fin 7 → ℂ := ![0,moserA,moserB,moserT,moserU*moserA,moserU*moserB,moserU*moserT]
@[simp] lemma moserPoint_0 : moserPoint 0=0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma moserPoint_1 : moserPoint 1=moserA := rfl
@[simp] lemma moserPoint_2 : moserPoint 2=moserB := rfl
@[simp] lemma moserPoint_3 : moserPoint 3=moserT := rfl
@[simp] lemma moserPoint_4 : moserPoint 4=moserU*moserA := rfl
@[simp] lemma moserPoint_5 : moserPoint 5=moserU*moserB := rfl
@[simp] lemma moserPoint_6 : moserPoint 6=moserU*moserT := rfl
def moserEdges : Finset (Fin 7 × Fin 7) :=
  {(0,1),(0,2),(1,2),(3,1),(3,2),(0,4),(0,5),(4,5),(6,4),(6,5),(3,6)}
lemma complex_norm_one_of_sq {z : ℂ} (h : z.re^2+z.im^2=1) : ‖z‖=1 := by
  have he : ‖z‖^2=1 := by rw [← Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq,Complex.normSq_apply]; nlinarith
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
lemma moser_edge_unit {i j : Fin 7} (h : (i,j)∈moserEdges) : ‖moserPoint i-moserPoint j‖=1 := by
  have h3 := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ)≤3 by norm_num)
  have h11 := Real.sq_sqrt (show (0:ℝ)≤11 by norm_num)
  simp only [moserEdges,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  rcases h with h|h|h|h|h|h|h|h|h|h|h <;> rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  all_goals
    apply complex_norm_one_of_sq
    norm_num [moserA,moserB,moserT,moserU,Complex.mul_re,Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.div_ofReal_re,Complex.div_ofReal_im,Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im,
      Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im] <;>
      (ring_nf; norm_num [h3,h11])
lemma three_color_diamond {a b p q : Fin 3} (hab : a≠b)
    (hpa : p≠a) (hpb : p≠b) (hqa : q≠a) (hqb : q≠b) : p=q := by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> fin_cases p <;> fin_cases q <;> simp_all
lemma moser_not_three_colorable (f : Fin 7 → Fin 3)
    (hf : ∀i j,(i,j)∈moserEdges → f i≠f j) : False := by
  have h03 : f 0=f 3 := three_color_diamond
    (hf 1 2 (by decide)) (hf 0 1 (by decide)) (hf 0 2 (by decide))
    (hf 3 1 (by decide)) (hf 3 2 (by decide))
  have h06 : f 0=f 6 := three_color_diamond
    (hf 4 5 (by decide)) (hf 0 4 (by decide)) (hf 0 5 (by decide))
    (hf 6 4 (by decide)) (hf 6 5 (by decide))
  exact hf 3 6 (by decide) (h03.symm.trans h06)
def moserRotation : ℂ := (35+12*Complex.I)/37
def placedMoser (i : Fin 7) : ℂ := moserRotation*(moserPoint i+(-290+149*Complex.I)/250)
lemma moserRotation_unit : ‖moserRotation‖=1 := by
  apply complex_norm_one_of_sq
  norm_num [moserRotation,Complex.div_ofReal_re,Complex.div_ofReal_im]
lemma placedMoser_edge_unit {i j : Fin 7} (h : (i,j)∈moserEdges) : ‖placedMoser i-placedMoser j‖=1 := by
  have he : placedMoser i-placedMoser j=moserRotation*(moserPoint i-moserPoint j) := by
    unfold placedMoser; ring
  rw [he,norm_mul,moserRotation_unit,moser_edge_unit h,one_mul]
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

    Real.sqrt 3*Real.sqrt 11≤1.73206*3.31663 := by
  obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩ := radical_bounds

  change |(placedMoser 0).re-(-1.2906)|≤0.00011 ∧ |(placedMoser 0).im-(0.1876)|≤0.00011
  norm_num [placedMoser,moserRotation,moserA,moserB,moserT,moserU,

  norm_num [placedMoser,moserRotation,moserA,moserB,moserT,moserU,

lemma seven_point_box_4 :
    |(placedMoser 4).re-certificateX 4|≤(0.00011 : ℝ) ∧
    |(placedMoser 4).im-certificateY 4|≤(0.00011 : ℝ) := by

    Complex.add_re,Complex.add_im,Complex.sub_re,Complex.sub_im]
  constructor <;> rw [abs_le] <;> constructor <;> nlinarith

lemma seven_point_boxes (i : Fin 7) :
    |(placedMoser i).re-certificateX i|≤(0.00011 : ℝ) ∧
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Sectors.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Sectors.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.AngularBoundary
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Moser

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def triangleEdge (i : Fin 3) : Finset (Fin 5) := if i=0 then {0,1} else if i=1 then {1,2} else {2,0}
lemma triangle_majority_cover : ∀s : Fin 3 → Bool,∃b : Bool,
    ∀j∈({0,1,2} : Finset (Fin 5)),∃i : Fin 3,s i=b ∧ j∈triangleEdge i := by decide
lemma triangle_outsider : ∀s : Fin 3 → Bool,∀b : Bool,
    (∀j∈({0,1,2} : Finset (Fin 5)),∃i : Fin 3,s i=b ∧ j∈triangleEdge i) →
    ∀j : Fin 5,(∀i : Fin 3,s i=b → j∉triangleEdge i) → j=3 ∨ j=4 := by decide
lemma ApproachingContinuum.side_strip {x : ℂ} {K : Set ℂ} {v e : ℂ}
    (h : ApproachingContinuum x K v) (he : ‖e‖=1) (hn : ⟪e,v⟫≠0) (b : Bool)
    (hs : decide (0<⟪e,v⟫)=b) : ∃δ>0,∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,
      0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if b then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈Straddle K := by
  cases b
  · have hneg : ⟪e,v⟫<0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt (of_decide_eq_false hs)) hn
    obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hh⟩ := h.inner_strip he hneg
    refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun e' he' hd r hr hab hr1 => hh e' he' hd r hr ?_ hr1⟩
    have := (abs_lt.mp hab).1
    linarith
  · obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hh⟩ := h.outer_strip he (of_decide_eq_true hs)
    refine ⟨δ,hδ,fun e' he' hd r _ hab hr1 => hh e' he' hd r hr1 ?_⟩
    have := (abs_lt.mp hab).2
    linarith
/-- Three interface edges supply an actual outsider-only open strip in every
nonexceptional direction, with the radial side chosen by the majority sign. -/
lemma triangle_outsider_strip {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
    {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ}
    (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i)))
    {e : ℂ} (he : ‖e‖=1) (hn : ∀i,⟪e,v i⟫≠0) :
    ∃b : Bool,∃δ>0,∃W : Set ℂ,IsOpen W ∧
      (∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z=3 ∨ c z=4) ∧
      ∀e' : ℂ,‖e'‖=1 → dist e' e<δ → ∀r : ℝ,
        0<r → |r-1|<δ → (if b then 1<r else r<1) → x+(r:ℂ)*e'∈W := by
  classical
  let s : Fin 3 → Bool := fun i => decide (0<⟪e,v i⟫)
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := triangle_majority_cover s
  let E : Finset (Fin 3) := Finset.univ.filter fun i => s i=b
  have hex (i : E) := (hK i).side_strip he (hn i) b ((Finset.mem_filter.mp i.2).2)
  choose d hd hs using hex
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,_,hδd⟩ := finite_positive_lower_bound Finset.univ d (fun i _ => hd i)
  let W : Set ℂ := ⋂i : E,Straddle (K i)
  refine ⟨b,δ,hδ,W,isOpen_iInter_of_finite (fun i => straddle_isOpen (K i)),?_,?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [finite_support_exclusion_ae c hc K triangleEdge hH] with z hz hzW
    apply triangle_outsider s b hb (c z)
    intro i hi
    exact hz i (mem_iInter.mp hzW ⟨i,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hi⟩⟩)
  · intro e' he' heδ r hr hrδ hside
    apply mem_iInter.mpr
    intro i
    exact hs i e' he' (heδ.trans_le (hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _))) r hr
      (hrδ.trans_le (hδd i (Finset.mem_univ _))) hside
/-- Actual local triangle palette rigidity, without terminal angular sectors
or boundary information as hypotheses. -/
lemma triangle_palette_local {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ}
    (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i)))
    {t : Angles} (hn : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0)
    (hnR : ∀i,⟪direction t*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ),v i⟫≠0) :
    ∃i : Fin 5,(i=3 ∨ i=4) ∧ ∃A : Set Angles,IsOpen A ∧ t∈A ∧
      ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈A → i∈palette c hc x u := by
  obtain ⟨bu,δu,hδu,U,hU,hUc,hsU⟩ := triangle_outsider_strip hc hK hH (direction_norm t) hn
  have hunit : ‖direction t*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ)‖=1 := by
    rw [norm_mul,direction_norm,Circle.norm_coe,one_mul]
  obtain ⟨bv,δv,hδv,V,hV,hVc,hsV⟩ := triangle_outsider_strip hc hK hH hunit hnR
  apply binary_strip_palette_rigidity c hc hw hU hV hUc hVc (lt_min hδu hδv) bu bv
  · intro e' he' hd r hr hrd hb
    exact hsU e' he' (hd.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)) r hr (hrd.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)) hb
  · intro e' he' hd r hr hrd hb
    exact hsV e' he' (hd.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)) r hr (hrd.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)) hb
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma triangle_binary_from_continua {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
    {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1)
    (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) :
    BinaryCenter c hc x 3 4 := by
  have hh : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,(∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0) →
      t∈paletteSet c hc x 3 ∨ t∈paletteSet c hc x 4 := by
    apply ae_of_locally_ae angularMeasure
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨b,δ,hδ,W,hW,hWc,hs⟩ := triangle_outsider_strip hc hK hH (direction_norm t) ht
    have hcols : ∀ᵐz : ℂ∂volume,z∈W → c z∈({3,4} : Finset (Fin 5)) :=
      hWc.mono fun z hz hzw => by simpa only [Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] using hz hzw
    have hex : ∃A : Set Angles,IsOpen A ∧ t∈A ∧
        ∀ᵐu∂angularMeasure,u∈A → (palette c hc x u∩{3,4}).Nonempty := by
      cases b
      · apply inner_strip_trace c hc hδ hW hcols
        intro u hu r hr hrδ hr1
        apply hs (direction u) (direction_norm u) hu r hr _ hr1
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
      · apply outer_strip_trace c hc hδ hW hcols
        intro u hu r hr1 hrδ
        apply hs (direction u) (direction_norm u) hu r (by linarith) _ hr1
        rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨A,hA,htA,hae⟩ := hex
    refine ⟨A,hA,htA,hae.mono fun u hu hAu => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hu hAu
    rcases Finset.mem_inter.mp hi with ⟨hip,hi⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl|hi
    · exact Or.inl ((mem_palette c hc x u 3).mp hip)
    · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hi
      subst i
      exact Or.inr ((mem_palette c hc x u 4).mp hip)
  filter_upwards [hh,ae_all_iff.mpr (fun i => ae_direction_nonorthogonal (hv i))] with t ht hn
  exact ht hn
def triangleState (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c) (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) : Bool := by
  classical
  exact if t∈paletteSet c hc x 3 then false else true
lemma triangleState_measurable (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (hc : Measurable c) (x : ℂ) :
    Measurable (triangleState c hc x) := Measurable.ite (paletteSet_measurable c hc x 3) measurable_const measurable_const
lemma triangleState_flip {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ}
    (hb : BinaryCenter c hc x 3 4) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,triangleState c hc x (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(triangleState c hc x t) := by
  filter_upwards [binary_alternation c hc hw hb] with t ht
  by_cases hp : t∈paletteSet c hc x 3
  · have hn : t+(sixty : Angles)∉paletteSet c hc x 3 := fun h => (ht.1.mp h) hp
    simp only [triangleState,hp,hn,ite_true,ite_false,Bool.not_false]
  · have hn : t+(sixty : Angles)∈paletteSet c hc x 3 := ht.1.mpr hp
    simp only [triangleState,hp,hn,ite_true,ite_false,Bool.not_true]
lemma triangleState_local {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1)
    (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i)))
    {t : Angles} (hn : ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0)
    (hnR : ∀i,⟪direction t*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ),v i⟫≠0) :
    ∃b,t∈angleEssential (triangleState c hc x) b := by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,A,hA,htA,hae⟩ := triangle_palette_local hc hw hK hH hn hnR
  have hb := binary_alternation c hc hw (triangle_binary_from_continua hc hv hK hH)
  rcases hi with rfl|rfl
  · refine ⟨false,A,hA,htA,hae.mono fun u hu hAu => ?_⟩
    have hp := (mem_palette c hc x u 3).mp (hu hAu)
    simp only [triangleState,hp,ite_true]
  · refine ⟨true,A,hA,htA,?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hae,hb] with u hu hu' hAu
    have hp := hu'.2.mp ((mem_palette c hc x u 4).mp (hu hAu))
    simp only [triangleState,hp,ite_false]
lemma direction_injective : Function.Injective direction := fun _ _ h =>
  AddCircle.injective_toCircle (by positivity : (2*Real.pi:ℝ)≠0) (Subtype.ext h)
lemma direction_plus_sixty (t : Angles) :
    direction (t+(sixty : Angles))=direction t*(Circle.exp (Real.pi/3) : ℂ) := by
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective t
  rw [←AddCircle.coe_add,direction_real,direction_real,Circle.exp_add]
  rfl
lemma triple_orthogonal_cover (v : Fin 3 → ℂ) (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1) :
    ∃B : Finset Angles,B.card≤6 ∧ (∀t,t+(Real.pi : Angles)∈B ↔ t∈B) ∧
      ∀t,t∉B → ∀i,⟪direction t,v i⟫≠0 := by
  classical
  have hex (i : Fin 3) : ∃t : Angles,direction t=Complex.I*v i := direction_exists
    (by rw [norm_mul,Complex.norm_I,hv,one_mul])
  choose a ha using hex
  let B : Finset Angles := Finset.univ.biUnion fun i : Fin 3 => {a i,a i+(Real.pi : Angles)}
  have hmem (t : Angles) : t∈B ↔ ∃i : Fin 3,t=a i ∨ t=a i+(Real.pi : Angles) := by
    simp only [B,Finset.mem_biUnion,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton]
  have hdouble (t : Angles) : t+(Real.pi : Angles)+(Real.pi : Angles)=t := by
    apply direction_injective
    simp only [direction_add_pi,neg_neg]
  refine ⟨B,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · calc B.card ≤ ∑i : Fin 3,({a i,a i+(Real.pi : Angles)} : Finset Angles).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
         _ ≤ ∑_i : Fin 3,2 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => by simpa using (Finset.card_insert_le (a _) ({a _+(Real.pi : Angles)} : Finset Angles))
         _ = 6 := by norm_num
  · intro t
    rw [hmem,hmem]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i,hi|hi⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inr (by rw [←hi,hdouble])⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inl (add_right_cancel hi)⟩
    · rintro ⟨i,rfl|rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inr rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨i,Or.inl (hdouble _)⟩
  · intro t ht i hinner
    apply ht
    rw [hmem]
    rcases complex_unit_orthogonal (direction_norm t) (hv i) hinner with he|he
    · exact ⟨i,Or.inl (direction_injective (he.trans (ha i).symm))⟩
    · refine ⟨i,Or.inr (direction_injective ?_)⟩
      rw [direction_add_pi,ha,he]
      ring
/-- The actual three-interface data force the source's unique six-position
boundary orbit. This theorem does not assume local rigidity or orbit finiteness. -/
lemma triangle_boundary_one_orbit {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1)
    (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) :
    ∃t,angleBoundary (triangleState c hc x)={u | ∃j : Fin 6,u=t+sixAngle j} := by
  obtain ⟨B,hB,ha,hn⟩ := triple_orthogonal_cover v hv
  apply angleBoundary_one_orbit (triangleState_flip hc hw (triangle_binary_from_continua hc hv hK hH)) B hB ha
  intro t ht htR
  apply triangleState_local hc hw hv hK hH (hn t ht)
  simpa only [direction_plus_sixty] using hn (t+(sixty : Angles)) htR
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma angleEssential_connected {s : Angles → Bool} {U : Set Angles}
    (hU : IsPreconnected U) (hne : U.Nonempty) (hbound : Disjoint U (angleBoundary s)) :
    ∃b,U⊆angleEssential s b := by
  have hcov : U⊆angleEssential s false∪angleEssential s true := by
    intro t ht
    have hn := disjoint_left.mp hbound ht
    simp only [angleBoundary,mem_compl_iff,not_not,mem_iUnion] at hn
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hn
    cases b
    · exact Or.inl hb
    · exact Or.inr hb
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := hne
  rcases hcov ht with hb|hb
  · exact ⟨false,hU.subset_left_of_subset_union (angleEssential_open s false) (angleEssential_open s true)
      (angleEssential_disjoint s (by decide)) hcov ⟨t,ht,hb⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨true,hU.subset_left_of_subset_union (angleEssential_open s true) (angleEssential_open s false)
      (angleEssential_disjoint s (by decide)) (by simpa only [union_comm] using hcov) ⟨t,ht,hb⟩⟩
lemma one_orbit_first_arc {s : Angles → Bool} {φ : ℝ}
    (hboundary : angleBoundary s={u | ∃j : Fin 6,u=(φ : Angles)+sixAngle j}) :
    ∃b,∀t∈Ioo φ (φ+Real.pi/3),(t : Angles)∈angleEssential s b := by
  let U : Set Angles := ((↑) : ℝ → Angles) '' Ioo φ (φ+Real.pi/3)
  have hU : IsPreconnected U := isPreconnected_Ioo.image _ continuous_quotient_mk'.continuousOn
  have hne : U.Nonempty := (nonempty_Ioo.mpr (by linarith [Real.pi_pos] : φ<φ+Real.pi/3)).image _
  have hd : Disjoint U (angleBoundary s) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro q ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ hq
    rw [hboundary] at hq
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hq
    have he : (t : Angles)=((φ+(j.val:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) : Angles) := by
      have hx : sixAngle j=((j.val:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) := by
        rw [sixAngle,←AddCircle.coe_nsmul]
        simp only [nsmul_eq_mul,sixty]
      simpa only [hx,AddCircle.coe_add] using hj
    have htI : t∈Ico φ (φ+2*Real.pi) := ⟨ht.1.le,by linarith [Real.pi_pos,ht.2]⟩
    have hjI : φ+(j.val:ℝ)*(Real.pi/3)∈Ico φ (φ+2*Real.pi) := by
      have hj0 : 0≤(j.val:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      have hj6 : (j.val:ℝ)<6 := by exact_mod_cast j.isLt
      constructor
      · nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
      · nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hv := (AddCircle.coe_eq_coe_iff_of_mem_Ico htI hjI).mp he
    by_cases hz : j.val=0
    · simp only [hz,Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul,add_zero] at hv
      linarith [ht.1]
    · have hj1 : (1:ℝ)≤j.val := by exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz
      nlinarith [ht.2,Real.pi_pos]
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := angleEssential_connected hU hne hd
  exact ⟨b,fun t ht => hb ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩⟩
lemma angleEssential_real_periodic {s : Angles → Bool}
    (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t)) (b : Bool) :
    Function.Periodic (fun t : ℝ => (t : Angles)∈angleEssential s b) (2*(Real.pi/3)) := by
  intro t
  apply propext
  have hh := angleEssential_shift hf ((t : Angles)+(sixty : Angles)) (!b)
  rw [Bool.not_not] at hh
  have hh' := angleEssential_shift hf (t : Angles) b
  have he : ((t+2*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) : Angles) = (t : Angles)+(sixty : Angles)+(sixty : Angles) := by
    calc ((t+2*(Real.pi/3) : ℝ) : Angles) = ((t+sixty+sixty : ℝ) : Angles) := by
           congr 1
           dsimp [sixty]
           ring
         _ = _ := by rw [AddCircle.coe_add,AddCircle.coe_add]
  dsimp only
  rw [he]
  exact hh.trans hh'
lemma one_orbit_sectors {s : Angles → Bool} {φ : ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,s (t+(sixty : Angles))= !(s t))
    (hboundary : angleBoundary s={u | ∃j : Fin 6,u=(φ : Angles)+sixAngle j}) :
    ∃b,(∀t,0<Real.sin (3*(t-φ)) → (t : Angles)∈angleEssential s b) ∧
      (∀t,Real.sin (3*(t-φ))<0 → (t : Angles)∈angleEssential s (!b)) := by
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := one_orbit_first_arc hboundary
  have hb' (t : ℝ) (ht : t∈Ioo (φ+Real.pi/3) (φ+2*(Real.pi/3))) :
      (t : Angles)∈angleEssential s (!b) := by
    have hh := (angleEssential_shift hf ((t-Real.pi/3 : ℝ) : Angles) b).mpr
      (hb (t-Real.pi/3) ⟨by linarith [ht.1],by linarith [ht.2]⟩)
    simpa only [sixty,←AddCircle.coe_add,sub_add_cancel] using hh
  have hreduce (t : ℝ) : ∃r : ℝ,∃n : ℤ,0≤r ∧ r<2*(Real.pi/3) ∧
      t=φ+r+n*(2*(Real.pi/3)) ∧ Real.sin (3*(t-φ))=Real.sin (3*r) := by
    let n : ℤ := ⌊(t-φ)/(2*(Real.pi/3))⌋
    let r : ℝ := (t-φ)-n*(2*(Real.pi/3))
    have he : t=φ+r+n*(2*(Real.pi/3)) := by dsimp [r]; ring
    refine ⟨r,n,Int.sub_floor_div_mul_nonneg _ (by positivity),Int.sub_floor_div_mul_lt _ (by positivity),he,?_⟩
    have he' : 3*(t-φ)=3*r+(n:ℝ)*(2*Real.pi) := by rw [he]; ring
    rw [he',Real.sin_add_int_mul_two_pi]
  refine ⟨b,?_,?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨r,n,hr0,hrP,he,hsin⟩ := hreduce t
    rw [hsin] at ht
    have hrpos : 0<r := by
      by_contra hn
      have hr : r=0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn) hr0
      simp only [hr,mul_zero,Real.sin_zero,lt_self_iff_false] at ht
    have hra : r<Real.pi/3 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hh := Real.sin_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_neg_pi_le
        (by linarith : 3*r-2*Real.pi≤0) (by linarith : -Real.pi≤3*r-2*Real.pi)
      rw [Real.sin_sub_two_pi] at hh
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hh) ht
    have hy := hb (φ+r) ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩
    rw [he]
    exact (angleEssential_real_periodic hf b).int_mul n (φ+r) ▸ hy
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨r,n,hr0,hrP,he,hsin⟩ := hreduce t
    rw [hsin] at ht
    have hra : Real.pi/3<r := by
      by_contra hn
      have hh := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (by linarith : 0≤3*r) (by linarith : 3*r≤Real.pi)
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hh) ht
    have hy := hb' (φ+r) ⟨by linarith,by linarith⟩
    rw [he]
    exact (angleEssential_real_periodic hf (!b)).int_mul n (φ+r) ▸ hy
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

lemma moser_density_impossible {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k}
    (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c) (x v : ℂ) (hv : ‖v‖=1)
    (J : Finset (Fin k)) (hJ : J.card≤3) :
    ¬(∀ i, DensityOne {q | c q∈J} (x+v*placedMoser i)) := by
  intro hD
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hp⟩ := finite_density_realization hc hw (fun i => x+v*placedMoser i)
    (fun _ => J) hD
  have hh : Fintype.card J≤Fintype.card (Fin 3) := by simpa using hJ
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le hh
  apply moser_not_three_colorable (fun i => f ⟨c (q+(x+v*placedMoser i)),hq i⟩)
  intro i j hij he
  have hd : ‖(x+v*placedMoser i)-(x+v*placedMoser j)‖=1 := by
    rw [show (x+v*placedMoser i)-(x+v*placedMoser j)=v*(placedMoser i-placedMoser j) by ring,
      norm_mul,hv,placedMoser_edge_unit hij,one_mul]
  exact hp i j hd (congrArg Subtype.val (f.injective he))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma lineDensityZero_compl_of_mem_nhds {A : Set ℝ} {t : ℝ} (hA : A∈𝓝 t) :
    LineDensityZero Aᶜ t := by
  obtain ⟨ε,hε,hsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hA
  apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
  filter_upwards [(eventually_lt_nhds hε).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with r hr
  have hempty : Aᶜ∩Metric.closedBall t r=∅ := by
    ext q
    simp only [mem_empty_iff_false,iff_false]
    rintro ⟨hq,hqr⟩
    exact hq (hsub (lt_of_le_of_lt hqr hr))
  simp [hempty]
def positiveSector (φ : ℝ) : Set ℝ := {t | 0<Real.sin (3*(t-φ))}
def negativeSector (φ : ℝ) : Set ℝ := {t | Real.sin (3*(t-φ))<0}
lemma positiveSector_open (φ : ℝ) : IsOpen (positiveSector φ) := by
  apply isOpen_lt <;> fun_prop
lemma negativeSector_open (φ : ℝ) : IsOpen (negativeSector φ) := by
  apply isOpen_lt <;> fun_prop
variable {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c)
lemma polynomial_region_density (hw : WeakColoring k c) {x : ℂ} {a b : Fin k} {φ : ℝ}
    (hpos : RealState hc x (positiveSector φ) {a})
    (hneg : RealState hc x (negativeSector φ) {b})
    {z : ℂ} (hz : ThreeLabelRegion z.re z.im) :
    DensityOne {q | c q∉({a,b} : Finset (Fin k))} (x+(Circle.exp φ:ℂ)*z) := by
  obtain ⟨t,u,hs,hn,ht⟩ := polynomial_region_angles hz
  have hpoint : angularSum x 1 (angleChart (φ+t,φ+u))=x+(Circle.exp φ:ℂ)*z := by
    simp only [angularSum,angleChart,Complex.ofReal_one,one_mul,direction_real,Circle.exp_add,Circle.coe_mul]
    rw [add_assoc,←mul_add,hs]
  have hnon : Real.sin ((φ+u)-(φ+t))≠0 := by
    simpa only [show φ+u-(φ+t)=u-t by ring] using hn
  rcases mul_neg_iff.mp ht with ⟨ht,hu⟩|⟨ht,hu⟩
  · have htm : φ+t∈positiveSector φ := by simpa [positiveSector] using ht
    have hum : φ+u∈negativeSector φ := by simpa [negativeSector] using hu
    have hd := states_densityOne hc hw hpos hneg
      (lineDensityZero_compl_of_mem_nhds ((positiveSector_open φ).mem_nhds htm))
      (lineDensityZero_compl_of_mem_nhds ((negativeSector_open φ).mem_nhds hum)) hnon
    rw [hpoint] at hd
    simpa only [Finset.singleton_union] using hd
  · have htm : φ+t∈negativeSector φ := by simpa [negativeSector] using ht
    have hum : φ+u∈positiveSector φ := by simpa [positiveSector] using hu
    have hd := states_densityOne hc hw hneg hpos
      (lineDensityZero_compl_of_mem_nhds ((negativeSector_open φ).mem_nhds htm))
      (lineDensityZero_compl_of_mem_nhds ((positiveSector_open φ).mem_nhds hum)) hnon
    rw [hpoint] at hd
    simpa only [Finset.singleton_union,Finset.pair_comm b a] using hd
/-- The exact six-sector outcome of triangle rigidity is impossible, for every center and phase. -/
lemma no_alternating_sectors {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℂ} {a b : Fin 5} (hab : a≠b) (φ : ℝ)
    (hpos : RealState hc x (positiveSector φ) {a})
    (hneg : RealState hc x (negativeSector φ) {b}) : False := by
  let J : Finset (Fin 5) := {a,b}ᶜ
  have hJ : J.card≤3 := by
    change ({a,b}ᶜ : Finset (Fin 5)).card≤3
    rw [Finset.card_compl,Finset.card_pair hab]
    decide
  apply moser_density_impossible hc hw x (Circle.exp φ) (Circle.norm_coe _) J hJ
  intro i
  simpa only [J,Finset.mem_compl] using polynomial_region_density hc hw hpos hneg
    (seven_point_certificate i)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma triangleState_palette {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℂ} (hb : BinaryCenter c hc x 3 4) (b : Bool) :
    ∀ᵐt∂angularMeasure,triangleState c hc x t=b → t∈paletteSet c hc x (if b then 4 else 3) := by
  classical
  filter_upwards [binary_alternation c hc hw hb] with t ht he
  cases b
  · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
    by_contra hn
    simp only [triangleState,hn,ite_false] at he
    exact Bool.noConfusion he
  · simp only [ite_true]
    apply ht.2.mpr
    intro hp
    simp only [triangleState,hp,ite_true] at he
    exact Bool.noConfusion he
/-- Complete actual triangle-interface endgame, including boundary rigidity,
sector extraction and the exact seven-point unit-distance certificate. -/
lemma no_triangle_interfaces {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {x : ℂ} {K : Fin 3 → Set ℂ} {v : Fin 3 → ℂ} (hv : ∀i,‖v i‖=1)
    (hK : ∀i,ApproachingContinuum x (K i) (v i))
    (hH : ∀i,∀j∈triangleEdge i,Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle (K i))) : False := by
  have hbinary := triangle_binary_from_continua hc hv hK hH
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := triangle_boundary_one_orbit hc hw hv hK hH
  obtain ⟨φ,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective q
  obtain ⟨b,hpos,hneg⟩ := one_orbit_sectors (triangleState_flip hc hw hbinary) hq
  have hstate (d : Bool) (A : Set ℝ) (hA : MeasurableSet A)
      (hAd : ∀t∈A,(t : Angles)∈angleEssential (triangleState c hc x) d) :
      RealState hc x A {if d then 4 else 3} := by
    refine ⟨hA,?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hi
    subst i
    have hh := angleMk_quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
      ((angleEssential_ae (triangleState c hc x) d).and (triangleState_palette hc hw hbinary d))
    filter_upwards [hh] with t ht hAt
    exact ht.2 (ht.1 (hAd t hAt))
  have hp := hstate b (positiveSector φ) (positiveSector_open φ).measurableSet hpos
  have hn := hstate (!b) (negativeSector φ) (negativeSector_open φ).measurableSet hneg
  exact no_alternating_sectors hc hw (by cases b <;> decide) φ hp hn
end EuclideanFiveColor
end
~~~~

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/ContinuumLimits.lean
