~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.GraphRealization
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Interfaces
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Sectors

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Vanishing exceptional measure is enough: almost every point is outside the
exceptional sets infinitely often. No summability or nesting is required. -/
lemma ae_frequently_notMem_of_measure_tendsto_zero {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {μ : Measure X} {E : ℕ → Set X}
    (hE : Tendsto (fun n => μ (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, ∃ᶠ n in atTop, z ∉ E n := by
  let T : ℕ → Set X := fun N => ⋂ n ≥ N, E n
  have hT : ∀ N, μ (T N) = 0 := by
    intro N
    apply le_antisymm _ (by positivity)
    apply ge_of_tendsto hE
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
    exact measure_mono (fun z hz => (mem_iInter.mp (mem_iInter.mp hz n)) hn)
  have hn : μ (⋃ N, T N) = 0 := measure_iUnion_null hT
  filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hn] with z hz
  rw [← not_eventually]
  intro he
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp he
  exact hz (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨N,mem_iInter.mpr fun n => mem_iInter.mpr (hN n)⟩)

/-- Pointwise differentiation plus vanishing exceptional sets gives the measure
exclusion used for both the mesh bound and the common continuum exclusions. -/
lemma ae_ne_one_of_eventual_bound {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {μ : Measure X} {p : ℕ → X → ℝ} {f : X → ℝ} {E : ℕ → Set X} {U : Set X}
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
    (hp : ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => p n z) atTop (𝓝 (f z)))
    (hE : Tendsto (fun n => μ (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hb : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, z ∉ E n → p n z ≤ 1-α) :
    ∀ᵐ z ∂μ, z ∈ U → f z ≠ 1 := by
  filter_upwards [hp,ae_frequently_notMem_of_measure_tendsto_zero hE] with z hz hgood hzU hf
  have hgt : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 1-α < p n z :=
    hz.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds (by rw [hf]; linarith))
  obtain ⟨n,hn,hbnd,hlarge⟩ := (hgood.and_eventually ((hb z hzU).and hgt)).exists
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbnd hn)) hlarge
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory MeasureTheory.Measure
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma colorFn_locallyIntegrable {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c) (i : Fin k) :
    LocallyIntegrable (colorFn c i) (volume : Measure ℂ) :=
  (continuous_const.locallyIntegrable (f := fun _ : ℂ => (1:ℝ))).mono
    (colorFn_measurable hc i).aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (colorFn_nonneg c i z),abs_one] using colorFn_le_one c i z)
lemma diskAverage_eq_average_ball {k : ℕ} (c : ℂ → Fin k) (ε : ℝ) (i : Fin k) (q : ℂ) :
    diskAverage c ε i q = ⨍ z in Metric.ball q ε, colorFn c i z ∂volume := by
  have he : (fun v : ℂ => q+v) ⁻¹' Metric.ball q ε = Metric.ball 0 ε := by
    ext v
    simp [Metric.mem_ball,dist_eq_norm]
  have hi := (measurePreserving_add_left (volume : Measure ℂ) q).setIntegral_preimage_emb
    (MeasurableEquiv.addLeft q).measurableEmbedding (colorFn c i) (Metric.ball q ε)
  rw [he] at hi
  unfold diskAverage diskLaw
  rw [integral_smul_measure,ENNReal.toReal_inv,hi,setAverage_eq]
  simp only [Measure.real,Complex.volume_ball]
lemma complex_ball_ae_closedBall (q : ℂ) (ε : ℝ) :
    Metric.ball q ε =ᵐ[volume] Metric.closedBall q ε :=
  ae_eq_of_subset_of_measure_ge Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    (by rw [Complex.volume_closedBall,Complex.volume_ball])
    measurableSet_ball.nullMeasurableSet ((isCompact_closedBall q ε).measure_ne_top)
lemma diskAverage_ae_tendsto {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c)
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀ n,0<ε n) (i : Fin k) :
    ∀ᵐ z : ℂ ∂volume, Tendsto (fun n => diskAverage c (ε n) i z) atTop (𝓝 (colorFn c i z)) := by
  have hε' : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝[>] 0) := tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr
    ⟨hε,Eventually.of_forall hpos⟩
  filter_upwards [IsUnifLocDoublingMeasure.ae_tendsto_average volume
    (colorFn_locallyIntegrable hc i) 1] with z hz
  have h := hz (fun _ : ℕ => z) ε hε' (Eventually.of_forall fun n => by
    simp only [one_mul,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_self]; exact (hpos n).le)
  convert h using 1
  ext n
  rw [diskAverage_eq_average_ball]
  exact setAverage_congr (complex_ball_ae_closedBall z (ε n))

lemma support_disjoint_open_of_ae {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c)
    {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (i : Fin k)
    (h : ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume : Measure ℂ),z∈U → c z≠i) :
    Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) U := by
  have he : Uᶜ ∈ ae (volume.restrict {z | c z=i}) := by
    change ∀ᵐ z ∂volume.restrict {z | c z=i},z∈Uᶜ
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const)]
    filter_upwards [h] with z hz hczi hzU
    exact hz hzU hczi
  have hs := Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed hU.isClosed_compl he
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun z hz hzU => hs hz hzU

lemma diskAverage_support_exclusion {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c)
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀ n,0<ε n)
    {E : ℕ → Set ℂ} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => volume (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (i : Fin k)
    (hb : ∀ z∈U,∀ᶠ n in atTop,z∉E n → diskAverage c (ε n) i z≤1-α) :
    Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) U := by
  apply support_disjoint_open_of_ae hc hU i
  filter_upwards [ae_ne_one_of_eventual_bound hα (diskAverage_ae_tendsto hc hε hpos i) hE hb]
    with z hz hzU hczi
  exact hz hzU (by simp [colorFn,hczi])
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology TopologicalSpace
universe u v
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Connectedness passes to a Vietoris (equivalently compact Hausdorff metric) limit. -/
theorem nonemptyCompacts_preconnected_limit {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [T2Space X] [NormalSpace X] {ι : Type v} {l : Filter ι} [NeBot l]
    {K : ι → NonemptyCompacts X} {L : NonemptyCompacts X}
    (hlim : Tendsto K l (𝓝 L)) (hc : ∀ᶠn in l,IsPreconnected (K n : Set X)) :
    IsPreconnected (L : Set X) := by
  apply (isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_fully_disjoint_closed L.isCompact.isClosed).mpr
  intro A B hA hB hcov hd
  by_contra hh
  push Not at hh
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hxA⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hh.1
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hyB⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hh.2
  have hxB := (hcov hx).resolve_left hxA
  have hyA := (hcov hy).resolve_right hyB
  obtain ⟨U,V,hU,hV,hAU,hBV,hUV⟩ := normal_separation hA hB hd
  have hL : (L : Set X)⊆U∪V := hcov.trans (union_subset_union hAU hBV)
  have hs : ∀ᶠn in l,(K n : Set X)⊆U∪V := hlim.eventually
    ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_subsets_of_isOpen (hU.union hV)).mem_nhds hL)
  have hu : ∀ᶠn in l,((K n : Set X)∩U).Nonempty := hlim.eventually
    ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hU).mem_nhds ⟨y,hy,hAU hyA⟩)
  have hv : ∀ᶠn in l,((K n : Set X)∩V).Nonempty := hlim.eventually
    ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen hV).mem_nhds ⟨x,hx,hBV hxB⟩)
  obtain ⟨n,hnc,hns,hnu,hnv⟩ := (hc.and (hs.and (hu.and hv))).exists
  obtain ⟨z,_,hzU,hzV⟩ := hnc U V hU hV hns hnu hnv
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hUV hzU hzV

lemma nonemptyCompacts_mem_limit {X : Type u} [MetricSpace X]
    {ι : Type v} {l : Filter ι} [NeBot l]
    {K : ι → NonemptyCompacts X} {L : NonemptyCompacts X} {x : ι → X} {y : X}
    (hK : Tendsto K l (𝓝 L)) (hx : Tendsto x l (𝓝 y))
    (hm : ∀ᶠn in l,x n∈K n) : y∈L := by
  have hh := (NonemptyCompacts.lipschitz_infDist.continuous.tendsto (y,L)).comp (hx.prodMk_nhds hK)
  have h0 : (fun n => Metric.infDist (x n) (K n : Set X)) =ᶠ[l] fun _ => 0 :=
    hm.mono fun n hn => Metric.infDist_zero_of_mem hn
  have he : Metric.infDist y (L : Set X)=0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hh
    (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' h0.symm)
  exact (L.isCompact.isClosed.mem_iff_infDist_zero L.nonempty).mpr he

lemma nonemptyCompacts_inter_closed_limit {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {ι : Type v} {l : Filter ι} [NeBot l]
    {K : ι → NonemptyCompacts X} {L : NonemptyCompacts X} {F : Set X}
    (hF : IsClosed F) (hK : Tendsto K l (𝓝 L))
    (hm : ∀ᶠn in l,((K n : Set X)∩F).Nonempty) : ((L : Set X)∩F).Nonempty :=
  (NonemptyCompacts.isClosed_inter_nonempty_of_isClosed hF).mem_of_tendsto hK hm

/-- A finite family of nonempty compact continua in a compact metric space has
one common subsequence of connected compact limits. -/
theorem finite_continuum_subsequence {X : Type u} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
    {J : Type v} [Finite J] (K : ℕ → J → NonemptyCompacts X)
    (hc : ∀n j,IsPreconnected (K n j : Set X)) :
    ∃L : J → NonemptyCompacts X, ∃φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      (∀j,Tendsto (fun n => K (φ n) j) atTop (𝓝 (L j))) ∧
      (∀j,IsPreconnected (L j : Set X)) := by
  obtain ⟨L,_,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (J → NonemptyCompacts X))).tendsto_subseq (fun n => Set.mem_univ (K n))
  refine ⟨L,φ,hφ,?_,?_⟩
  · intro j
    exact (continuous_apply j).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim
  · intro j
    exact nonemptyCompacts_preconnected_limit
      ((continuous_apply j).continuousAt.tendsto.comp hlim)
      (Eventually.of_forall fun n => hc (φ n) j)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory TopologicalSpace
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma straddle_eventually_of_compact_limit {K : ℕ → NonemptyCompacts ℂ}
    {L : NonemptyCompacts ℂ} (hlim : Tendsto K atTop (𝓝 L)) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z∈Straddle (L : Set ℂ)) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,z∈Straddle (K n : Set ℂ) := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp,q,hq,hp1,hq1⟩ := hz
  have ha : ∀ᶠn in atTop,((K n : Set ℂ)∩{p : ℂ | dist z p<1}).Nonempty :=
    hlim.eventually ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.dist continuous_id) continuous_const)).mem_nhds ⟨p,hp,hp1⟩)
  have hb : ∀ᶠn in atTop,((K n : Set ℂ)∩{q : ℂ | 1<dist z q}).Nonempty :=
    hlim.eventually ((NonemptyCompacts.isOpen_inter_nonempty_of_isOpen
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.dist continuous_id))).mem_nhds ⟨q,hq,hq1⟩)
  filter_upwards [ha,hb] with n hn hm
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hp1⟩ := hn
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hq1⟩ := hm
  exact ⟨p,hp,q,hq,hp1,hq1⟩
/-- The common-exclusion continuum limit argument. The sole exceptional sets are
actual unit neighborhoods of the holes, and their measures tend to zero. -/
theorem continuum_limit_support_exclusion {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k}
    (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring k c)
    {K : ℕ → NonemptyCompacts ℂ} {L : NonemptyCompacts ℂ}
    (hlim : Tendsto K atTop (𝓝 L)) (hconn : ∀n,IsPreconnected (K n : Set ℂ))
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀n,0<ε n)
    {H E : ℕ → Set ℂ} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => volume (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hnear : ∀n z q,q∈H n → dist z q=1 → z∈E n)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (i : Fin k)
    (hprob : ∀n q,q∈K n → q∉H n → α<diskAverage c (ε n) i q) :
    Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle (L : Set ℂ)) := by
  apply diskAverage_support_exclusion hc hε hpos hE hα (straddle_isOpen _) i
  intro z hz
  filter_upwards [straddle_eventually_of_compact_limit hlim hz] with n hn hzE
  obtain ⟨q,hq,hunit⟩ := straddle_connected_unit (hconn n) hn
  have hqH : q∉H n := fun hh => hzE (hnear n z q hh hunit)
  have hb := hprob n q hq hqH
  have hu : ‖q-z‖=1 := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm,norm_sub_rev] using hunit
  have hh := diskAverage_unit_pair hc hw (hpos n) hu i
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- One interface excludes both labels from the same straddling set and approaches
its center in an actual unit direction. -/
def CommonInterface (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (x : ℂ) (i j : Fin 5) : Prop :=
  ∃K : Set ℂ, ∃v : ℂ, ‖v‖=1 ∧ Nonempty (ApproachingContinuum x K v) ∧
    Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle K) ∧ Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle K)
lemma CommonInterface.symm {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {x : ℂ} {i j : Fin 5}
    (h : CommonInterface c x i j) : CommonInterface c x j i := by
  obtain ⟨K,v,hv,hK,hi,hj⟩ := h
  exact ⟨K,v,hv,hK,hj,hi⟩
lemma spatialSupport_perm (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (i : Fin 5) :
    spatialSupport (e.symm ∘ c) i=spatialSupport c (e i) := by
  have he : {z : ℂ | (e.symm ∘ c) z=i}={z : ℂ | c z=e i} := by
    ext z
    exact e.symm_apply_eq
  simp only [spatialSupport,he]
lemma CommonInterface.perm {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {x : ℂ} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5))
    {i j : Fin 5} (h : CommonInterface c x (e i) (e j)) :
    CommonInterface (e.symm ∘ c) x i j := by
  obtain ⟨K,v,hv,hK,hi,hj⟩ := h
  exact ⟨K,v,hv,hK,by rwa [spatialSupport_perm],by rwa [spatialSupport_perm]⟩
lemma commonInterface_of_continuum {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {x y : ℂ} {i j : Fin 5}
    {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsPreconnected K) (hx : x∈K) (hy : y∈K) (hne : y≠x)
    (hi : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Straddle K))
    (hj : Disjoint (spatialSupport c j) (Straddle K)) : CommonInterface c x i j := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,ha⟩ := continuum_has_approach hK hx hy hne
  exact ⟨K,v,hv,ha,hi,hj⟩
lemma no_triangle_commonInterface {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
    (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (h01 : CommonInterface c x 0 1)
    (h12 : CommonInterface c x 1 2) (h20 : CommonInterface c x 2 0) : False := by
  let a : Fin 3 → Fin 5 := ![0,1,2]
  let b : Fin 3 → Fin 5 := ![1,2,0]
  have h (i : Fin 3) : CommonInterface c x (a i) (b i) := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact h01
    · exact h12
    · exact h20
  choose K v hv hK hA hB using h
  apply no_triangle_interfaces hc hw hv (fun i => Classical.choice (hK i))
  intro i j hj
  have he : triangleEdge i={a i,b i} := by fin_cases i <;> decide
  rw [he] at hj
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl|hj
  · exact hA i
  · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hj; subst j; exact hB i
lemma no_four_commonInterface {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
    (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (h01 : CommonInterface c x 0 1)
    (h12 : CommonInterface c x 1 2) (h23 : CommonInterface c x 2 3)
    (h30 : CommonInterface c x 3 0) : False := by
  let a : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![0,1,2,3]
  let b : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![1,2,3,0]
  have h (i : Fin 4) : CommonInterface c x (a i) (b i) := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact h01
    · exact h12
    · exact h23
    · exact h30
  choose K v hv hK hA hB using h
  apply no_four_interfaces hc hw hv (fun i => Classical.choice (hK i))
  intro i j hj
  have he : fourEdge i={a i,b i} := by fin_cases i <;> decide
  rw [he] at hj
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl|hj
  · exact hA i
  · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hj; subst j; exact hB i
lemma no_five_commonInterface {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
    (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} (h : ∀i,CommonInterface c x i (i+1)) : False := by
  choose K v hv hK hi hj using h
  exact no_five_exclusion_continua c hc hw hv (fun i => Classical.choice (hK i)) (fun i => ⟨hi i,hj i⟩)
/-- All actual common-exclusion interfaces at a point form a forest. This
assembles triangle, four and five cases for arbitrary labels, not just canonical cycles. -/
theorem commonInterface_graph_acyclic {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
    (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) (x : ℂ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))
    (hG : ∀i j,G.Adj i j → CommonInterface c x i j) : G.IsAcyclic := by
  intro v p hp
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := cycle_standard_permutation hp
  have hm : Measurable (e.symm ∘ c) := (measurable_of_finite e.symm).comp hc
  have hw' := weak_relabel c e.symm hw
  have h (i j : Fin 5) (hij : G.Adj (e i) (e j)) : CommonInterface (e.symm ∘ c) x i j :=
    (hG _ _ hij).perm e
  rcases he with ⟨h01,h02,h12⟩|⟨h01,h12,h23,h30⟩|hfive
  · exact no_triangle_commonInterface hm hw' (h _ _ h01) (h _ _ h12) (h _ _ h02).symm
  · exact no_four_commonInterface hm hw' (h _ _ h01) (h _ _ h12) (h _ _ h23) (h _ _ h30)
  · exact no_five_commonInterface hm hw' (fun i => h _ _ (hfive i))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology TopologicalSpace MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- End-to-end limit of actual connected midpoint fibers, retaining both endpoint
exclusions on the same limiting continuum. -/
theorem commonInterface_of_compact_sequence {c : ℂ → Fin 5}
    (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0<ρ)
    (K : ℕ → NonemptyCompacts ℂ) (hsub : ∀n,(K n : Set ℂ)⊆Metric.closedBall x ρ)
    (hconn : ∀n,IsPreconnected (K n : Set ℂ))
    (a : ℕ → ℂ) (ha : ∀n,a n∈K n) (halim : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 x))
    (hout : ∀n,((K n : Set ℂ)∩Metric.sphere x ρ).Nonempty)
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀n,0<ε n)
    {H E : ℕ → Set ℂ} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => volume (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hnear : ∀n z q,q∈H n → dist z q=1 → z∈E n)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (i j : Fin 5)
    (hi : ∀n q,q∈K n → q∉H n → α<diskAverage c (ε n) i q)
    (hj : ∀n q,q∈K n → q∉H n → α<diskAverage c (ε n) j q) :
    CommonInterface c x i j := by
  obtain ⟨L,hL,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := (NonemptyCompacts.isCompact_subsets_of_isCompact
    (isCompact_closedBall x ρ)).tendsto_subseq hsub
  have hx : x∈L := nonemptyCompacts_mem_limit hlim (halim.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n => ha (φ n))
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hyρ⟩ := nonemptyCompacts_inter_closed_limit Metric.isClosed_sphere hlim
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n => hout (φ n))
  have hne : y≠x := by
    intro he
    subst y
    have he : (0:ℝ)=ρ := by simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_self] using hyρ
    linarith
  apply commonInterface_of_continuum
    (nonemptyCompacts_preconnected_limit hlim (Eventually.of_forall fun n => hconn (φ n))) hx hy hne
  · exact continuum_limit_support_exclusion hc hw hlim (fun n => hconn (φ n))
      (hε.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) (fun n => hpos (φ n)) (hE.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
      (fun n => hnear (φ n)) hα i (fun n => hi (φ n))
  · exact continuum_limit_support_exclusion hc hw hlim (fun n => hconn (φ n))
      (hε.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) (fun n => hpos (φ n)) (hE.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
      (fun n => hnear (φ n)) hα j (fun n => hj (φ n))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/DiskExtension.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/DiskExtension.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.GraphRealization

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
structure MarkedDisk where
  center : ℂ
  radius : ℝ
  core : Bool
namespace MarkedDisk
def ball (d : MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := Metric.ball d.center d.radius
def closedBall (d : MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall d.center d.radius
def noncoreCost (d : MarkedDisk) : ℝ := if d.core then 0 else d.radius
def Valid (L : Set ℂ) (d : MarkedDisk) : Prop :=
  0<d.radius ∧ (d.core=true → ∃x∈L,x∈d.ball)

lemma merge {a b : MarkedDisk} {L : Set ℂ} (ha : a.Valid L) (hb : b.Valid L)
    (hab : ¬Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0<η) :
    ∃d : MarkedDisk, d.Valid L ∧ a.closedBall⊆d.ball ∧ b.closedBall⊆d.ball ∧
      d.radius≤a.radius+b.radius+η ∧ d.noncoreCost≤a.noncoreCost+b.noncoreCost+η ∧ d.core=(a.core || b.core) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hza,hzb⟩ := Set.not_disjoint_iff.mp hab
  have hd : dist a.center b.center≤a.radius+b.radius :=
    (dist_triangle a.center z b.center).trans (add_le_add (by simpa [closedBall,dist_comm] using hza) hzb)
  let t : ℝ := b.radius/(a.radius+b.radius)
  have hrs : 0<a.radius+b.radius := add_pos ha.1 hb.1
  have ht0 : 0≤t := (div_pos hb.1 hrs).le
  have ht1 : t≤1 := (div_le_one hrs).mpr (by linarith [ha.1])
  let c := AffineMap.lineMap a.center b.center t
  have hca : dist a.center c≤b.radius := by
    rw [dist_left_lineMap,Real.norm_of_nonneg ht0]
    calc t*dist a.center b.center ≤ t*(a.radius+b.radius) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd ht0
         _ = b.radius := by dsimp [t]; field_simp
  have hcb : dist b.center c≤a.radius := by
    rw [dist_right_lineMap,Real.norm_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1)]
    calc (1-t)*dist a.center b.center ≤ (1-t)*(a.radius+b.radius) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1)
         _ = a.radius := by dsimp [t]; field_simp; ring
  let d : MarkedDisk := ⟨c,a.radius+b.radius+η,a.core || b.core⟩
  have hA : a.closedBall⊆d.ball := by
    intro q hq
    have hq' : dist q a.center≤a.radius := hq
    change dist q c<a.radius+b.radius+η
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle q a.center c) (by linarith)
  have hB : b.closedBall⊆d.ball := by
    intro q hq
    have hq' : dist q b.center≤b.radius := hq
    change dist q c<a.radius+b.radius+η
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle q b.center c) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨d,⟨by dsimp [d]; linarith,?_⟩,hA,hB,le_refl _,?_,rfl⟩
  · intro hc
    have hc' : a.core=true ∨ b.core=true := by cases hca : a.core <;> cases hcb : b.core <;> simp_all [d]
    rcases hc' with hh|hh
    · obtain ⟨x,hx,hxa⟩ := ha.2 hh
      exact ⟨x,hx,hA (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hxa)⟩
    · obtain ⟨x,hx,hxb⟩ := hb.2 hh
      exact ⟨x,hx,hB (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hxb)⟩
  · dsimp [noncoreCost,d]
    cases a.core <;> cases b.core <;> simp <;> linarith [ha.1,hb.1]
end MarkedDisk
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
namespace MarkedDisk
lemma erased_pair_sum {D : Type*} [DecidableEq D] (S : Finset D) {a b : D}
    (ha : a∈S) (hb : b∈S) (hab : a≠b) (f : D → ℝ) :
    (∑x∈(S.erase a).erase b,f x)+f a+f b=∑x∈S,f x := by
  have h1 := Finset.sum_erase_add S f ha
  have h2 := Finset.sum_erase_add (S.erase a) f (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab.symm,hb⟩)
  linarith
lemma merge_sum_bound {D : Type*} [DecidableEq D] (S : Finset D) {a b d : D}
    (ha : a∈S) (hb : b∈S) (hab : a≠b) (f : D → ℝ) {η : ℝ}
    (hd0 : 0≤f d) (hd : f d≤f a+f b+η) :
    (∑x∈insert d ((S.erase a).erase b),f x)≤(∑x∈S,f x)+η := by
  have hs := erased_pair_sum S ha hb hab f
  by_cases hmem : d∈(S.erase a).erase b
  · rw [Finset.insert_eq_of_mem hmem]
    linarith
  · rw [Finset.sum_insert hmem]
    linarith

/-- Finite disk merging with separate total and non-core radius budgets. Strict
containment at merges, and the retained core witness, are both included. -/
theorem separate (S : Finset MarkedDisk) {L : Set ℂ} (hS : ∀d∈S,d.Valid L)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0<η) : ∃T : Finset MarkedDisk,
      (∀d∈T,d.Valid L) ∧ (T : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) ∧
      (∀d∈S,∃e∈T,d.ball⊆e.ball ∧ (d.core=true → e.core=true)) ∧
      (∑d∈T,d.radius)<(∑d∈S,d.radius)+η ∧
      (∑d∈T,d.noncoreCost)<(∑d∈S,d.noncoreCost)+η := by
  suffices hh : ∀n : ℕ, ∀S : Finset MarkedDisk, S.card=n →
      (∀d∈S,d.Valid L) → ∀η : ℝ,0<η → ∃T : Finset MarkedDisk,
      (∀d∈T,d.Valid L) ∧ (T : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) ∧
      (∀d∈S,∃e∈T,d.ball⊆e.ball ∧ (d.core=true → e.core=true)) ∧
      (∑d∈T,d.radius)<(∑d∈S,d.radius)+η ∧
      (∑d∈T,d.noncoreCost)<(∑d∈S,d.noncoreCost)+η from hh _ S rfl hS η hη
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro S hn hS η hη
    by_cases hp : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)
    · exact ⟨S,hS,hp,fun d hd => ⟨d,hd,Subset.rfl,fun h => h⟩,
        lt_add_of_pos_right _ hη,lt_add_of_pos_right _ hη⟩
    · simp only [Set.Pairwise,Finset.mem_coe] at hp
      push Not at hp
      obtain ⟨a,ha,b,hb,hab,hd⟩ := hp
      obtain ⟨d,hdv,hda,hdb,hdr,hdc,hdcore⟩ := merge (hS a ha) (hS b hb) hd (half_pos hη)
      let R := (S.erase a).erase b
      let S' := insert d R
      have hR : ∀e∈R,e∈S := by intro e he; exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp he).2).2
      have hS' : ∀e∈S',e.Valid L := by
        intro e he
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp he with rfl|he
        · exact hdv
        · exact hS e (hR e he)
      have hcard : S'.card<n := by
        have hc₁ := Finset.card_erase_add_one ha
        have hc₂ := Finset.card_erase_add_one (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab.symm,hb⟩)
        have hc₃ := Finset.card_insert_le d R
        change R.card+1=(S.erase a).card at hc₂
        dsimp only [S']
        omega
      obtain ⟨T,hT,hdis,hcov,hr,hc⟩ := ih S'.card hcard S' rfl hS' (η/2) (half_pos hη)
      refine ⟨T,hT,hdis,?_,?_,?_⟩
      · intro e he
        have he' : ∃f∈S',e.ball⊆f.ball ∧ (e.core=true → f.core=true) := by
          by_cases hea : e=a
          · subst e
            refine ⟨d,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _,fun _ hq => hda (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hq),?_⟩
            intro ha
            rw [hdcore,ha]
            simp
          · by_cases heb : e=b
            · subst e
              refine ⟨d,Finset.mem_insert_self _ _,fun _ hq => hdb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hq),?_⟩
              intro hb
              rw [hdcore,hb]
              simp
            · exact ⟨e,Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (by simp [R,he,hea,heb]),Subset.rfl,fun h => h⟩
        obtain ⟨f,hf,hef,hcore⟩ := he'
        obtain ⟨g,hg,hfg,hcore'⟩ := hcov f hf
        exact ⟨g,hg,hef.trans hfg,fun hec => hcore' (hcore hec)⟩
      · have hb' := merge_sum_bound S ha hb hab radius hdv.1.le hdr
        change (∑x∈S',x.radius)≤(∑x∈S,x.radius)+η/2 at hb'
        linarith
      · have hdc0 : 0≤d.noncoreCost := by unfold noncoreCost; split_ifs <;> linarith [hdv.1]
        have hb' := merge_sum_bound S ha hb hab noncoreCost hdc0 hdc
        change (∑x∈S',x.noncoreCost)≤(∑x∈S,x.noncoreCost)+η/2 at hb'
        linarith
end MarkedDisk
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma cone_dist (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (z : Metric.sphere c r) (t : unitInterval) :
    dist ((1-t.val) • (z.val-c)+c) c=(1-t.val)*r := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr t.property.2)]
  rw [←dist_eq_norm,z.property]
def diskCone (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) :
    C(unitInterval × Metric.sphere c r, Metric.closedBall c r) where
  toFun p := ⟨(1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c,by
    change dist ((1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c) c≤r
    rw [cone_dist]
    nlinarith [p.1.property.1]⟩
  continuous_toFun := (((continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).smul
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_const)).add continuous_const).subtype_mk _
lemma diskCone_surjective (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) : Function.Surjective (diskCone c hr) := by
  intro q
  by_cases hq : q.val=c
  · obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty (x:=c)).mpr hr.le
    refine ⟨(1,⟨z,hz⟩),?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [diskCone] using hq.symm
  · let d := dist q.val c
    have hd : 0<d := dist_pos.mpr hq
    have hdr : d≤r := q.property
    let t : unitInterval := ⟨1-d/r,⟨by rw [sub_nonneg,div_le_one hr]; exact hdr,
      by linarith [div_nonneg hd.le hr.le]⟩⟩
    have hz : (r/d) • (q.val-c)+c∈Metric.sphere c r := by
      rw [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_eq_norm,add_sub_cancel_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (div_pos hr hd).le]
      rw [←dist_eq_norm]
      change r/d*d=r
      field_simp
    refine ⟨(t,⟨(r/d) • (q.val-c)+c,hz⟩),?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (1-(1-d/r)) • (((r/d) • (q.val-c)+c)-c)+c=q.val
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right,smul_smul]
    have he : (1-(1-d/r))*(r/d)=1 := by field_simp; ring
    rw [he,one_smul,sub_add_cancel]
lemma diskCone_fiber (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r)
    {p q : unitInterval × Metric.sphere c r} (he : diskCone c hr p=diskCone c hr q) :
    p=q ∨ (p.1=1 ∧ q.1=1) := by
  have hv := congrArg Subtype.val he
  have hd := congrArg (fun x : Metric.closedBall c r => dist x.val c) he
  change dist ((1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c) c=dist ((1-q.1.val) • (q.2.val-c)+c) c at hd
  rw [cone_dist,cone_dist] at hd
  have ht : p.1=q.1 := Subtype.ext (by nlinarith)
  by_cases h1 : p.1=1
  · exact Or.inr ⟨h1,ht.symm.trans h1⟩
  · left
    apply Prod.ext ht
    have hneq : 1-p.1.val≠0 := by
      intro hh
      apply h1
      apply Subtype.ext
      change p.1.val=1
      linarith
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (1-p.1.val) • (p.2.val-c)+c=(1-q.1.val) • (q.2.val-c)+c at hv
    rw [←ht] at hv
    have hsub : p.2.val-c=q.2.val-c := (smul_right_injective ℂ hneq (add_right_cancel hv))
    exact sub_left_injective hsub

/-- A contraction genuinely extends arbitrary continuous sphere data across a disk. -/
theorem contractible_disk_extension {Y : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Y] [ContractibleSpace Y]
    (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) (f : C(Metric.sphere c r,Y)) :
    ∃g : C(Metric.closedBall c r,Y), ∀z : Metric.sphere c r,
      g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩=f z := by
  let : CompactSpace (Metric.sphere c r) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_sphere c r)
  obtain ⟨a,⟨H⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic Y
  let F : C(unitInterval × Metric.sphere c r,Y) := H.toContinuousMap.comp
    (ContinuousMap.prodMk ContinuousMap.fst (f.comp ContinuousMap.snd))
  have hf : Function.FactorsThrough F (diskCone c hr) := by
    intro p q he
    rcases diskCone_fiber c hr he with rfl|⟨hp,hq⟩
    · rfl
    · change H (p.1,f p.2)=H (q.1,f q.2)
      rw [hp,hq]
      exact (H.map_one_left (f p.2)).trans (H.map_one_left (f q.2)).symm
  have hquot := IsQuotientMap.of_surjective_continuous (diskCone_surjective c hr) (diskCone c hr).continuous
  refine ⟨hquot.lift F hf,?_⟩
  intro z
  have he : diskCone c hr (0,z)=⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [diskCone]
  rw [←he]
  have hh := DFunLike.congr_fun (hquot.lift_comp F hf) (0,z)
  change (hquot.lift F hf) (diskCone c hr (0,z))=H (0,f z) at hh
  exact hh.trans (H.map_zero_left _)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology
universe u
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Linear transfer of a leaf coordinate along its unique incident edge. -/
def graphLeafMove {V : Type u} (v w : V) (t : ℝ) (p : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  p+(t*p v) • (graphVertex w-graphVertex v)
lemma continuous_graphLeafMove {V : Type u} (v w : V) :
    Continuous (fun tp : ℝ × (V → ℝ) => graphLeafMove v w tp.1 tp.2) := by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  change Continuous (fun tp : ℝ × (V → ℝ) => tp.2 i + (tp.1 * tp.2 v) * (graphVertex w i-graphVertex v i))
  fun_prop
@[simp] lemma graphLeafMove_zero {V : Type u} (v w : V) (p : V → ℝ) : graphLeafMove v w 0 p=p := by
  simp [graphLeafMove]
lemma graphLeafMove_of_zero {V : Type u} (v w : V) (p : V → ℝ) (hp : p v=0) (t : ℝ) :
    graphLeafMove v w t p=p := by simp [graphLeafMove,hp]
lemma graphLeafMove_edge {V : Type u} {v w : V} (hvw : v≠w) (t s : ℝ) :
    graphLeafMove v w t (graphEdgePoint v w s)=graphEdgePoint v w (s+t*(1-s)) := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i=v
  · subst i; simp [graphLeafMove,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hvw]; ring
  · by_cases hj : i=w
    · subst i; simp [graphLeafMove,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hvw,Ne.symm hvw]
    · simp [graphLeafMove,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hi,hj,hvw]
lemma graphLeafMove_vertex {V : Type u} {v w : V} (hvw : v≠w) (t : ℝ) :
    graphLeafMove v w t (graphVertex v)=graphEdgePoint v w t := by
  simpa using graphLeafMove_edge hvw t 0
lemma graphLeafMove_mem {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v w : V}
    (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hleaf : ∀i,G.Adj v i → i=w)
    {p : V → ℝ} (hp : p∈graphRealization G) {t : ℝ} (ht : t∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    graphLeafMove v w t p∈graphRealization G := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,s,hs,rfl⟩ := hp
  by_cases ha : a=v
  · subst a
    by_cases hb : b=v
    · subst b
      rw [graphEdgePoint_self,graphLeafMove_vertex hvw.ne]
      exact graphEdgePoint_mem (.inr hvw) ht
    · have : b=w := hleaf b (hab.resolve_left (Ne.symm hb))
      subst b
      rw [graphLeafMove_edge hvw.ne]
      apply graphEdgePoint_mem (.inr hvw)
      constructor
      · nlinarith [hs.1,hs.2,ht.1,ht.2]
      · nlinarith [hs.1,hs.2,ht.1,ht.2]
  · by_cases hb : b=v
    · subst b
      have haw : a=w := hleaf a ((hab.resolve_left ha).symm)
      subst a
      rw [graphEdgePoint_swap,graphLeafMove_edge hvw.ne]
      apply graphEdgePoint_mem (.inr hvw)
      constructor <;> nlinarith [hs.1,hs.2,ht.1,ht.2]
    · rw [graphLeafMove_of_zero v w _ (by simp [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Ne.symm ha,Ne.symm hb])]
      exact graphEdgePoint_mem hab hs
lemma graphLeafMove_one_at {V : Type u} {v w : V} (hvw : v≠w) (p : V → ℝ) :
    graphLeafMove v w 1 p v=0 := by
  simp [graphLeafMove,graphVertex,hvw]

def graphDrop {V : Type u} (v : V) (p : V → ℝ) : {i : V // i≠v} → ℝ := fun i => p i

def graphLift {V : Type u} (v : V) (p : {i : V // i≠v} → ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  fun i => if hi : i≠v then p ⟨i,hi⟩ else 0
lemma continuous_graphDrop {V : Type u} (v : V) : Continuous (graphDrop v) :=
  continuous_pi fun i => continuous_apply i.val
lemma continuous_graphLift {V : Type u} (v : V) : Continuous (graphLift v) := by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i≠v
  · simpa [graphLift,hi] using (continuous_apply (⟨i,hi⟩ : {i : V // i≠v}))
  · simpa [graphLift,hi] using (continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ({i : V // i≠v} → ℝ) => (0:ℝ)))
@[simp] lemma graphLift_drop {V : Type u} (v : V) (p : V → ℝ) (hp : p v=0) :
    graphLift v (graphDrop v p)=p := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i=v
  · subst i; simp [graphLift,hp]
  · simp [graphLift,graphDrop,hi]
@[simp] lemma graphDrop_lift {V : Type u} (v : V) (p : {i : V // i≠v} → ℝ) :
    graphDrop v (graphLift v p)=p := by
  ext i; simp [graphDrop,graphLift,i.property]
lemma graphDrop_vertex {V : Type u} {v a : V} (ha : a≠v) :
    graphDrop v (graphVertex a)=graphVertex (⟨a,ha⟩ : {i : V // i≠v}) := by
  ext i; simp [graphDrop,graphVertex,Subtype.ext_iff]
lemma graphDrop_edge {V : Type u} {v a b : V} (ha : a≠v) (hb : b≠v) (t : ℝ) :
    graphDrop v (graphEdgePoint a b t)=graphEdgePoint (⟨a,ha⟩ : {i : V // i≠v}) ⟨b,hb⟩ t := by
  ext i; simp [graphDrop,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Subtype.ext_iff]
lemma graphLift_vertex {V : Type u} (v : V) (a : {i : V // i≠v}) :
    graphLift v (graphVertex a)=graphVertex a.val := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i=v
  · subst i; simp [graphLift,graphVertex,Ne.symm a.property]
  · simp [graphLift,graphVertex,hi,Subtype.ext_iff]
lemma graphLift_edge {V : Type u} (v : V) (a b : {i : V // i≠v}) (t : ℝ) :
    graphLift v (graphEdgePoint a b t)=graphEdgePoint a.val b.val t := by
  ext i
  by_cases hi : i=v
  · subst i; simp [graphLift,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Ne.symm a.property,Ne.symm b.property]
  · simp [graphLift,graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hi,Subtype.ext_iff]
lemma graphLift_mem {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} (v : V) {p : {i : V // i≠v} → ℝ}
    (hp : p∈graphRealization (G.induce {i | i≠v})) : graphLift v p∈graphRealization G := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,t,ht,rfl⟩ := hp
  rw [graphLift_edge]
  exact graphEdgePoint_mem (hab.imp (congrArg Subtype.val) id) ht
lemma graphDrop_mem {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} (v : V) {p : V → ℝ}
    (hp : p∈graphRealization G) (hz : p v=0) :
    graphDrop v p∈graphRealization (G.induce {i | i≠v}) := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,t,ht,rfl⟩ := hp
  by_cases ha : a=v
  · subst a
    by_cases hb : b=v
    · subst b
      simp [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex] at hz
    · have he : t=1 := by
        have : 1-t=0 := by simpa [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Ne.symm hb] using hz
        linarith
      subst t
      rw [graphEdgePoint_one,graphDrop_vertex hb]
      exact graphVertex_mem _ _
  · by_cases hb : b=v
    · subst b
      have he : t=0 := by simpa [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,Ne.symm ha] using hz
      subst t
      rw [graphEdgePoint_zero,graphDrop_vertex ha]
      exact graphVertex_mem _ _
    · rw [graphDrop_edge ha hb]
      exact graphEdgePoint_mem (hab.imp (fun h => Subtype.ext h) id) ht
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u
namespace EuclideanFiveColor

def graphLeafRetraction {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v w : V}
    (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hleaf : ∀i,G.Adj v i → i=w) :
    C(GraphSpace G, GraphSpace (G.induce {i | i≠v})) where
  toFun p := ⟨graphDrop v (graphLeafMove v w 1 p.val),
    graphDrop_mem v (graphLeafMove_mem hvw hleaf p.property (by norm_num))
      (graphLeafMove_one_at hvw.ne p.val)⟩
  continuous_toFun := (continuous_graphDrop v |>.comp
    ((continuous_graphLeafMove v w).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_subtype_val))).subtype_mk _

def graphLeafInclusion {V : Type u} (G : SimpleGraph V) (v : V) :
    C(GraphSpace (G.induce {i | i≠v}), GraphSpace G) where
  toFun p := ⟨graphLift v p.val,graphLift_mem v p.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := ((continuous_graphLift v).comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _

def graphLeafHomotopy {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {v w : V}
    (hvw : G.Adj v w) (hleaf : ∀i,G.Adj v i → i=w) :
    (ContinuousMap.id (GraphSpace G)).Homotopy
      ((graphLeafInclusion G v).comp (graphLeafRetraction hvw hleaf)) where
  toFun tp := ⟨graphLeafMove v w tp.1.val tp.2.val,
    graphLeafMove_mem hvw hleaf tp.2.property tp.1.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := ((continuous_graphLeafMove v w).comp
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))).subtype_mk _
  map_zero_left p := by apply Subtype.ext; exact graphLeafMove_zero v w p.val
  map_one_left p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (graphLift_drop v _ (graphLeafMove_one_at hvw.ne p.val)).symm

private lemma graphTree_contractible_aux (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (V : Type u) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V), Fintype.card V=n →
      G.IsTree → ContractibleSpace (GraphSpace G) := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro V inst G hcard hG
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial V with hSS|hNT
    · let := hSS
      obtain ⟨a⟩ := hG.nonempty
      let : Nonempty (GraphSpace G) := ⟨⟨graphVertex a,graphVertex_mem G a⟩⟩
      let : Subsingleton (GraphSpace G) := ⟨fun p q => Subtype.ext (by
        have hp := p.property
        have hq := q.property
        simp only [graphRealization_singleton G a,mem_singleton_iff] at hp hq
        exact hp.trans hq.symm)⟩
      infer_instance
    · let := hNT
      obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hG.exists_vert_degree_one_of_nontrivial
      obtain ⟨w,hvw,hleaf⟩ := SimpleGraph.degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj.mp hv
      let W := {i : V // i≠v}
      let G' : SimpleGraph W := G.induce {i | i≠v}
      have hs : ({v}ᶜ : Set V)={i | i≠v} := by ext i; simp
      have hconn : G'.Connected := by
        have hh := hG.connected.induce_compl_singleton_of_degree_eq_one hv
        rwa [hs] at hh
      have hac : G'.IsAcyclic := hG.isAcyclic.induce _
      have hlt : Fintype.card W<n := by
        rw [←hcard]
        apply Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective (Subtype.val : W → V) Subtype.val_injective
        intro hh
        obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hh v
        exact i.property hi
      let : ContractibleSpace (GraphSpace G') := ih _ hlt W G' rfl ⟨hconn,hac⟩
      have hn := ((id_nullhomotopic (GraphSpace G')).comp_left
        (graphLeafRetraction hvw hleaf)).comp_right (graphLeafInclusion G v)
      obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hn
      apply (contractible_iff_id_nullhomotopic _).mpr
      refine ⟨a,ContinuousMap.Homotopic.trans ⟨graphLeafHomotopy hvw hleaf⟩ ?_⟩
      simpa only [ContinuousMap.id_comp] using ha

/-- Genuine contraction of the geometric probability-simplex realization of a finite tree. -/
theorem graphTree_contractible {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.IsTree) :
    ContractibleSpace (GraphSpace G) := graphTree_contractible_aux _ V G rfl hG
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Forest-valued boundary data extend through an actual spanning tree inside the
complete graph. Isolated labels and empty edge sets are retained. -/
theorem forest_disk_extension {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (c : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) (f : C(Metric.sphere c r,V → ℝ))
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.IsAcyclic) (hf : ∀z,f z∈graphRealization G) :
    ∃g : C(Metric.closedBall c r,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)), ∀z : Metric.sphere c r,
      (g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩).val=f z := by
  obtain ⟨T,hGT,_,hT⟩ := SimpleGraph.connected_top.exists_isTree_le_of_le_of_isAcyclic
    (show G≤⊤ from le_top) hG
  let : ContractibleSpace (GraphSpace T) := graphTree_contractible hT
  let F : C(Metric.sphere c r,GraphSpace T) := ⟨fun z => ⟨f z,graphRealization_mono hGT (hf z)⟩,
    f.continuous.subtype_mk _⟩
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := contractible_disk_extension c hr F
  let g' : C(Metric.closedBall c r,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => ⟨(g z).val,graphRealization_mono le_top (g z).property⟩,
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp g.continuous).subtype_mk _⟩
  exact ⟨g',fun z => congrArg Subtype.val (hg z)⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u v w
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Finite closed-cover pasting, with the actual glued continuous map. -/
def closedCoverMap {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Finite ι]
    (S : ι → Set X) (hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i)) (hc : ⋃i,S i=univ)
    (f : ∀i,C(S i,Y))
    (hf : ∀i j x (hi : x∈S i) (hj : x∈S j), f i ⟨x,hi⟩=f j ⟨x,hj⟩) : C(X,Y) where
  toFun := Set.liftCover S (fun i => f i) hf hc
  continuous_toFun := (locallyFinite_of_finite S).continuous hc hS (fun i => by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
    simpa +unfoldPartialApp only [Set.domRestrict,Set.liftCover_coe] using (f i).continuous)
@[simp] lemma closedCoverMap_apply {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} {ι : Type w}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Finite ι]
    (S : ι → Set X) (hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i)) (hc : ⋃i,S i=univ)
    (f : ∀i,C(S i,Y))
    (hf : ∀i j x (hi : x∈S i) (hj : x∈S j), f i ⟨x,hi⟩=f j ⟨x,hj⟩)
    {i : ι} (x : S i) : closedCoverMap S hS hc f hf x=f i x := by
  change Set.liftCover S (fun i => f i) hf hc x=f i x
  exact Set.liftCover_coe x
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def diskHoles (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := ⋃d∈S,d.ball
def coreHoles (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := ⋃d∈S,⋃(_ : d.core=true),d.ball
lemma diskHoles_open (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : IsOpen (diskHoles S) :=
  isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball
lemma coreHoles_open (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : IsOpen (coreHoles S) :=
  isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball
lemma mem_diskHoles {S : Finset MarkedDisk} {z : ℂ} : z∈diskHoles S ↔ ∃d∈S,z∈d.ball := by
  simp [diskHoles]
lemma mem_coreHoles {S : Finset MarkedDisk} {z : ℂ} : z∈coreHoles S ↔ ∃d∈S,d.core=true ∧ z∈d.ball := by
  simp only [coreHoles,mem_iUnion]
  aesop

/-- Finite closed pasting fills precisely the non-core holes, with actual continuous
tree extensions on their disks and no change outside the original open holes. -/
theorem fill_noncore_disks {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (Q : Set ℂ) (S : Finset MarkedDisk) (hr : ∀d∈S,0<d.radius)
    (hdis : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall))
    (f : C(ℂ,V → ℝ))
    (hg : ∀z∈Q,z∉diskHoles S → f z∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph V))
    (hb : ∀d∈S,d.core=false → (d.closedBall∩Q).Nonempty →
      ∃G : SimpleGraph V,G.IsAcyclic ∧ ∀z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius,f z∈graphRealization G) :
    ∃g : C(↥(Q \ coreHoles S),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)),
      ∀z : ↥(Q \ coreHoles S),z.val∉diskHoles S → (g z).val=f z.val := by
  let D : Finset MarkedDisk := S.filter fun d => d.core=false ∧ (d.closedBall∩Q).Nonempty
  have hD (d : D) : d.val∈S ∧ d.val.core=false ∧ (d.val.closedBall∩Q).Nonempty :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mp d.property
  have hex (d : D) : ∃g : C(Metric.closedBall d.val.center d.val.radius,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)),
      ∀z : Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius,
        (g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩).val=f z.val := by
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hf⟩ := hb d.val (hD d).1 (hD d).2.1 (hD d).2.2
    exact forest_disk_extension d.val.center (hr _ (hD d).1) (f.restrict _) hG (fun z => hf z.val z.property)
  choose g hg' using hex
  let X := Q \ coreHoles S
  let Z : Option D → Set X := fun i => match i with
    | none => {z | z.val∉diskHoles S}
    | some d => {z | z.val∈d.val.closedBall}
  have hZ : ∀i,IsClosed (Z i) := by
    intro i
    cases i with
    | none => exact (diskHoles_open S).isClosed_compl.preimage continuous_subtype_val
    | some d => exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  have hcov : ⋃i,Z i=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z.val∈diskHoles S
    · obtain ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hz
      have hdf : d.core=false := by
        cases he : d.core
        · rfl
        · exact False.elim (z.property.2 (mem_coreHoles.mpr ⟨d,hd,he,hzd⟩))
      let d' : D := ⟨d,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hd,hdf,⟨z.val,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd,z.property.1⟩⟩⟩
      exact ⟨some d',Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd⟩
    · exact ⟨none,hz⟩
  let f₀ : C(Z none,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => ⟨f z.val.val,hg z.val.val z.val.property.1 z.property⟩,
      (f.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val)).subtype_mk _⟩
  let ψ (d : D) : C(Z (some d),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => g d ⟨z.val.val,z.property⟩,
      (g d).continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ : ∀i,C(Z i,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) := fun i => match i with
    | none => f₀
    | some d => ψ d
  have hbd (d : D) (z : X) (h0 : z∈Z none) (h1 : z∈Z (some d)) :
      f₀ ⟨z,h0⟩=ψ d ⟨z,h1⟩ := by
    have hn : z.val∉d.val.ball := fun hz => h0 (mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨d.val,(hD d).1,hz⟩)
    have hs : z.val∈Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius := by
      change dist z.val d.val.center=d.val.radius
      exact le_antisymm h1 (le_of_not_gt hn)
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (hg' d ⟨z.val,hs⟩).symm
  have hφ : ∀i j z (hi : z∈Z i) (hj : z∈Z j),φ i ⟨z,hi⟩=φ j ⟨z,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j z hi hj
    cases i with
    | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => rfl
      | some d => exact hbd d z hi hj
    | some d =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact (hbd d z hj hi).symm
      | some e =>
        by_cases hde : d=e
        · subst e; rfl
        · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdis (hD d).1 (hD e).1
            (fun he => hde (Subtype.ext he))) hi hj)
  refine ⟨closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ,?_⟩
  intro z hz
  change (closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ z).val=f z.val
  rw [closedCoverMap_apply Z hZ hcov φ hφ (i:=none) ⟨z,hz⟩]
  rfl
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/GraphCuts.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/GraphCuts.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.DiskExtension

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma graphEdgePoint_index {V : Type u} {i j k : V} {t : ℝ}
    (h : graphEdgePoint i j t k ≠ 0) : k=i ∨ k=j := by
  by_contra hh
  simp only [not_or] at hh
  exact h (by simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hh.1,hh.2])
lemma graphRealization_positive_adj {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ}
    (hp : p∈graphRealization G) {i j : V} (hne : i≠j) (hi : 0<p i) (hj : 0<p j) : G.Adj i j := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,t,ht,rfl⟩ := hp
  have ha := graphEdgePoint_index (ne_of_gt hi)
  have hb := graphEdgePoint_index (ne_of_gt hj)
  rcases ha with rfl|rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl|rfl
  · exact (hne rfl).elim
  · exact hab.resolve_left hne
  · exact (hab.resolve_left hne.symm).symm
  · exact (hne rfl).elim
lemma graphRealization_pair_le {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ}
    (hp : p∈graphRealization G) {i j : V} (hne : i≠j) : p i+p j≤1 := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,hab,t,ht,rfl⟩ := hp
  simp only [graphEdgePoint_apply]
  split_ifs <;> subst_vars <;> first | contradiction | nlinarith [ht.1,ht.2]

def graphCutRealization {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) : Set (V → ℝ) :=
  {p | p∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph V) ∧ ∀ i j, i≠j → ¬T.Adj i j →
    p≠graphEdgePoint i j (1/2)}
abbrev GraphCutSpace {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) := ↥(graphCutRealization T)
lemma graphRealization_subset_cut {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) :
    graphRealization T⊆graphCutRealization T := by
  intro p hp
  refine ⟨graphRealization_mono le_top hp,?_⟩
  intro i j hne hn he
  apply hn
  apply graphRealization_positive_adj hp hne
  · rw [he]; norm_num [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne,hne.symm]
  · rw [he]; norm_num [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne,hne.symm]
lemma graphCut_dominant {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ}
    (hp : p∈graphCutRealization T) (hn : p∉graphRealization T) : ∃i,1/2<p i := by
  obtain ⟨i,j,hij,t,ht,he⟩ := hp.1
  have hne : i≠j := by
    intro h; apply hn; exact ⟨i,j,Or.inl h,t,ht,he⟩
  have hadj : ¬T.Adj i j := by
    intro h; apply hn; exact ⟨i,j,Or.inr h,t,ht,he⟩
  have htm : t≠1/2 := by intro h; exact hp.2 i j hne hadj (he.trans (by rw [h]))
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne htm with hl|hr
  · refine ⟨i,?_⟩; rw [he]; simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne]; linarith
  · refine ⟨j,?_⟩; rw [he]; simpa [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne.symm] using hr
lemma graphCut_dominant_unique {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ}
    (hp : p∈graphCutRealization T) {i j : V} (hi : 1/2<p i) (hj : 1/2<p j) : i=j := by
  by_contra hne
  have hh := graphRealization_pair_le hp.1 hne
  linarith

def graphCutRetract {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) (p : GraphCutSpace T) : V → ℝ :=
  if h : p.val∈graphRealization T then p.val else graphVertex (graphCut_dominant p.property h).choose
lemma graphCutRetract_tree {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} (p : GraphCutSpace T)
    (hp : p.val∈graphRealization T) : graphCutRetract T p=p.val := by
  simp [graphCutRetract,hp]
lemma graphCutRetract_dominant {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} (p : GraphCutSpace T)
    (hp : p.val∉graphRealization T) {i : V} (hi : 1/2<p.val i) : graphCutRetract T p=graphVertex i := by
  rw [graphCutRetract,dite_eq_right hp]
  congr 1
  exact graphCut_dominant_unique p.property (graphCut_dominant p.property hp).choose_spec hi
lemma graphCutRetract_mem {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) (p : GraphCutSpace T) :
    graphCutRetract T p∈graphRealization T := by
  unfold graphCutRetract
  split
  · assumption
  · exact graphVertex_mem _ _
/-- The closed half of a deleted edge, viewed inside the cut graph. -/
def graphCutStub {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) (i j : V) : Set (GraphCutSpace T) :=
  {p | i≠j ∧ ¬T.Adj i j ∧ p.val∈graphEdgePoint i j '' Icc (0:ℝ) (1/2)}
lemma graphCutStub_retract {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} {i j : V}
    {p : GraphCutSpace T} (hp : p∈graphCutStub T i j) : graphCutRetract T p=graphVertex i := by
  obtain ⟨hne,hadj,t,ht,he⟩ := hp
  have he' := he.symm
  have htm : t<1/2 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 (by
    intro h; exact p.property.2 i j hne hadj (he'.trans (by rw [h])))
  by_cases hT : p.val∈graphRealization T
  · rw [graphCutRetract_tree p hT]
    have ht0 : t=0 := by
      by_contra hh
      have hp1 : 0<p.val i := by rw [he']; simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne]; linarith
      have hp2 : 0<p.val j := by rw [he']; simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne.symm]; exact lt_of_le_of_ne ht.1 (Ne.symm hh)
      exact hadj (graphRealization_positive_adj hT hne hp1 hp2)
    rw [he',ht0,graphEdgePoint_zero]
  · apply graphCutRetract_dominant p hT
    rw [he']; simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne]; linarith
lemma graphCut_cover {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} (p : GraphCutSpace T) :
    p.val∈graphRealization T ∨ ∃i j,p∈graphCutStub T i j := by
  by_cases h : p.val∈graphRealization T
  · exact Or.inl h
  right
  obtain ⟨i,j,hij,t,ht,he⟩ := p.property.1
  have hne : i≠j := by intro hh; exact h ⟨i,j,Or.inl hh,t,ht,he⟩
  have hadj : ¬T.Adj i j := by intro hh; exact h ⟨i,j,Or.inr hh,t,ht,he⟩
  by_cases ht' : t≤1/2
  · exact ⟨i,j,hne,hadj,t,⟨ht.1,ht'⟩,he.symm⟩
  · refine ⟨j,i,hne.symm,fun hh => hadj hh.symm,1-t,⟨by linarith [ht.2],by linarith⟩,?_⟩
    exact (graphEdgePoint_swap i j t).symm.trans he.symm
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma graphCutStub_closed {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} (i j : V) :
    IsClosed (graphCutStub T i j) := by
  change IsClosed ({p : GraphCutSpace T | i≠j} ∩
    ({p : GraphCutSpace T | ¬T.Adj i j} ∩ Subtype.val ⁻¹' (graphEdgePoint i j '' Icc (0:ℝ) (1/2))))
  exact isClosed_const.inter (isClosed_const.inter ((isCompact_Icc.image (continuous_graphEdgePoint i j)).isClosed.preimage
    continuous_subtype_val))
lemma continuous_graphCutRetract {V : Type u} [Finite V] (T : SimpleGraph V) :
    Continuous (graphCutRetract T) := by
  let S : Option (V × V) → Set (GraphCutSpace T) := fun a => match a with
    | none => Subtype.val ⁻¹' graphRealization T
    | some (i,j) => graphCutStub T i j
  have hcov : ⋃a,S a=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro p
    rcases graphCut_cover p with hp|⟨i,j,hp⟩
    · exact ⟨none,hp⟩
    · exact ⟨some (i,j),hp⟩
  apply (locallyFinite_of_finite S).continuous hcov
  · intro a
    cases a with
    | none => exact (graphRealization_closed T).preimage continuous_subtype_val
    | some a => exact graphCutStub_closed a.1 a.2
  · intro a
    cases a with
    | none => exact continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn.congr (fun p hp => graphCutRetract_tree p hp)
    | some a => exact continuous_const.continuousOn.congr (fun p hp => graphCutStub_retract hp)

lemma graphMidpoint_coord_le {V : Type u} {i j : V} (hne : i≠j) (k : V) :
    graphEdgePoint i j (1/2) k ≤ 1/2 := by
  simp only [graphEdgePoint_apply]
  split_ifs <;> subst_vars <;> first | contradiction | norm_num
lemma graph_dominant_mem_cut {V : Type u} {T : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ}
    (hp : p∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) {i : V} (hi : 1/2<p i) :
    p∈graphCutRealization T := by
  refine ⟨hp,?_⟩
  intro j k hjk _ he
  have hh := graphMidpoint_coord_le hjk i
  rw [←he] at hh
  linarith
lemma graphEdgePoint_lerp_vertex {V : Type u} (i j : V) (t s : ℝ) :
    (1-s) • graphEdgePoint i j t+s • graphVertex i=graphEdgePoint i j ((1-s)*t) := by
  ext k
  simp only [graphEdgePoint,Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  ring
lemma graphCut_lerp_mem {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) (p : GraphCutSpace T)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : s∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    (1-s) • p.val+s • graphCutRetract T p∈graphCutRealization T := by
  rcases graphCut_cover p with hp|⟨i,j,hp⟩
  · rw [graphCutRetract_tree p hp,←add_smul]
    simp
  · have hr := graphCutStub_retract hp
    obtain ⟨hne,hadj,t,ht,he⟩ := hp
    have htm : t<1/2 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 (by
      intro h; exact p.property.2 i j hne hadj (he.symm.trans (by rw [h])))
    rw [hr,←he,graphEdgePoint_lerp_vertex]
    have hu0 : 0≤(1-s)*t := mul_nonneg (by linarith [hs.2]) ht.1
    have hu1 : (1-s)*t≤t := mul_le_of_le_one_left ht.1 (by linarith [hs.1])
    have hu : (1-s)*t<1/2 := lt_of_le_of_lt hu1 htm
    apply graph_dominant_mem_cut (graphEdgePoint_mem (Or.inr (show (⊤ : SimpleGraph V).Adj i j from hne)) ⟨hu0,by linarith⟩) (i := i)
    simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hne]
    linarith

def graphCutRetraction {V : Type u} [Finite V] (T : SimpleGraph V) :
    C(GraphCutSpace T,GraphSpace T) where
  toFun p := ⟨graphCutRetract T p,graphCutRetract_mem T p⟩
  continuous_toFun := (continuous_graphCutRetract T).subtype_mk _
def graphCutInclusion {V : Type u} (T : SimpleGraph V) : C(GraphSpace T,GraphCutSpace T) where
  toFun p := ⟨p.val,graphRealization_subset_cut T p.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _
def graphCutHomotopy {V : Type u} [Finite V] (T : SimpleGraph V) :
    (ContinuousMap.id (GraphCutSpace T)).Homotopy
      ((graphCutInclusion T).comp (graphCutRetraction T)) where
  toFun sp := ⟨(1-sp.1.val) • sp.2.val+sp.1.val • graphCutRetract T sp.2,
    graphCut_lerp_mem T sp.2 sp.1.property⟩
  continuous_toFun := (((continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).smul
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).add
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).smul
      ((continuous_graphCutRetract T).comp continuous_snd))).subtype_mk _
  map_zero_left p := by apply Subtype.ext; simp
  map_one_left p := by apply Subtype.ext; simp [graphCutInclusion,graphCutRetraction]
/-- Removing the non-tree edge midpoints leaves a contractible graph (tree with half-open stubs). -/
theorem graphCut_contractible {V : Type u} [Fintype V] {T : SimpleGraph V} (hT : T.IsTree) :
    ContractibleSpace (GraphCutSpace T) := by
  let := graphTree_contractible hT
  have hn := ((id_nullhomotopic (GraphSpace T)).comp_left
    (graphCutRetraction T)).comp_right (graphCutInclusion T)
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hn
  apply (contractible_iff_id_nullhomotopic _).mpr
  refine ⟨a,ContinuousMap.Homotopic.trans ⟨graphCutHomotopy T⟩ ?_⟩
  simpa only [ContinuousMap.id_comp] using ha
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u v
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- A compact connected fiber joins both designated boundary sets. -/
def FiberCrosses {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : X → Y) (A B : Set X) (b : Y) : Prop :=
  ∃K : Set X, IsCompact K ∧ IsConnected K ∧ K⊆f ⁻¹' {b} ∧
    (K∩A).Nonempty ∧ (K∩B).Nonempty
lemma fiberCrosses_symm {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {f : X → Y} {A B : Set X} {b : Y} (h : FiberCrosses f A B b) : FiberCrosses f B A b := by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hC,hf,hA,hB⟩ := h
  exact ⟨K,hK,hC,hf,hB,hA⟩
lemma compact_fiber_partition {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [T1Space Y]
    (f : C(X,Y)) {A B : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B) (b : Y)
    (hn : ¬FiberCrosses f A B b) :
    ∃K₀ K₁ : Set X, IsCompact K₀ ∧ IsCompact K₁ ∧ Disjoint K₀ K₁ ∧
      K₀∪K₁=f ⁻¹' {b} ∧ Disjoint K₀ B ∧ Disjoint K₁ A := by
  let F : Set X := f ⁻¹' {b}
  have hF : IsClosed F := isClosed_singleton.preimage f.continuous
  let : CompactSpace F := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hF.isCompact
  let I : Set F := Subtype.val ⁻¹' A
  let O : Set F := Subtype.val ⁻¹' B
  have hI : IsCompact I := (hA.preimage continuous_subtype_val).isCompact
  have hO : IsCompact O := (hB.preimage continuous_subtype_val).isCompact
  have hno : ∀x∈I,Disjoint (connectedComponent x) O := by
    intro x hx
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro y hy hOy
    apply hn
    refine ⟨Subtype.val '' connectedComponent x,
      isClosed_connectedComponent.isCompact.image continuous_subtype_val,
      isConnected_connectedComponent.image _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rintro z ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩; exact w.property
    · exact ⟨x.val,⟨⟨x,mem_connectedComponent,rfl⟩,hx⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨y.val,⟨⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,hOy⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨Z₀,Z₁,hZ₀,hZ₁,hd,hcov,hIZ,hOZ⟩ := compact_component_partition hI hO hno
  refine ⟨Subtype.val '' Z₀,Subtype.val '' Z₁,hZ₀.image continuous_subtype_val,
    hZ₁.image continuous_subtype_val,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro x ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ ⟨z,hz,he⟩
    have hh : z=y := Subtype.ext he
    subst z
    exact disjoint_left.mp hd hy hz
  · rw [←image_union,hcov]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y,_,rfl⟩; exact y.property
    · intro hx; exact ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,mem_univ _,rfl⟩
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ hz
    exact disjoint_left.mp hd hx (hOZ hz)
  · apply disjoint_left.mpr
    rintro z ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ hz
    exact disjoint_left.mp hd (hIZ hz) hx

/-- All finitely many non-crossing bad fibers can simultaneously be separated,
 with the prescribed inner/outer closed sets on opposite sides. -/
theorem finite_fiber_separation {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [T1Space Y]
    (f : C(X,Y)) {A B : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B) (hd : Disjoint A B)
    (S : Finset Y) (hn : ∀b∈S,¬FiberCrosses f A B b) :
    ∃C₀ C₁ : Set X, IsCompact C₀ ∧ IsCompact C₁ ∧ Disjoint C₀ C₁ ∧
      A⊆C₀ ∧ B⊆C₁ ∧ f ⁻¹' (↑S : Set Y)⊆C₀∪C₁ := by
  choose K₀ K₁ hK using (fun b : S => compact_fiber_partition f hA hB b.val (hn b.val b.property))
  let Z₀ : Set X := ⋃b : S,K₀ b
  let Z₁ : Set X := ⋃b : S,K₁ b
  have hz₀ : IsCompact Z₀ := isCompact_iUnion fun b => (hK b).1
  have hz₁ : IsCompact Z₁ := isCompact_iUnion fun b => (hK b).2.1
  have hsub₀ (b : S) : K₀ b⊆f ⁻¹' {b.val} := by
    rw [←(hK b).2.2.2.1]; exact subset_union_left
  have hsub₁ (b : S) : K₁ b⊆f ⁻¹' {b.val} := by
    rw [←(hK b).2.2.2.1]; exact subset_union_right
  have h01 : Disjoint Z₀ Z₁ := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
    have he : b=c := Subtype.ext ((hsub₀ b hb).symm.trans (hsub₁ c hc))
    subst c
    exact disjoint_left.mp (hK b).2.2.1 hb hc
  have h0B : Disjoint Z₀ B := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hB
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact disjoint_left.mp (hK b).2.2.2.2.1 hb hB
  have h1A : Disjoint Z₁ A := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hA
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact disjoint_left.mp (hK b).2.2.2.2.2 hb hA
  refine ⟨A∪Z₀,B∪Z₁,hA.isCompact.union hz₀,hB.isCompact.union hz₁,?_,subset_union_left,subset_union_left,?_⟩
  · exact disjoint_union_left.mpr ⟨disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨hd,h1A.symm⟩,
      disjoint_union_right.mpr ⟨h0B,h01⟩⟩
  · intro x hx
    let b : S := ⟨f x,hx⟩
    have hh : x∈K₀ b∪K₁ b := by rw [(hK b).2.2.2.1]; rfl
    rcases hh with hh|hh
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨b,hh⟩))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨b,hh⟩))
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.DiskExtension

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
namespace MarkedDisk
lemma radius_le_sum {S : Finset MarkedDisk} (hS : ∀d∈S,0≤d.radius) {d : MarkedDisk} (hd : d∈S) :
    d.radius≤∑e∈S,e.radius := Finset.single_le_sum hS hd
lemma noncoreCost_nonneg {d : MarkedDisk} (hd : 0≤d.radius) : 0≤d.noncoreCost := by
  unfold noncoreCost
  split <;> positivity
lemma noncore_radius_le_sum {S : Finset MarkedDisk} (hS : ∀d∈S,0≤d.radius)
    {d : MarkedDisk} (hd : d∈S) (hc : d.core=false) : d.radius≤∑e∈S,e.noncoreCost := by
  have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (fun e he => noncoreCost_nonneg (hS e he)) hd
  simpa [noncoreCost,hc] using hh
lemma sphere_avoids_holes {S : Finset MarkedDisk}
    (hdis : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall))
    {d : MarkedDisk} (hd : d∈S) {z : ℂ} (hz : z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius) : z∉diskHoles S := by
  rintro hh
  obtain ⟨e,he,hze⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hh
  by_cases hde : d=e
  · subst e
    have hh' : dist z d.center<d.radius := hze
    have hz' : dist z d.center=d.radius := hz
    linarith
  · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdis hd he hde) (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)
      (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hze)
lemma closedBall_near_core {L : Set ℂ} {d : MarkedDisk} (hd : d.Valid L) (hc : d.core=true) :
    ∃x∈L,d.closedBall⊆Metric.ball x (2*d.radius) := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hxd⟩ := hd.2 hc
  refine ⟨x,hx,fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hx' : dist d.center x<d.radius := by simpa only [ball,Metric.mem_ball,dist_comm] using hxd
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (dist_triangle z d.center x) (by dsimp [closedBall] at hz; change dist z d.center≤d.radius at hz; linarith)
lemma sphere_norm_bound {d : MarkedDisk} {R : ℝ}
    (hmeet : (d.closedBall∩Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) R).Nonempty) {z : ℂ}
    (hz : z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius) : dist z 0≤2*d.radius+R := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,haR⟩ := hmeet
  have hza : dist z a≤2*d.radius := calc
    dist z a≤dist z d.center+dist d.center a := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ 2*d.radius := by
      have hh : dist z d.center=d.radius := hz
      have ha' : dist d.center a≤d.radius := by simpa only [closedBall,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_comm] using ha
      linarith
  exact (dist_triangle z a 0).trans (by change dist a 0≤R at haR; linarith)
end MarkedDisk
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
namespace MarkedDisk
def initialDisks (L C : Finset ℂ) (δ u : ℝ) : Finset MarkedDisk :=
  L.image (fun x => ⟨x,δ,true⟩) ∪ C.image (fun x => ⟨x,u,false⟩)
lemma mem_initialDisks {L C : Finset ℂ} {δ u : ℝ} {d : MarkedDisk} :
    d∈initialDisks L C δ u ↔ (∃x∈L,d=⟨x,δ,true⟩) ∨ (∃x∈C,d=⟨x,u,false⟩) := by
  simp [initialDisks,eq_comm]
lemma initialDisks_valid (L C : Finset ℂ) {δ u : ℝ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hu : 0<u) :
    ∀d∈initialDisks L C δ u,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ) := by
  intro d hd
  rcases mem_initialDisks.mp hd with ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩|⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨hδ,fun _ => ⟨x,hx,Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨hu,by simp⟩
lemma initialDisks_sum (L C : Finset ℂ) (δ u : ℝ) :
    (∑d∈initialDisks L C δ u,d.radius)=(L.card:ℝ)*δ+(C.card:ℝ)*u ∧
    (∑d∈initialDisks L C δ u,d.noncoreCost)=(C.card:ℝ)*u := by
  have hd : Disjoint (L.image (fun x => (⟨x,δ,true⟩ : MarkedDisk)))
      (C.image (fun x => (⟨x,u,false⟩ : MarkedDisk))) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro d hd he
    obtain ⟨x,hx,hxd⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hd
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hyd⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp he
    have hh := congrArg MarkedDisk.core (hxd.trans hyd.symm)
    exact Bool.noConfusion hh
  have hi (r : ℝ) (b : Bool) : Function.Injective (fun x : ℂ => (⟨x,r,b⟩ : MarkedDisk)) := by
    intro x y h; exact congrArg MarkedDisk.center h
  simp only [initialDisks,Finset.sum_union hd]
  rw [Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi δ true h),Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi u false h),
      Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi δ true h),Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => hi u false h)]
  simp [noncoreCost]
lemma initial_core_cover (L C : Finset ℂ) (δ u : ℝ) {x z : ℂ} (hx : x∈L)
    (hz : z∈Metric.ball x δ) : z∈coreHoles (initialDisks L C δ u) := by
  exact mem_coreHoles.mpr ⟨⟨x,δ,true⟩,mem_initialDisks.mpr (Or.inl ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩),rfl,hz⟩
lemma initial_marked_cover (L C : Finset ℂ) (δ u : ℝ) {x z : ℂ} (hx : x∈C)
    (hz : z∈Metric.ball x u) : z∈diskHoles (initialDisks L C δ u) := by
  exact mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨⟨x,u,false⟩,mem_initialDisks.mpr (Or.inr ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩),hz⟩
lemma holes_subset_of_cover {S T : Finset MarkedDisk}
    (hcov : ∀d∈S,∃e∈T,d.ball⊆e.ball ∧ (d.core=true → e.core=true)) :
    diskHoles S⊆diskHoles T ∧ coreHoles S⊆coreHoles T := by
  constructor
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hz
    obtain ⟨e,he,hde,_⟩ := hcov d hd
    exact mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨e,he,hde hzd⟩
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨d,hd,hcd,hzd⟩ := mem_coreHoles.mp hz
    obtain ⟨e,he,hde,hc⟩ := hcov d hd
    exact mem_coreHoles.mpr ⟨e,he,hc hcd,hde hzd⟩
end MarkedDisk
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory ContinuousMap
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
open MarkedDisk
/-- Actual small-hole maps on a fixed disk, with arbitrarily small total radii.
The core witnesses lie in the finite actual cyclic core; all other holes have been
filled by genuine tree extensions. -/
theorem small_hole_map {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {α : ℝ}
    (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) (L : Finset ℂ)
    (hL : ∀x∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8,¬(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic → x∈L)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) (ht' : t<1/2) :
    ∃e>0,∀ε,0<ε → ε<e → ∃S : Finset MarkedDisk,
      (∀d∈S,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ)) ∧
      (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) ∧
      (∑d∈S,d.radius)<t ∧
      ∃g : C(↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles S),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))),
        ∀z : ↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles S),z.val∉diskHoles S →
          (g z).val=thresholdMap c ε α z.val := by
  let δ : ℝ := t/(4*((L.card:ℝ)+1))
  have hδ : 0<δ := div_pos ht (by positivity)
  have hδeq : δ*(4*((L.card:ℝ)+1))=t := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by positivity)
  have hδbudget : (L.card:ℝ)*δ<t/4 := by nlinarith
  let M := Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8 \ ⋃x∈L,Metric.ball x δ
  have hM : IsCompact M := (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 8).diff
    (isOpen_iUnion fun _ => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
  have hf : ∀x∈M,(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    exact hx.2 (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hL x hx.1 hn,Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩⟩)
  obtain ⟨l,hl,hcharts⟩ := compact_forest_charts hc hα hα' M hM hf
  let κ := min (t/4) (l/6)
  have hκ : 0<κ := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hκt : κ≤t/4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hκl : κ≤l/6 := min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨e,he,hC⟩ := hcharts κ hκ
  refine ⟨e,he,fun ε hε hεe => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨C,hCr,hCv⟩ := hC ε hε hεe
  let u := α*ε/4
  have hu : 0<u := by dsimp [u]; positivity
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hdis,hcov,hsum,hcost⟩ := MarkedDisk.separate
    (initialDisks L C δ u) (initialDisks_valid L C hδ hu) hκ
  have htot : (∑d∈S,d.radius)<t := by
    rw [(initialDisks_sum L C δ u).1] at hsum
    change (C.card:ℝ)*u<κ at hCr
    linarith
  have hnrad : ∀d∈S,d.core=false → 2*d.radius<l := by
    rw [(initialDisks_sum L C δ u).2] at hcost
    intro d hd hdf
    have hd' := noncore_radius_le_sum (fun a ha => (hS a ha).1.le) hd hdf
    change (C.card:ℝ)*u<κ at hCr
    linarith
  have hcover := holes_subset_of_cover hcov
  have hMof (z : ℂ) (hz : z∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8) (hzS : z∉diskHoles S) : z∈M := by
    refine ⟨hz,?_⟩
    intro hh
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hh
    obtain ⟨hxL,hzx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact hzS (hcover.1 (mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨⟨x,δ,true⟩,
      mem_initialDisks.mpr (Or.inl ⟨x,hxL,rfl⟩),hzx⟩))
  have hmarked (z : ℂ) (hz : z∉diskHoles S) : z∉⋃x∈C,Metric.ball x u := by
    intro hh
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hh
    obtain ⟨hxC,hzx⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hx
    exact hz (hcover.1 (initial_marked_cover L C δ u hxC hzx))
  let f : C(ℂ,Fin 5 → ℝ) := ⟨thresholdMap c ε α,continuous_thresholdMap hc hε hα'⟩
  have hg : ∀z∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7,z∉diskHoles S →
      f z∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)) := by
    intro z hz hzS
    have hzM := hMof z (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by norm_num) hz) hzS
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hq⟩ := hCv z hzM
    exact graphRealization_mono le_top (hq z (Metric.mem_ball_self hl) (hmarked z hzS))
  have hb : ∀d∈S,d.core=false → (d.closedBall∩Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7).Nonempty →
      ∃G : SimpleGraph (Fin 5),G.IsAcyclic ∧ ∀z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius,
        f z∈graphRealization G := by
    intro d hd hdf hmeet
    have hr := (hS d hd).1
    have hsph (z : ℂ) (hz : z∈Metric.sphere d.center d.radius) : z∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8 := by
      have hzr := sphere_norm_bound hmeet hz
      have hd' := radius_le_sum (fun a ha => (hS a ha).1.le) hd
      change dist z 0≤8
      linarith
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty (x:=d.center)).mpr hr.le
    have haM := hMof a (hsph a ha) (sphere_avoids_holes hdis hd ha)
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hq⟩ := hCv a haM
    refine ⟨G,hG,fun z hz => hq z ?_ (hmarked z (sphere_avoids_holes hdis hd hz))⟩
    have hza : dist z a≤2*d.radius := calc
      dist z a≤dist z d.center+dist d.center a := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = 2*d.radius := by
        have hz' : dist z d.center=d.radius := hz
        have ha' : dist d.center a=d.radius := by simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_comm] using ha
        rw [hz',ha']; ring
    exact hza.trans_lt (hnrad d hd hdf)
  obtain ⟨g,hg'⟩ := fill_noncore_disks (Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7) S
    (fun d hd => (hS d hd).1) hdis f hg hb
  exact ⟨S,hS,hdis,htot,g,hg'⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical ENNReal
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Exception annuli for exact unit distances from the small closed disks. -/
def diskAnnulus (d : MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ :=
  Metric.closedBall d.center (1+d.radius) \ Metric.ball d.center (1-d.radius)
def holeAnnuli (S : Finset MarkedDisk) : Set ℂ := ⋃d∈S,diskAnnulus d
lemma diskAnnulus_measurable (d : MarkedDisk) : MeasurableSet (diskAnnulus d) :=
  Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet.diff Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
lemma unit_from_disk_mem_annulus {d : MarkedDisk} {z q : ℂ}
    (hq : q∈d.closedBall) (hzq : dist z q=1) : z∈diskAnnulus d := by
  have hq' : dist q d.center≤d.radius := hq
  constructor
  · change dist z d.center≤1+d.radius
    exact (dist_triangle z q d.center).trans (by linarith)
  · change ¬ dist z d.center<1-d.radius
    have hh := dist_triangle z d.center q
    rw [dist_comm d.center q,hzq] at hh
    linarith
lemma volume_diskAnnulus {d : MarkedDisk} (h0 : 0≤d.radius) (h1 : d.radius≤1) :
    volume (diskAnnulus d)=ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*d.radius) := by
  have hsub : Metric.ball d.center (1-d.radius)⊆Metric.closedBall d.center (1+d.radius) :=
    Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith))
  have hvol (r : ℝ) (hr : 0≤r) : ENNReal.ofReal r ^ 2 * (NNReal.pi : ℝ≥0∞)=ENNReal.ofReal (r^2*Real.pi) := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg r),ENNReal.ofReal_pow hr]
    congr 1
    rw [←NNReal.coe_real_pi,ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
  rw [diskAnnulus,measure_sdiff hsub Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet.nullMeasurableSet (by finiteness),
    Complex.volume_closedBall,Complex.volume_ball,hvol _ (by linarith),hvol _ (by linarith),
    ←ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ (by positivity : 0≤(1-d.radius)^2*Real.pi)]
  congr 1
  ring

lemma volume_holeAnnuli_le {S : Finset MarkedDisk}
    (hS : ∀d∈S,0≤d.radius ∧ d.radius≤1) :
    volume (holeAnnuli S)≤ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S,d.radius)) := by
  calc
    volume (holeAnnuli S)≤∑d∈S,volume (diskAnnulus d) := measure_biUnion_finset_le S _
    _ = ∑d∈S,ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*d.radius) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      exact volume_diskAnnulus (hS d hd).1 (hS d hd).2
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑d∈S,4*Real.pi*d.radius) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun d hd => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hS d hd).1)]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S,d.radius)) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
lemma unit_from_hole_mem_annuli {S : Finset MarkedDisk} {z q : ℂ}
    (hq : q∈diskHoles S) (hzq : dist z q=1) : z∈holeAnnuli S := by
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hqd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hq
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨d,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hd,unit_from_disk_mem_annulus (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hqd) hzq⟩⟩
lemma holeAnnuli_tendsto_zero (S : ℕ → Finset MarkedDisk)
    (hS : ∀n d,d∈S n → 0≤d.radius)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∑d∈S n,d.radius) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => volume (holeAnnuli (S n))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,(∑d∈S n,d.radius)≤1 :=
    hlim.eventually (eventually_le_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1))
  have hbound : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,volume (holeAnnuli (S n))≤ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S n,d.radius)) := by
    filter_upwards [hsmall] with n hn
    apply volume_holeAnnuli_le
    exact fun d hd => ⟨hS n d hd,(MarkedDisk.radius_le_sum (hS n) hd).trans hn⟩
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal (4*Real.pi*(∑d∈S n,d.radius))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (hlim.const_mul (4*Real.pi))
  apply ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero.mpr
  intro a ha
  filter_upwards [hbound,ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero.mp ht a ha] with n hn hn'
  exact hn.trans hn'
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory ContinuousMap
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Data actually constructed by the small-hole lemma. -/
structure HoleApprox (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (α : ℝ) (L : Finset ℂ) (t : ℝ) where
  ε : ℝ
  ε_pos : 0<ε
  ε_lt : ε<t
  disks : Finset MarkedDisk
  valid : ∀d∈disks,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ)
  disjoint : (disks : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)
  sum_lt : (∑d∈disks,d.radius)<t
  map : C(↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles disks),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)))
  agrees : ∀z : ↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles disks),z.val∉diskHoles disks →
    (map z).val=thresholdMap c ε α z.val
lemma holeApprox_exists {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {α : ℝ}
    (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) (L : Finset ℂ)
    (hL : ∀x∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8,¬(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic → x∈L)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) (ht' : t<1/2) : Nonempty (HoleApprox c α L t) := by
  obtain ⟨e,he,h⟩ := small_hole_map hc hα hα' L hL ht ht'
  let ε := min (e/2) (t/2)
  have hε : 0<ε := lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
  have hεe : ε<e := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
  have hεt : ε<t := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hdis,hsum,g,hg⟩ := h ε hε hεe
  exact ⟨⟨ε,hε,hεt,S,hS,hdis,hsum,g,hg⟩⟩
namespace HoleApprox
lemma cores_near {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ}
    (a : HoleApprox c α L t) : coreHoles a.disks⊆⋃x∈L,Metric.ball x (2*t) := by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hcd,hzd⟩ := mem_coreHoles.mp hz
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hsub⟩ := MarkedDisk.closedBall_near_core (a.valid d hd) hcd
  have hrad := MarkedDisk.radius_le_sum (fun e he => (a.valid e he).1.le) hd
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hx,
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [a.sum_lt]) (hsub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd))⟩⟩
lemma ε_tendsto {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ} {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (a n).ε) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  squeeze_zero (fun n => (a n).ε_pos.le) (fun n => (a n).ε_lt.le) ht
lemma sum_tendsto {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ} {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∑d∈(a n).disks,d.radius) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  squeeze_zero (fun n => Finset.sum_nonneg fun d hd => ((a n).valid d hd).1.le)
    (fun n => (a n).sum_lt.le) ht
lemma annuli_tendsto {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ} {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => volume (holeAnnuli (a n).disks)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  holeAnnuli_tendsto_zero _ (fun n d hd => ((a n).valid d hd).1.le) (sum_tendsto a ht)
end HoleApprox
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~
