Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/GraphPatches.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.GraphCuts
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.HoleApproximation

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u v
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Patch a map across separated bad fibers. Only the intervening values need lie in
 a contractible subspace; the map is kept on one closed set and made constant on the other. -/
theorem contractible_patch {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [NormalSpace X] (D : Set Y) [ContractibleSpace D]
    (f : C(X,Y)) {A B : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B) (hd : Disjoint A B)
    (hg : ∀x,x∉A → x∉B → f x∈D) :
    ∃a : D, ∃g : C(X,Y), EqOn g (fun _ => a.val) A ∧ EqOn g f B ∧
      ∀x,g x=f x ∨ g x∈D := by
  obtain ⟨t,htB,htA,ht⟩ := exists_continuous_zero_one_of_isClosed hB hA hd.symm
  obtain ⟨a,⟨H⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic D
  let S : Fin 3 → Set X := ![{x | t x≤1/3},{x | 1/3≤t x ∧ t x≤2/3},{x | 2/3≤t x}]
  have hS : ∀i,IsClosed (S i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact isClosed_le t.continuous continuous_const
    · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const t.continuous).inter
        (isClosed_le t.continuous continuous_const)
    · exact isClosed_le continuous_const t.continuous
  have hc : ⋃i,S i=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro x
    by_cases h0 : t x≤1/3
    · exact ⟨0,h0⟩
    by_cases h1 : t x≤2/3
    · exact ⟨1,⟨(not_le.mp h0).le,h1⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨2,(not_le.mp h1).le⟩
  have hgood (x : S 1) : f x.val∈D := by
    apply hg
    · intro hx
      have he : t x.val=1 := htA hx
      have hh : t x.val≤2/3 := x.property.2
      linarith
    · intro hx
      have he : t x.val=0 := htB hx
      have hh : 1/3≤t x.val := x.property.1
      linarith
  have hτmem (x : S 1) : 3*t x.val-1∈unitInterval := by
    constructor
    · linarith [x.property.1]
    · linarith [x.property.2]
  let τ : C(S 1,unitInterval) := ⟨fun x => ⟨3*t x.val-1,hτmem x⟩,
    ((continuous_const.mul (t.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val)).sub continuous_const).subtype_mk hτmem⟩
  let φ₁ : C(S 1,Y) := ⟨fun x => (H (τ x,⟨f x.val,hgood x⟩)).val,
    continuous_subtype_val.comp (H.continuous.comp (τ.continuous.prodMk
      ((f.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk hgood)))⟩
  let φ : ∀i,C(S i,Y) := fun i => Fin.cases (f.restrict (S 0))
    (fun j => Fin.cases φ₁ (fun j => ContinuousMap.const (S j.succ.succ) a.val) j) i
  have h01 (x : X) (h0 : x∈S 0) (h1 : x∈S 1) : φ 0 ⟨x,h0⟩=φ 1 ⟨x,h1⟩ := by
    have he : t x=1/3 := le_antisymm h0 h1.1
    have hτ : τ ⟨x,h1⟩=0 := by apply Subtype.ext; change 3*t x-1=0; rw [he]; norm_num
    change f x=(H (τ ⟨x,h1⟩,⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩)).val
    rw [hτ]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (H.map_zero_left ⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩) |>.symm
  have h12 (x : X) (h1 : x∈S 1) (h2 : x∈S 2) : φ 1 ⟨x,h1⟩=φ 2 ⟨x,h2⟩ := by
    have he : t x=2/3 := le_antisymm h1.2 h2
    have hτ : τ ⟨x,h1⟩=1 := by apply Subtype.ext; change 3*t x-1=1; rw [he]; norm_num
    change (H (τ ⟨x,h1⟩,⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩)).val=a.val
    rw [hτ]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (H.map_one_left ⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,h1⟩⟩)
  have hφ : ∀i j x (hi : x∈S i) (hj : x∈S j),φ i ⟨x,hi⟩=φ j ⟨x,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j x hi hj
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · rfl
    · exact h01 x hi hj
    · have h0 : t x≤1/3 := hi; have h2 : 2/3≤t x := hj; linarith
    · exact (h01 x hj hi).symm
    · rfl
    · exact h12 x hi hj
    · have h0 : t x≤1/3 := hj; have h2 : 2/3≤t x := hi; linarith
    · exact (h12 x hj hi).symm
    · rfl
  refine ⟨a,closedCoverMap S hS hc φ hφ,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hx2 : x∈S 2 := by change 2/3≤t x; rw [htA hx]; norm_num
    exact closedCoverMap_apply S hS hc φ hφ ⟨x,hx2⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hx0 : x∈S 0 := by change t x≤1/3; rw [htB hx]; norm_num
    exact closedCoverMap_apply S hS hc φ hφ ⟨x,hx0⟩
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mp hc x
    rw [closedCoverMap_apply S hS hc φ hφ ⟨x,hi⟩]
    fin_cases i
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr (H (τ ⟨x,hi⟩,⟨f x,hgood ⟨x,hi⟩⟩)).property
    · exact Or.inr a.property
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u v
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Edges whose midpoint fibers contain a compact continuum joining the two boundaries. -/
def crossingGraph {X : Type u} {V : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : X → V → ℝ) (A B : Set X) : SimpleGraph V where
  Adj i j := i≠j ∧ FiberCrosses f A B (graphEdgePoint i j (1/2))
  symm := ⟨by
    intro i j h
    refine ⟨h.1.symm,?_⟩
    have he : graphEdgePoint j i (1/2)=graphEdgePoint i j (1/2) := by
      convert graphEdgePoint_swap j i (1/2) using 1; norm_num
    rw [he]; exact h.2⟩
  loopless := ⟨by intro i h; exact h.1 rfl⟩
/-- If the crossing edges form a forest, the boundary map can be patched to a constant
 on the inner closed set, unchanged on the outer closed set. This replaces the graph-word
 and winding detour for the existential interface-cycle producer. -/
theorem graph_forest_patch {X : Type u} {V : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [CompactSpace X] [T2Space X] [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (f : C(X,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V))) {A B : Set X}
    (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B) (hd : Disjoint A B)
    (hforest : (crossingGraph (fun x => (f x).val) A B).IsAcyclic) :
    ∃a : GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V), ∃g : C(X,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)),
      EqOn g (fun _ => a) A ∧ EqOn g f B := by
  let G := crossingGraph (fun x => (f x).val) A B
  obtain ⟨T,hGT,_,hT⟩ := SimpleGraph.connected_top.exists_isTree_le_of_le_of_isAcyclic
    (show G≤⊤ from le_top) hforest
  let f₀ : C(X,V → ℝ) := ⟨fun x => (f x).val,continuous_subtype_val.comp f.continuous⟩
  let S : Finset (V → ℝ) := ((Finset.univ : Finset (V×V)).filter
    (fun a => a.1≠a.2 ∧ ¬T.Adj a.1 a.2)).image (fun a => graphEdgePoint a.1 a.2 (1/2))
  have hn : ∀b∈S,¬FiberCrosses f₀ A B b := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨⟨i,j⟩,hij,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and] at hij
    intro hh
    exact hij.2 (hGT ⟨hij.1,hh⟩)
  obtain ⟨C₀,C₁,hC₀,hC₁,hCd,hAC,hBC,hSC⟩ := finite_fiber_separation f₀ hA hB hd S hn
  let : ContractibleSpace (GraphCutSpace T) := graphCut_contractible hT
  have hg : ∀x,x∉C₀ → x∉C₁ → f₀ x∈graphCutRealization T := by
    intro x hx₀ hx₁
    refine ⟨(f x).property,?_⟩
    intro i j hij hTij he
    have hm : f₀ x∈S := Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(i,j),by simp [hij,hTij],he.symm⟩
    rcases hSC hm with hh|hh
    · exact hx₀ hh
    · exact hx₁ hh
  obtain ⟨a,g,hgA,hgB,hgR⟩ := contractible_patch (graphCutRealization T) f₀ hC₀.isClosed hC₁.isClosed hCd hg
  have hgr (x : X) : g x∈graphRealization (⊤ : SimpleGraph V) := by
    rcases hgR x with hh|hh
    · rw [hh]; exact (f x).property
    · exact hh.1
  let g' : C(X,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) := ⟨fun x => ⟨g x,hgr x⟩,g.continuous.subtype_mk hgr⟩
  refine ⟨⟨a.val,a.property.1⟩,g',?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hgA (hAC hx)
  · intro x hx
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hgB (hBC hx)
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
def planeAnnulus (x : ℂ) (r R : ℝ) : Set ℂ := Metric.closedBall x R \ Metric.ball x r
lemma planeAnnulus_compact (x : ℂ) (r R : ℝ) : IsCompact (planeAnnulus x r R) :=
  (isCompact_closedBall x R).diff Metric.isOpen_ball
lemma mem_planeAnnulus {x z : ℂ} {r R : ℝ} : z∈planeAnnulus x r R ↔ dist z x≤R ∧ r≤dist z x := by
  simp [planeAnnulus,not_lt]
def annulusInner (x : ℂ) (r R : ℝ) : Set (planeAnnulus x r R) := {z | dist z.val x=r}
def annulusOuter (x : ℂ) (r R : ℝ) : Set (planeAnnulus x r R) := {z | dist z.val x=R}
lemma sphere_mem_annulus {x z : ℂ} {r R : ℝ} (hrR : r≤R) (hz : z∈Metric.sphere x R) :
    z∈planeAnnulus x r R := by
  apply mem_planeAnnulus.mpr
  have hz' : dist z x=R := hz
  rw [hz']
  exact ⟨le_rfl,hrR⟩
/-- A forest crossing graph yields an actual extension of the outer boundary over
its disk. This uses compact fiber separation and tree contraction, not graph words. -/
theorem annulus_forest_extension {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    {x : ℂ} {r R : ℝ} (hrR : r<R)
    (f : C(planeAnnulus x r R,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)))
    (hforest : (crossingGraph (fun z => (f z).val) (annulusInner x r R) (annulusOuter x r R)).IsAcyclic) :
    ∃g : C(Metric.closedBall x R,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)),
      ∀z : Metric.sphere x R,g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩=
        f ⟨z.val,sphere_mem_annulus hrR.le z.property⟩ := by
  let : CompactSpace (planeAnnulus x r R) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (planeAnnulus_compact x r R)
  have hA : IsClosed (annulusInner x r R) := isClosed_eq (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const) continuous_const
  have hB : IsClosed (annulusOuter x r R) := isClosed_eq (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const) continuous_const
  have hd : Disjoint (annulusInner x r R) (annulusOuter x r R) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z hz hz'
    exact hrR.ne (hz.symm.trans hz')
  obtain ⟨a,g,hgA,hgB⟩ := graph_forest_patch f hA hB hd hforest
  let X := Metric.closedBall x R
  let Z : Bool → Set X := fun b => if b then {z | r≤dist z.val x} else {z | dist z.val x≤r}
  have hZ : ∀b,IsClosed (Z b) := by
    intro b
    cases b
    · exact isClosed_le (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const) continuous_const
    · exact isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_subtype_val.dist continuous_const)
  have hcov : ⋃b,Z b=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro z
    rcases le_total (dist z.val x) r with hh|hh
    · exact ⟨false,hh⟩
    · exact ⟨true,hh⟩
  let g₁ : C(Z true,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :=
    ⟨fun z => g ⟨z.val.val,mem_planeAnnulus.mpr ⟨z.val.property,z.property⟩⟩,
      g.continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ : ∀b,C(Z b,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) := fun b => Bool.casesOn b (ContinuousMap.const _ a) g₁
  have heq (z : X) (h0 : z∈Z false) (h1 : z∈Z true) : φ false ⟨z,h0⟩=φ true ⟨z,h1⟩ := by
    exact (hgA (show (⟨z.val,mem_planeAnnulus.mpr ⟨z.property,h1⟩⟩ : planeAnnulus x r R)∈annulusInner x r R from
      le_antisymm h0 h1)).symm
  have hφ : ∀i j z (hi : z∈Z i) (hj : z∈Z j),φ i ⟨z,hi⟩=φ j ⟨z,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j z hi hj
    cases i <;> cases j
    · rfl
    · exact heq z hi hj
    · exact (heq z hj hi).symm
    · rfl
  refine ⟨closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ,fun z => ?_⟩
  have hz : (⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩ : X)∈Z true := by
    change r≤dist z.val x
    rw [show dist z.val x=R from z.property]
    exact hrR.le
  rw [closedCoverMap_apply Z hZ hcov φ hφ (i:=true) ⟨⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩,hz⟩]
  exact hgB z.property
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma finite_centers_separation (L : Finset ℂ) : ∃s>0,∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → s<dist x y := by
  let P := {p : L×L // p.1≠p.2}
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsp⟩ := finite_pos_lt (fun p : P => dist p.val.1.val p.val.2.val)
    (fun p => dist_pos.mpr (fun he => p.property (Subtype.ext he)))
  refine ⟨s,hs,fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_⟩
  exact hsp ⟨(⟨x,hx⟩,⟨y,hy⟩),fun h => hxy (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
def centerDisks (L : Finset ℂ) (R : ℝ) : Finset MarkedDisk := L.image fun x => ⟨x,R,false⟩
lemma mem_centerDisks {L : Finset ℂ} {R : ℝ} {d : MarkedDisk} :
    d∈centerDisks L R ↔ ∃x∈L,d=⟨x,R,false⟩ := by simp [centerDisks,eq_comm]
lemma centerDisks_sum (L : Finset ℂ) (R : ℝ) : (∑d∈centerDisks L R,d.radius)=(L.card:ℝ)*R := by
  rw [centerDisks,Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ h => congrArg MarkedDisk.center h)]
  simp
lemma centerDisks_disjoint {L : Finset ℂ} {R : ℝ}
    (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y) :
    (centerDisks L R : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) := by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp ha
  obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp hb
  have hxy : x≠y := by intro he; subst y; exact hab rfl
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hz hz'
  have h1 : dist x z≤R := by simpa only [MarkedDisk.closedBall,Metric.mem_closedBall,dist_comm] using hz
  have h2 : dist z y≤R := hz'
  have hh := dist_triangle x z y
  have hh' := hsep x hx y hy hxy
  linarith
lemma mem_center_holes {L : Finset ℂ} {R : ℝ} {z : ℂ} :
    z∈diskHoles (centerDisks L R) ↔ ∃x∈L,dist z x<R := by
  rw [mem_diskHoles]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩
    obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp hd
    exact ⟨x,hx,hzd⟩
  · rintro ⟨x,hx,hzx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x,R,false⟩,mem_centerDisks.mpr ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩,hzx⟩
def activeCenters (L : Finset ℂ) : Finset ℂ := L.filter (fun x => dist x 0≤6)
namespace HoleApprox
lemma annulus_in_domain {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t R : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ}
    (a : HoleApprox c α L t) (hR : R<1) (htR : 2*t<R)
    (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y) {x : ℂ} (hx : x∈activeCenters L) :
    planeAnnulus x (2*t) R⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles a.disks := by
  have hx' := Finset.mem_filter.mp hx
  intro z hz
  have hz' := mem_planeAnnulus.mp hz
  constructor
  · change dist z 0≤7
    exact (dist_triangle z x 0).trans (by linarith [hx'.2])
  · intro hh
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp (a.cores_near hh)
    obtain ⟨hyL,hzy⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
    change dist z y<2*t at hzy
    by_cases he : x=y
    · subst y; linarith [hz'.2]
    · have hh' := hsep x hx'.1 y hyL he
      have htri := dist_triangle x z y
      rw [dist_comm x z] at htri
      linarith [hz'.1]
lemma outside_centers_in_domain {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t R : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ}
    (a : HoleApprox c α L t) (htR : 2*t<R) (ht1 : 2*t<1) :
    Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 \ diskHoles (centerDisks (activeCenters L) R)⊆
      Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 7 \ coreHoles a.disks := by
  intro z hz
  refine ⟨Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by norm_num) hz.1,?_⟩
  intro hh
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp (a.cores_near hh)
  obtain ⟨hyL,hzy⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hy
  change dist z y<2*t at hzy
  have hy0 : dist y 0≤6 := calc
    dist y 0≤dist y z+dist z 0 := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ 6 := by rw [dist_comm y z]; have hz0 : dist z 0≤5 := hz.1; linarith
  exact hz.2 (mem_center_holes.mpr ⟨y,Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hyL,hy0⟩,hzy.trans htR⟩)
end HoleApprox
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.ContinuumLimits

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology TopologicalSpace MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Compactness and the angular theorems force all sufficiently fine crossing graphs
to be forests. This is about actual compact bridges, not assumed interface data. -/
theorem eventually_forest_of_bridges {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
    (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0<ρ)
    (D : ℕ → SimpleGraph (Fin 5)) {r ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0)) (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀n,0<ε n)
    {H E : ℕ → Set ℂ} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => volume (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hnear : ∀n z q,q∈H n → dist z q=1 → z∈E n)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α)
    (hbridge : ∀n i j,(D n).Adj i j → ∃K : NonemptyCompacts ℂ,
      (K : Set ℂ)⊆Metric.closedBall x ρ ∧ IsPreconnected (K : Set ℂ) ∧
      (∃a∈K,dist a x≤r n) ∧ ((K : Set ℂ)∩Metric.sphere x ρ).Nonempty ∧
      (∀q∈K,q∉H n → α<diskAverage c (ε n) i q) ∧
      (∀q∈K,q∉H n → α<diskAverage c (ε n) j q)) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop,(D n).IsAcyclic := by
  have he : ∀i j : Fin 5,∀ᶠ n in atTop,(D n).Adj i j → CommonInterface c x i j := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hcommon : CommonInterface c x i j
    · exact Eventually.of_forall fun _ _ => hcommon
    · have hn : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,¬(D n).Adj i j := by
        by_contra hnot
        have hfreq : ∃ᶠ n in atTop,(D n).Adj i j := hnot
        obtain ⟨φ,hφ,hφD⟩ := subseq_forall_of_frequently (x:=fun n : ℕ => n) (p:=fun n => (D n).Adj i j) tendsto_id hfreq
        choose K hK hconn ha hout hi hj using fun n => hbridge (φ n) i j (hφD n)
        choose a haK har using ha
        have halim : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 x) := by
          rw [tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
          exact squeeze_zero (fun _ => dist_nonneg) har (hr.comp hφ)
        exact hcommon (commonInterface_of_compact_sequence hc hw hρ K hK hconn a haK halim hout
          (hε.comp hφ) (fun n => hpos (φ n)) (hE.comp hφ) (fun n => hnear (φ n)) hα i j hi hj)
      exact hn.mono fun _ hn hd => False.elim (hn hd)
  have hall : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,∀i j : Fin 5,(D n).Adj i j → CommonInterface c x i j :=
    eventually_all.mpr fun i => eventually_all.mpr (he i)
  filter_upwards [hall] with n hn
  exact commonInterface_graph_acyclic hc hw x (D n) hn
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology TopologicalSpace MeasureTheory ContinuousMap
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma midpoint_threshold_labels {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {ε α : ℝ}
    (hε : 0<ε) (hα : α<1/5) {q : ℂ} {i j : Fin 5} (hij : i≠j)
    (he : thresholdMap c ε α q=graphEdgePoint i j (1/2)) :
    α<diskAverage c ε i q ∧ α<diskAverage c ε j q := by
  constructor
  · apply (thresholdMap_pos hc hε hα q i).mp
    rw [he]
    norm_num [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hij,hij.symm]
  · apply (thresholdMap_pos hc hε hα q j).mp
    rw [he]
    norm_num [graphEdgePoint,graphVertex,hij,hij.symm]
/-- The actual continuous annulus maps eventually permit disk extensions. -/
theorem annulus_maps_eventually_forest {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
    (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {x : ℂ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0<R) {r ε : ℕ → ℝ}
    (hr : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0)) (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) (hpos : ∀n,0<ε n)
    {H E : ℕ → Set ℂ} (hE : Tendsto (fun n => volume (E n)) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hnear : ∀n z q,q∈H n → dist z q=1 → z∈E n)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5)
    (f : ∀n,C(planeAnnulus x (r n) R,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))))
    (hf : ∀n z,z.val∉H n → (f n z).val=thresholdMap c (ε n) α z.val) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop,(crossingGraph (fun z => (f n z).val)
      (annulusInner x (r n) R) (annulusOuter x (r n) R)).IsAcyclic := by
  apply eventually_forest_of_bridges hc hw hR _ hr hε hpos hE hnear hα
  intro n i j hij
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hconn,hval,hin,hout⟩ := hij.2
  let L : NonemptyCompacts ℂ := ⟨⟨Subtype.val '' K,hK.image continuous_subtype_val⟩,
    hconn.nonempty.image _⟩
  have hsub : (L : Set ℂ)⊆Metric.closedBall x R := by
    rintro q ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩
    exact z.property.1
  have hpre : IsPreconnected (L : Set ℂ) :=
    hconn.isPreconnected.image _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn
  have hanc : ∃a∈L,dist a x≤r n := by
    obtain ⟨a,ha,har⟩ := hin
    exact ⟨a.val,⟨a,ha,rfl⟩,har.le⟩
  have hout' : ((L : Set ℂ)∩Metric.sphere x R).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨a,ha,haR⟩ := hout
    exact ⟨a.val,⟨a,ha,rfl⟩,haR⟩
  refine ⟨L,hsub,hpre,hanc,hout',?_,?_⟩
  · rintro q ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩ hzH
    have he : thresholdMap c (ε n) α z.val=graphEdgePoint i j (1/2) := (hf n z hzH).symm.trans (hval hz)
    exact (midpoint_threshold_labels hc (hpos n) hα' hij.1 he).1
  · rintro q ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩ hzH
    have he : thresholdMap c (ε n) α z.val=graphEdgePoint i j (1/2) := (hf n z hzH).symm.trans (hval hz)
    exact (midpoint_threshold_labels hc (hpos n) hα' hij.1 he).2
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
universe u
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Actual finite disk pasting from a closed outside domain. Disks may cross the
boundary of the ambient compact region. -/
theorem finite_disk_paste {Y : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Y] (Q : Set ℂ)
    (S : Finset MarkedDisk)
    (hdis : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall))
    (f : C(↥(Q \ diskHoles S),Y))
    (g : ∀d : S,C(d.val.closedBall,Y))
    (hb : ∀d : S,∀z : Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius,∀hzQ : z.val∈Q,
      ∀hzS : z.val∉diskHoles S,
      g d ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩=f ⟨z.val,hzQ,hzS⟩) :
    ∃F : C(Q,Y),∀z : Q,∀hz : z.val∉diskHoles S,F z=f ⟨z.val,z.property,hz⟩ := by
  let Z : Option S → Set Q := fun i => match i with
    | none => {z | z.val∉diskHoles S}
    | some d => {z | z.val∈d.val.closedBall}
  have hZ : ∀i,IsClosed (Z i) := by
    intro i
    cases i with
    | none => exact (diskHoles_open S).isClosed_compl.preimage continuous_subtype_val
    | some d => exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall.preimage continuous_subtype_val
  have hcov : ⋃i,Z i=univ := by
    apply iUnion_eq_univ_iff.mpr
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z.val∈diskHoles S
    · obtain ⟨d,hd,hzd⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp hz
      exact ⟨some ⟨d,hd⟩,Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzd⟩
    · exact ⟨none,hz⟩
  let φ₀ : C(Z none,Y) := ⟨fun z => f ⟨z.val.val,z.val.property,z.property⟩,
    f.continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ₁ (d : S) : C(Z (some d),Y) := ⟨fun z => g d ⟨z.val.val,z.property⟩,
    (g d).continuous.comp ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _)⟩
  let φ : ∀i,C(Z i,Y) := fun i => match i with | none => φ₀ | some d => φ₁ d
  have hbd (d : S) (z : Q) (h0 : z∈Z none) (h1 : z∈Z (some d)) :
      φ none ⟨z,h0⟩=φ (some d) ⟨z,h1⟩ := by
    have hn : z.val∉d.val.ball := fun hz => h0 (mem_diskHoles.mpr ⟨d.val,d.property,hz⟩)
    have hs : z.val∈Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius :=
      le_antisymm h1 (le_of_not_gt hn)
    exact (hb d ⟨z.val,hs⟩ z.property h0).symm
  have hφ : ∀i j z (hi : z∈Z i) (hj : z∈Z j),φ i ⟨z,hi⟩=φ j ⟨z,hj⟩ := by
    intro i j z hi hj
    cases i with
    | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => rfl
      | some d => exact hbd d z hi hj
    | some d =>
      cases j with
      | none => exact (hbd d z hj hi).symm
      | some e =>
        by_cases hde : d=e
        · subst e; rfl
        · exact False.elim (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdis d.property e.property
            (fun he => hde (Subtype.ext he))) hi hj)
  refine ⟨closedCoverMap Z hZ hcov φ hφ,fun z hz => ?_⟩
  exact closedCoverMap_apply Z hZ hcov φ hφ (i:=none) ⟨z,hz⟩
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory ContinuousMap
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
namespace HoleApprox
def annulusMap {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t R : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ}
    (a : HoleApprox c α L t) (hR : R<1) (htR : 2*t<R)
    (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y) {x : ℂ} (hx : x∈activeCenters L) :
    C(planeAnnulus x (2*t) R,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))) :=
  ⟨fun z => a.map ⟨z.val,a.annulus_in_domain hR htR hsep hx z.property⟩,
    a.map.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _)⟩
/-- Fill all the actual core holes simultaneously when their surrounding crossing
graphs are forests, retaining the threshold map outside the original and outer disks. -/
theorem fill_cores {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α t R : ℝ} {L : Finset ℂ}
    (a : HoleApprox c α L t) (hR : R<1) (htR : 2*t<R)
    (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y)
    (hforest : ∀x (hx : x∈activeCenters L),
      (crossingGraph (fun z => (a.annulusMap hR htR hsep hx z).val)
        (annulusInner x (2*t) R) (annulusOuter x (2*t) R)).IsAcyclic) :
    ∃F : C(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))),
      ∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∉diskHoles a.disks →
        z.val∉diskHoles (centerDisks (activeCenters L) R) →
        (F z).val=thresholdMap c a.ε α z.val := by
  let D := centerDisks (activeCenters L) R
  have hdis : (D : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall) :=
    centerDisks_disjoint fun x hx y hy hxy => hsep x (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).1 y (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).1 hxy
  let f : C(↥(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 \ diskHoles D),GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))) :=
    ⟨fun z => a.map ⟨z.val,a.outside_centers_in_domain htR (htR.trans hR) z.property⟩,
      a.map.continuous.comp (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _)⟩
  have hex (d : D) : ∃g : C(d.val.closedBall,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))),
      ∀z : Metric.sphere d.val.center d.val.radius,∀hzQ : z.val∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,
        ∀hzD : z.val∉diskHoles D,
        g ⟨z.val,Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall z.property⟩=f ⟨z.val,hzQ,hzD⟩ := by
    obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := d
    obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp hd
    obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := annulus_forest_extension htR (a.annulusMap hR htR hsep hx) (hforest x hx)
    exact ⟨g,fun z _ _ => hg z⟩
  choose g hg using hex
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := finite_disk_paste (Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5) D hdis f g hg
  refine ⟨F,fun z hzS hzD => ?_⟩
  rw [hF z hzD]
  exact a.agrees _ hzS
/-- The common-exclusion limit contradiction applies to the constructed maps, so
all these actual core fillings exist eventually at any fixed separated outer scale. -/
theorem eventually_fill_cores {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {α R : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) {L : Finset ℂ} {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hR0 : 0<R) (hR : R<1) (htR : ∀n,2*t n<R)
    (hsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop,∃F : C(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))),
      ∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∉diskHoles (a n).disks →
        z.val∉diskHoles (centerDisks (activeCenters L) R) →
        (F z).val=thresholdMap c (a n).ε α z.val := by
  have hrad : Tendsto (fun n => 2*t n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by simpa using ht.const_mul 2
  have h (x : activeCenters L) : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      (crossingGraph (fun z => ((a n).annulusMap hR (htR n) hsep x.property z).val)
        (annulusInner x.val (2*t n) R) (annulusOuter x.val (2*t n) R)).IsAcyclic := by
    apply annulus_maps_eventually_forest hc hw hR0 hrad (ε_tendsto a ht)
      (fun n => (a n).ε_pos) (annuli_tendsto a ht)
      (fun _ _ _ => unit_from_hole_mem_annuli) hα hα'
      (fun n => (a n).annulusMap hR (htR n) hsep x.property)
    intro n z hz
    exact (a n).agrees _ hz
  have hall := eventually_all.mpr h
  filter_upwards [hall] with n hn
  exact (a n).fill_cores hR (htR n) hsep (fun x hx => hn ⟨x,hx⟩)
end HoleApprox
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

lemma diskHoles_union (S T : Finset MarkedDisk) : diskHoles (S∪T)=diskHoles S∪diskHoles T := by
  ext z
  simp only [mem_diskHoles,Finset.mem_union,mem_union]
  aesop
lemma disk_radius_sum_union_le (S T : Finset MarkedDisk) (h : ∀d∈S∪T,0≤d.radius) :
    (∑d∈S∪T,d.radius)≤(∑d∈S,d.radius)+(∑d∈T,d.radius) := by
  have hs : (∑d∈S∪T,d.radius)+(∑d∈S∩T,d.radius)=(∑d∈S,d.radius)+(∑d∈T,d.radius) := Finset.sum_union_inter
  have h0 : 0≤∑d∈S∩T,d.radius := Finset.sum_nonneg fun d hd =>
    h d (Finset.mem_union_left T (Finset.mem_inter.mp hd).1)
  linarith
end EuclideanFiveColor

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory ContinuousMap
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- A global graph approximation, with actual small exceptional disks.
All fields will be constructed, not postulated as coloring hypotheses. -/
structure FullApprox (c : ℂ → Fin 5) (α t : ℝ) where
  ε : ℝ
  ε_pos : 0<ε
  ε_lt : ε<t
  disks : Finset MarkedDisk
  positive : ∀d∈disks,0<d.radius
  disjoint : (disks : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall)
  sum_lt : (∑d∈disks,d.radius)<t
  map : C(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)))
  agrees : ∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∉diskHoles disks →
    (map z).val=thresholdMap c ε α z.val
/-- The whole producer, using actual annular crossing fibers and all angular
contradictions: global graph approximants exist at arbitrarily small exception scales. -/
theorem fullApprox_exists_of_finite_core {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
    (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5)
    (L : Finset ℂ) (hL : ∀x∈Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 8,¬(transitionGraph c x).IsAcyclic → x∈L)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) : Nonempty (FullApprox c α t) := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsep⟩ := finite_centers_separation L
  let A := activeCenters L
  let R := min (s/4) (min (1/2) (t/(4*((A.card:ℝ)+1))))
  have hR0 : 0<R := lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos ht (by positivity)))
  have hRs : R ≤ s/4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hRhalf : R≤1/2 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hRt : R≤t/(4*((A.card:ℝ)+1)) := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hR1 : R<1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hRhalf (by norm_num)
  have hRsep : ∀x∈L,∀y∈L,x≠y → 2*R<dist x y := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hh := hsep x hx y hy hxy
    linarith
  have hRbudget : (A.card:ℝ)*R<t/4 := by
    have hh := (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<4*((A.card:ℝ)+1))).mp hRt
    nlinarith
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => min (R/4) (min (t/4) (1/((n:ℝ)+1)))
  have hu : ∀n,0<u n := fun n => lt_min (by positivity) (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))
  have huR : ∀n,2*u n<R := by
    intro n
    have hh : u n≤R/4 := min_le_left _ _
    linarith
  have hut : ∀n,u n<t := by
    intro n
    have hh : u n≤t/4 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith
  have hult : ∀n,u n<1/2 := by
    intro n
    have hh := huR n
    linarith
  have hulim : Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun n => (hu n).le) (fun n => (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  let a : ∀n,HoleApprox c α L (u n) := fun n => Classical.choice (holeApprox_exists hc hα hα' L hL (hu n) (hult n))
  obtain ⟨n,F,hF⟩ := ((HoleApprox.eventually_fill_cores hc hw hα hα' a hulim hR0 hR1 huR hRsep).exists)
  let D := centerDisks A R
  have hD : ∀d∈D,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ) := by
    intro d hd
    obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := mem_centerDisks.mp hd
    exact ⟨hR0,by simp⟩
  have hU : ∀d∈(a n).disks∪D,d.Valid (L : Set ℂ) := by
    intro d hd
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hd with hh|hh
    · exact (a n).valid d hh
    · exact hD d hh
  obtain ⟨S,hS,hdis,hcov,hsum,_⟩ := MarkedDisk.separate ((a n).disks∪D) hU (show 0<t/4 by positivity)
  have htS : (∑d∈S,d.radius)<t := by
    have hh := disk_radius_sum_union_le (a n).disks D (fun d hd => (hU d hd).1.le)
    have hDbudget : (∑d∈D,d.radius)<t/4 := by rw [centerDisks_sum]; exact hRbudget
    have hun : u n≤t/4 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith [(a n).sum_lt]
  refine ⟨⟨(a n).ε,(a n).ε_pos,(a n).ε_lt.trans (hut n),S,
    fun d hd => (hS d hd).1,hdis,htS,F,?_⟩⟩
  intro z hz
  have hn : z.val∉diskHoles ((a n).disks∪D) := fun hh => hz ((MarkedDisk.holes_subset_of_cover hcov).1 hh)
  rw [diskHoles_union] at hn
  exact hF z (fun hh => hn (Or.inl hh)) (fun hh => hn (Or.inr hh))
/-- The finite core used above is obtained from the proved actual transition core
local-finiteness theorem; no regularity of the original coloring is added. -/
theorem fullApprox_exists {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c)
    (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0<t) :
    Nonempty (FullApprox c α t) := by
  let hfin := cyclicCore_compact_finite c hc hw (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 8)
  exact fullApprox_exists_of_finite_core hc hw hα hα' hfin.toFinset
    (fun x hx hcyc => hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨hx,hcyc⟩) ht
end EuclideanFiveColor
end
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Mesh.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Mesh.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.FullApproximation

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- A point of a connected set with a distant partner can be moved to the
boundary of its (unique) small hole. Pairwise disjoint closed disks make the
new point lie outside every open hole. No path regularity is required. -/
lemma connected_escape_holes {S : Finset MarkedDisk} {t : ℝ}
    (hS : ∀d∈S,0≤d.radius)
    (hdis : (S : Set MarkedDisk).Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint a.closedBall b.closedBall))
    (hsum : (∑d∈S,d.radius)<t) {K : Set ℂ} (hK : IsPreconnected K)
    {a b : ℂ} (ha : a∈K) (hb : b∈K) (hab : 2*t<dist a b) :
    ∃a'∈K,a'∉diskHoles S ∧ dist a a'≤2*t := by
  have ht : 0<t := (Finset.sum_nonneg hS).trans_lt hsum
  by_cases haS : a∈diskHoles S
  · obtain ⟨d,hd,had⟩ := mem_diskHoles.mp haS
    have hrad : d.radius<t := (MarkedDisk.radius_le_sum hS hd).trans_lt hsum
    have had' : dist a d.center<d.radius := had
    have hbd : d.radius<dist b d.center := by
      by_contra! hh
      have htri := dist_triangle a d.center b
      rw [dist_comm d.center b] at htri
      linarith
    obtain ⟨p,hp,hpd⟩ := hK.intermediate_value ha hb
      (continuous_id.dist continuous_const).continuousOn ⟨had'.le,hbd.le⟩
    refine ⟨p,hp,MarkedDisk.sphere_avoids_holes hdis hd hpd,?_⟩
    change dist p d.center=d.radius at hpd
    have htri := dist_triangle a d.center p
    rw [dist_comm d.center p,hpd] at htri
    linarith
  · exact ⟨a,ha,haS,by simpa using (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) ht).le⟩

/-- Positive averages on shrinking disks force every limit center into the
actual measure support of that color. -/
lemma support_of_positive_diskAverage_limit {k : ℕ} {c : ℂ → Fin k} (hc : Measurable c)
    {ε : ℕ → ℝ} (hε : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0)) {a : ℕ → ℂ} {x : ℂ}
    (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 x)) (i : Fin k)
    (hp : ∀n,0<diskAverage c (ε n) i (a n)) : x∈spatialSupport c i := by
  apply (Measure.mem_support_iff_forall x).mpr
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hrU⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,dist (a n) x<r/2 := ha.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (by positivity))
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,ε n<r/2 := hε.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<r/2))
  obtain ⟨n,han,hεn⟩ := (hnear.and hsmall).exists
  have hsub : Metric.ball (a n) (ε n)⊆U := by
    intro z hz
    apply hrU
    have hh : dist z (a n)<ε n := hz
    have htri := dist_triangle z (a n) x
    change dist z x<r
    linarith
  have hpos := hp n
  rw [diskAverage_area hc] at hpos
  apply pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  intro hzero
  have hzero' : volume (U∩{z | c z=i})=0 := by
    simpa only [spatialSupport,Measure.restrict_apply' (measurableSet_eq_fun hc measurable_const)] using hzero
  have hball : volume (Metric.ball (a n) (ε n)∩{z | c z=i})=0 :=
    measure_mono_null (inter_subset_inter_left _ hsub) hzero'
  simp only [Measure.real,hball,ENNReal.toReal_zero,zero_div,lt_self_iff_false] at hpos
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory ContinuousMap
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
namespace FullApprox
lemma ε_tendsto {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α : ℝ} {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (a : ∀n,FullApprox c α (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (a n).ε) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
  squeeze_zero (fun n => (a n).ε_pos.le) (fun n => (a n).ε_lt.le) ht
lemma annuli_tendsto {c : ℂ → Fin 5} {α : ℝ} {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (a : ∀n,FullApprox c α (t n)) (ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n => volume (holeAnnuli (a n).disks)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  apply holeAnnuli_tendsto_zero _ (fun n d hd => ((a n).positive d hd).le)
  exact squeeze_zero (fun n => Finset.sum_nonneg fun d hd => ((a n).positive d hd).le)
    (fun n => (a n).sum_lt.le) ht
lemma positive_average {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) {α t : ℝ} (hα : α<1/5)
    (a : FullApprox c α t) (i : Fin 5) (q : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5)
    (hq : q.val∉diskHoles a.disks) (hp : 0<(a.map q).val i) : α<diskAverage c a.ε i q.val := by
  rw [a.agrees q hq] at hp
  exact (thresholdMap_pos hc a.ε_pos hα q.val i).mp hp

/-- A continuous graph approximant cannot have positive-coordinate connected
sets of macroscopic diameter at every shrinking scale. This is the manuscript
mesh argument, with connectedness replacing the stronger path assumption. -/
theorem no_large_positive_sequence {c : ℂ → Fin 5} (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c)
    {α : ℝ} (hα : 0<α) (hα' : α<1/5) {t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (F : ∀n,FullApprox c α (t n)) (htlim : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0))
    (htsmall : ∀n,t n≤1/16) (i : Fin 5)
    (hbad : ∀n,∃K : Set ℂ, IsPreconnected K ∧ K⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 ∧
      (∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∈K → 0<((F n).map z).val i) ∧
      ∃x∈K,∃y∈K,2<dist x y) : False := by
  choose K hK hsub hprob x hx y hy hxy using hbad
  have hxy' (n : ℕ) : 2*t n<dist (x n) (y n) := by linarith [htsmall n,hxy n]
  have hyx' (n : ℕ) : 2*t n<dist (y n) (x n) := by rw [dist_comm]; exact hxy' n
  choose a haK haH hax using fun n => connected_escape_holes
    (fun d hd => ((F n).positive d hd).le) (F n).disjoint (F n).sum_lt (hK n) (hx n) (hy n) (hxy' n)
  choose b hbK hbH hby using fun n => connected_escape_holes
    (fun d hd => ((F n).positive d hd).le) (F n).disjoint (F n).sum_lt (hK n) (hy n) (hx n) (hyx' n)
  have hab (n : ℕ) : 3/2≤dist (a n) (b n) := by
    have h1 := dist_triangle (x n) (a n) (y n)
    have h2 := dist_triangle (a n) (b n) (y n)
    rw [dist_comm (b n) (y n)] at h2
    linarith [hxy n,hax n,hby n,htsmall n]
  obtain ⟨p,hp,φ,hφ,hlim⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5).prod
    (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5)).tendsto_subseq (x := fun n => (a n,b n)) (fun n => ⟨hsub n (haK n),hsub n (hbK n)⟩)
  have halim : Tendsto (fun n => a (φ n)) atTop (𝓝 p.1) := (continuous_fst.tendsto p).comp hlim
  have hblim : Tendsto (fun n => b (φ n)) atTop (𝓝 p.2) := (continuous_snd.tendsto p).comp hlim
  have hpdist : 3/2≤dist p.1 p.2 := ge_of_tendsto (halim.dist hblim) (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => hab (φ n)))
  have hεlim := (ε_tendsto F htlim).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hE := (annuli_tendsto F htlim).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hasup : p.1∈spatialSupport c i := support_of_positive_diskAverage_limit hc hεlim halim i
    (fun n => hα.trans (positive_average hc hα' (F (φ n)) i ⟨a (φ n),hsub _ (haK _)⟩
      (haH _) (hprob _ _ (haK _))))
  have hexc : Disjoint (spatialSupport c i) (Metric.ball p.1 (1/8)) := by
    apply diskAverage_support_exclusion hc hεlim (fun n => (F (φ n)).ε_pos) hE hα Metric.isOpen_ball i
    intro z hz
    have hane : ∀ᶠn in atTop,dist (a (φ n)) p.1<1/8 :=
      halim.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num))
    have hbne : ∀ᶠn in atTop,dist (b (φ n)) p.2<1/8 :=
      hblim.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num))
    filter_upwards [hane,hbne] with n han hbn hzE
    have hza : dist z (a (φ n))<1 := by
      have hh := dist_triangle z p.1 (a (φ n))
      rw [dist_comm p.1 (a (φ n))] at hh
      change dist z p.1<1/8 at hz
      linarith
    have hzb : 1<dist z (b (φ n)) := by
      have h1 := dist_triangle p.1 z p.2
      have h2 := dist_triangle z (b (φ n)) p.2
      rw [dist_comm p.1 z] at h1
      change dist z p.1<1/8 at hz
      linarith
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hunit⟩ := straddle_connected_unit (hK (φ n))
      ⟨a (φ n),haK _,b (φ n),hbK _,hza,hzb⟩
    have hqH : q∉diskHoles (F (φ n)).disks := fun hh => hzE (unit_from_hole_mem_annuli hh hunit)
    have hqprob := positive_average hc hα' (F (φ n)) i ⟨q,hsub _ hq⟩ hqH (hprob _ _ hq)
    have hu : ‖q-z‖=1 := by simpa only [dist_eq_norm,norm_sub_rev] using hunit
    have hh := diskAverage_unit_pair hc hw (F (φ n)).ε_pos hu i
    change diskAverage c (F (φ n)).ε i z≤1-α
    change α<diskAverage c (F (φ n)).ε i q at hqprob
    linarith
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hexc hasup (Metric.mem_ball_self (by norm_num))
end FullApprox
end EuclideanFiveColor
end
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Five.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Five.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.BorelTransfer
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Mesh

namespace OAI

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Topology ContinuousMap
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
lemma graphRealization_positive_three {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {p : V → ℝ}
    (hp : p∈graphRealization G) {i j k : V} (hi : 0<p i) (hj : 0<p j) (hk : 0<p k) :
    i=j ∨ i=k ∨ j=k := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,_,t,_,rfl⟩ := hp
  have hpos (v : V) (hv : 0<graphEdgePoint a b t v) : v=a ∨ v=b := by
    by_contra! hh
    simp [graphEdgePoint_apply,hh.1,hh.2] at hv
  rcases hpos i hi with rfl|rfl <;> rcases hpos j hj with rfl|rfl <;>
    rcases hpos k hk with rfl|rfl <;> simp

/-- The actual positive-coordinate component cover contradicts the planar cover
obstruction whenever every connected positive region has diameter at most two. -/
theorem graph_map_small_mesh_impossible
    (F : C(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5))))
    (hmesh : ∀(i : Fin 5) (K : Set ℂ),IsPreconnected K → K⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 →
      (∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∈K → 0<(F z).val i) →
      ∀x∈K,∀y∈K,dist x y≤2) : False := by
  let Q := Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5
  have : LocallyPathConnectedSpace Q := (convex_closedBall (0:ℂ) (5:ℝ)).locallyPathConnectedSpace
  let U : Fin 5 → Set Q := fun i => {z | 0<(F z).val i}
  have hU (i : Fin 5) : IsOpen (U i) :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const ((continuous_apply i).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp F.continuous))
  let I := {p : Fin 5 × Set Q // ∃x : Q,p.2=connectedComponentIn (U p.1) x}
  let W : I → Set Q := fun p => p.val.2
  have hW (p : I) : IsOpen (W p) := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := p.property
    change IsOpen p.val.2
    rw [hx]
    exact (hU _).connectedComponentIn
  have hpos {p : I} {z : Q} (hz : z∈W p) : 0<(F z).val p.val.1 := by
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := p.property
    change z∈p.val.2 at hz
    rw [hx] at hz
    exact connectedComponentIn_subset (U p.val.1) x hz
  have heq {p q : I} {z : Q} (hpq : p.val.1=q.val.1) (hp : z∈W p) (hq : z∈W q) : p=q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext hpq
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := p.property
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := q.property
    change z∈p.val.2 at hp
    change z∈q.val.2 at hq
    rw [hx,hpq] at hp
    rw [hy] at hq
    rw [hx,hy,hpq,connectedComponentIn_eq hp,connectedComponentIn_eq hq]
  apply PlanarCover.compact_open_cover_impossible Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    (isCompact_closedBall (0:ℂ) 5) W hW ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro z
    have he : ∃i,0<(F z).val i := by
      by_contra! hh
      have hsum := Finset.sum_nonpos (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 5))) (fun i _ => hh i)
      rw [graphRealization_sum (F z).property] at hsum
      norm_num at hsum
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := he
    exact ⟨⟨(i,connectedComponentIn (U i) z),⟨z,rfl⟩⟩,mem_connectedComponentIn hi⟩
  · intro z p q r hp hq hr
    rcases graphRealization_positive_three (F z).property (hpos hp) (hpos hq) (hpos hr) with h|h|h
    · exact Or.inl (heq h hp hq)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (heq h hp hr))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (heq h hq hr))
  · intro p x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := p.property
    let K : Set ℂ := Subtype.val '' W p
    have hK : IsPreconnected K := by
      apply IsPreconnected.image _ _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn
      change IsPreconnected p.val.2
      rw [hz]
      exact isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
    have hsub : K⊆Q := by rintro a ⟨b,_,rfl⟩; exact b.property
    have hprob : ∀z : Q,z.val∈K → 0<(F z).val p.val.1 := by
      rintro z ⟨b,hb,he⟩
      have hh : b=z := Subtype.ext he
      subst b
      exact hpos hb
    have hh := hmesh p.val.1 K hK hsub hprob x.val ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ y.val ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hh
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

noncomputable section
open scoped Classical
open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
namespace EuclideanFiveColor
/-- Every continuous graph-valued map of the disk has a positive-coordinate
connected region of diameter greater than two. -/
lemma graph_map_large_positive
    (F : C(Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,GraphSpace (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 5)))) :
    ∃i : Fin 5,∃K : Set ℂ,IsPreconnected K ∧ K⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 ∧
      (∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∈K → 0<(F z).val i) ∧
      ∃x∈K,∃y∈K,2<dist x y := by
  by_contra! h
  exact graph_map_small_mesh_impossible F h

/-- No Borel weak five-coloring exists. The global approximants here are
constructed from the actual coloring, its transition graph, and its common
interface limits, rather than supplied as an extra coloring hypothesis. -/
theorem no_measurable_weak_five_coloring {c : ℂ → Fin 5}
    (hc : Measurable c) (hw : WeakColoring 5 c) : False := by
  let t : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => min (1/16) (1/((n:ℝ)+1))
  have hpos (n : ℕ) : 0<t n := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hsmall (n : ℕ) : t n≤1/16 := min_le_left _ _
  have ht : Tendsto t atTop (𝓝 0) := squeeze_zero (fun n => (hpos n).le)
    (fun n => min_le_right _ _) tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  let F : ∀n,FullApprox c (1/10) (t n) := fun n =>
    Classical.choice (fullApprox_exists hc hw (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (hpos n))
  have hbad : ∃ᶠn in atTop,∃i : Fin 5,∃K : Set ℂ,IsPreconnected K ∧ K⊆Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5 ∧
      (∀z : Metric.closedBall (0:ℂ) 5,z.val∈K → 0<((F n).map z).val i) ∧
      ∃x∈K,∃y∈K,2<dist x y :=
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => graph_map_large_positive (F n).map)).frequently
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Filter.frequently_exists.mp hbad
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ,hφbad⟩ := extraction_of_frequently_atTop hi
  exact FullApprox.no_large_positive_sequence hc hw (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (fun n => F (φ n)) (ht.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) (fun n => hsmall (φ n)) i hφbad

/-- No unrestricted five-coloring separates all unit-distance pairs in the Euclidean plane. -/
theorem no_proper_five_coloring : ¬ ∃ c : ℂ → Fin 5, ProperColoring 5 c := by
  rintro ⟨c,hc⟩
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hw⟩ := proper_to_borel_weak hc
  exact no_measurable_weak_five_coloring hd hw
end EuclideanFiveColor
end

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Assembly.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Assembly.lean

~~~~lean
import Mathlib

namespace OAI

noncomputable section

namespace Problem160

/-- A covering by small cells, whose equally colored distinct centers are far
apart, gives a proper coloring of the unit-distance graph. The covering need
not form a partition: classical choice assigns boundary points to one cell. -/
theorem exists_unit_distance_coloring_of_center_cover
    {X I : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] {k : ℕ}
    (center : I → X) (color : I → Fin k) (r : ℝ)
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i : I, dist x (center i) ≤ r)
    (hdiam : 2 * r < 1)
    (hsep : ∀ i j : I, i ≠ j → color i = color j →
      1 + 2 * r < dist (center i) (center j)) :
    ∃ c : X → Fin k, ∀ x y : X, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y := by
  classical
  choose cell hcell using hcover
  refine ⟨fun x => color (cell x), ?_⟩
  intro x y hdist hcolor
  by_cases hsame : cell x = cell y
  · have htriangle := dist_triangle x (center (cell x)) y
    have hx := hcell x
    have hy := hcell y
    rw [← hsame] at hy
    rw [dist_comm (center (cell x)) y] at htriangle
    linarith
  · have hfar := hsep (cell x) (cell y) hsame hcolor
    have htriangle₁ := dist_triangle (center (cell x)) x (center (cell y))
    have htriangle₂ := dist_triangle x y (center (cell y))
    have hx := hcell x
    have hy := hcell y
    rw [dist_comm (center (cell x)) x] at htriangle₁
    linarith

end Problem160

end

end OAI
~~~~

~~~~lean
import Mathlib

namespace OAI

/-! Integer arithmetic for the classical seven-color triangular lattice. -/

namespace Problem160
namespace SevenLattice

/-- Squared Euclidean norm in a triangular lattice of unit spacing. -/
def normSq (a b : ℤ) : ℤ := a ^ 2 + a * b + b ^ 2

/-- The index-seven coloring of triangular-lattice sites. -/
def color (a b : ℤ) : ZMod 7 := (a : ZMod 7) + 3 * (b : ZMod 7)

lemma normSq_nonneg (a b : ℤ) : 0 ≤ normSq a b := by
  unfold normSq
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * a + b), sq_nonneg b]

lemma normSq_pos {a b : ℤ} (h : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) : 0 < normSq a b := by
  unfold normSq
  rcases h with ha | hb
  · have ha' : 0 < a ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero ha
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a + 2 * b)]
  · have hb' : 0 < b ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hb
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * a + b)]

lemma seven_dvd_normSq {a b : ℤ} (h : 7 ∣ a + 3 * b) : 7 ∣ normSq a b := by
  have hi : normSq a b = (a + 3 * b) * (a - 2 * b) + 7 * b ^ 2 := by
    unfold normSq
    ring
  rw [hi]
  exact dvd_add (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left h _) (dvd_mul_right _ _)

lemma normSq_ge_seven {a b : ℤ} (h : 7 ∣ a + 3 * b)
    (hn : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) : 7 ≤ normSq a b := by
  exact Int.le_of_dvd (normSq_pos hn) (seven_dvd_normSq h)

lemma color_eq_iff_dvd {a b c d : ℤ} :
    color a b = color c d ↔ 7 ∣ (a - c) + 3 * (b - d) := by
  have hd := ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd ((a - c) + 3 * (b - d)) 7
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hd
  rw [← hd]
  change color a b = color c d ↔ (((a - c) + 3 * (b - d) : ℤ) : ZMod 7) = 0
  simp only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_ofNat]
  unfold color
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination h

lemma same_color_separation {a b c d : ℤ} (hc : color a b = color c d)
    (hne : (a, b) ≠ (c, d)) : 7 ≤ normSq (a - c) (b - d) := by
  apply normSq_ge_seven (color_eq_iff_dvd.mp hc)
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hne
  apply Prod.ext <;> omega

/-- The colors can be used directly as the `Fin 7` target of a coloring. -/
def colorFin (a b : ℤ) : Fin 7 := color a b

lemma colorFin_injective_value {a b c d : ℤ}
    (h : colorFin a b = colorFin c d) : color a b = color c d := h

end SevenLattice
end Problem160

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Basic.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Basic.lean

~~~~lean
import Mathlib

namespace OAI

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory

namespace Problem160

abbrev Plane := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)

def circleDir (t : ℝ) : Plane :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 ![Real.cos t, Real.sin t]

def normalizedAngleMeasure : Measure ℝ :=
  (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ •
    Measure.restrict volume (Set.Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi))

def circleMeasure : Measure Plane :=
  Measure.map circleDir normalizedAngleMeasure

def weakPairMeasure (R : ℝ) : Measure (Plane × Plane) :=
  (Measure.restrict volume (Metric.ball (0 : Plane) R)).prod circleMeasure

def ProperColoring (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : Plane → Fin k,
    ∀ x y : Plane, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y

def WeakMeasurableColoring (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : Plane → Fin k,
    AEMeasurable c volume ∧
      ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
        (∑ i : Fin k,
          (weakPairMeasure R)
            {p : Plane × Plane |
              c (Prod.fst p) = i ∧
              c (Prod.fst p + Prod.snd p) = i}) = 0

def planeChromaticNumber : ℕ :=
  sInf {k : ℕ | ProperColoring k}

end Problem160

end

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Metric.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Metric.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Basic

namespace OAI

noncomputable section

namespace Problem160

/-- Triangular lattice with nearest-neighbor spacing `4/5`. -/
def triangularLattice (a b : ℤ) : Plane :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 ![(4 / 5 : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)/2),
    (2 * Real.sqrt 3 / 5 : ℝ) * b]

@[simp] theorem triangularLattice_zero (a b : ℤ) :
    triangularLattice a b 0 = (4 / 5 : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)/2) := rfl

@[simp] theorem triangularLattice_one (a b : ℤ) :
    triangularLattice a b 1 = (2 * Real.sqrt 3 / 5 : ℝ) * b := rfl

theorem triangularLattice_norm_sq (a b : ℤ) :
    ‖triangularLattice a b‖ ^ 2 =
      (16 / 25 : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ)^2 + (a : ℝ)*b + (b : ℝ)^2) := by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, triangularLattice_zero, triangularLattice_one]
  ring_nf
  norm_num
  ring

theorem triangularLattice_sub (a b c d : ℤ) :
    triangularLattice a b - triangularLattice c d = triangularLattice (a-c) (b-d) := by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [triangularLattice] <;> ring

theorem triangularLattice_dist_sq (a b c d : ℤ) :
    dist (triangularLattice a b) (triangularLattice c d) ^ 2 =
      (16 / 25 : ℝ) * (((a-c : ℤ) : ℝ)^2 +
        ((a-c : ℤ) : ℝ)*(b-d : ℤ) + ((b-d : ℤ) : ℝ)^2) := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, triangularLattice_sub, triangularLattice_norm_sq]

theorem triangularLattice_dist_gt_two (a b c d : ℤ)
    (h : 7 ≤ (a-c)^2 + (a-c)*(b-d) + (b-d)^2) :
    (2 : ℝ) < dist (triangularLattice a b) (triangularLattice c d) := by
  have hr : (7 : ℝ) ≤ ((a-c : ℤ) : ℝ)^2 +
      ((a-c : ℤ) : ℝ)*(b-d : ℤ) + ((b-d : ℤ) : ℝ)^2 := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  have heq := triangularLattice_dist_sq a b c d
  have hd := dist_nonneg (x := triangularLattice a b) (y := triangularLattice c d)
  nlinarith

theorem dist_triangularLattice_sq (x : Plane) (a b : ℤ) :
    dist x (triangularLattice a b)^2 =
      (16 / 25 : ℝ) *
        (((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 0 - ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)/2))^2 +
         ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 1 - Real.sqrt 3 * b / 2)^2) := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, PiLp.sub_apply, triangularLattice_zero,
    triangularLattice_one]
  ring

theorem dist_triangularLattice_le_of_coordinates (x : Plane) (a b : ℤ)
    (h : ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 0 - ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ)/2))^2 +
         ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 1 - Real.sqrt 3 * b / 2)^2 ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ)) :
    dist x (triangularLattice a b) ≤ (7 / 15 : ℝ) := by
  have heq := dist_triangularLattice_sq x a b
  have hd := dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := triangularLattice a b)
  nlinarith

end Problem160

end

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Covering.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Covering.lean

~~~~lean
import Mathlib

namespace OAI

noncomputable section

namespace Problem160

private theorem triangular_wedge_bound (s x y : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hsq : s ^ 2 = 3)
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hxy : s * y ≤ 1 - x) :
    x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (1 - x) - s * y := by linarith
  have hplus : 0 ≤ (1 - x) + s * y := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hs) hy0]
  have hprod := mul_nonneg hnonneg hplus
  have hxprod := mul_nonneg hx0 (show 0 ≤ 1 / 2 - x by linarith)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (s * y), sq_nonneg y]

private theorem triangular_rectangle_cover (s x y : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 < s) (hsq : s ^ 2 = 3)
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1)
    (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ s / 2) :
    x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 3 ∨
    (x - 1) ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 3 ∨
    (x - 1 / 2) ^ 2 + (y - s / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  by_cases hx : x ≤ 1 / 2
  · by_cases hxy : s * y ≤ 1 - x
    · exact Or.inl (triangular_wedge_bound s x y hs hsq hx0 hx hy0 hxy)
    · right; right
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (1 / 2 - x) (s / 2 - y) hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith
  · by_cases hxy : s * y ≤ x
    · right; left
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (1 - x) y hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) hy0 (by linarith)
      nlinarith
    · right; right
      have h := triangular_wedge_bound s (x - 1 / 2) (s / 2 - y) hs hsq
        (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith

/-- Every point in the plane is within squared distance `1/3` of the
unit triangular lattice. The proof gives one of three explicit nearby centers. -/
theorem triangular_lattice_cover (x y : ℝ) :
    ∃ m n : ℤ,
      (x - ((m : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 +
        (y - Real.sqrt 3 * (n : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 3 := by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt 3
  have hs : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)
  have hsq : s ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  let n : ℤ := ⌊2 * y / s⌋
  let m : ℤ := ⌊x - (n : ℝ) / 2⌋
  let u : ℝ := x - ((m : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) / 2)
  let v : ℝ := y - s * (n : ℝ) / 2
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * y / s := Int.floor_le _
  have hn1 : 2 * y / s < (n : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hm0 : (m : ℝ) ≤ x - (n : ℝ) / 2 := Int.floor_le _
  have hm1 : x - (n : ℝ) / 2 < (m : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by dsimp [u]; linarith
  have hu1 : u ≤ 1 := by dsimp [u]; linarith
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := by
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ hs).mp hn0
    dsimp [v]
    nlinarith
  have hv1 : v ≤ s / 2 := by
    have h := (div_lt_iff₀ hs).mp hn1
    dsimp [v]
    nlinarith
  rcases triangular_rectangle_cover s u v hs hsq hu0 hu1 hv0 hv1 with h | h | h
  · exact ⟨m, n, h⟩
  · refine ⟨m + 1, n, ?_⟩
    have hu : x - (((m + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) + (n : ℝ) / 2) = u - 1 := by
      dsimp [u]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hu]
    exact h
  · refine ⟨m, n + 1, ?_⟩
    have hu : x - ((m : ℝ) + ((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2) = u - 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp [u]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hv : y - Real.sqrt 3 * ((n + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) / 2 = v - s / 2 := by
      dsimp [v, s]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hu, hv]
    exact h

end Problem160

end

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/MeasurableAssembly.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/MeasurableAssembly.lean

~~~~lean
import Mathlib

namespace OAI

noncomputable section

namespace Problem160

/-- A countable cover admits a measurable least-index choice, so separated
small cells give a measurable proper coloring, not merely an arbitrary one. -/
theorem exists_measurable_unit_distance_coloring_of_center_cover
    {X I : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X]
    [Countable I] [Nonempty I] {k : ℕ}
    (center : I → X) (color : I → Fin k) (r : ℝ)
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i : I, dist x (center i) ≤ r)
    (hdiam : 2 * r < 1)
    (hsep : ∀ i j : I, i ≠ j → color i = color j →
      1 + 2 * r < dist (center i) (center j)) :
    ∃ c : X → Fin k, Measurable c ∧
      ∀ x y : X, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_surjective_nat I
  have hcoverNat : ∀ x : X, ∃ n : ℕ, dist x (center (e n)) ≤ r := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover x
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := he i
    exact ⟨n, hi⟩
  let pick : X → ℕ := fun x => Nat.find (hcoverNat x)
  have hpick : Measurable pick := by
    apply measurable_find hcoverNat
    intro n
    exact (isClosed_le (continuous_id.dist continuous_const) continuous_const).measurableSet
  let cell : X → I := fun x => e (pick x)
  have hcell (x : X) : dist x (center (cell x)) ≤ r := Nat.find_spec (hcoverNat x)
  refine ⟨fun x => color (cell x), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (measurable_of_countable (fun n => color (e n))).comp hpick
  · intro x y hdist hcolor
    by_cases hsame : cell x = cell y
    · have htriangle := dist_triangle x (center (cell x)) y
      have hx := hcell x
      have hy := hcell y
      rw [← hsame] at hy
      rw [dist_comm (center (cell x)) y] at htriangle
      linarith
    · have hfar := hsep (cell x) (cell y) hsame hcolor
      have htriangle₁ := dist_triangle (center (cell x)) x (center (cell y))
      have htriangle₂ := dist_triangle x y (center (cell y))
      have hx := hcell x
      have hy := hcell y
      rw [dist_comm (center (cell x)) x] at htriangle₁
      linarith

end Problem160

end

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/MeasurableProper.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/MeasurableProper.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Basic

namespace OAI

noncomputable section

open MeasureTheory

namespace Problem160

@[continuity, fun_prop]
theorem continuous_circleDir : Continuous circleDir := by
  unfold circleDir
  fun_prop

@[fun_prop]
theorem measurable_circleDir : Measurable circleDir :=
  continuous_circleDir.measurable

instance normalizedAngleMeasure_isProbabilityMeasure :
    IsProbabilityMeasure normalizedAngleMeasure where
  measure_univ := by
    have hpos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) * Real.pi := by positivity
    simp only [normalizedAngleMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.restrict_apply_univ,
      Real.volume_Ico, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hpos))
      ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

instance circleMeasure_isProbabilityMeasure : IsProbabilityMeasure circleMeasure :=
  inferInstanceAs (IsProbabilityMeasure (Measure.map circleDir normalizedAngleMeasure))

@[simp]
theorem norm_circleDir (t : ℝ) : ‖circleDir t‖ = 1 := by
  have h : ‖circleDir t‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    simp [circleDir, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (circleDir t)]

theorem ae_circleMeasure_norm : ∀ᵐ u ∂circleMeasure, ‖u‖ = 1 := by
  unfold circleMeasure
  rw [ae_map_iff measurable_circleDir.aemeasurable]
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall norm_circleDir
  · exact isClosed_eq continuous_norm continuous_const |>.measurableSet

theorem ae_weakPairMeasure_unit (R : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ p ∂weakPairMeasure R, ‖p.2‖ = 1 := by
  exact Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae ae_circleMeasure_norm

theorem weakMeasurableColoring_of_aemeasurable_proper {k : ℕ}
    (c : Plane → Fin k) (hc : AEMeasurable c volume)
    (hproper : ∀ x y : Plane, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y) :
    WeakMeasurableColoring k := by
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  intro R hR
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i hi
  apply measure_mono_null (t := {p : Plane × Plane | ‖p.2‖ ≠ 1})
  · intro p hp hnorm
    have hd : dist p.1 (p.1 + p.2) = 1 := by
      simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hnorm
    exact hproper _ _ hd (hp.1.trans hp.2.symm)
  · exact ae_iff.mp (ae_weakPairMeasure_unit R)

end Problem160

end

end OAI
~~~~

## `lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Seven.lean`

Source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb/lean/OAI/Geometry/PlaneColoring/Seven.lean

~~~~lean
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Assembly
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Lattice
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Metric
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.Covering
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.MeasurableAssembly
import OAI.Geometry.PlaneColoring.MeasurableProper

namespace OAI

noncomputable section

namespace Problem160

/-- The elementary covering-radius statement is the only geometric input
needed to turn the index-seven lattice coloring into a plane coloring. -/
theorem properColoring_seven_of_normalized_cover
    (hcover : ∀ x y : ℝ, ∃ a b : ℤ,
      (x - ((a : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) / 2)) ^ 2 +
        (y - Real.sqrt 3 * b / 2) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 3 : ℝ)) :
    ProperColoring 7 := by
  apply exists_unit_distance_coloring_of_center_cover
    (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => triangularLattice p.1 p.2)
    (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => SevenLattice.colorFin p.1 p.2) (7 / 15 : ℝ)
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hcover ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 0) ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 1)
    exact ⟨(a, b), dist_triangularLattice_le_of_coordinates x a b hab⟩
  · norm_num
  · intro i j hij hc
    have hq := SevenLattice.same_color_separation
      (SevenLattice.colorFin_injective_value hc) hij
    have hsep := triangularLattice_dist_gt_two i.1 i.2 j.1 j.2 hq
    linarith

/-- The classical seven-color upper bound, with all boundary points assigned
using the closed triangular-lattice cover. -/
theorem properColoring_seven : ProperColoring 7 :=
  properColoring_seven_of_normalized_cover triangular_lattice_cover

/-- The seven-color construction admits a measurable choice on its boundary
points: select the first covering center in a countable enumeration. -/
theorem exists_measurable_proper_seven :
    ∃ c : Plane → Fin 7, Measurable c ∧
      ∀ x y : Plane, dist x y = 1 → c x ≠ c y := by
  apply exists_measurable_unit_distance_coloring_of_center_cover
    (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => triangularLattice p.1 p.2)
    (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => SevenLattice.colorFin p.1 p.2) (7 / 15 : ℝ)
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := triangular_lattice_cover
      ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 0) ((5 / 4 : ℝ) * x 1)
    exact ⟨(a, b), dist_triangularLattice_le_of_coordinates x a b hab⟩
  · norm_num
  · intro i j hij hc
    have hq := SevenLattice.same_color_separation
      (SevenLattice.colorFin_injective_value hc) hij
    have hsep := triangularLattice_dist_gt_two i.1 i.2 j.1 j.2 hq
    linarith

/-- The classical measurable seven-color construction satisfies the exact
weak pair-measure condition. -/
theorem weakMeasurableColoring_seven : WeakMeasurableColoring 7 := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hproper⟩ := exists_measurable_proper_seven
  exact weakMeasurableColoring_of_aemeasurable_proper c hc.aemeasurable hproper

end Problem160

end

end OAI
~~~~
